public def Statement (c : Raw.Claim) : Prop :=
  ∃ x, decode c.spectrum c.s c.t c.x = some x ∧
    match c.kind with
    | .reaches => ReachesPage (sequence c.spectrum) c.r (c.s,c.t) x
    | .boundaryBy => IsBoundaryBy (sequence c.spectrum) c.r (c.s,c.t) x
    | .equation => ∃ y, decode c.spectrum c.ts c.tt c.y = some y ∧
        HasDifferential (sequence c.spectrum) c.r (c.s,c.t) (c.ts,c.tt) x y
    | .refutation => ∃ y, decode c.spectrum c.ts c.tt c.y = some y ∧
        ¬ HasDifferential (sequence c.spectrum) c.r (c.s,c.t) (c.ts,c.tt) x y

public def Claim.valid (degrees : List Degree) (c : Claim) : Bool :=
  2 ≤ c.r && coordinatesValid degrees c.spectrum c.s c.t c.x &&
    match c.kind with
    | .reaches | .boundaryBy => true
    | .equation | .refutation => c.ts == c.s + c.r && c.tt == c.t + c.r - 1 &&
        coordinatesValid degrees c.spectrum c.ts c.tt c.y

public theorem mapAdamsFiltration_zero (P : ClassicalTowerPresentation H.unit A)
    {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : MapAdamsFiltration P f 0 := by
  refine ⟨f ≫ (P.tower Y).zeroIso.inv, ?_⟩
  change (f ≫ (P.tower Y).zeroIso.inv) ≫ (P.tower Y).projection 0 = f
  rw [AbstractAdamsTower.projection, AbstractAdamsTower.map_self]
  change (f ≫ (P.tower Y).zeroIso.inv) ≫
    (𝟙 _ ≫ (P.tower Y).zeroIso.hom) = f
  rw [Category.id_comp, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

label: decl:068a1377fbd5ca93
name: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.finite_filtration_of_not_odd
title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.finite_filtration_of_not_odd
code:
public theorem finite_filtration_of_not_odd (P : ClassicalTowerPresentation H.unit A)
    (separation : FiniteMapSeparation P) {X Y : C}
    (hX : IsFiniteSpectrum X) (hY : IsFiniteSpectrum Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : ¬ IsOddTorsionMap f) : ∃ s : ℤ, ExactMapAdamsFiltration P f s := by
  classical
  have failure : ∃ n : ℕ, ¬ MapAdamsFiltration P f (n : ℤ) := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hf
    apply separation hX hY f
    intro s
    exact h s.toNat
  let n := Nat.find failure
  have hn : ¬ MapAdamsFiltration P f (n : ℤ) := Nat.find_spec failure
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by
    by_contra h
    have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
    exact hn (by simpa [hn0] using mapAdamsFiltration_zero P f)
  refine ⟨((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ), ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra hprev
    have hle := Nat.find_min' failure hprev
    change n ≤ n - 1 at hle
    omega
  · have heq : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 = (n : ℤ) := by omega
    simpa only [heq] using hn

public theorem AdamsBoundednessInput.excludes_nonzero
    {P : ClassicalTowerPresentation H.unit A} (B : AdamsBoundednessInput P)
    (X : C) (hX : IsFiniteSpectrum X) (hr : RationallyAcyclic X) (hl : HomotopyTwoLocal X)
    (i : ℤ) : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ s : ℤ, N < s → ∀ x : HomotopyGroup i X,
      x ≠ 0 → x ∉ (P.tower X).filtrationSubmodule s i := by
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := B.bounded X hX hr hl i
  refine ⟨N, fun s hs x hx hmem => ?_⟩
  rw [hN s hs] at hmem
  exact hx hmem

    SyntheticCategory.biShift (0, -(n : ℤ)) ⟶ 𝟭 Syn
  | 0 => SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom
  | n + 1 => by
      have step : SyntheticCategory.biShift ((0 : ℤ), -1) ⋙
          SyntheticCategory.biShift ((0 : ℤ), -(n : ℤ)) ⟶ 𝟭 Syn :=
        Functor.whiskerRight SyntheticCategory.lam
            (SyntheticCategory.biShift ((0 : ℤ), -(n : ℤ))) ≫
          lambdaPowNatTrans n
      have result : SyntheticCategory.biShift ((0, -1) + (0, -(n : ℤ))) ⟶ 𝟭 Syn :=
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (0, -1) (0, -(n : ℤ))).inv ≫ step
      have heq : ((0 : ℤ), (-1 : ℤ)) + ((0 : ℤ), -(n : ℤ)) =
          ((0 : ℤ), -(↑(n + 1) : ℤ)) := by simp
      exact heq ▸ result

public structure BiShiftCoherence : Prop where
  associativity : ∀ (a b c ab bc total : ℤ × ℤ)
      (hab : a + b = ab) (hbc : b + c = bc)
      (habc : ab + c = total) (habc' : a + bc = total) (X : Syn),
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift c).map ((biShiftAddIso a b ab hab).hom.app X) ≫
        (biShiftAddIso ab c total habc).hom.app X =

public theorem lambdaPow_one (coh : BiShiftCoherence Syn) (X : Syn) :
    lambdaPow 1 X = SyntheticCategory.lam.app X := by
  apply (cancel_epi (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app
    ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0, -1)).obj X))).mp
  calc
    _ = (lambdaShiftAddIso 1 0 1 rfl).hom.app X ≫ lambdaPow 1 X := by
      rw [show (lambdaShiftAddIso 1 0 1 rfl).hom.app X =
          SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app
            ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0, -1)).obj X) from
        coh.right_unit (0, -1) X]
    _ = (SyntheticCategory.biShift (lambdaDegree 0)).map
          (SyntheticCategory.lam.app X) ≫ lambdaPow 0 X :=
      lambdaPow_succ_comparison_of_eq 0 1 rfl X
    _ = _ := SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.naturality (SyntheticCategory.lam.app X)

name: KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaPow_add_comparison
title: KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaPow_add_comparison
code:
public theorem lambdaPow_add_comparison (coh : BiShiftCoherence Syn)
    (i j k : ℕ) (h : i + j = k) (X : Syn) :
    (lambdaShiftAddIso i j k h).hom.app X ≫ lambdaPow k X =
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (lambdaDegree j)).map (lambdaPow i X) ≫
        lambdaPow j X := by
  induction i generalizing k with
  | zero =>
    have hk : k = j := by omega
    cases hk
    rw [coh.lambdaShift_zero_left]
  | succ i ih =>
    apply (cancel_epi ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (lambdaDegree j)).map
      ((lambdaShiftAddIso 1 i (i + 1) (by omega)).hom.app X))).mp
    calc
      _ = (lambdaShiftAddIso i j (i + j) rfl).hom.app
            ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (lambdaDegree 1)).obj X) ≫
          ((lambdaShiftAddIso 1 (i + j) k (by omega)).hom.app X ≫
            lambdaPow k X) := by
        rw [← Category.assoc,
          coh.lambdaShift_associativity 1 i j (i + 1) (i + j) k
            (by omega) rfl h (by omega) X]
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = (lambdaShiftAddIso i j (i + j) rfl).hom.app
            ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (lambdaDegree 1)).obj X) ≫
          ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (lambdaDegree (i + j))).map
            (SyntheticCategory.lam.app X) ≫ lambdaPow (i + j) X) := by
        rw [lambdaPow_succ_comparison_of_eq]
      _ = (SyntheticCategory.biShift (lambdaDegree j)).map
            ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (lambdaDegree i)).map
              (SyntheticCategory.lam.app X)) ≫
          ((lambdaShiftAddIso i j (i + j) rfl).hom.app X ≫
            lambdaPow (i + j) X) := by
        rw [← Category.assoc, ← NatTrans.naturality]
        simp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_obj, Category.assoc]
      _ = (SyntheticCategory.biShift (lambdaDegree j)).map
            ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (lambdaDegree i)).map
              (SyntheticCategory.lam.app X)) ≫
          ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (lambdaDegree j)).map (lambdaPow i X) ≫
            lambdaPow j X) := by rw [ih (i + j) rfl]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, ← lambdaPow_succ_comparison,
          Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
statement:
public theorem lambdaPow_add_comparison (coh : BiShiftCoherence Syn)
    (i j k : ℕ) (h : i + j = k) (X : Syn) :
    (lambdaShiftAddIso i j k h).hom.app X ≫ lambdaPow k X =
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (lambdaDegree j)).map (lambdaPow i X) ≫
        lambdaPow j X

public def sphereFirstQuotient {A : ClassicalAdamsFamily C}
    (N : NuFunctorData C Syn) {aux : AuxiliaryData C}
    (Q : LambdaQuotientFunctoriality (Syn := Syn))
    (comparison : FirstQuotientComparison A N aux) (s t : ℤ) :
    BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (S_0_0 : Syn) 1) ≃ₗ[ℤ] A.sphere.Page 2 (s,t) := by
  let e : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).obj (N.functor.obj SphereSpectrum) ≅
      (S_0_0 : Syn) := SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.app _ ≪≫ N.unitIso
  let q := (Q.functor 1).mapIso e
  let c : BiHom (t-s) t
      (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).obj
        (N.functor.obj SphereSpectrum)) 1) ≃ₗ[ℤ] A.sphere.Page 2 (s,t) := by
    exact Eq.mp (congrArg (fun z : ℤ =>
      BiHom (t-s) z (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).obj
        (N.functor.obj SphereSpectrum)) 1) ≃ₗ[ℤ] A.sphere.Page 2 (s,t))
      (Int.add_zero t)) (comparison .sphere 0 s t)
  exact (biHomTargetIso (t-s) t q.symm).toIntLinearEquiv.trans c

public def MultiplicationCompatible
    {A : ClassicalAdamsFamily C} {F : SyntheticAdamsFamily Syn}
    {N : NuFunctorData C Syn} {aux : AuxiliaryData C}
    (K : E2Comparison A F N aux) (P : SphereE2Algebra A)
    {H : Syn} {unit : S_0_0 ⟶ H} {T : SyntheticTowerPresentation unit F}
    (cSphere : SyntheticTowerConvergence T (S_0_0 : Syn)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (s t s' t' k l : ℕ)
    (x : A.sphere.Page 2 (s,t)) (y : A.sphere.Page 2 (s',t'))
    (α : BiHom ((t : ℤ)-s) ((t : ℤ)-k) (S_0_0 : Syn))
    (β : BiHom ((t' : ℤ)-s') ((t' : ℤ)-l) (S_0_0 : Syn)),
    Detects cSphere (s,t,(t : ℤ)-k) (K.sphereE2 s t k x) α →
    Detects cSphere (s',t',(t' : ℤ)-l) (K.sphereE2 s' t' l y) β →
    Detects cSphere ((s : ℤ)+s', (t : ℤ)+t', (t : ℤ)+t'-(k+l : ℕ))
      (K.sphereE2 ((s : ℤ)+s') ((t : ℤ)+t') (k+l)
        (P.product (s,t) (s',t') x y))
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega)
        (by dsimp; omega) (sphereProduct α β))

public def SyntheticRepresentsOnPage (E : SyntheticAdamsSS.{v}) (r : ℤ)
    (p : Tridegree) (x : E.E₂ p) (y : E.Page r p) : Prop :=
  ∃ hr : 2 ≤ r,
    let A := E.sequence.ssData p
    let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2-E.sequence.r₀).toNat
    let m : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r-E.sequence.r₀).toNat
    ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (A.Z m) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (A.Z_anti (by
        dsimp [n,m]; exact_mod_cast (show (2-E.sequence.r₀).toNat ≤
          (r-E.sequence.r₀).toNat by omega))) ≫ A.pageπ n) z = x ∧ A.pageπ m z = y

public def SyntheticHasDifferential (E : SyntheticAdamsSS.{v}) (r : ℤ)
    (p q : Tridegree) (x : E.E₂ p) (y : E.E₂ q) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : p+E.sequence.diffDeg r = q,
    ∃ (xr : E.Page r p) (yr : E.Page r q),
      SyntheticRepresentsOnPage E r p x xr ∧ SyntheticRepresentsOnPage E r q y yr ∧
      (E.sequence.d r p ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (E.Page r) h)) xr = yr
statement:

  ∃ h : p+E.sequence.diffDeg r = q,
    ∃ (xr : E.Page r p) (yr : E.Page r q),
      SyntheticRepresentsOnPage E r p x xr ∧ SyntheticRepresentsOnPage E r q y yr ∧
      (E.sequence.d r p ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (E.Page r) h)) xr = yr

name: KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaPow
title: KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaPow
code:
public noncomputable def lambdaPow : (n : ℕ) → (X : Syn) →
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0, -(n : ℤ))).obj X ⟶ X
  | 0, X => SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app X
  | n + 1, X => by
      have step1 :
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift ((0 : ℤ), -1) ⋙
            SyntheticCategory.biShift ((0 : ℤ), -(n : ℤ))).obj X ⟶ X :=
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift ((0 : ℤ), -(n : ℤ))).map
            (SyntheticCategory.lam.app X) ≫ lambdaPow n X
      have step2 :
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift ((0, -1) + (0, -(n : ℤ)))).obj X ⟶ X :=
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (0, -1) (0, -(n : ℤ))).inv.app X ≫ step1
      have heq :
          ((0 : ℤ), (-1 : ℤ)) + ((0 : ℤ), -(n : ℤ)) =
            ((0 : ℤ), -(↑(n + 1) : ℤ)) := by
        simp
      exact heq ▸ step2

  | n + 1, X => by
      have step1 :
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift ((0 : ℤ), -1) ⋙

    functor.obj ((shiftFunctor Stable (1 : ℤ)).obj X) ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1, 1)).obj (functor.obj X)

public noncomputable def NuFunctorData.boundaryLandingIso
    {Stable : Type u} [StableHomotopyCategory.{u, v} Stable]
    {Syn : Type u'} [SyntheticCategory.{u', v'} Syn]
    (N : NuFunctorData Stable Syn) (X : Stable) :
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0, -1)).obj
        (N.functor.obj ((shiftFunctor Stable (1 : ℤ)).obj X)) ≅
      (shiftFunctor Syn (1 : ℤ)).obj (N.functor.obj X) :=
  (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0, -1)).mapIso (N.suspensionIso X) ≪≫
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (1, 1) (0, -1)).app (N.functor.obj X) ≪≫
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift_compat (Syn := Syn) 1).app (N.functor.obj X)

    (e : ∀ p : ℤ × ℤ, ((A.obj X).ssData p).eInfty ≅
      (P.tower X).filtration.associatedGraded p.1 (p.2-p.1)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : ℤ × ℤ) (a : HomotopyGroup (p.2-p.1) ((P.tower X).stageAt p.1))

public def ClassicalTowerConvergence.toConvergence
    {P : ClassicalTowerPresentation unit A} {X : C} (c : ClassicalTowerConvergence P X) :
    Convergence (A.obj X) (AbstractAdamsTower.homotopy X) (P.tower X).filtration where
  reindex p := (p.1,p.2-p.1)
  reindex_bijective := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s,t⟩ ⟨s',t'⟩ h
      have hs := congrArg Prod.fst h
      have ht := congrArg Prod.snd h
      dsimp at hs ht
      ext <;> omega
    · rintro ⟨s,m⟩
      exact ⟨(s,m+s),by ext <;> simp⟩
  iso := c.identification

    (X : Syn) (p : ℤ × ℤ) : Antitone (fun s => P.filtrationSubmodule X s p) := by
  intro s t h a ha
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨b ≫ (P.tower X).mapAt h, ?_⟩
  change (b ≫ (P.tower X).mapAt h) ≫ (P.tower X).projection s = b ≫ (P.tower X).projection t
  rw [Category.assoc, (P.tower X).projection_compat h]

      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h

public theorem detects_zero_infinity_filtration
    {x : (F.obj X).E₂ i} {a : BiHom (i.2.1-i.1) i.2.2 X}
    (ha : Detects c i x a)
    (hx : HasInfinityRepresentative (F.obj X) 2 i x 0) :

  obtain ⟨e, he, a', ha', hgr⟩ := ha

  rw [he0, map_zero] at hgr
  rw [← ha']
  exact filtrationAtLeast_of_graded_eq_zero i.1 (i.2.1-i.1) i.2.2 a' hgr.symm

    {a b : BiHom (i.2.1-i.1) i.2.2 X}
    (ha : Detects c i x a) (hb : Detects c i x b) :
    FiltrationAtLeast P (i.1+1) (a-b) := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, a', ha', hga⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨e', he', b', hb', hgb⟩ := hb
  have heq := he.unique he'
  have hzero : (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) (a'-b') = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, ← hga, ← hgb, heq, sub_self]
  have h := filtrationAtLeast_of_graded_eq_zero i.1 (i.2.1-i.1) i.2.2 (a'-b') hzero
  simpa only [map_sub, ha', hb'] using h

public structure SyntheticESSShiftComparison (D : Model C Syn) (δ : ℤ × ℤ) where
  filtered : ∀ (X : SyntheticObject) (p : ℤ × ℤ),
    FilteredPieceIso (D.convergence X).filtration
      (D.convergence (.shift δ X)).filtration p (p+δ)
  ambient_eq : ∀ (X : SyntheticObject) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
      (a : BiHom p.1 p.2 (X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)),
    (filtered X p).ambient.hom a = shiftHomotopyClass δ p a
  page : ∀ (X : SyntheticObject) (r : ℤ) (_hr : 2 ≤ r) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s : ℤ),
    (D.family.obj (X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).Page r (s,p.1+s,p.2) ≅
      (D.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.shift δ X).obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).Page r
        (s,(p+δ).1+s,(p+δ).2)
  representative_iff : ∀ (X : SyntheticObject) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
      (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s : ℤ)
      (x : (D.family.obj (X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).Page r (s,p.1+s,p.2))
      (z : ((D.family.obj (X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty),
    HasInfinityRepresentative _ r (s,p.1+s,p.2) x z ↔
      HasInfinityRepresentative _ r (s,(p+δ).1+s,(p+δ).2)
        ((page X r hr p s).hom x)
        ((towerInfinityIso (D.convergence X) (D.convergence (.shift δ X))
          (filtered X p) s).hom z)

  ambient_eq : ∀ (X : SyntheticObject) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
      (a : BiHom p.1 p.2 (X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)),
    (filtered X p).ambient.hom a = shiftHomotopyClass δ p a
  page : ∀ (X : SyntheticObject) (r : ℤ) (_hr : 2 ≤ r) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s : ℤ),

public theorem towerExtensionEquation_iff (X Y : SyntheticObject)
    (g : X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.nu D.auxiliary) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n : ℤ)
    (x : ((D.family.obj (X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((D.family.obj (Y.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty) :
    TowerExtensionEquation (D.convergentMap X Y g) p s n x y ↔
      TowerExtensionEquation
        (D.convergentMap (.shift δ X) (.shift δ Y)
          ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map g)) (p+δ) s n
        ((towerInfinityIso (D.convergence X) (D.convergence (.shift δ X))
          (S.filtered X p) s).hom x)
        ((towerInfinityIso (D.convergence Y) (D.convergence (.shift δ Y))
          (S.filtered Y p) (s+n)).hom y) := by
  change FilteredMapExtension.Relation _ p s n
      (elementMap x ≫ (towerGradedIso (D.convergence X) p s).hom)
      (elementMap y ≫ (towerGradedIso (D.convergence Y) p (s+n)).hom) ↔
    FilteredMapExtension.Relation _ (p+δ) s n
      (elementMap _ ≫ (towerGradedIso (D.convergence (.shift δ X)) (p+δ) s).hom)
      (elementMap _ ≫ (towerGradedIso (D.convergence (.shift δ Y)) (p+δ) (s+n)).hom)
  rw [(S.transport X Y g p).relation_iff]
  simp only [elementMap_comp, towerInfinityIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id, transport]

    (g : X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.nu D.auxiliary) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n : ℤ)
    (x : ((D.family.obj (X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((D.family.obj (Y.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty) :
    TowerExtensionEquation (D.convergentMap X Y g) p s n x y ↔
      TowerExtensionEquation
        (D.convergentMap (.shift δ X) (.shift δ Y)
          ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map g)) (p+δ) s n
        ((towerInfinityIso (D.convergence X) (D.convergence (.shift δ X))
          (S.filtered X p) s).hom x)
        ((towerInfinityIso (D.convergence Y) (D.convergence (.shift δ Y))

title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.homogeneous_assoc
code:
private theorem homogeneous_assoc (coh : BiShiftCoherence Syn)
    {W X Y Z : Syn} (a b c : ℤ)
    (f : WeightHom W X a) (g : WeightHom X Y b) (h : WeightHom Y Z c) :
    weightHomInclusion ((a+b)+c) (weightHomComp (weightHomComp f g) h) =
      weightHomInclusion (a+(b+c)) (weightHomComp f (weightHomComp g h)) := by
  rw [homogeneous_regrade (a+b) c (a+(b+c)) (add_assoc a b c)]
  apply congrArg (weightHomInclusion (a+(b+c)))
  let eab := biShiftAddIso (Syn := Syn) (0,a) (0,b) (0,a+b) (by ext <;> simp)
  let ebc := biShiftAddIso (Syn := Syn) (0,b) (0,c) (0,b+c) (by ext <;> simp)
  let eabc := biShiftAddIso (Syn := Syn) (0,a+b) (0,c) (0,a+(b+c)) (by ext <;> simp [add_assoc])
  let eabc' := biShiftAddIso (Syn := Syn) (0,a) (0,b+c) (0,a+(b+c)) (by ext <;> simp)
  have hi : ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,c)).mapIso (eab.app W) ≪≫ eabc.app W) =
      (ebc.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,a)).obj W) ≪≫ eabc'.app W) := by
    apply Iso.ext
    exact coh.associativity (0,a) (0,b) (0,c) (0,a+b) (0,b+c) (0,a+(b+c))
      (by ext <;> simp) (by ext <;> simp)
      (by ext <;> simp [add_assoc]) (by ext <;> simp) W
  have hinv : eabc.inv.app W ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,c)).map (eab.inv.app W) =
      eabc'.inv.app W ≫ ebc.inv.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,a)).obj W) :=
    congrArg Iso.inv hi
  change eabc.inv.app W ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,c)).map
      (eab.inv.app W ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,b)).map f ≫ g) ≫ h =
    eabc'.inv.app W ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,b+c)).map f ≫
      ebc.inv.app X ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,c)).map g ≫ h
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (eabc.inv.app W), hinv]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  have hn : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,b+c)).map f ≫ ebc.inv.app X =
      ebc.inv.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,a)).obj W) ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,c)).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,b)).map f) :=
    ebc.inv.naturality f
  rw [← Category.assoc (ebc.inv.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,a)).obj W)), ← hn]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
statement:
private theorem homogeneous_assoc (coh : BiShiftCoherence Syn)
    {W X Y Z : Syn} (a b c : ℤ)
    (f : WeightHom W X a) (g : WeightHom X Y b) (h : WeightHom Y Z c) :
    weightHomInclusion ((a+b)+c) (weightHomComp (weightHomComp f g) h) =
      weightHomInclusion (a+(b+c)) (weightHomComp f (weightHomComp g h))

  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | of a f =>

label: decl:84d18376342a7e8b
name: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.GradedLambdaEnrichment.assoc
title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.GradedLambdaEnrichment.assoc
code:
public theorem assoc (W X Y Z : Syn) (f : TotalWeightHom W X)
    (g : TotalWeightHom X Y) (h : TotalWeightHom Y Z) :
    E.compose W Y Z h (E.compose W X Y g f) =
      E.compose W X Z (E.compose X Y Z h g) f := by
  letI := E.module W X
  letI := E.module X Y
  letI := E.module Y Z
  letI := E.module W Y
  letI := E.module X Z
  letI := E.module W Z
  induction f using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | add f f' hf hf' => simp only [map_add, hf, hf']
  | of a f =>
    induction g using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    | add g g' hg hg' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hg, hg']
    | of b g =>
      induction h using DirectSum.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      | add h h' hh hh' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hh, hh']
      | of c h =>
        change E.compose W Y Z (weightHomInclusion c h)
          (E.compose W X Y (weightHomInclusion b g) (weightHomInclusion a f)) =
          E.compose W X Z (E.compose X Y Z (weightHomInclusion c h) (weightHomInclusion b g))
            (weightHomInclusion a f)
        rw [E.compose_homogeneous, E.compose_homogeneous,
          E.compose_homogeneous, E.compose_homogeneous]
        exact homogeneous_assoc E.coherence a b c f g h
statement:
public theorem assoc (W X Y Z : Syn) (f : TotalWeightHom W X)
    (g : TotalWeightHom X Y) (h : TotalWeightHom Y Z) :
    E.compose W Y Z h (E.compose W X Y g f) =
      E.compose W X Z (E.compose X Y Z h g) f

public theorem extensionEquation_iff
    (x : T ⟶ ((F.obj X).sequence.ssData i).eInfty)
    (y : T ⟶ ((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData j).eInfty) :
    M.ExtensionEquation p s n hi hj x y ↔
      0 ≤ n ∧ ∃ (a : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj (FX.F s p))
        (b : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj (FY.F (s+n) p)),
        a ≫ FX.toAssociatedGraded s p = toGraded cx hi x ∧
        b ≫ FY.toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p = toGraded cy hj y ∧
        a ≫ (FX.F s p).arrow ≫ syntheticHomotopyMap g p = b ≫ (FY.F (s+n) p).arrow := by
  simp only [ExtensionEquation, FilteredMapExtension.Relation, filteredMap_map]

code:
public structure FiniteExtensionWitness (r : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ)
    (x : (D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)).Page 2 (s,t))
    (y : (D.classical.obj (Y.obj D.auxiliary)).Page 2 (s+n,t+n)) where
  page_ge_two : 2 ≤ r
  length_lower : (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ n
  length_upper : n ≤ (r : ℤ) - 2 + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f
  source_cycle : ReachesPage (D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)) r (s, t) x
  target_cycle : ReachesPage (D.classical.obj (Y.obj D.auxiliary))
    ((r : ℤ) - n + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f) (s + n, t + n) y
  source : ((D.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.quotient (r - 1)
    (extensionSourceObject D X Y f)).obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (s, (t - s) + s, t + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f)).eInfty
  target : ((D.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.quotient (r - 1) (.nu Y)).obj
    D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (s + n, (t - s) + (s + n), t + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f)).eInfty
  source_rep : HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 _
    (finiteSourceForExtension D X Y f (r - 1) s t x) source
  target_rep : HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 _
    (finiteTargetForExtension D X Y f (r - 1) n s t length_lower y) target
  equation : TowerExtensionEquation
    (D.convergentMap (.quotient (r - 1) (extensionSourceObject D X Y f))
      (.quotient (r - 1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap D X Y f (r - 1)))
    (t - s, t + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f) s n source target

    (M : ConvergentMap F g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (i : Tridegree) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s : ℤ)
    (hi : cx.toConvergence.reindex i = (s,p))
    {T : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ} [Projective T]
    (x : T ⟶ ((F.obj X).sequence.ssData i).eInfty) :
    M.ExtensionEquation p s 0 hi
      (by simpa only [SyntheticTowerConvergence.toConvergence, add_zero] using hi)
      x (x ≫ (F.map g).eInftyMap i) := by
  have hs : i.1 = s := congrArg Prod.fst hi
  have hp : (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) = p := congrArg Prod.snd hi
  subst s
  subst p
  exact M.extensionEquation_zero i x

public theorem towerExtensionEquation_zero
    (M : ConvergentMap F g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s : ℤ)
    (x : ((F.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty) :
    TowerExtensionEquation M p s 0 x
      ((eqToHom (by simp) :
        ((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty ⟶
        ((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+0,p.1+(s+0),p.2)).eInfty)
        ((F.map g).eInftyMap (s,p.1+s,p.2) x)) := by
  unfold TowerExtensionEquation
  rw [elementMap_comp, elementMap_comp]
  exact extensionEquation_zero_transport M (s,p.1+s,p.2)
    (s+0,p.1+(s+0),p.2) p s _ _ (by simp) (elementMap x)

code:
private def exactEmbedding {A B D : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B]
    [AddCommGroup D] (f : A →+ B) (g : B →+ D) (h : Function.Exact f g) : B ↪ A × D := by
  classical
  let sectionMap : Set.range g → B := fun y => Classical.choose y.property
  have section_eq (y : Set.range g) : g (sectionMap y) = y.val :=
    Classical.choose_spec y.property
  let rep (b : B) := sectionMap ⟨g b, b, rfl⟩
  have hrep (b : B) : g (rep b) = g b := section_eq _
  have preimage (b : B) : ∃ a : A, f a = b - rep b :=
    (h (b - rep b)).mp (by rw [map_sub, hrep, sub_self])
  let lift (b : B) := Classical.choose (preimage b)
  have hlift (b : B) : f (lift b) = b - rep b := Classical.choose_spec (preimage b)
  refine ⟨fun b => (lift b, g b), ?_⟩
  intro b b' heq
  have hl : lift b = lift b' := congrArg Prod.fst heq
  have hg : g b = g b' := congrArg Prod.snd heq
  have hr : rep b = rep b' := congrArg sectionMap (Subtype.ext hg)
  calc
    b = f (lift b) + rep b := (eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mp (hlift b)).symm
    _ = f (lift b') + rep b' := by rw [hl, hr]
    _ = b' := eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mp (hlift b')

name: _private.KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.HomologyExactness.0.KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.exact_card_bound
title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.exact_card_bound
code:
private theorem exact_card_bound {A B D : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B]
    [AddCommGroup D] (f : A →+ B) (g : B →+ D) (h : Function.Exact f g)
    (nA nD : ℕ) (hA : ∀ S : Finset A, S.card ≤ nA)
    (hD : ∀ S : Finset D, S.card ≤ nD) (S : Finset B) : S.card ≤ nA * nD := by
  classical
  let T := S.map (exactEmbedding f g h)
  have hsub : T ⊆ (T.image Prod.fst) ×ˢ (T.image Prod.snd) := by
    intro b hb
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩⟩
  calc
    S.card = T.card := (Finset.card_map _).symm
    _ ≤ ((T.image Prod.fst) ×ˢ (T.image Prod.snd)).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ = (T.image Prod.fst).card * (T.image Prod.snd).card := Finset.card_product _ _
    _ ≤ nA * nD := Nat.mul_le_mul (hA _) (hD _)
statement:

    [AddCommGroup D] (f : A →+ B) (g : B →+ D) (h : Function.Exact f g)
    (nA nD : ℕ) (hA : ∀ S : Finset A, S.card ≤ nA)
    (hD : ∀ S : Finset D, S.card ≤ nD) (S : Finset B) : S.card ≤ nA * nD

name: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.ModTwoHomologyExactness.cofiber_card_bound
title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.ModTwoHomologyExactness.cofiber_card_bound
code:
public theorem ModTwoHomologyExactness.cofiber_card_bound
    {H : ModTwoCoefficients C} (E : ModTwoHomologyExactness H)
    (T : HoCofiberSequence (C := C)) (i : ℤ) (nX nY : ℕ)
    (hX : ∀ S : Finset (ModTwoHomology H (i-1) T.X), S.card ≤ nX)
    (hY : ∀ S : Finset (ModTwoHomology H i T.Y), S.card ≤ nY) :
    ∀ S : Finset (ModTwoHomology H i T.Z), S.card ≤ nX * nY := by
  intro S
  simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using exact_card_bound
    (modTwoHomologyMap H T.g i) (modTwoConnecting H E.shiftIso T i)
    (E.exact T i) nY nX hY hX S
statement:

    {H : ModTwoCoefficients C} (E : ModTwoHomologyExactness H)
    (T : HoCofiberSequence (C := C)) (i : ℤ) (nX nY : ℕ)
    (hX : ∀ S : Finset (ModTwoHomology H (i-1) T.X), S.card ≤ nX)
    (hY : ∀ S : Finset (ModTwoHomology H i T.Y), S.card ≤ nY) :
    ∀ S : Finset (ModTwoHomology H i T.Z), S.card ≤ nX * nY

    differential (s + s') (t + t') (cup x y) =

    (reindex _ _ (cup (differential s t x) y)).val +

  rw [reindex_cup_val, reindex_cup_val]
  exact differentialPolynomial_cup_blocks x.val y.val

  map_smul' a x := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro y
    exact Subtype.ext (cup_smul_left a x.val y.val)

theorem cup_boundary_cycle {s s' t t' : ℕ} (x : cochains s t) (y : cochains s' t')
    (hx : x ∈ boundaries s t) (hy : IsCycle y) :
    cup x y ∈ boundaries (s + s') (t + t') := by
  cases s with
  | zero =>
      have hx0 : x = 0 := hx
      rw [hx0, cup_zero_left]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | succ s =>
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hx
      have hd : differential (s + s') (t + t') (cup b y) =
          reindex (by omega) rfl (cup (differential s t b) y) := by
        rw [differential_cup, hy, cup_zero_right, map_zero, add_zero]
      apply (reindex_mem_boundaries_iff (by omega : (s + 1) + s' = (s + s') + 1)
        rfl _).mp
      exact ⟨cup b y, hd⟩

        rw [differential_cup, hx, cup_zero_left, map_zero, zero_add]

theorem homogeneous_rename_slots {s s' t : ℕ} (f : Fin s → Fin s')
    {x : TensorPower s} (hx : IsWeightedHomogeneous weight x t) :
    IsWeightedHomogeneous weight (rename (fun a : Fin s × ℕ => (f a.1, a.2)) x) t := by
  induction hx using IsWeightedHomogeneous.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa using isWeightedHomogeneous_zero F2 (@weight s') t
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy => simpa using ihx.add ihy
  | monomial d r hd =>
    rw [rename_monomial]
    apply isWeightedHomogeneous_monomial
    rw [← hd]
    simp only [Finsupp.weight_apply, weight, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (by simp) (by intros; simp [add_mul])]

name: _private.KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Internal.Milnor.Polynomial.Grading.0.KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Milnor.homogeneous_aeval
title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Milnor.homogeneous_aeval
code:
theorem homogeneous_aeval {σ τ : Type*} {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    (w : σ → ℕ) (w' : τ → ℕ) (f : σ → MvPolynomial τ R)
    (hf : ∀ a, IsWeightedHomogeneous w' (f a) (w a))
    {x : MvPolynomial σ R} {t : ℕ} (hx : IsWeightedHomogeneous w x t) :
    IsWeightedHomogeneous w' (aeval f x) t := by
  classical
  induction hx using IsWeightedHomogeneous.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa using isWeightedHomogeneous_zero R w' t
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy => simpa using ihx.add ihy
  | monomial d r hd =>
    rw [aeval_monomial]
    have h := (IsWeightedHomogeneous.prod d.support
      (fun a => f a ^ d a) (fun a => d a * w a)
      (fun a _ => by simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using (hf a).pow (d a))).C_mul r
    have hd' : ∑ a ∈ d.support, d a * w a = t := by
      simpa [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum, smul_eq_mul] using hd
    simpa only [Finsupp.prod, hd', MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq] using h
statement:
theorem homogeneous_aeval {σ τ : Type*} {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    (w : σ → ℕ) (w' : τ → ℕ) (f : σ → MvPolynomial τ R)
    (hf : ∀ a, IsWeightedHomogeneous w' (f a) (w a))
    {x : MvPolynomial σ R} {t : ℕ} (hx : IsWeightedHomogeneous w x t) :
    IsWeightedHomogeneous w' (aeval f x) t

name: _private.KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Internal.Milnor.Polynomial.Grading.0.KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Milnor.homogeneous_coproductGenerator
title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Milnor.homogeneous_coproductGenerator
code:
theorem homogeneous_coproductGenerator {s : ℕ} (slot : Fin s) (j : ℕ) :
    IsWeightedHomogeneous weight (coproductGenerator slot j) (2 ^ (j + 1) - 1) := by
  apply IsWeightedHomogeneous.sum
  intro i hi
  have hi' : i ≤ j + 1 := by
    have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    omega
  have he : (2 ^ i) * (2 ^ (j + 1 - i) - 1) + (2 ^ i - 1) = 2 ^ (j + 1) - 1 := by
    have hp : 2 ^ (j + 1 - i) * 2 ^ i = 2 ^ (j + 1) := by
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hi']
    have h₁ : 1 ≤ 2 ^ (j + 1 - i) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    have h₂ : 1 ≤ 2 ^ i := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    have h₃ : 1 ≤ 2 ^ (j + 1) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    nlinarith [Nat.sub_add_cancel h₁, Nat.sub_add_cancel h₂, Nat.sub_add_cancel h₃]
  simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_id, he] using
    ((homogeneous_xi slot.castSucc (j + 1 - i)).pow (2 ^ i)).mul
      (homogeneous_xi slot.succ i)
statement:
theorem homogeneous_coproductGenerator {s : ℕ} (slot : Fin s) (j : ℕ) :
    IsWeightedHomogeneous weight (coproductGenerator slot j) (2 ^ (j + 1) - 1)

code:
theorem homogeneous_splitSlot {s t : ℕ} (slot : Fin s) {x : TensorPower s}
    (hx : IsWeightedHomogeneous weight x t) :
    IsWeightedHomogeneous weight (splitSlot slot x) t := by
  apply homogeneous_aeval weight weight _ _ hx
  intro a
  by_cases h : a.1 = slot
  · simpa only [if_pos h, weight] using homogeneous_coproductGenerator slot a.2
  · simp only [if_neg h]
    exact isWeightedHomogeneous_X (R := F2) weight _

    ext a : 1

    · have h₁ : slot.castSucc ≠ other.castSucc := by
        intro h; have := Fin.castSucc_injective _ h; subst other; exact (lt_irrefl _ hlt)
      have h₂ : slot.succ ≠ other.castSucc := by
        intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h

    · have hiff : (if a.1 < slot then a.1.castSucc else a.1.succ) = other.castSucc ↔ a.1 = other := by
        split_ifs with h
        · exact Fin.castSucc_inj
        · constructor
          · intro heq
            have := congrArg Fin.val heq
            simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at this
            have := Fin.not_lt.mp h

          · intro heq; exact (h (heq ▸ hlt)).elim

theorem differentialPolynomial_normalized {s : ℕ} (x : TensorPower s)
    (hx : ∀ slot, augmentSlot slot x = 0) (j : Fin (s + 1)) :
    augmentSlot j (differentialPolynomial s x) = 0 := by
  classical
  let q := rename (fun a : Fin s × ℕ => (j.succAbove a.1, a.2)) x
  have hleft : (if j = 0 then q else 0) + ∑ i : Fin s, (if j = i.succ then q else 0) = q := by
    rw [← Fin.sum_univ_succ (fun k : Fin (s + 1) => if j = k then q else 0)]
    simp
  have hright : (∑ i : Fin s, (if j = i.castSucc then q else 0)) +
      (if j = Fin.last s then q else 0) = q := by
    rw [← Fin.sum_univ_castSucc (fun k : Fin (s + 1) => if j = k then q else 0)]
    simp
  simp only [differentialPolynomial, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_add, map_sum,
    augmentSlot_insertLeft_normalized x hx, augmentSlot_insertRight_normalized x hx,
    augmentSlot_splitSlot_normalized x hx, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  change (if j = 0 then q else 0) + (if j = Fin.last s then q else 0) +
    ((∑ i : Fin s, if j = i.castSucc then q else 0) +
      ∑ i : Fin s, if j = i.succ then q else 0) = 0
  calc
    _ = ((∑ i : Fin s, if j = i.castSucc then q else 0) + (if j = Fin.last s then q else 0)) +
        ((if j = 0 then q else 0) + ∑ i : Fin s, if j = i.succ then q else 0) := by abel
    _ = q + q := by rw [hleft, hright]
    _ = 0 := CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero q

  change towerI T (p.2-p.1-1) (p.1+1) (p.1+(i+2:ℕ)) _ _ = _

private theorem finiteBoundaries_monotone (T : AbstractAdamsTower unit X) (p : ℤ × ℤ) :

  intro i j hij x hx

  refine ⟨y, ?_, hj⟩
  change towerI T (p.2-p.1) (p.1-(i+2:ℕ)+1) p.1 _ y = 0 at hy
  change towerI T (p.2-p.1) (p.1-(j+2:ℕ)+1) p.1 _ y = 0
  rw [← towerI_comp T (p.2-p.1) (p.1-(j+2:ℕ)+1)
    (p.1-(i+2:ℕ)+1) p.1 (by omega) (by omega), hy, map_zero]

code:
private theorem connecting_layerMap (T : AbstractAdamsTower unit X) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (a : HomotopyGroup (p.2-p.1) (T.stageAt p.1)) :
    T.connecting p (T.layerMap p a) = 0 := by
  let f := T.mapAt (show p.1 ≤ p.1+1 by omega)
  have hzero : HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι f ≫ HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ f = 0 :=
    comp_distTriang_mor_zero₂₃ _ (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished f)
  change (AbstractAdamsTower.desuspend _ _)
    ((a ≫ HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι f) ≫ HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ f) = 0
  rw [Category.assoc, hzero, comp_zero, map_zero]

private theorem finiteBoundaries_le_cycles (T : AbstractAdamsTower unit X) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (i j : ℕ) : finiteBoundaries T p i ≤ finiteCycles T p j := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, _, hj⟩ := hx
  change T.layerMap p y = x.val at hj
  change T.connecting p x.val ∈ LinearMap.range _
  rw [← hj, connecting_layerMap]
  exact Submodule.zero_mem _

  intro i j hij
  cases i using WithTop.recTopCoe with
  | top => have h : j = ⊤ := top_le_iff.mp hij; subst j; exact le_rfl
  | coe i =>
    cases j using WithTop.recTopCoe with
    | top => exact iInf_le _ i
    | coe j => exact finiteCycles_antitone T p (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp hij)

  B_mono := (ModuleCat.subobjectModule _).symm.monotone.comp (allBoundaries_monotone T p)

    change (ModuleCat.subobjectModule (ModuleCat.of ℤ (cycleAmbient T p))).symm
      ((T.cycles 2 (by decide) p).comap (T.cycles 2 (by decide) p).subtype) = ⊤
    rw [Submodule.comap_subtype_self, OrderIso.map_top]

    change (ModuleCat.subobjectModule _) A ≤ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule _)

    rw [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
    refine le_iInf fun n => ?_
    have hn := (ModuleCat.subobjectModule _).monotone (h n)

    exact hn
  B_top_least A h := by
    apply (ModuleCat.subobjectModule _).le_iff_le.mp
    change (ModuleCat.subobjectModule _) ((ModuleCat.subobjectModule _).symm _) ≤

    rw [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
    refine iSup_le fun n => ?_
    have hn := (ModuleCat.subobjectModule _).monotone (h n)

code:
private theorem adamsMap_succ (s t : ℕ) (h : s ≤ t) :
    adamsMap unit X s (t + 1) (by omega) =
      adamsStep unit X t ≫ adamsMap unit X s t h := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  apply eq_of_heq
  simp only [adamsMap, eqToHom_comp_heq_iff]
  have h : adamsComposite unit X s (s + n + 1 - s) ≍
      adamsStep unit X (s + n) ≫ adamsComposite unit X s n := by
    have hn : s + n + 1 - s = n + 1 := by omega
    rw [hn]
    rfl
  apply h.trans
  apply CategoryTheory.heq_comp rfl rfl rfl (HEq.rfl)
  symm
  rw [eqToHom_comp_heq_iff, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]

  | base => simp

    rw [adamsMap_succ unit X t z htz,
      adamsMap_succ unit X s z (by omega), Category.assoc, ih]

private theorem fiberLayerComparison_exists {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    Nonempty {e : HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib (fiberι f) ≅ B //
      HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι (fiberι f) ≫ e.hom = f} := by
  let T := (Triangle.mk f (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι f)
    (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ f)).invRotate
  have hT : T ∈ distTriang C :=
    inv_rot_of_distTriang _ (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished f)
  have hfirst : T.mor₁ = -fiberι f := by
    simp only [T, Triangle.invRotate, Triangle.mk, fiberι]
    rfl
  let e : Triangle.mk (fiberι f) (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι (fiberι f))
      (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ (fiberι f)) ≅ T :=
    isoTriangleOfIso₁₂ _ _ (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished (fiberι f)) hT
      (-(Iso.refl _)) (Iso.refl _) (by
        simp only [Triangle.mk, hfirst]
        change fiberι f ≫ 𝟙 A = (-𝟙 (fiber f)) ≫ (-fiberι f)
        simp)
  refine ⟨⟨Triangle.π₃.mapIso e, ?_⟩⟩
  have h := e.hom.comm₂
  change HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι (fiberι f) ≫ e.hom.hom₃ = 𝟙 A ≫ f at h
  exact h.trans (Category.id_comp f)

code:
theorem pairedBond_exists (X Y : Prespectrum.{0}) :
    ∃! b : C((X.level 0 |>.smash (Y.level 0)).suspension × I,
        (X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1)),
      (∀ x y s t,
        b (BasedSpace.suspensionProjection _ (BasedSpace.smashPoint _ _ x y,s),t) =
          BasedSpace.smashPoint _ _ (X.bond 0 (x,s)) (Y.bond 0 (y,t))) ∧
      (∀ t, b (((X.level 0).smash (Y.level 0)).suspension.point,t) =
        ((X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1)).point) ∧
      (∀ a, b (a,0) = ((X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1)).point) ∧
      (∀ a, b (a,1) = ((X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1)).point) := by
  have kc (S : CompHaus.{0}) (k : C(S, X.level 1 × Y.level 1)) :
      Continuous (fun s : S => BasedSpace.smashPoint (X.level 1) (Y.level 1) (k s).1 (k s).2) := by
    let ev : (Σ i : (T : CompHaus.{0}) × C(T, X.level 1 × Y.level 1), i.fst) →
        X.level 1 × Y.level 1 := fun q => q.1.2 q.2
    have hi : Continuous (fun s : S => (⟨⟨S,k⟩,s⟩ :
        Σ i : (T : CompHaus.{0}) × C(T, X.level 1 × Y.level 1), i.fst)) :=
      @continuous_sigmaMk _ (fun i : (T : CompHaus.{0}) × C(T, X.level 1 × Y.level 1) => i.fst)
        (fun _ => inferInstance) ⟨S,k⟩
    letI : TopologicalSpace (X.level 1 × Y.level 1) := TopologicalSpace.coinduced ev inferInstance
    exact continuous_quot_mk.comp ((show Continuous ev from continuous_coinduced_rng).comp hi)
  let family (p : X.level 0 × Y.level 0) :
      C(I, C(I, (X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1))) :=
    (⟨fun st : I × I => BasedSpace.smashPoint _ _ (X.bond 0 (p.1,st.1)) (Y.bond 0 (p.2,st.2)),
      kc (CompHaus.of (I × I)) ⟨_,
        ((X.bond 0).continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_fst)).prodMk
          ((Y.bond 0).continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd))⟩⟩ :
      C(I × I, (X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1))).curry
  have hf : Continuous[TopologicalSpace.compactlyGenerated.{0} (X.level 0 × Y.level 0),
      inferInstance] family := by
    refine @continuous_from_compactlyGenerated (X.level 0 × Y.level 0) _ _ _ family ?_
    intro S k
    apply ContinuousMap.continuous_of_continuous_uncurry
    apply ContinuousMap.continuous_of_continuous_uncurry
    exact kc (CompHaus.of ((S × I) × I)) ⟨fun p =>
      (X.bond 0 ((k p.1.1).1,p.1.2), Y.bond 0 ((k p.1.1).2,p.2)),
      ((X.bond 0).continuous.comp ((k.continuous.fst.comp continuous_fst.fst).prodMk
        continuous_fst.snd)).prodMk
      ((Y.bond 0).continuous.comp ((k.continuous.snd.comp continuous_fst.fst).prodMk
        continuous_snd))⟩
  let raw (p : (X.level 0 × Y.level 0) × (I × I)) : (X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1) :=
    BasedSpace.smashPoint _ _ (X.bond 0 (p.1.1,p.2.1)) (Y.bond 0 (p.1.2,p.2.2))
  have collapsed (p : X.level 0 × Y.level 0) (st : I × I)
      (hp : p.1 = (X.level 0).point ∨ p.2 = (Y.level 0).point) :
      raw (p,st) = ((X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1)).point := by
    rcases hp with h | h
    · dsimp [raw]
      rw [h, X.bond_point]
      exact BasedSpace.smashPoint_base_left _ _ _
    · dsimp [raw]
      rw [h, Y.bond_point]
      exact BasedSpace.smashPoint_base_right _ _ _
  have hr (st : I × I) : ∀ a b, BasedSpace.SmashRelation (X.level 0) (Y.level 0) a b →
      raw (a,st) = raw (b,st) :=
    fun a b h => (collapsed a st h.1).trans (collapsed b st h.2).symm
  let mid (p : (X.level 0).smash (Y.level 0) × (I × I)) :=
    Quot.lift (fun q => raw (q,p.2)) (hr p.2) p.1
  have hm : Continuous mid := by
    letI : TopologicalSpace (X.level 0 × Y.level 0) :=
      TopologicalSpace.compactlyGenerated.{0} (X.level 0 × Y.level 0)
    apply isQuotientMap_quot_mk.continuous_lift_prod_left
    exact ((⟨family,hf⟩ : C(X.level 0 × Y.level 0,
      C(I,C(I,(X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1))))).uncurry.uncurry.continuous).comp
      ((continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_snd.fst).prodMk continuous_snd.snd)
  have mid_left (s t : I) : mid (((X.level 0).smash (Y.level 0)).point,(s,t)) =
      ((X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1)).point := collapsed _ _ (Or.inl rfl)
  have mid_zero (a : (X.level 0).smash (Y.level 0)) (t : I) :
      mid (a,(0,t)) = ((X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1)).point := by
    refine Quot.inductionOn a ?_
    rintro ⟨x,y⟩
    change BasedSpace.smashPoint _ _ (X.bond 0 (x,0)) (Y.bond 0 (y,t)) = _
    rw [X.bond_zero]
    exact BasedSpace.smashPoint_base_left _ _ _
  have mid_one (a : (X.level 0).smash (Y.level 0)) (t : I) :
      mid (a,(1,t)) = ((X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1)).point := by
    refine Quot.inductionOn a ?_
    rintro ⟨x,y⟩
    change BasedSpace.smashPoint _ _ (X.bond 0 (x,1)) (Y.bond 0 (y,t)) = _
    rw [X.bond_one]
    exact BasedSpace.smashPoint_base_left _ _ _
  have collapse_outer (p : (X.level 0).smash (Y.level 0) × I) (t : I)
      (hp : BasedSpace.SuspensionCollapsed ((X.level 0).smash (Y.level 0)) p) :
      mid (p.1,(p.2,t)) = ((X.level 1).smash (Y.level 1)).point := by
    rcases hp with h | h | h
    · rw [h, mid_left]
    · rw [h, mid_zero]
    · rw [h, mid_one]
  have hrout (t : I) : ∀ a b,
      BasedSpace.SuspensionRelation ((X.level 0).smash (Y.level 0)) a b →
      mid (a.1,(a.2,t)) = mid (b.1,(b.2,t)) :=

theorem diagonalMapLevel_bond {X Y X' Y' : Prespectrum.{0}}
    (f : X ⟶ X') (g : Y ⟶ Y') (n : ℕ) (a : diagonalLevel X Y n) (t : I) :
    (diagonalMapLevel f g (n+1)).map (diagonalBond X Y n (a,t)) =
      diagonalBond X' Y' n ((diagonalMapLevel f g n).map a,t) := by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction generalizing X Y X' Y' with
  | zero => rfl
  | one =>
    refine Quot.inductionOn a ?_
    rintro ⟨b,s⟩
    refine Quot.inductionOn b ?_
    rintro ⟨x,y⟩
    have hsm {A B A' B' : BasedSpace.{0}} (p : A ⟶ A') (q : B ⟶ B') (x : A) (y : B) :
        (BasedSpace.smashMap p q).map (BasedSpace.smashPoint A B x y) =
          BasedSpace.smashPoint A' B' (p.map x) (q.map y) :=
      (BasedSpace.smashMap_exists p q).exists.choose_spec x y
    have hp (U V : Prespectrum.{0}) (x : U.level 0) (y : V.level 0) (s t : I) :
        pairedBond U V (BasedSpace.suspensionProjection _
          (BasedSpace.smashPoint _ _ x y,s),t) =
        BasedSpace.smashPoint _ _ (U.bond 0 (x,s)) (V.bond 0 (y,t)) :=
      (pairedBond_exists U V).exists.choose_spec.1 x y s t
    change (BasedSpace.smashMap ⟨f.level 1, f.point 1⟩ ⟨g.level 1, g.point 1⟩).map
        (pairedBond X Y (BasedSpace.suspensionProjection _
          (BasedSpace.smashPoint _ _ x y,s),t)) =
      pairedBond X' Y' (BasedSpace.suspensionProjection _
        ((BasedSpace.smashMap ⟨f.level 0, f.point 0⟩ ⟨g.level 0, g.point 0⟩).map
          (BasedSpace.smashPoint _ _ x y),s),t)
    rw [hp, hsm, hsm, hp]
    change BasedSpace.smashPoint _ _ (f.level 1 (X.bond 0 (x,s)))
        (g.level 1 (Y.bond 0 (y,t))) = _
    rw [f.bond, g.bond]
  | more n ih _ => exact ih (tailMap f) (tailMap g) a

title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Internal.Source.towerFirstDifferential_eq_zero_iff
code:
private theorem towerFirstDifferential_eq_zero_iff (T : AbstractAdamsTower unit X)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : T.FirstPage p) :
    towerFirstDifferential T p x = 0 ↔ x ∈ T.cycles 2 (by decide) p := by
  let hdegree : p.2-p.1-1 = p.2-(p.1+1) := by omega
  let f := T.mapAt (show p.1+1 ≤ (p.1+1)+1 by omega)
  let e := homotopyDegreeEquiv (T.stageAt (p.1+1)) hdegree
  let e' := homotopyDegreeEquiv (T.stageAt ((p.1+1)+1)) hdegree
  change e (T.connecting p x) ≫ HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι f = 0 ↔
    ∃ a, a ≫ T.mapAt (show p.1+1 ≤ p.1+2 by omega) = T.connecting p x
  have hrange (q : ℤ) (hq : q = (p.1+1)+1) :
      (∃ a : HomotopyGroup (p.2-p.1-1) (T.stageAt q),
        a ≫ T.mapAt (show p.1+1 ≤ q by omega) = T.connecting p x) ↔
      ∃ a : HomotopyGroup (p.2-p.1-1) (T.stageAt ((p.1+1)+1)),
        a ≫ f = T.connecting p x := by
    subst q
    rfl
  rw [hrange (p.1+2) (by omega)]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ _
      (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished f) (e (T.connecting p x)) h
    refine ⟨e'.symm a, ?_⟩
    apply e.injective
    change homotopyDegreeEquiv _ hdegree (e'.symm a ≫ f) = _
    rw [homotopyDegreeEquiv_postcomp]
    change e' (e'.symm a) ≫ f = _
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact ha.symm
  · rintro ⟨a,ha⟩
    rw [← ha]
    change homotopyDegreeEquiv _ hdegree (a ≫ f) ≫ _ = 0
    rw [homotopyDegreeEquiv_postcomp, Category.assoc]
    have hzero : f ≫ HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι f = 0 :=
      comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished f)
    rw [hzero, comp_zero]

  rw [LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff, towerFirstDifferential_eq_zero_iff]

private theorem ambientToZeroPage_eq_zero_iff (D : SSData (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
    (a : D.V) : ambientToZeroPage D a = 0 ↔ a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ (D.B 0) := by
  change D.pageπ 0 (inv (D.Z 0).arrow a) = 0 ↔ _
  have hz := subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (D.B 0) (D.Z 0) (D.B_le_Z 0)
    (inv (D.Z 0).arrow a)
  change D.pageπ 0 (inv (D.Z 0).arrow a) = 0 ↔ _ at hz
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f a) (IsIso.inv_hom_id (D.Z 0).arrow)
  simp only [ModuleCat.comp_apply, ModuleCat.id_apply] at h
  exact hz.trans (by rw [h])

title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Source.BasedSpace.smashMap_exists
code:
theorem smashMap_exists {X Y X' Y' : BasedSpace.{u}} (f : X ⟶ X') (g : Y ⟶ Y') :
    ∃! h : X.smash Y ⟶ X'.smash Y', ∀ x y,
      h.map (smashPoint X Y x y) = smashPoint X' Y' (f.map x) (g.map y) := by
  have hc : Continuous[TopologicalSpace.compactlyGenerated.{u} (X × Y),
      TopologicalSpace.compactlyGenerated.{u} (X' × Y')]
      (fun p : X × Y => (f.map p.1,g.map p.2)) := by
    refine @continuous_from_compactlyGenerated (X × Y) (X' × Y') _
      (TopologicalSpace.compactlyGenerated.{u} (X' × Y')) _ ?_
    intro S k
    let l : C(S, X' × Y') :=
      ⟨fun s => (f.map (k s).1,g.map (k s).2),
        (f.map.continuous.comp k.continuous.fst).prodMk
          (g.map.continuous.comp k.continuous.snd)⟩
    let ev : (Σ i : (T : CompHaus.{u}) × C(T, X' × Y'), i.fst) → X' × Y' :=
      fun q => q.1.2 q.2
    have hi : Continuous (fun s : S => (⟨⟨S,l⟩,s⟩ :
        Σ i : (T : CompHaus.{u}) × C(T, X' × Y'), i.fst)) :=
      @continuous_sigmaMk _ (fun i : (T : CompHaus.{u}) × C(T, X' × Y') => i.fst)
        (fun _ => inferInstance) ⟨S,l⟩
    letI : TopologicalSpace (X' × Y') := TopologicalSpace.coinduced ev inferInstance
    exact (show Continuous ev from continuous_coinduced_rng).comp hi
  let raw : X × Y → X'.smash Y' := fun p => smashPoint X' Y' (f.map p.1) (g.map p.2)
  have collapsed (p : X × Y) (hp : p.1 = X.point ∨ p.2 = Y.point) :
      raw p = (X'.smash Y').point := by
    rcases hp with h | h
    · dsimp [raw]
      rw [h, f.point]
      exact smashPoint_base_left _ _ _
    · dsimp [raw]
      rw [h, g.point]
      exact smashPoint_base_right _ _ _
  have hr : ∀ a b, SmashRelation X Y a b → raw a = raw b :=
    fun a b h => (collapsed a h.1).trans (collapsed b h.2).symm
  letI : TopologicalSpace (X × Y) := TopologicalSpace.compactlyGenerated.{u} (X × Y)
  letI : TopologicalSpace (X' × Y') := TopologicalSpace.compactlyGenerated.{u} (X' × Y')
  let h : X.smash Y ⟶ X'.smash Y' :=
    { map := ⟨Quot.lift raw hr, continuous_quot_lift hr (continuous_quot_mk.comp hc)⟩
      point := collapsed _ (Or.inl rfl) }
  refine ⟨h, fun _ _ => rfl, ?_⟩
  intro h' hh'
  apply Hom.ext
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro z
  refine Quot.inductionOn z ?_
  intro p
  exact hh' p.1 p.2
statement:
theorem smashMap_exists {X Y X' Y' : BasedSpace.{u}} (f : X ⟶ X') (g : Y ⟶ Y') :
    ∃! h : X.smash Y ⟶ X'.smash Y', ∀ x y,
      h.map (smashPoint X Y x y) = smashPoint X' Y' (f.map x) (g.map y)

theorem smashUnit_exists (A : BasedSpace.{0}) (hA : A.IsGood) :
    ∃! f : zeroSphere.smash A ⟶ A,
      ∀ a, f.map (smashPoint zeroSphere A (show zeroSphere from (1 : Fin 2)) a) = a := by
  classical
  letI : DiscreteTopology zeroSphere := inferInstanceAs (DiscreteTopology (Fin 2))
  let raw : zeroSphere × A → A := fun p => if p.1 = zeroSphere.point then A.point else p.2
  have hc : Continuous raw := by
    apply continuous_prod_of_discrete_left.mpr
    intro x
    dsimp [raw]
    split_ifs
    · exact continuous_const
    · exact continuous_id

theorem coneBondRepresentative_respects {X Y : Prespectrum.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (t : I) (a b) (h : ConeRelation f n a b) :
    coneBondRepresentative f n t a = coneBondRepresentative f n t b := by
  cases h with
  | start x =>
    change Quot.mk (ConeRelation f (n+1)) (.inr (X.bond n (x,t),0)) =
      Quot.mk (ConeRelation f (n+1)) (.inl (Y.bond n (f.level n x,t)))
    rw [← f.bond]
    exact Quot.sound (ConeRelation.start _)
  | finish x =>
    change Quot.mk (ConeRelation f (n+1)) (.inr (X.bond n (x,t),1)) =
      Quot.mk (ConeRelation f (n+1)) (.inl (Y.bond n ((Y.level n).point,t)))
    rw [Y.bond_point]
    exact Quot.sound (ConeRelation.finish _)
  | point s =>
    change Quot.mk (ConeRelation f (n+1)) (.inr (X.bond n ((X.level n).point,t),s)) =
      Quot.mk (ConeRelation f (n+1)) (.inl (Y.bond n ((Y.level n).point,t)))
    rw [X.bond_point, Y.bond_point]
    exact Quot.sound (ConeRelation.point s)

code:
def stabilizeLoop (X : Prespectrum.{u}) (n r : ℕ)
    (p : GenLoop (Fin r) (X.level n) (X.level n).point) :
    GenLoop (Fin (r + 1)) (X.level (n + 1)) (X.level (n + 1)).point := by
  refine ⟨⟨fun t => X.bond n (p (fun i => t i.succ), t 0), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact (X.bond n).continuous.comp
      ((p.val.continuous.comp (continuous_pi fun i => continuous_apply i.succ)).prodMk
        (continuous_apply 0))
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ht
    induction i using Fin.cases with
    | zero =>
      rcases hi with h | h
      · simpa [h] using X.bond_zero n (p (fun i => t i.succ))
      · simpa [h] using X.bond_one n (p (fun i => t i.succ))
    | succ j =>
      have hp : p (fun i => t i.succ) = (X.level n).point := p.property _ ⟨j, hi⟩
      simpa [hp] using X.bond_point n (t 0)

theorem Representative.map_relation {X Y : Prespectrum.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {d : ℤ}
    {a b : Representative X d} (h : StableRelation X d a b) :
    StableRelation Y d (a.map f) (b.map f) := by
  cases h with
  | homotopy p h =>
    exact StableRelation.homotopy (a.map f) _
      (h.comp_continuousMap (f.level a.stage))
  | stabilization =>
    have hm : a.next.map f = (a.map f).next := by
      unfold Representative.next Representative.map
      congr 1
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext t
      exact f.bond a.stage _ _
    rw [hm]
    exact StableRelation.stabilization (a.map f)

structure SourceRecognition (C : Type u) [StableHomotopyCategory.{u,v} C]
    (H : ModTwoCoefficients C) where
  equivalence : SourceCategory.{0} ≌ C
  sphereIso : equivalence.functor.obj (sourceLocalization.obj Prespectrum.sphere) ≅
    SphereSpectrum
  suspensionIso : ∀ (X : Prespectrum.{0}), X.IsWellBased →
    (equivalence.functor.obj (sourceLocalization.obj X.suspension) ≅
      (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).obj
        (equivalence.functor.obj (sourceLocalization.obj X)))
  suspension_natural : ∀ {X Y : Prespectrum.{0}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
      (hX : X.IsWellBased) (hY : Y.IsWellBased),
    equivalence.functor.map (sourceLocalization.map (Prespectrum.suspensionMap f)) ≫
      (suspensionIso Y hY).hom =
        (suspensionIso X hX).hom ≫ (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map
          (equivalence.functor.map (sourceLocalization.map f))
  desuspensionIso : ∀ X : Prespectrum.{0},
    equivalence.functor.obj (sourceLocalization.obj X.desuspension) ≅
      (shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).obj
        (equivalence.functor.obj (sourceLocalization.obj X))
  desuspension_natural : ∀ {X Y : Prespectrum.{0}} (f : X ⟶ Y),
    equivalence.functor.map (sourceLocalization.map (Prespectrum.desuspensionMap f)) ≫
      (desuspensionIso Y).hom =
        (desuspensionIso X).hom ≫ (shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).map
          (equivalence.functor.map (sourceLocalization.map f))
  homotopy : ∀ (X : Prespectrum.{0}) (d : ℤ),
    HomotopyGroup d (equivalence.functor.obj (sourceLocalization.obj X)) ≃
      Prespectrum.StableHomotopy X d
  homotopy_natural : ∀ {X Y : Prespectrum.{0}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (d : ℤ)
      (a : HomotopyGroup d (equivalence.functor.obj (sourceLocalization.obj X))),
    homotopy Y d (a ≫ equivalence.functor.map (sourceLocalization.map f)) =
      Prespectrum.stableHomotopyMap f d (homotopy X d a)
  homotopy_zero : ∀ (X : Prespectrum.{0}) (d : ℤ) (n r : ℕ)
      (h : (r : ℤ) = d + n),
    homotopy X d 0 = Prespectrum.loopClass X d n r h GenLoop.const
  /-- Stable addition is the actual concatenation of cubical loops. Two
  coordinates ensure the displayed representative lies in the abelian range. -/
  homotopy_add : ∀ (X : Prespectrum.{0}) (d : ℤ) (n r : ℕ)
      (h : ((r + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = d + n)
      (p q : GenLoop (Fin (r + 2)) (X.level n) (X.level n).point),
    (homotopy X d).symm
        (Prespectrum.loopClass X d n (r + 2) h (GenLoop.transAt 0 p q)) =
      (homotopy X d).symm (Prespectrum.loopClass X d n (r + 2) h p) +
        (homotopy X d).symm (Prespectrum.loopClass X d n (r + 2) h q)
  /-- The identity of the selected sphere has the actual positive point-set
  generator, fixing the normalization of the source sphere comparison. -/
  sphere_identity : homotopy Prespectrum.sphere 0
      ((shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).hom.app SphereSpectrum ≫ sphereIso.inv) =
    Prespectrum.sphereGenerator
  sourceHF2 : Prespectrum.{0}
  sourceHF2Pi0 : Prespectrum.StableHomotopy sourceHF2 0 ≃ ZMod 2
  sourceHF2Vanishes : ∀ d : ℤ, d ≠ 0 →
    Subsingleton (Prespectrum.StableHomotopy sourceHF2 d)
  hf2Iso : equivalence.functor.obj (sourceLocalization.obj sourceHF2) ≅ H.object
  /-- The source coefficient coordinate is the selected target coordinate on
  the same homotopy comparison, not a separately named two-element set. -/
  hf2_pi0 : ∀ a : HomotopyGroup 0
      (equivalence.functor.obj (sourceLocalization.obj sourceHF2)),
    H.pi0Equiv (a ≫ hf2Iso.hom) = sourceHF2Pi0 (homotopy sourceHF2 0 a)
  sourceUnit : Prespectrum.sphere ⟶ sourceHF2
  /-- The actual point-set unit represents this same selected coefficient
  unit under the fixed sphere and coefficient comparisons. -/
  unit_compat : equivalence.functor.map (sourceLocalization.map sourceUnit) ≫
      hf2Iso.hom = sphereIso.hom ≫ H.unit

private theorem exists_compatible_of_finite (m₀ : ℕ)
    (A : (m : ℕ) → m₀ ≤ m → Type u)
    (restrict : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m₀ ≤ m),
      A (m + 1) (Nat.le_succ_of_le hm) → A m hm)
    (hfinite : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m₀ ≤ m), Finite (A m hm))
    (hne : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m₀ ≤ m), Nonempty (A m hm)) :
    ∃ a : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m₀ ≤ m), A m hm,
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m₀ ≤ m),
        restrict m hm (a (m + 1) (Nat.le_succ_of_le hm)) = a m hm := by
  classical
  let B (m : ℕ) := ∀ hm : m₀ ≤ m, A m hm
  let step (m : ℕ) (b : B (m + 1)) : B m :=
    fun hm => restrict m hm (b (Nat.le_succ_of_le hm))
  letI : ∀ m, Finite (B m) := fun m => by
    letI : ∀ hm : m₀ ≤ m, Finite (A m hm) := hfinite m
    exact Pi.finite
  letI : ∀ m, Nonempty (B m) :=
    fun m => ⟨fun hm => Classical.choice (hne m hm)⟩
  let π : {i j : ℕ} → i ≤ j → B j → B i :=
    fun {_ _} hij b => Nat.decreasingInduction (fun k _ => step k) b hij
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_seq_forall_proj_of_forall_finite π
    (fun {_} _ => Nat.decreasingInduction_self _ _)
    (by
      intro i j k hij hjk b
      exact (Nat.decreasingInduction_trans (motive := fun m (_ : m ≤ k) => B m)
        hij hjk (fun m _ => step m) b).symm)
    (fun _ _ => Set.toFinite _)
  refine ⟨fun m hm => a m hm, ?_⟩
  intro m hm
  have h := congrFun (ha (Nat.le_succ m)) hm
  simpa only [π, Nat.decreasingInduction_succ', step] using h

      A (m + 1) (Nat.le_succ_of_le hm) → A m hm)
    (hfinite : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m₀ ≤ m), Finite (A m hm))
    (hne : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m₀ ≤ m), Nonempty (A m hm)) :
    ∃ a : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m₀ ≤ m), A m hm,
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m₀ ≤ m),
        restrict m hm (a (m + 1) (Nat.le_succ_of_le hm)) = a m hm

      ⟨a.val - a₀.val, by simp only [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, map_sub, a.property, a₀.property, sub_self]⟩

private theorem finite_fiber_comp
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} {C : Type w}
    (f : B → C) (g : A → B)
    (hf : ∀ c, Finite {b // f b = c}) (hg : ∀ b, Finite {a // g a = b})
    (c : C) : Finite {a // f (g a) = c} := by
  letI : Finite {b // f b = c} := hf c
  letI : ∀ b : {b // f b = c}, Finite {a // g a = b.val} := fun b => hg b.val
  let e : {a // f (g a) = c} → Σ b : {b // f b = c}, {a // g a = b.val} :=
    fun a => ⟨⟨g a.val, a.property⟩, ⟨a.val, rfl⟩⟩

    (G : ℕ → Type u) [∀ n, AddCommGroup (G n)]

    (pcomp : ∀ a b c (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) x,

      intro y y' h
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg (fun z : {y : G a // y = x} => z.val) h)

    letI := hfinite b
    have hf : ∀ z, Finite {y : G b // p a b hab y = z} := by
      intro z
      exact ih z

    exact Finite.of_injective
      (fun y : {y : G (b+1) // p a (b+1) (hab.trans (Nat.le_succ b)) y = x} =>
        (⟨y.val, (pcomp a b (b+1) hab (Nat.le_succ b) y.val).trans y.property⟩ :

      (by
        intro y y' h
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact congrArg (fun z : {y : G (b+1) // p a b hab (p b (b+1) (Nat.le_succ b) y) = x} => z.val) h)

    (G : ℕ → Type u) [∀ n, AddCommGroup (G n)]
    (p : ∀ a b, a ≤ b → G b →+ G a)
    (pid : ∀ a x, p a a (Nat.le_refl a) x = x)
    (pcomp : ∀ a b c (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) x,
      p a b hab (p b c hbc x) = p a c (hab.trans hbc) x)
    (hfinite : ∀ n, Finite (p n (n+1) (Nat.le_succ n)).ker)
    (hzero : ∀ z : ∀ n, G n,
      (∀ n, p n (n+1) (Nat.le_succ n) (z (n+1)) = z n) → ∀ n, z n = 0)
    (a : ℕ) (x : G a)

  classical
  let A (b : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) := {y : G b // p a b hab y = x}
  let step (b : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) : A (b+1) (Nat.le_succ_of_le hab) → A b hab :=
    fun y => ⟨p b (b+1) (Nat.le_succ b) y.val,
      (pcomp a b (b+1) hab (Nat.le_succ b) y.val).trans y.property⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_compatible_of_finite a A step
    (fun b hab => finite_fiber_tower G p pid pcomp hfinite a b hab x)
    (fun b hab => let ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx b hab; ⟨⟨y, hy⟩⟩)
  have hua : (u a (Nat.le_refl a)).val = x :=
    (pid a _).symm.trans (u a (Nat.le_refl a)).property
  let z (b : ℕ) : G b := if hab : a ≤ b then (u b hab).val else p b a (by omega) x
  have hcompat : ∀ b, p b (b+1) (Nat.le_succ b) (z (b+1)) = z b := by
    intro b
    by_cases hab : a ≤ b
    · have hab' : a ≤ b+1 := Nat.le_succ_of_le hab

      exact congrArg Subtype.val (hu b hab)
    · by_cases hab' : a ≤ b+1
      · have hba : b+1 = a := by omega
        subst a
        simp only [z, dif_pos hab', dif_neg hab]
        rw [hua]
      · simp only [z, dif_neg hab, dif_neg hab']
        exact pcomp b (b+1) a (Nat.le_succ b) (by omega) x

private theorem common_representative
    (G : ℕ → Type v) [∀ s, AddCommGroup (G s)]
    {A : Type w} [AddCommGroup A]
    (i : ∀ s, G (s+1) →+ G s) (p : ∀ s, G s →+ A)
    (hp : ∀ s y, p s (i s y) = p (s+1) y)
    (hdelta : Function.Surjective (fun z : ∀ s, G s => fun s => z s - i s (z (s+1))))
    (x : ℕ → A) (hx : ∀ s, ∃ y, p s y = x s - x (s+1)) :
    ∃ a : A, ∀ s, ∃ y, p s y = x s - a := by
  classical
  choose y hy using hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hdelta y
  have hz' (s : ℕ) : p s (z s) - p (s+1) (z (s+1)) = x s - x (s+1) := by
    have h := congrArg (p s) (congrFun hz s)
    simpa only [map_sub, hp, hy] using h
  have hw (s : ℕ) : x s - p s (z s) = x 0 - p 0 (z 0) := by
    induction s with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ s ih =>
      calc
        x (s+1) - p (s+1) (z (s+1)) = x s - p s (z s) := by
          rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp (hz' s)]
          abel
        _ = _ := ih
  refine ⟨x 0 - p 0 (z 0), fun s => ⟨z s, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [← hw s]
  abel

    (∀ x, f x = 0 → x + x = 0 → x = 0) ∧
    (∀ x, f x = 0 → ∃ y, f y = 0 ∧ y + y = x) ∧
    (∀ x, ∃ y z, y + y + f z = x) ∧

    {B : Type u} [AddCommGroup B] (sigma : Module.End ℤ B) (m : ℕ)
    (heven : ∀ x, ∃ y, (sigma ^ m) x = y + y)
    (htors : ∀ x, x + x = 0 → (sigma ^ m) x = 0) :
    (∀ b, ∃ x y, (1 - sigma) x + (y + y) = b) ∧
    (∀ x y, (1 - sigma) x = y + y → ∃ z, x = z + z) ∧
    (∀ b, b + b = 0 → ∃ x, x + x = 0 ∧ (1 - sigma) x = b) ∧
    (∀ x, x + x = 0 → (1 - sigma) x = 0 → x = 0) := by
  let S : Module.End ℤ B := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, sigma ^ i
  have hleft (x : B) : S ((1 - sigma) x) = x - (sigma ^ m) x := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℤ B => f x) (geom_sum_mul_neg sigma m)
    exact h
  have hright (x : B) : (1 - sigma) (S x) = x - (sigma ^ m) x := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℤ B => f x) (mul_neg_geom_sum sigma m)
    exact h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro b
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := heven b
    exact ⟨S b, y, by rw [hright, hy, sub_add_cancel]⟩
  · intro x y h
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := heven x
    refine ⟨S y + z, ?_⟩
    have hh := hleft x
    rw [h, map_add, hz] at hh
    have hh' : x = (S y + S y) + (z + z) := (sub_eq_iff_eq_add).mp hh.symm
    rw [hh']
    abel
  · intro b hb
    refine ⟨S b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← map_add, hb, map_zero]
    · rw [hright, htors b hb, sub_zero]
  · intro x hx hd
    have hh := hleft x
    rw [hd, map_zero, htors x hx, sub_zero] at hh
    exact hh.symm

private theorem doubling_middle_of_exact
    {A B K C D : Type u} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B]
    [AddCommGroup K] [AddCommGroup C] [AddCommGroup D]
    (f : A →+ B) (g : B →+ K) (i : K →+ C) (j : C →+ D)
    (hfg : ∀ b, g b = 0 ↔ ∃ a, f a = b)
    (hgi : ∀ z, i z = 0 ↔ ∃ b, g b = z)
    (hij : ∀ c, j c = 0 ↔ ∃ z, i z = c)
    (hkinj : ∀ c, j c = 0 → c + c = 0 → c = 0)
    (hksurj : ∀ c, j c = 0 → ∃ d, j d = 0 ∧ d + d = c)
    (hcsurj : ∀ b, ∃ c a, c + c + f a = b)
    (hcinj : ∀ b a, b + b = f a → ∃ c, f c = b) :
    Function.Bijective (fun z : K => z + z) := by
  have kill : ∀ z : K, z + z = 0 → z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have hiz : i z = 0 := hkinj (i z) ((hij _).mpr ⟨z, rfl⟩)
      (by rw [← map_add, hz, map_zero])
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (hgi z).mp hiz
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (hfg (b+b)).mp (by rw [map_add, hb, hz])
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hcinj b a ha.symm
    rw [← hb]
    exact (hfg b).mpr ⟨c, hc⟩
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    have hz : (x-y) + (x-y) = 0 := by
      have h : (x+x) - (y+y) = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hxy
      calc
        (x-y) + (x-y) = (x+x) - (y+y) := by abel
        _ = 0 := h
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (kill (x-y) hz)
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hd⟩ := hksurj (i z) ((hij _).mpr ⟨z, rfl⟩)
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (hij c).mp hc
    have hz : i (z - (w+w)) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, map_add, hw, hd, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (hgi _).mp hz
    obtain ⟨b', a, ha⟩ := hcsurj b
    have hfa : g (f a) = 0 := (hfg _).mpr ⟨a, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨w + g b', ?_⟩
    have hgb : g b = g b' + g b' := by rw [← ha, map_add, map_add, hfa, add_zero]
    rw [hgb] at hb
    calc
      (w + g b') + (w + g b') = (g b' + g b') + (w + w) := by abel
      _ = z := eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mp hb

    have hcs : F.quotientTransition hsk n (c k) = c s :=
      hc (homOfLE (show (k : OrderDual ℤ) ≤ s from hsk))

    exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (F.quotientProjection_transition hsk n) a).symm
  refine ⟨a, haall, ?_⟩
  intro b hb
  change HomotopyGroup n X at b
  change ∀ s : ℤ, q s b = c s at hb
  change (b : HomotopyGroup n X) = a
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply hsep
  intro s
  apply (hk s _).mp
  rw [map_sub]
  change q s b - q s a = 0
  rw [hb, haall, sub_self]

    (hsep : ∀ x : HomotopyGroup n X,
      (∀ s : ℕ, x ∈ T.filtrationSubmodule s n) → x = 0) :
    Nonempty (Filtration.CompletionWitness
      T.filtration n)

public theorem MappingComposition.eInfty_associative
    {S : MappingSpectrumSystem B P scope} (M : MappingComposition S)
    (W X Y Z : MappingObject scope) (i j k : ℤ × ℤ)
    (x : ((S.hom W X).underlying.E.ssData i).eInfty)
    (y : ((S.hom X Y).underlying.E.ssData j).eInfty)
    (z : ((S.hom Y Z).underlying.E.ssData k).eInfty) :
    HEq ((M.pairing W Y Z).eInftyPair (i+j) k
      ((M.pairing W X Y).eInftyPair i j x y) z)
      ((M.pairing W X Z).eInftyPair i (j+k) x
        ((M.pairing X Y Z).eInftyPair j k y z)) := by
  haveI : Epi (((S.hom W X).underlying.E.ssData i).pageπ ⊤) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  haveI : Epi (((S.hom X Y).underlying.E.ssData j).pageπ ⊤) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  haveI : Epi (((S.hom Y Z).underlying.E.ssData k).pageπ ⊤) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective
    (((S.hom W X).underlying.E.ssData i).pageπ ⊤)).mp inferInstance x
  obtain ⟨b,rfl⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective
    (((S.hom X Y).underlying.E.ssData j).pageπ ⊤)).mp inferInstance y
  obtain ⟨c,rfl⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective
    (((S.hom Y Z).underlying.E.ssData k).pageπ ⊤)).mp inferInstance z
  have h := M.page_associative W X Y Z 2 i j k
    (infinityToPage _ 2 i a) (infinityToPage _ 2 j b) (infinityToPage _ 2 k c)
  simp only [MappingComposition.page_pair_infinity] at h
  have hi := infinity_heq_of_page_heq (S.hom W Z).underlying.E
    ((i+j)+k) (i+(j+k)) (add_assoc i j k) 2 _ _ h
  simpa only [ConvergingSSPairing.eInftyPair_induced] using hi

code:
private theorem shiftedAssoc {W X Y Z : C} (i j k : ℤ)
    (f : (shiftFunctor C i).obj W ⟶ X) (g : (shiftFunctor C j).obj X ⟶ Y)
    (h : (shiftFunctor C k).obj Y ⟶ Z) :
    HEq ((shiftFunctorAdd C (i+j) k).hom.app W ≫
      (shiftFunctor C k).map ((shiftFunctorAdd C i j).hom.app W ≫
        (shiftFunctor C j).map f ≫ g) ≫ h)
      ((shiftFunctorAdd C i (j+k)).hom.app W ≫
        (shiftFunctor C (j+k)).map f ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd C j k).hom.app X ≫ (shiftFunctor C k).map g ≫ h) := by
  apply homHEq (congrArg (fun a => (shiftFunctor C a).obj W) (add_assoc i j k))
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc ((shiftFunctorAdd C (i+j) k).hom.app W)
    ((shiftFunctor C k).map ((shiftFunctorAdd C i j).hom.app W))]
  rw [shiftFunctorAdd_assoc_hom_app]
  simp only [shiftFunctorAdd', Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app, eqToIso.hom,
    eqToHom_app, Category.assoc]
  rw [(shiftFunctorAdd C j k).hom.naturality_assoc]
  rfl

label: decl:4c62c3c2145cec1a
name: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.nonzeroClassicalDetection_of_exact
title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.nonzeroClassicalDetection_of_exact
code:
public theorem nonzeroClassicalDetection_of_exact {X : C}
    (c : ClassicalTowerConvergence P X) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (a : HomotopyGroup (p.2-p.1) X)
    (ha : a ∈ (P.tower X).filtrationSubmodule p.1 (p.2-p.1))
    (ha' : a ∉ (P.tower X).filtrationSubmodule (p.1+1) (p.2-p.1)) :
    Nonempty (NonzeroClassicalDetection c p a) := by
  have hmem : a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _
      ((P.tower X).filtration.F p.1 (p.2-p.1)) := by
    simpa only [AbstractAdamsTower.filtration, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using ha
  change ∃ b, ((P.tower X).filtration.F p.1 (p.2-p.1)).arrow.hom b = a at hmem
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hmem
  have hgraded : (P.tower X).filtration.toAssociatedGraded p.1 (p.2-p.1) b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hnext := ((P.tower X).filtration.toAssociatedGraded_eq_zero_iff
      p.1 (p.2-p.1) b).mp hz
    apply ha'
    change ((P.tower X).filtration.F p.1 (p.2-p.1)).arrow.hom b ∈
      ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.tower X).filtration.F (p.1+1) (p.2-p.1)) at hnext
    rw [hb] at hnext
    simpa only [AbstractAdamsTower.filtration, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hnext
  let e := (c.identification p).inv
    ((P.tower X).filtration.toAssociatedGraded p.1 (p.2-p.1) b)
  have he : (c.identification p).hom e =
      (P.tower X).filtration.toAssociatedGraded p.1 (p.2-p.1) b := by
    change ((c.identification p).inv ≫ (c.identification p).hom) _ = _
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  have hene : e ≠ 0 := by
    intro hezero
    apply hgraded
    rw [← he, hezero, map_zero]
  haveI : Epi (((A.obj X).ssData p).pageπ ⊤) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective
    (((A.obj X).ssData p).pageπ ⊤)).mp inferInstance e
  exact ⟨⟨z, by simpa only [hz] using hene, b, hb, by rw [hz]; exact he⟩⟩
statement:
public theorem nonzeroClassicalDetection_of_exact {X : C}
    (c : ClassicalTowerConvergence P X) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (a : HomotopyGroup (p.2-p.1) X)
    (ha : a ∈ (P.tower X).filtrationSubmodule p.1 (p.2-p.1))
    (ha' : a ∉ (P.tower X).filtrationSubmodule (p.1+1) (p.2-p.1)) :
    Nonempty (NonzeroClassicalDetection c p a)

code:
public theorem MappingDetectionInput.detects_exact
    {B : ClosedSymmetricTensorTriangulated C}
    {S : MappingSpectrumSystem B P (IsFiniteSpectrum (C := C))}
    (D : MappingDetectionInput B P S)
    {X Y : C} (hX : IsFiniteSpectrum X) (hY : IsFiniteSpectrum Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (s : ℤ) (hs : ExactMapAdamsFiltration P f s) :
    Nonempty (NonzeroClassicalDetection (S.convergence X Y hX hY) (s,s) (mappingClass B f s)) := by
  apply nonzeroClassicalDetection_of_exact
  · have ha := (D.mappingComparison.agrees hX hY f s).mp hs.1
    exact (homotopy_filtration_transport (P := P) (s-s) 0 s (sub_self s) _).mpr ha
  · intro ha
    apply hs.2
    apply (D.mappingComparison.agrees hX hY f (s+1)).mpr
    exact (homotopy_filtration_transport (P := P) (s-s) 0 (s+1) (sub_self s) _).mp ha

public structure MappingEnrichment {S : MappingSpectrumSystem B P scope}
    (M : MappingComposition S) where
  monoidal : MonoidalCategory (ConvergingSequence.{0,v} ℤ)
  enriched : @EnrichedCategory (ConvergingSequence.{0,v} ℤ) _ monoidal (MappingObject scope)
  hom_eq : ∀ X Y : MappingObject scope, enriched.Hom X Y = S.hom X Y
  /-- Elementary tensor products for the composable mapping systems. These
  are requested only for these systems, whose differential degrees agree;
  arbitrary ambient converging sequences need not have compatible degrees. -/
  tensorPairing : letI := monoidal
    ∀ X Y Z : MappingObject scope,
      ConvergingSSPairing (S.hom X Y).underlying (S.hom Y Z).underlying
        ((S.hom X Y ⊗ S.hom Y Z).underlying)
  /-- Actual enriched composition takes elementary page tensors to the
  specified page products. No arbitrary equivalence of pairing records is
  used to give composition its mathematical meaning. -/
  composition_page : letI := monoidal
    ∀ (X Y Z : MappingObject scope) (r : ℤ) (i j : ℤ × ℤ)
      (x : (S.hom X Y).underlying.E.Page r i)
      (y : (S.hom Y Z).underlying.E.Page r j),
      let f : (S.hom X Y ⊗ S.hom Y Z) ⟶ S.hom X Z :=
        eqToHom (congrArg₂ (fun A B : ConvergingSequence.{0,v} ℤ => A ⊗ B)
          (hom_eq X Y).symm (hom_eq Y Z).symm) ≫ enriched.comp X Y Z ≫
            eqToHom (hom_eq X Z)
      f.sequence.pageMap r (i+j) ((tensorPairing X Y Z).ssPairing.pair r i j x y) =
        (M.pairing X Y Z).ssPairing.pair r i j x y
  composition_eInfty : letI := monoidal
    ∀ (X Y Z : MappingObject scope) (i j : ℤ × ℤ)
      (x : ((S.hom X Y).underlying.E.ssData i).eInfty)
      (y : ((S.hom Y Z).underlying.E.ssData j).eInfty),
      let f : (S.hom X Y ⊗ S.hom Y Z) ⟶ S.hom X Z :=
        eqToHom (congrArg₂ (fun A B : ConvergingSequence.{0,v} ℤ => A ⊗ B)
          (hom_eq X Y).symm (hom_eq Y Z).symm) ≫ enriched.comp X Y Z ≫
            eqToHom (hom_eq X Z)
      f.sequence.eInftyMap (i+j) ((tensorPairing X Y Z).eInftyPair i j x y) =
        (M.pairing X Y Z).eInftyPair i j x y
  composition_abutment : letI := monoidal
    ∀ (X Y Z : MappingObject scope) (i j : ℤ)
      (x : (S.hom X Y).underlying.A i) (y : (S.hom Y Z).underlying.A j),
      let f : (S.hom X Y ⊗ S.hom Y Z) ⟶ S.hom X Z :=
        eqToHom (congrArg₂ (fun A B : ConvergingSequence.{0,v} ℤ => A ⊗ B)
          (hom_eq X Y).symm (hom_eq Y Z).symm) ≫ enriched.comp X Y Z ≫
            eqToHom (hom_eq X Z)
      f.convergence.aMap (i+j) ((tensorPairing X Y Z).abutmentPair i j x y) =
        (M.pairing X Y Z).abutmentPair i j x y
  unit_reindex : monoidal.tensorUnit.underlying.conv.reindex (0,0) = (0,0)
  unit_data : ConvergingSSUnit monoidal.tensorUnit.underlying unit_reindex
  identity_page : letI := monoidal
    ∀ (X : MappingObject scope) (r : ℤ),
      let f : 𝟙_ (ConvergingSequence.{0,v} ℤ) ⟶ S.hom X X :=
        enriched.id X ≫ eqToHom (hom_eq X X)
      f.sequence.pageMap r (0,0) (unit_data.page r) = (M.identity X).page r
  identity_eInfty : letI := monoidal
    ∀ X : MappingObject scope,
      let f : 𝟙_ (ConvergingSequence.{0,v} ℤ) ⟶ S.hom X X :=
        enriched.id X ≫ eqToHom (hom_eq X X)
      f.sequence.eInftyMap (0,0) unit_data.eInfty = (M.identity X).eInfty
  identity_abutment : letI := monoidal
    ∀ X : MappingObject scope,
      let f : 𝟙_ (ConvergingSequence.{0,v} ℤ) ⟶ S.hom X X :=
        enriched.id X ≫ eqToHom (hom_eq X X)
      f.convergence.aMap 0 unit_data.abutment = (M.identity X).abutment

public def IsModelPushout {X Y Z W : C}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X ⟶ Z) (h : Y ⟶ W) (k : Z ⟶ W) : Prop :=
  ∃ (A B D E : P) (f' : A ⟶ B) (g' : A ⟶ D)
      (h' : B ⟶ E) (k' : D ⟶ E),
    cofibrations P f' ∧ IsPushout f' g' h' k' ∧
    ∃ (iX : L.obj A ≅ X) (iY : L.obj B ≅ Y)
      (iZ : L.obj D ≅ Z) (iW : L.obj E ≅ W),
      iX.hom ≫ f = L.map f' ≫ iY.hom ∧
      iX.hom ≫ g = L.map g' ≫ iZ.hom ∧
      iY.hom ≫ h = L.map h' ≫ iW.hom ∧
      iZ.hom ≫ k = L.map k' ≫ iW.hom

public structure StableLocalization
    {P : Type u} [Category.{v} P] [ModelCategory P]
    {C : Type w} [StableHomotopyCategory.{w,z} C] (L : P ⥤ C) where
  localizes : L.IsLocalization (weakEquivalences P)
  suspension : C ⥤ C
  loop : C ⥤ C
  suspensionLoop : suspension ⊣ loop
  suspensionIso : suspension ≅ shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)
  bicartesian : ∀ {X Y Z W : C}
      (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X ⟶ Z) (h : Y ⟶ W) (k : Z ⟶ W),
    f ≫ h = g ≫ k → (IsModelPushout L f g h k ↔ IsModelPullback L f g h k)
  pullbackComparison : ∀ {A B D E : P}
      (f : A ⟶ B) (g : A ⟶ D) (h : B ⟶ E) (k : D ⟶ E)
      (sq : f ≫ h = g ≫ k),
    fibrations P h →
    IsModelPullback L (L.map f) (L.map g) (L.map h) (L.map k) →
    IsIso (L.map (pullback.lift f g sq))
  pushoutComparison : ∀ {A B D E : P}
      (f : A ⟶ B) (g : A ⟶ D) (h : B ⟶ E) (k : D ⟶ E)
      (sq : f ≫ h = g ≫ k),
    cofibrations P f →
    IsModelPushout L (L.map f) (L.map g) (L.map h) (L.map k) →
    IsIso (L.map (pushout.desc h k sq))
  cofiberTriangle : ∀ {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z),
    IsModelPushout L f (0 : X ⟶ 0) g (0 : 0 ⟶ Z) →
    ∃ δ : Z ⟶ (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).obj X,
      Triangle.mk f g δ ∈ distTriang C

code:
public structure SphereE2Algebra (A : ClassicalAdamsFamily C) where
  scalar : ∀ p : Bidegree, Module (ZMod 2) (ActualE2At A p)
  product : ∀ p q : Bidegree,
    ActualE2At A p →ₗ[ℤ] ActualE2At A q →ₗ[ℤ] ActualE2At A (p + q)
  unit : ActualE2At A (0, 0)
  assoc : ∀ (p q r : Bidegree) (x : ActualE2At A p) (y : ActualE2At A q)
      (z : ActualE2At A r),
    HEq (product (p + q) r (product p q x y) z)
      (product p (q + r) x (product q r y z))
  unit_left : ∀ (p : Bidegree) (x : ActualE2At A p),
    HEq (product (0, 0) p unit x) x
  unit_right : ∀ (p : Bidegree) (x : ActualE2At A p),
    HEq (product p (0, 0) x unit) x
statement:
public structure SphereE2Algebra (A : ClassicalAdamsFamily C) where
  scalar : ∀ p : Bidegree, Module (ZMod 2) (ActualE2At A p)
  product : ∀ p q : Bidegree,
    ActualE2At A p →ₗ[ℤ] ActualE2At A q →ₗ[ℤ] ActualE2At A (p + q)
  unit : ActualE2At A (0, 0)
  assoc : ∀ (p q r : Bidegree) (x : ActualE2At A p) (y : ActualE2At A q)
      (z : ActualE2At A r),
    HEq (product (p + q) r (product p q x y) z)
      (product p (q + r) x (product q r y z))
  unit_left : ∀ (p : Bidegree) (x : ActualE2At A p),
    HEq (product (0, 0) p unit x) x
  unit_right : ∀ (p : Bidegree) (x : ActualE2At A p),
    HEq (product p (0, 0) x unit) x

label: decl:5a31a0220ac39c09
name: KIP126.Classical.Adams.SphereE2Algebra.product_smul_left
title: KIP126.Classical.Adams.SphereE2Algebra.product_smul_left
code:
public theorem product_smul_left (P : SphereE2Algebra A) (p q : Bidegree)
    (a : ZMod 2) (x : ActualE2At A p) (y : ActualE2At A q) :
    letI := P.scalar p
    letI := P.scalar (p + q)
    P.product p q (a • x) y = a • P.product p q x y := by
  letI := P.scalar p
  letI := P.scalar (p + q)
  let f : ActualE2At A p →+ ActualE2At A (p + q) :=
    { toFun := fun z => P.product p q z y
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_add' := by intros; simp }
  exact ZMod.map_smul f a x

label: decl:c4d2b5afc78f6fcf
name: KIP126.Classical.Adams.SphereE2Algebra.product_smul_right
title: KIP126.Classical.Adams.SphereE2Algebra.product_smul_right
code:
public theorem product_smul_right (P : SphereE2Algebra A) (p q : Bidegree)
    (a : ZMod 2) (x : ActualE2At A p) (y : ActualE2At A q) :
    letI := P.scalar q
    letI := P.scalar (p + q)
    P.product p q x (a • y) = a • P.product p q x y := by
  letI := P.scalar q
  letI := P.scalar (p + q)
  exact ZMod.map_smul (P.product p q x) a y

    intro n
    apply (ModuleCat.subobjectModule _).le_iff_le.mp
    simp only [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply, Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]

  exact Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
