private theorem representative_of_lift {C : Type u} [StableHomotopyCategory.{u,v} C]
    [HasFunctorialCofiber (C := C)] {H : C} {unit : SphereSpectrum ⟶ H}
    {X : C} {T : AbstractAdamsTower unit X}
    {D : (ℤ × ℤ) → SSData (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)}
    {d : ∀ (r : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ), (D p).page (↑(r - 2).toNat : WithTop ℕ) ⟶
      (D (p + (r, r - 1))).page (↑(r - 2).toNat : WithTop ℕ)}
    (P : TowerSequencePresentation unit T D d) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (a : HomotopyGroup (p.2-p.1) (T.stageAt p.1)) :
    ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((D p).Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      P.infiniteRepresentativeE1 p z = T.layerMap p a := by
  let a₂ : T.cycles 2 (by decide) p := ⟨T.layerMap p a, layerMap_mem_cycles T p a 2 (by decide)⟩
  let v : (D p).V := (P.ambient p).inv a₂
  have hv : ∀ n : ℕ, v ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((D p).Z n) := by
    intro n
    apply (P.cycles p n v).mpr
    have he : (P.ambient p).hom v = a₂ := by simp only [v, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
    rw [he]
    exact layerMap_mem_cycles T p a (n+2) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mem_top_cycles (D p) v hv
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  change ((P.ambient p).hom (((D p).Z ⊤).arrow z)).val = T.layerMap p a
  rw [hz]
  simp only [v, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply, a₂]

private theorem filtration_maps {Syn : Type u} [SyntheticCategory.{u,v} Syn]
    [HasFunctorialCofiber (C := Syn)] {H : Syn} {unit : S_0_0 ⟶ H}
    {F : SyntheticAdamsFamily Syn} (P : SyntheticTowerPresentation unit F)
    {X Y : Syn} (f : X ⟶ Y) (s : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (a : BiHom p.1 p.2 X) (ha : a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X s p) :
    a ≫ f ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y s p := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨b ≫ (P.map f).stage s.toNat, ?_⟩
  change (b ≫ (P.map f).stage s.toNat) ≫ (P.tower Y).projection s = a ≫ f
  rw [Category.assoc, (P.map f).projection, ← Category.assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun q => q ≫ f) hb

    (a ≫ φ.stage p.1.toNat) ≫ HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι _
  rw [Category.assoc]
  change a ≫ HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι _ ≫
    HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibMap _ _ _ _ _ = _

private theorem mapped_representative_eq {Syn : Type u} [SyntheticCategory.{u,v} Syn]
    [HasFunctorialCofiber (C := Syn)] {H : Syn} {unit : S_0_0 ⟶ H}
    {F : SyntheticAdamsFamily Syn} (P : SyntheticTowerPresentation unit F)
    {X Y : Syn} (f : X ⟶ Y) (i : Tridegree)
    (a : HomotopyGroup (i.2.1-i.1)
      ((P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj X)).stageAt i.1))
    (z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (((F.obj X).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ))
    (hz : (P.sequence X i.2.2).infiniteRepresentativeE1 (i.1,i.2.1) z =
      (P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj X)).layerMap (i.1,i.2.1) a)
    (z' : (Subobject.underlying.obj (((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ))
    (hz' : (P.sequence Y i.2.2).infiniteRepresentativeE1 (i.1,i.2.1) z' =
      (P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj Y)).layerMap (i.1,i.2.1)
        (a ≫ (P.map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).map f)).stage i.1.toNat)) :
    (F.map f).eInftyMap i (((F.obj X).sequence.ssData i).pageπ ⊤ z) =
      ((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i).pageπ ⊤ z' := by
  let zf := (F.map f).toSSDataMorphism.cycleMap i ⊤ z
  have hzf : (((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤).arrow zf =
      (F.map f).φ i ((((F.obj X).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤).arrow z) := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ((F.map f).preserves_Z i ⊤).choose_spec z
  have hn := P.natural_e2 f i.2.2 (i.1,i.2.1)
    ((((F.obj X).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤).arrow z)
  have he1 : (P.sequence Y i.2.2).infiniteRepresentativeE1 (i.1,i.2.1) zf -
      (P.sequence Y i.2.2).infiniteRepresentativeE1 (i.1,i.2.1) z' ∈
      (P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj Y)).boundaries 2 (by decide)
        (i.1,i.2.1) := by
    rw [hz', ← layerMap_natural, ← hz]
    change (((P.sequence Y i.2.2).ambient (i.1,i.2.1)).hom
        ((((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤).arrow zf)).val -
      (((P.sequence X i.2.2).ambient (i.1,i.2.1)).hom
        ((((F.obj X).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤).arrow z)).val ≫
          (P.map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).map f)).layer i.1 ∈ _
    rw [hzf]
    exact hn
  have hb : (((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤).arrow zf -
      (((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤).arrow z' ∈
      ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ (((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i).B 0) := by
    apply ((P.sequence Y i.2.2).boundaries (i.1,i.2.1) 0 _).mpr
    change (((P.sequence Y i.2.2).ambient (i.1,i.2.1)).hom
      ((((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤).arrow zf -
        (((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤).arrow z')).val ∈
      (P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj Y)).boundaries 2 (by decide)
        (i.1,i.2.1)
    have hsub := congrArg Subtype.val (map_sub
      (((P.sequence Y i.2.2).ambient (i.1,i.2.1)).hom.hom)
      ((((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤).arrow zf)
      ((((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤).arrow z'))
    exact hsub.symm ▸ he1
  have hinfty := infty_eq_of_ambient_boundary ((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i) zf z' hb
  have hmap := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    ((F.map f).toSSDataMorphism.pageπ_pageMap i ⊤) z
  exact hmap.trans hinfty

private theorem mapped_representative_eq {Syn : Type u} [SyntheticCategory.{u,v} Syn]
    [HasFunctorialCofiber (C := Syn)] {H : Syn} {unit : S_0_0 ⟶ H}
    {F : SyntheticAdamsFamily Syn} (P : SyntheticTowerPresentation unit F)
    {X Y : Syn} (f : X ⟶ Y) (i : Tridegree)
    (a : HomotopyGroup (i.2.1-i.1)
      ((P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj X)).stageAt i.1))
    (z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (((F.obj X).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ))
    (hz : (P.sequence X i.2.2).infiniteRepresentativeE1 (i.1,i.2.1) z =
      (P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj X)).layerMap (i.1,i.2.1) a)
    (z' : (Subobject.underlying.obj (((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData i).Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ))
    (hz' : (P.sequence Y i.2.2).infiniteRepresentativeE1 (i.1,i.2.1) z' =
      (P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj Y)).layerMap (i.1,i.2.1)

name: _private.KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Standard.Background.0.KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Standard.canonical_convergence_natural
title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Standard.canonical_convergence_natural
code:
private theorem canonical_convergence_natural {Syn : Type u} [SyntheticCategory.{u,v} Syn]
    [HasFunctorialCofiber (C := Syn)] {H : Syn} {unit : S_0_0 ⟶ H}
    {F : SyntheticAdamsFamily Syn} (P : SyntheticTowerPresentation unit F)
    {X Y : Syn} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (cx : SyntheticTowerConvergence P X) (cy : SyntheticTowerConvergence P Y) :
    Nonempty (ConvergentMap F f cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence) := by
  let hpres : ∀ (s : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ),
      ∃ φ : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat ℤ) ⟶
        (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F s p) : ModuleCat ℤ),
        φ ≫ ((P.filtration Y).F s p).arrow =
          ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ≫ syntheticHomotopyMap f p := by
    intro s p
    have h : ∀ b : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat ℤ),
        syntheticHomotopyMap f p (((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow b) ∈
          ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration Y).F s p) := by
      intro b
      have hb := filtration_maps P f s p _ (filtration_arrow_mem P X s p b)
      simp only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
      change (((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow b ≫ f) ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y s p
      exact hb
    exact ⟨restrict_subobject _ _ _ h, restrict_subobject_arrow _ _ _ h⟩
  refine ⟨{
    comparison := {
      eMap := (F.map f).eInftyMap
      aMap := syntheticHomotopyMap f
      filtration_compat := hpres
      reindex_eq := rfl
      iso_compat := ?_ }
    abutment_eq := rfl
    infinity_eq := rfl }⟩
  intro i
  dsimp only [SyntheticTowerConvergence.toConvergence]
  simp only [Filtration.transportGraded_self, Category.comp_id]
  apply (cancel_epi (cx.identification i).inv).mp
  letI : Epi ((P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2)) := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π _)
    infer_instance
  apply (cancel_epi ((P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2))).mp
  ext b
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (cx.canonical.1 i.1 (i.2.1-i.1) i.2.2
    (((P.filtration X).F i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2)).arrow b)).mp
      (filtration_arrow_mem P X i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) b)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := representative_of_lift (P.sequence X i.2.2) (i.1,i.2.1) a
  have hx := cx.canonical.2 i a z hz b ha.symm
  have hxi : (cx.identification i).inv
      ((P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) b) =
      ((F.obj X).sequence.ssData i).pageπ ⊤ z := by
    rw [← hx, Iso.hom_inv_id_apply]
  let a' := a ≫ (P.map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).map f)).stage i.1.toNat
  obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := representative_of_lift (P.sequence Y i.2.2) (i.1,i.2.1) a'
  have hm := mapped_representative_eq P f i a z hz z' hz'
  let b' := (hpres i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2)).choose b
  have hb' : ((P.filtration Y).F i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2)).arrow b' =
      ((P.filtration X).F i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2)).arrow b ≫ f :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (hpres i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2)).choose_spec b
  have ha' : weightHomotopyMap (i.2.1-i.1) i.2.2 Y
      (((P.filtration Y).F i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2)).arrow b') =
      a' ≫ (P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj Y)).projection i.1 := by
    rw [hb', weightMap_natural, ← ha]
    change (a ≫ (P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj X)).projection i.1) ≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).map f =
      (a ≫ (P.map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).map f)).stage i.1.toNat) ≫
        (P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj Y)).projection i.1
    calc
      _ = a ≫ ((P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj X)).projection i.1 ≫
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).map f) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = a ≫ ((P.map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).map f)).stage i.1.toNat ≫
          (P.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).obj Y)).projection i.1) :=
        congrArg (fun z => a ≫ z)
          ((P.map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i.2.2)).map f)).projection i.1).symm
      _ = _ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

  have hy := cy.canonical.2 i a' z' hz' b' ha'
  have hg : (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) ≫
      Filtration.inducedAssocGradedMap (syntheticHomotopyMap f) hpres
        i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) =
      (hpres i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2)).choose ≫
        (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) := by
    exact cokernel.π_desc _ _ _
  change (cy.identification i).hom ((F.map f).eInftyMap i
      ((cx.identification i).inv
        ((P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) b))) = _
  rw [hxi, hm, hy]
  have hg' := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hg b
  simpa only [ModuleCat.comp_apply, b', ← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] using hg'.symm
statement:

    {X Y : Syn} (f : X ⟶ Y)

code:
private theorem infinity_rep_morphism
    {E E' : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) Tridegree}
    (f : E ⟶ E') (i : Tridegree) {x : E.Page 2 i} {e : (E.ssData i).eInfty}
    (h : ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((E.ssData i).Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((E.ssData i).Z_anti le_top) ≫
        (E.ssData i).pageπ (↑(2-E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ)) z = x ∧
      (E.ssData i).pageπ ⊤ z = e) :
    ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((E'.ssData i).Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((E'.ssData i).Z_anti le_top) ≫
        (E'.ssData i).pageπ (↑(2-E'.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ)) z = f.pageMap 2 i x ∧
      (E'.ssData i).pageπ ⊤ z = f.eInftyMap i e := by
  have hstart := f.r₀_eq
  rcases E with ⟨⟨r₀,D,δ,d⟩,dd,Zs,Bs⟩
  rcases E' with ⟨⟨r₀',D',δ',d'⟩,dd',Zs',Bs'⟩
  dsimp at hstart
  subst r₀'
  obtain ⟨z,hz,he⟩ := h
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2-r₀).toNat
  refine ⟨f.toSSDataMorphism.cycleMap i ⊤ z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hs := f.toSSDataMorphism.cycleMap_ofLE_assoc i
      (r := n) (s := ⊤) le_top ((D' i).pageπ n)
    have hp := f.toSSDataMorphism.pageπ_pageMap i n
    have hq : (Subobject.ofLE ((D i).Z ⊤) ((D i).Z n) ((D i).Z_anti le_top) ≫
        (D i).pageπ n) ≫ f.toSSDataMorphism.pageMap i n =
        f.toSSDataMorphism.cycleMap i ⊤ ≫
          Subobject.ofLE ((D' i).Z ⊤) ((D' i).Z n) ((D' i).Z_anti le_top) ≫ (D' i).pageπ n := by
      rw [Category.assoc,hp]
      exact hs
    change ((Subobject.ofLE _ _ _ ≫ (D' i).pageπ n)
      (f.toSSDataMorphism.cycleMap i ⊤ z)) =
      ((f.toSSDataMorphism.pageMap i n ≫ eqToHom _) x)
    simpa only [ModuleCat.comp_apply, hz, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, n]
      using (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hq z).symm
  · have hp := f.toSSDataMorphism.pageπ_pageMap i ⊤
    change (D' i).pageπ ⊤ (f.toSSDataMorphism.cycleMap i ⊤ z) =
      f.toSSDataMorphism.pageMap i ⊤ e
    simpa only [ModuleCat.comp_apply, he] using
      (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hp z).symm
statement:
private theorem infinity_rep_morphism
    {E E' : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) Tridegree}
    (f : E ⟶ E') (i : Tridegree) {x : E.Page 2 i} {e : (E.ssData i).eInfty}
    (h : ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((E.ssData i).Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((E.ssData i).Z_anti le_top) ≫
        (E.ssData i).pageπ (↑(2-E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ)) z = x ∧
      (E.ssData i).pageπ ⊤ z = e) :
    ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((E'.ssData i).Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((E'.ssData i).Z_anti le_top) ≫
        (E'.ssData i).pageπ (↑(2-E'.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ)) z = f.pageMap 2 i x ∧
      (E'.ssData i).pageπ ⊤ z = f.eInftyMap i e

private theorem infinity_rep_map {Syn : Type u} [SyntheticCategory.{u,v} Syn]
    {F : SyntheticAdamsFamily Syn} {X Y : Syn} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (i : Tridegree) {x : (F.obj X).Page 2 i}
    {e : ((F.obj X).sequence.ssData i).eInfty}
    (h : HasInfinityRepresentative (F.obj X) 2 i x e) :
    HasInfinityRepresentative (F.obj Y) 2 i (F.pageMap g 2 i x)
      ((F.map g).eInftyMap i e) := by
  obtain ⟨hr,z,hz,he⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨z',hz',he'⟩ := infinity_rep_morphism (F.map g) i ⟨z,hz,he⟩
  exact ⟨hr,z',hz',he'⟩

    {e : ((F.obj X).sequence.ssData i).eInfty}
    (h : HasInfinityRepresentative (F.obj X) 2 i x e) :
    HasInfinityRepresentative (F.obj Y) 2 i (F.pageMap g 2 i x)
      ((F.map g).eInftyMap i e)

code:
private theorem detects_map {Syn : Type u} [SyntheticCategory.{u,v} Syn]
    [HasFunctorialCofiber (C := Syn)] {H : Syn} {unit : S_0_0 ⟶ H}
    {F : SyntheticAdamsFamily Syn} {P : SyntheticTowerPresentation unit F}
    {X Y : Syn} {g : X ⟶ Y} {cx : SyntheticTowerConvergence P X}
    {cy : SyntheticTowerConvergence P Y}
    (M : ConvergentMap F g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (i : Tridegree) {x : (F.obj X).Page 2 i}
    {a : BiHom (i.2.1-i.1) i.2.2 X}
    (h : KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Detects cx i x a) :
    KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Detects cy i (F.pageMap g 2 i x) (a ≫ g) := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, b, hb, hgr⟩ := h
  let hc := M.comparison.filtration_compat i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2)
  let b' := hc.choose b
  refine ⟨(F.map g).eInftyMap i e, infinity_rep_map g i he, b', ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hmap := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hc.choose_spec b
    have heq := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (congrFun M.abutment_eq (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2))
      (((P.filtration X).F i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2)).arrow b)
    change ((P.filtration Y).F i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2)).arrow b' = _
    exact hmap.trans (heq.trans (congrArg (fun z => z ≫ g) hb))
  · have hm := M.comparison.iso_compat i
    simp only [SyntheticTowerConvergence.toConvergence, Filtration.transportGraded_self,
      Category.comp_id] at hm
    rw [M.infinity_eq] at hm
    have hm' := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hm e
    change (cy.identification i).hom ((F.map g).eInftyMap i e) =
      Filtration.inducedAssocGradedMap M.comparison.aMap M.comparison.filtration_compat
        i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) ((cx.identification i).hom e) at hm'
    rw [hgr] at hm'
    have hg : (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) ≫
        Filtration.inducedAssocGradedMap M.comparison.aMap M.comparison.filtration_compat
          i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) =
        hc.choose ≫ (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) := by
      exact cokernel.π_desc _ _ _
    exact hm'.trans (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hg b)

private theorem familyPageMap_comp {Syn : Type u} [SyntheticCategory.{u,v} Syn]
    (F : SyntheticAdamsFamily Syn) {X Y Z : Syn} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (r : ℤ) (i : Tridegree) :
    F.pageMap (f ≫ g) r i = F.pageMap f r i ≫ F.pageMap g r i := by
  change (F.map (f ≫ g)).pageMap r i =
    (F.map f).pageMap r i ≫ (F.map g).pageMap r i
  rw [F.map_comp, SpectralSequenceMorphism.pageMap_comp]

    (F : SyntheticAdamsFamily Syn) {X Y Z : Syn} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (r : ℤ) (i : Tridegree) :
    F.pageMap (f ≫ g) r i = F.pageMap f r i ≫ F.pageMap g r i

code:
public theorem sphere_first_quotient : ∀ (s t : ℤ) (x : classical.sphere.Page 2 (s,t)),
    Detects (convergence (.quotient 1 .sphere)) (s,t,t)
      (family.pageMap (XModLambdaN.incl S_0_0 1) 2 (s,t,t)
        (by simpa only [SyntheticAdamsFamily.sphere, SyntheticAdamsSS.Page,
          Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero] using comparison.sphereE2 s t 0 x))
      ((sphereFirstQuotient nu quotients.functoriality firstQuotient s t).symm x) := by
  intro s t x
  let Z := (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).obj (nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum)
  let e : Z ≅ (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) :=
    SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.app _ ≪≫ nu.unitIso
  let q := (quotients.functoriality.functor 1).mapIso e
  let u0 : (family.obj Z).Page 2 (s,t,t+0) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero, ClassicalObject.obj] using
      comparison.nuE2 .sphere 0 s t 0 x
  let u := trPage (Int.add_zero t) u0
  let b0 := (firstQuotient .sphere 0 s t).symm x
  let b := trHom (Int.add_zero t) b0
  have hd0 := first_quotient .sphere 0 s t x
  have hd : KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Detects
      (convergence (.quotient 1 (.shift (0,0) (.nu .sphere)))) (s,t,t)
      (family.pageMap (XModLambdaN.incl Z 1) 2 (s,t,t) u) b := by
    have ht := detects_tr _ (Int.add_zero t) hd0
    have htr := pageMap_tr family (XModLambdaN.incl Z 1) (Int.add_zero t) u0
    exact htr ▸ ht
  let M := Classical.choice (canonical_convergence_natural syntheticTower q.hom
    (convergence (.quotient 1 (.shift (0,0) (.nu .sphere))))
    (convergence (.quotient 1 .sphere)))
  have hm := detects_map M (s,t,t) hd
  have hn : family.pageMap e.hom 2 (s,t,t) u =
      (by simpa only [SyntheticAdamsFamily.sphere, SyntheticAdamsSS.Page,
        Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero] using comparison.sphereE2 s t 0 x) := by
    let un0 : (family.obj Z).Page 2 (s,t,t-(0 : ℕ)) := by
      simpa only [add_zero, ClassicalObject.obj] using comparison.nuE2 .sphere 0 s t 0 x
    have h0 := comparison.sphere_nu s t 0 x
    change family.pageMap e.hom 2 (s,t,t-(0 : ℕ)) un0 = comparison.sphereE2 s t 0 x at h0
    have ht := congrArg (trPage (F := family) (X := (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum))
      (s := s) (t := t) (show t-(0 : ℕ) = t by simp)) h0
    have htr := pageMap_tr family e.hom (show t-(0 : ℕ) = t by simp) un0
    rw [htr] at ht
    simpa only [u, u0, un0, trPage, eq_mp_eq_cast, cast_cast, id_eq] using ht
  have hp : family.pageMap q.hom 2 (s,t,t)
      (family.pageMap (XModLambdaN.incl Z 1) 2 (s,t,t) u) =
      family.pageMap (XModLambdaN.incl S_0_0 1) 2 (s,t,t)
        (by simpa only [SyntheticAdamsFamily.sphere, SyntheticAdamsSS.Page,
          Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero] using comparison.sphereE2 s t 0 x) := by
    change (family.pageMap (XModLambdaN.incl Z 1) 2 (s,t,t) ≫
      family.pageMap q.hom 2 (s,t,t)) u = _
    rw [← familyPageMap_comp]
    change family.pageMap (XModLambdaN.incl Z 1 ≫ XModLambdaN.map e.hom 1) 2 (s,t,t) u = _
    rw [← XModLambdaN.incl_naturality, familyPageMap_comp]
    change family.pageMap (XModLambdaN.incl S_0_0 1) 2 (s,t,t)
      (family.pageMap e.hom 2 (s,t,t) u) = _
    rw [hn]
  have hb : b ≫ q.hom = (sphereFirstQuotient nu quotients.functoriality firstQuotient s t).symm x := by
    have hcast := linearEquiv_cast_symm
      (A := fun w => BiHom (t-s) w (XModLambdaN Z 1))
      (Int.add_zero t) (firstQuotient .sphere 0 s t) x
    exact (congrArg (fun z : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Z 1) => z ≫ q.hom) hcast).symm

public theorem classical_page_negative (X : ClassicalObject) (r s t : ℤ)
    (hs : s < 0) :
    Subsingleton ((model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).Page r (s,t)) := by
  let T := model.classicalTower.tower (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  have hi (a b : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) (h : a = b) : IsIso (T.map hab) := by
    subst b
    rw [T.map_self]
    infer_instance
  let f := T.mapAt (show s ≤ s+1 by omega)
  haveI : IsIso f := hi s.toNat (s+1).toNat (by omega) (by omega)
  have hLayer : IsZero (T.layer s) :=
    Pretriangulated.Triangle.isZero₃_of_isIso₁
      (Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk f (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι f)
        (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ f))
      (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished f) (show IsIso f from inferInstance)
  letI : Subsingleton (T.FirstPage (s,t)) := ⟨fun a b => hLayer.eq_of_tgt a b⟩
  let D := (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).ssData (s,t)
  letI : Subsingleton D.V :=
    (model.classicalTower.sequence (X.obj model.auxiliary)).ambient (s,t)
      |>.toLinearEquiv.injective.subsingleton
  exact page_subsingleton_of_ambient D _

  letI := model.coefficients.homotopy_vanishes (t : ℤ) (by exact_mod_cast ht)

    exact (Iso.homCongr (Iso.refl (Sphere (C := Spectrum) (t : ℤ))) e).injective.subsingleton
  let D := model.classical.sphere.ssData (0,t)
  letI : Subsingleton D.V :=
    (model.classicalTower.sequence (SphereSpectrum (C := Spectrum))).ambient (0,t)
      |>.toLinearEquiv.injective.subsingleton

private theorem desuspend_injective (X : Spectrum) (i : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (AbstractAdamsTower.desuspend X i) := by
  let e := (shiftFunctorAdd' Spectrum i (-1) (i - 1) (by omega)).app SphereSpectrum
  let d := (shiftFunctorCompIsoId Spectrum 1 (-1) (by omega)).app X
  intro a b h
  change e.hom ≫ (shiftFunctor Spectrum (-1 : ℤ)).map a ≫ d.hom =
    e.hom ≫ (shiftFunctor Spectrum (-1 : ℤ)).map b ≫ d.hom at h
  apply (shiftFunctor Spectrum (-1 : ℤ)).map_injective
  apply (cancel_epi e.hom).mp
  apply (cancel_mono d.hom).mp
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using h

title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Standard.homology_triangle_distinguished
code:
private theorem homology_triangle_distinguished (T : HoCofiberSequence (C := Spectrum)) :
    Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk (coefficients.object ◁ T.f) (coefficients.object ◁ T.g)
      (coefficients.object ◁ T.h ≫ (homologyShift T.X).hom) ∈ distTriang Spectrum := by
  letI := closedBackground.symmetric
  letI := closedBackground.tensorShift coefficients.object
  letI := closedBackground.tensorExact coefficients.object
  let F := tensorRight coefficients.object
  refine Pretriangulated.isomorphic_distinguished _
    (F.map_distinguished _ T.distinguished) _ ?_
  refine Pretriangulated.Triangle.isoMk _ _ (β_ coefficients.object T.X)
    (β_ coefficients.object T.Y) (β_ coefficients.object T.Z) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_right _ T.f
  · exact BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_right _ T.g
  · change (coefficients.object ◁ T.h ≫
        ((β_ coefficients.object (T.X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)).hom ≫
          ((tensorRight coefficients.object).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app T.X ≫
          (shiftFunctor Spectrum (1 : ℤ)).map (β_ coefficients.object T.X).inv)) ≫
        (shiftFunctor Spectrum (1 : ℤ)).map (β_ coefficients.object T.X).hom =
      (β_ coefficients.object T.Z).hom ≫
        (T.h ▷ coefficients.object ≫
          ((tensorRight coefficients.object).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app T.X)
    simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_right_assoc]
    rw [(shiftFunctor Spectrum (1 : ℤ)).map_id ((tensorRight coefficients.object).obj T.X)]
    exact congrArg (fun k => (β_ coefficients.object T.Z).hom ≫
      T.h ▷ coefficients.object ≫ k)
      (Category.comp_id (((tensorRight coefficients.object).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app T.X))

name: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Standard.homology_exact
title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Standard.homology_exact
code:
public theorem homology_exact (T : HoCofiberSequence (C := Spectrum)) (i : ℤ) :
    Function.Exact (modTwoHomologyMap coefficients T.g i)
      (modTwoConnecting coefficients homologyShift T i) := by
  let U := Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk (coefficients.object ◁ T.f)
    (coefficients.object ◁ T.g) (coefficients.object ◁ T.h ≫ (homologyShift T.X).hom)
  have hU : U ∈ distTriang Spectrum := homology_triangle_distinguished T
  intro z
  change AbstractAdamsTower.desuspend (coefficients.object ⊗ T.X) i
    (z ≫ U.mor₃) = 0 ↔ ∃ y, y ≫ U.mor₂ = z
  have hzero : AbstractAdamsTower.desuspend (coefficients.object ⊗ T.X) i
      (z ≫ U.mor₃) = 0 ↔ z ≫ U.mor₃ = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro hz
      apply desuspend_injective (coefficients.object ⊗ T.X) i
      simpa only [map_zero] using hz
    · intro hz
      rw [hz, map_zero]
  rw [hzero]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Pretriangulated.Triangle.coyoneda_exact₃ U hU z hz
    exact ⟨y, hy.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [Category.assoc, Pretriangulated.comp_distTriang_mor_zero₂₃ U hU, comp_zero]

private theorem infinityToPageAt_naturality
    {D D' : (ℤ × ℤ) → SSData (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)}
    (g : SSDataMorphism (ℤ × ℤ) D D') (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (n m : WithTop ℕ) (hn : n = m)
    (z : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((D p).Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ)) :
    (g.pageMap p n ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (D' p).page hn))
      ((Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((D p).Z_anti (le_top : n ≤ ⊤)) ≫ (D p).pageπ n) z) =
      (Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((D' p).Z_anti (le_top : m ≤ ⊤)) ≫ (D' p).pageπ m)
        (g.cycleMap p ⊤ z) := by
  subst m
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id]
  have h : (Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((D p).Z_anti (le_top : n ≤ ⊤)) ≫
      (D p).pageπ n) ≫ g.pageMap p n =
      g.cycleMap p ⊤ ≫ Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((D' p).Z_anti (le_top : n ≤ ⊤)) ≫
        (D' p).pageπ n := by
    rw [Category.assoc, g.pageπ_pageMap, ← Category.assoc,
      g.cycleMap_ofLE p (le_top : n ≤ ⊤)]
    exact Category.assoc _ _ _
  exact congrArg (fun m => m z) h

public theorem mappingEnriched_composition_eInfty : letI := mappingEnriched_monoidal
    ∀ (X Y Z : MappingObject (IsFiniteSpectrum (C := Spectrum))) (i j : ℤ × ℤ)
      (x : ((mappingSystem.hom X Y).underlying.E.ssData i).eInfty)
      (y : ((mappingSystem.hom Y Z).underlying.E.ssData j).eInfty),
      let f : (mappingSystem.hom X Y ⊗ mappingSystem.hom Y Z) ⟶ mappingSystem.hom X Z :=
        eqToHom (congrArg₂ (fun A B : ConvergingSequence.{0,0} ℤ => A ⊗ B)
          (mappingEnriched_hom_eq X Y).symm (mappingEnriched_hom_eq Y Z).symm) ≫ mappingEnriched_enriched.comp X Y Z ≫
            eqToHom (mappingEnriched_hom_eq X Z)
      f.sequence.eInftyMap (i+j) ((mappingEnriched_tensorPairing X Y Z).eInftyPair i j x y) =
        (mappingComposition.pairing X Y Z).eInftyPair i j x y := by
  letI := mappingEnriched_monoidal
  intro X Y Z i j x y
  let f : (mappingSystem.hom X Y ⊗ mappingSystem.hom Y Z) ⟶ mappingSystem.hom X Z :=
    eqToHom (congrArg₂ (fun A B : ConvergingSequence.{0,0} ℤ => A ⊗ B)
      (mappingEnriched_hom_eq X Y).symm (mappingEnriched_hom_eq Y Z).symm) ≫
        mappingEnriched_enriched.comp X Y Z ≫ eqToHom (mappingEnriched_hom_eq X Z)
  let P := mappingEnriched_tensorPairing X Y Z
  let Q := mappingComposition.pairing X Y Z
  haveI : Epi (((mappingSystem.hom X Y).underlying.E.ssData i).pageπ ⊤) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  haveI : Epi (((mappingSystem.hom Y Z).underlying.E.ssData j).pageπ ⊤) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective
    (((mappingSystem.hom X Y).underlying.E.ssData i).pageπ ⊤)).mp inferInstance x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective
    (((mappingSystem.hom Y Z).underlying.E.ssData j).pageπ ⊤)).mp inferInstance y
  have h₀ (U V : MappingObject (IsFiniteSpectrum (C := Spectrum))) :
      (mappingSystem.hom U V).underlying.E.r₀ ≤ 2 :=
    le_of_eq (classical.firstPage _)
  have hT : (mappingSystem.hom X Y ⊗ mappingSystem.hom Y Z).underlying.E.r₀ ≤ 2 :=
    f.sequence.r₀_eq.le.trans (h₀ X Z)
  have h := mappingEnriched_composition_page X Y Z 2 i j
    (infinityToPage _ 2 i a) (infinityToPage _ 2 j b)
  change f.sequence.pageMap 2 (i+j)
      (P.ssPairing.pair 2 i j (infinityToPage _ 2 i a) (infinityToPage _ 2 j b)) =
    Q.ssPairing.pair 2 i j (infinityToPage _ 2 i a) (infinityToPage _ 2 j b) at h
  rw [P.finitePagePair_compatible 2 i j (h₀ X Y) (h₀ Y Z) hT,
    infinityToPage_naturality,
    Q.finitePagePair_compatible 2 i j (h₀ X Y) (h₀ Y Z) (h₀ X Z)] at h

  change DirectSum.toAddMonoid
    (fun v : ℤ => (DirectSum.of (WeightHom X Y) (v-1)).comp
      (Preadditive.leftComp Y

    (DirectSum.of (WeightHom X Y) w f) =
      DirectSum.of (WeightHom X Y) (w-1) (weightHomLambda f)

  change DirectSum.of (WeightHom X Y) (w-1)
      ((weightHomLambda (X := X) (𝟙 ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,w)).obj X))) ≫ f) =
    DirectSum.of (WeightHom X Y) (w-1) (weightHomLambda f)
  apply congrArg (DirectSum.of (WeightHom X Y) (w-1))
  dsimp only [weightHomLambda, Functor.id_obj, Functor.comp_obj]
  rw [Category.comp_id, Category.assoc]

          map_zero' := by

            rw [Functor.map_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero, map_zero]
          map_add' := by
            intro f f'
            dsimp only [weightHomComp]
            rw [Functor.map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, map_add] }

        rw [DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
        change weightHomInclusion (a+b) (weightHomComp f (0 : WeightHom Y Z b)) = 0
        dsimp only [weightHomComp]

        change (DirectSum.toAddMonoid (γ := TotalWeightHom X Z) _)
          (DirectSum.of (WeightHom X Y) a f) =

            (DirectSum.of (WeightHom X Y) a f) +
          (DirectSum.toAddMonoid (γ := TotalWeightHom X Z) _)

        rw [DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
        change weightHomInclusion (a+b) (weightHomComp f (g+g')) =

      totalComp W X Z (totalComp X Y Z h g) f := by
  induction f using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | add f f' hf hf' => simp only [map_add, hf, hf']
  | of a f =>
    induction g using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
    | add g g' hg hg' => simp only [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hg, hg']
    | of b g =>
      induction h using DirectSum.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
      | add h h' hh hh' => simp only [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hh, hh']
      | of c h =>
        change totalComp W Y Z (weightHomInclusion c h)
          (totalComp W X Y (weightHomInclusion b g) (weightHomInclusion a f)) =
          totalComp W X Z (totalComp X Y Z (weightHomInclusion c h) (weightHomInclusion b g))
            (weightHomInclusion a f)
        rw [totalComp_of, totalComp_of, totalComp_of, totalComp_of]
        exact homogeneous_assoc quotients.coherence a b c f g h

private theorem totalComp_assoc (W X Y Z : SyntheticSpectrum)
    (f : TotalWeightHom W X) (g : TotalWeightHom X Y) (h : TotalWeightHom Y Z) :
    totalComp W Y Z h (totalComp W X Y g f) =
      totalComp W X Z (totalComp X Y Z h g) f

title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Standard.totalComp_lambda_central
code:
private theorem totalComp_lambda_central (X Y : SyntheticSpectrum) (f : TotalWeightHom X Y) :
    totalComp X X Y f (weightHomInclusion (-1) (SyntheticCategory.lam.app X)) =
      totalComp X Y Y (weightHomInclusion (-1) (SyntheticCategory.lam.app Y)) f := by
  induction f using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
  | add f f' hf hf' => simp only [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hf, hf']
  | of w f =>
    change totalComp X X Y (weightHomInclusion w f) _ = totalComp X Y Y _ (weightHomInclusion w f)
    rw [totalComp_of, totalComp_of]
    rw [homogeneous_regrade (-1) w (w-1) (by omega), homogeneous_regrade w (-1) (w-1) (by omega)]
    apply congrArg (weightHomInclusion (w-1))
    rw [SyntheticCategory.lam.naturality]
    rw [lambda_comm_named (0,w) (0,w-1) (by ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg]) (by ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]) X]
    repeat rw [Category.assoc]
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc, Functor.id_map]

title: KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Standard.additive_polynomial_smul
code:
private theorem additive_polynomial_smul {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module (Polynomial ℤ) M] [Module (Polynomial ℤ) N]
    (f : M →+ N)
    (hX : ∀ m, f ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) • m) = (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) • f m)
    (p : Polynomial ℤ) (m : M) : f (p • m) = p • f m := by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on generalizing m with
  | C a =>
    have ha : (Polynomial.C a : Polynomial ℤ) = (a : Polynomial ℤ) := Polynomial.C_eq_intCast a
    rw [ha]
    exact map_intCast_smul f (Polynomial ℤ) (Polynomial ℤ) a m
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [add_smul, map_add, hp, hq]
  | monomial n a ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [mul_smul, ih, hX]
    simp only [mul_smul]
statement:
private theorem additive_polynomial_smul {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module (Polynomial ℤ) M] [Module (Polynomial ℤ) N]
    (f : M →+ N)
    (hX : ∀ m, f ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) • m) = (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) • f m)
    (p : Polynomial ℤ) (m : M) : f (p • m) = p • f m

  intro X Y Z
  letI := graded_module X Y
  letI := graded_module Y Z
  letI := graded_module X Z

    totalComp X Y Z

    { toFun := fun g =>
        { toFun := C g

            intro p f
            apply additive_polynomial_smul (C g) (fun f => ?_) p f
            change totalComp X Y Z g ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) • f) =
              (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) • totalComp X Y Z g f

      map_add' := by
        intro g g'
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro f
        exact congrArg (fun h : TotalWeightHom X Y →+ TotalWeightHom X Z => h f) ((totalComp X Y Z).map_add g g') }
  exact
    { toFun := F

        apply additive_polynomial_smul F (fun g => ?_) p g
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro f
        change totalComp X Y Z ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) • g) f =
          (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) • totalComp X Y Z g f
        rw [graded_X_smul, graded_X_smul]
        exact totalComp_lambda_left X Y Z f g }

  have h := sphereProduct_milnor 1 64 1 64 standardH6 standardH6
  simp only [standardH6Square_eq_product] at ⊢
  change sphereE2_milnorEquiv 2 128

  change sphereE2_milnorEquiv 2 128
    (sphereAlgebra.product (1,64) (1,64) standardH6 standardH6) = _ at h
  rw [h]

    standardHi_milnor 6
  rw [hh]
  exact (Milnor.hiSquare_eq_cup 6).symm

      map X s t w₁ w₃ (h₁₂.trans h₂₃) h₃

      (s t w₁ w₂ : ℤ) (hw : w₁ ≤ w₂) (ht : w₂ ≤ t),
    (D.family.map (D.nu.functor.map f)).eInftyMap (s,t,w₂) ≫ map Y s t w₁ w₂ hw ht =
      map X s t w₁ w₂ hw ht ≫ (D.family.map (D.nu.functor.map f)).eInftyMap (s,t,w₁)

      (hw : w₁ ≤ w₂) (ht : w₂ ≤ t)

      (z : ((D.family.obj (D.nu.functor.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary))).sequence.ssData (s,t,w₂)).eInfty),
    HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,t,w₂) (nuWeightLabel D X s t w₂ ht x) z →

    e.comparison 2 128 (by decide)
      (P.product 1 64 1 64 (P.atom .h6) (P.atom .h6)) =
      D.standardClasses.standardH6Square := by
  have h := e.comparison_mul 1 64 1 64 (by decide) (P.atom .h6) (P.atom .h6)

    D.sphereAlgebra.product (1,64) (1,64)
      (e.comparison 1 64 _ (P.atom .h6)) (e.comparison 1 64 _ (P.atom .h6)) at h
  rw [e.h6] at h
  exact h

public theorem basis_correct (d : Raw.Degree) (hd : d ∈ Raw.degrees) : BasisCorrect d := by
  rcases d with ⟨o,s,t,ms⟩
  cases o with
  | sphere =>
    have hc := basis_count ⟨.sphere,s,t,ms⟩ hd rfl
    have ht := table_degree_bound ⟨.sphere,s,t,ms⟩ hd
    dsimp only at hc ht
    change ∃ e : model.classical.sphere.Page 2 (s,t) ≃ₗ[ℤ] (Fin ms.length →₀ ZMod 2),
      ∀ i, e.symm (Finsupp.single i 1) = sphereBasis s t i.val
    rw [← hc]
    refine ⟨Standard.coordinates s t ht, ?_⟩
    intro i
    simp only [sphereBasis, dif_pos ht, dif_pos i.isLt]
  | nuCofiber => exact cofiber_basis_correct ⟨.nuCofiber,s,t,ms⟩ hd rfl

private theorem value_comparison (e : Expression) (ht : e.degree.2 ≤ 261) :
    e.value = Standard.comparison e.degree.1 e.degree.2 ht (sourceValue e) := by
  induction e with
  | one => exact Standard.comparison_unit.symm
  | named a => rfl
  | generator id s t =>
    change t ≤ 261 at ht
    change generatorImage id s t = Standard.comparison s t ht
      (sourceValue (.generator id s t))
    dsimp only [generatorImage, sourceValue]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | exact (map_zero _).symm
  | mul a b iha ihb =>
    have ha : a.degree.2 ≤ 261 := by change a.degree.2 + b.degree.2 ≤ 261 at ht; omega
    have hb : b.degree.2 ≤ 261 := by change a.degree.2 + b.degree.2 ≤ 261 at ht; omega
    have h := (Standard.comparison_product a.degree.1 a.degree.2 b.degree.1 b.degree.2
      ht (sourceValue a) (sourceValue b)).symm
    change Standard.product a.value b.value _ = _
    rw [iha ha, ihb hb]
    delta Standard.product
    simpa [Expression.degree, sourceValue, Nat.cast_add] using h

  if ht : t ≤ 261 then
    if hi : id < Standard.archive.generators.count then
      if hd : Standard.archive.generators.degree ⟨id,hi⟩ = (s,t) then
        Standard.comparison s t ht
          ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => Standard.sourceData.component p.1 p.2) hd))
            (Standard.sourceGenerator ⟨id,hi⟩))
      else 0
    else 0
  else 0

  | .generator id s t => generatorImage id s t
  | .mul a b => Standard.product a.value b.value
      (by simp only [Expression.degree, Prod.mk_add_mk, Nat.cast_add])

private theorem cycleLabel_factor (X : ClassicalObject) (p : Bidegree)
    (a b : WithTop ℕ) (h : a ≤ b) :
    let E := (D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)).ssData p
    Subobject.ofLE (E.Z b) (E.Z a) (E.Z_anti h) ≫ cycleLabel D X a p =
      cycleLabel D X b p := by
  dsimp [cycleLabel]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]

public theorem cycles_antitone (X : ClassicalObject) (p : Bidegree) :
    Antitone (fun c => cycles D X c p) := by
  intro a b hab x hx
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
  have h : (↑(a-1).toNat : WithTop ℕ) ≤ ↑(b-1).toNat := by
    exact_mod_cast (show (a-1).toNat ≤ (b-1).toNat by omega)
  refine ⟨(Subobject.ofLE _ _ (((D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)).ssData p).Z_anti h)) z, ?_⟩
  exact congrArg (fun f => f z) (cycleLabel_factor D X p _ _ h)

    Antitone (fun c => cycles D X c p)

private theorem EInfinityCompatibility.lambda_epi {P : EInfinityPresentation D}
    {S : InfinityShiftCoordinates D} (R : EInfinityCompatibility D P S)
    (X : ClassicalObject) (k : ℕ) (p : Bidegree) (w : ℤ) (hw : w ≤ p.2) :
    Epi (S.lambdaMap D (.nu X) k p w) := by
  apply (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := permanentQuotientMap_surjective D X
    (show 1+p.2-w ≤ 1+p.2-(w-k) by omega) p
    (P.nuWindow D X p (w-k) (by omega) y)
  refine ⟨(P.nuWindow D X p w hw).symm z, ?_⟩
  apply (P.nuWindow D X p (w-k) (by omega)).injective
  rw [R.lambda_nu X k p w hw]
  simpa only [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hz

public def MayContext.SignedBoundary (B : MayContext Syn) : Prop :=
  letI := B.leftShift; letI := B.rightShift
  letI := B.leftExact; letI := B.rightExact
  ∀ (T U : HoCofiberSequence (C := Syn)) (n : ℤ)
    (a : HomotopyGroup n (T.X ⊗ U.Z)) (b : HomotopyGroup n (T.Y ⊗ U.Y)),
    inducedMap (T.f ▷ U.Z) n a = inducedMap (T.Y ◁ U.g) n b →
    ∃ c : HomotopyGroup n (T.Z ⊗ U.X),
      inducedMap (T.g ▷ U.Y) n b = inducedMap (T.Z ◁ U.f) n c ∧
      connectingHomomorphism (U.map (tensorLeft T.X)) n a =
        -(connectingHomomorphism (T.map (tensorRight U.X)) n c)

name: _private.KIP126.Literature.May.0.KIP126.Literature.Route.may_signed_boundary_of_source
title: KIP126.Literature.Route.may_signed_boundary_of_source
code:
private theorem may_signed_boundary_of_source (B : MayContext Syn)
    (hB : MaySourceResults Syn B) : B.SignedBoundary := by
  letI := B.leftShift
  letI := B.rightShift
  letI := B.leftExact
  letI := B.rightExact
  intro T U n a b hab
  rcases hB T U with ⟨P⟩
  rcases P.lift n a b hab with ⟨z, hza, hzb⟩
  refine ⟨z ≫ P.j3, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change b ≫ (T.g ▷ U.Y) = (z ≫ P.j3) ≫ (T.Z ◁ U.f)
    rw [← hzb, Category.assoc, P.other_square, Category.assoc]
  · have hs : a ≫ (U.map (tensorLeft T.X)).h =
        -((z ≫ P.j3) ≫ (T.map (tensorRight U.X)).h) := by
      rw [← hza, Category.assoc, P.boundary]
      simp only [Preadditive.comp_neg, Category.assoc]
    simp only [connectingHomomorphism, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk,
      hs, Functor.map_neg, Preadditive.comp_neg, Preadditive.neg_comp]
    rfl
statement:
private theorem may_signed_boundary_of_source (B : MayContext Syn)
    (hB : MaySourceResults Syn B) : B.SignedBoundary

title: KIP126.Literature.Route.may_boundary_projected_of_exponent_two
code:
private theorem may_boundary_projected_of_exponent_two (B : MayContext Syn)
    (hB : MaySourceResults Syn B) (T U : HoCofiberSequence (C := Syn))
    (n : ℤ) (a : HomotopyGroup n (T.X ⊗ U.Z))
    (b : HomotopyGroup n (T.Y ⊗ U.Y))
    (hab : inducedMap (T.f ▷ U.Z) n a = inducedMap (T.Y ◁ U.g) n b)
    {G : Type w} [AddCommGroup G]
    (q : HomotopyGroup (n-1) (T.X ⊗ U.X) →+ G)
    (htwo : ∀ x, q x + q x = 0) :
    letI := B.leftShift; letI := B.rightShift
    letI := B.leftExact; letI := B.rightExact
    ∃ c : HomotopyGroup n (T.Z ⊗ U.X),
      inducedMap (T.g ▷ U.Y) n b = inducedMap (T.Z ◁ U.f) n c ∧
      q (connectingHomomorphism (U.map (tensorLeft T.X)) n a) =
        q (connectingHomomorphism (T.map (tensorRight U.X)) n c) := by
  letI := B.leftShift
  letI := B.rightShift
  letI := B.leftExact
  letI := B.rightExact
  rcases may_signed_boundary_of_source B hB T U n a b hab with ⟨c, hc, hboundary⟩
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  rw [hboundary, map_neg]
  exact neg_eq_of_add_eq_zero_right (htwo _)

    (b : HomotopyGroup n (T.Y ⊗ U.Y))
    (hab : inducedMap (T.f ▷ U.Z) n a = inducedMap (T.Y ◁ U.g) n b)
    {G : Type w} [AddCommGroup G]

    (htwo : ∀ x, q x + q x = 0) :
    letI

    {i j k : ℤ × ℤ} (x : (sequence S W Z).Page r (degree r i j k))
    (a : (sequence S W X).Page r i) (b : (sequence S X Y).Page r j)

    precedingDifferential S X Z r j k z = (M.pairing X Y Z).ssPairing.pair (r-1) j k b' c' ∧
    Passage S W Z r (degree r i j k) (definingValue S M W X Y Z r i j k a' c' y z) x

code:
public def StatementAt (W X Y Z : MappingObject scope) : Prop :=
  ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 3 ≤ r) (i j k : ℤ × ℤ),
    WeakConvergence (P := P) (B := B) W Y → WeakConvergence (P := P) (B := B) X Z →
    ∀ (a : (sequence S W X).Page r i) (b : (sequence S X Y).Page r j)
      (c : (sequence S Y Z).Page r k)
      (α : abutment (B := B) W X (stem i)) (β : abutment (B := B) X Y (stem j))
      (γ : abutment (B := B) Y Z (stem k)),
    let f := shiftMap W X i (stem j+stem k) α
    let g := shiftMap X Y j (stem k) β
    let h := abutmentMap Y Z k γ
    DetectsAbutment S W X r i a α → DetectsAbutment S X Y r j b β →
    DetectsAbutment S Y Z r k c γ →
    (M.pairing W X Y).ssPairing.pair r i j a b = 0 →
    (M.pairing X Y Z).ssPairing.pair r j k b c = 0 →
    f ≫ g = 0 → g ≫ h = 0 → NoMossCrossingForProducts S W X Y Z r i j k →
    ∃ (x : (sequence S W Z).Page r (PageMassey.degree r i j k))
      (ξ : abutment (B := B) W Z (stem (PageMassey.degree r i j k))),
      PageMassey.Relation S M r hr x a b c ∧
      PermanentCycle S W Z r (PageMassey.degree r i j k) x ∧
      DetectsAbutment S W Z r (PageMassey.degree r i j k) x ξ ∧
      KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.Relation (todaMap r W Z i j k ξ) f g h

public def StatementAt (W X Y Z : MappingObject scope) : Prop :=

    WeakConvergence (P := P) (B := B) W Y → WeakConvergence (P := P) (B := B) X Z →
    ∀ (a : (sequence S W X).Page r i) (b : (sequence S X Y).Page r j)
      (c : (sequence S Y Z).Page r k)
      (α : abutment (B := B) W X (stem i)) (β : abutment (B := B) X Y (stem j))
      (γ : abutment (B := B) Y Z (stem k)),
    let f := shiftMap W X i (stem j+stem k) α
    let g := shiftMap X Y j (stem k) β
    let h := abutmentMap Y Z k γ
    DetectsAbutment S W X r i a α → DetectsAbutment S X Y r j b β →
    DetectsAbutment S Y Z r k c γ →
    (M.pairing W X Y).ssPairing.pair r i j a b = 0 →
    (M.pairing X Y Z).ssPairing.pair r j k b c = 0 →
    f ≫ g = 0 → g ≫ h = 0 → NoMossCrossingForProducts S W X Y Z r i j k →
    ∃ (x : (sequence S W Z).Page r (PageMassey.degree r i j k))
      (ξ : abutment (B := B) W Z (stem (PageMassey.degree r i j k))),
      PageMassey.Relation S M r hr x a b c ∧
      PermanentCycle S W Z r (PageMassey.degree r i j k) x ∧
      DetectsAbutment S W Z r (PageMassey.degree r i j k) x ξ ∧
      KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.Relation (todaMap r W Z i j k ξ) f g h

private theorem bhsRealizeNuZeroNatural (R : RealizationCoordinates D)
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.auxiliary)
    {m w : ℤ} (a : BiHom m w (nuZero D X)) :
    realizeNuZero D R Y
        (a ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).map (D.nu.functor.map f)) =
      realizeNuZero D R X a ≫ f := by
  have hz := SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.naturality (D.nu.functor.map f)
  have hr := D.recovery.nuRealizationIso.hom.naturality f
  dsimp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map] at hz hr
  have hmap := congrArg
    (fun z => D.recovery.realization.map z ≫
      D.recovery.nuRealizationIso.hom.app (Y.obj D.auxiliary)) hz
  simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] at hmap
  rw [hr] at hmap
  unfold realizeNuZero
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
    (fun z => (R.sphere m w).hom ≫ D.recovery.realization.map a ≫ z) hmap
statement:
private theorem bhsRealizeNuZeroNatural (R : RealizationCoordinates D)
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.auxiliary)
    {m w : ℤ} (a : BiHom m w (nuZero D X)) :
    realizeNuZero D R Y
        (a ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).map (D.nu.functor.map f)) =
      realizeNuZero D R X a ≫ f

    {X : Syn} (m w : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (a : BiHom m w X) :
    (R.sphere m (w-k)).hom ≫ D.recovery.realization.map (lambdaMultiply k a) =

    dsimp only [lambdaMultiply]

private theorem bhsRealizationZeroOfLambdaTorsion (R : RealizationCoordinates D)
    {X : Syn} {m w : ℤ} (a : BiHom m w X)
    (ha : ∃ k : ℕ, lambdaMultiply k a = 0) :
    D.recovery.realization.map a = 0 := by
  letI := R.additive
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := ha
  have h := bhsRealizationLambdaAction D R m w k a
  rw [hk, Functor.map_zero, comp_zero] at h
  apply (cancel_epi (R.sphere m w).hom).mp
  simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [comp_zero] using h.symm

code:
private theorem bhsFiltrationPostcompose {X Y : Syn} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    {m w : ℤ} (s : ℤ) (a : BiHom m w X)
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast D.syntheticTower s a) :
    FiltrationAtLeast D.syntheticTower s (a ≫ g) := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := ha
  change b ≫ (D.syntheticTower.tower X).projection s = a at hb
  refine ⟨b ≫ (D.syntheticTower.map g).stage s.toNat, ?_⟩
  change (b ≫ (D.syntheticTower.map g).stage s.toNat) ≫
      (D.syntheticTower.tower Y).projection s = a ≫ g
  rw [Category.assoc, TowerMap.projection, ← Category.assoc, hb]

code:
private theorem bhsLambdaDivisiblePostcompose
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.auxiliary)
    (m w s : ℤ) (h : w-m ≤ s)
    (a : BiHom m w (D.nu.functor.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)))
    (ha : LambdaDivisible D X m w s h a) :
    LambdaDivisible D Y m w s h (a ≫ D.nu.functor.map f) := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨b ≫ D.nu.functor.map f, ?_⟩
  have hs : m+s - ((m+s-w).toNat : ℤ) = w := by
    rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)]
    omega
  change homotopyRegrade rfl hs
      (lambdaMultiply (m+s-w).toNat (b ≫ D.nu.functor.map f)) = a ≫ D.nu.functor.map f
  rw [bhsLambdaMultiplyPostcompose]
  rw [bhsHomotopyRegradePostcompose, hb]

    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.auxiliary)

    (a : BiHom m w (D.nu.functor.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)))
    (ha : LambdaDivisible D X m w s h a) :
    LambdaDivisible D Y m w s h (a ≫ D.nu.functor.map f)

code:
private theorem bhsPermanentLiftTransport
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.auxiliary)
    (s t : ℤ) (x : (D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)).Page 2 (s,t))
    (source : PermanentLiftAt D Y)
    (cycles : ClassicalPermanentCycle D X (s,t) x ↔
      ClassicalPermanentCycle D Y (s,t) ((D.classical.map f).pageMap 2 (s,t) x))
    (lifts : (∃ b : BiHom (t-s) t (nuZero D Y),
        quotientClass 1 b = firstLabel D Y s t ((D.classical.map f).pageMap 2 (s,t) x)) ↔
      ∃ a : BiHom (t-s) t (nuZero D X), quotientClass 1 a = firstLabel D X s t x) :
    ClassicalPermanentCycle D X (s,t) x ↔
      ∃ a : BiHom (t-s) t (nuZero D X), quotientClass 1 a = firstLabel D X s t x :=
  cycles.trans ((source s t _).trans lifts)
statement:

public theorem eta_exponent :
  normalizedExponent model.classicalTower model.auxiliary.etaMap = 1 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_, _, b, hb, _⟩ := eta_detection
  have hmem : model.auxiliary.etaMap ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _
      ((model.classicalTower.tower SphereSpectrum).filtration.F 1 1) := by
    change ∃ b, ((model.classicalTower.tower SphereSpectrum).filtration.F 1 1).arrow.hom b = _
    exact ⟨b, hb⟩
  simp only [AbstractAdamsTower.filtration, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] at hmem
  obtain ⟨lift, hlift⟩ := hmem
  have hF : MapFiltrationAtLeast model.classicalTower model.auxiliary.etaMap 1 :=
    ⟨lift, hlift⟩
  change (if MapFiltrationAtLeast model.classicalTower model.auxiliary.etaMap 1 then 1 else 0) = 1
  exact if_pos hF

name: KIP126.Literature.Standard.tmf_convergence
title: KIP126.Literature.Standard.tmf_convergence
code:
public def tmf_convergence :
  ClassicalTowerConvergence model.classicalTower tmf := by
  let e : tmf ≅ model.auxiliary.detector := tmfIso
  let c : ClassicalTowerConvergence model.classicalTower model.auxiliary.detector :=
    model.classicalConvergence .detector
  have tmf_filtration_map {X Y : Spectrum} (f : X ⟶ Y) (s m : ℤ) (x : HomotopyGroup m X)
      (hx : x ∈ (model.classicalTower.tower X).filtrationSubmodule s m) :
      x ≫ f ∈ (model.classicalTower.tower Y).filtrationSubmodule s m := by
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨a ≫ (model.classicalTower.map f).stage s.toNat, ?_⟩
    change (a ≫ (model.classicalTower.map f).stage s.toNat) ≫ (model.classicalTower.tower Y).projection s =
      (a ≫ (model.classicalTower.tower X).projection s) ≫ f
    rw [Category.assoc, (model.classicalTower.map f).projection s, ← Category.assoc]

  have tmf_filtration_iso_mem {X Y : Spectrum} (e : X ≅ Y) (s m : ℤ)
      (x : AbstractAdamsTower.homotopy X m) :
      x ≫ e.hom ∈
          ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((model.classicalTower.tower Y).filtration.F s m) ↔
        x ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((model.classicalTower.tower X).filtration.F s m) := by
    simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [AbstractAdamsTower.filtration, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
    change x ≫ e.hom ∈ (model.classicalTower.tower Y).filtrationSubmodule s m ↔
      x ∈ (model.classicalTower.tower X).filtrationSubmodule s m
    constructor
    · intro hx
      simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc, e.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id] using
        tmf_filtration_map e.inv s m (x ≫ e.hom) hx
    · exact tmf_filtration_map e.hom s m x

  have tmf_quotient_iso {R : Type} [Ring R] {M N : ModuleCat.{0} R}
      (B Z : Subobject M) (B' Z' : Subobject N) (h : B ≤ Z) (h' : B' ≤ Z')
      (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N)
      (hB : ∀ x, e x ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule N) B' ↔ x ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule M) B)
      (hZ : ∀ x, e x ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule N) Z' ↔ x ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule M) Z) :
      ∃ q : cokernel (Subobject.ofLE B Z h) ≅ cokernel (Subobject.ofLE B' Z' h'),
        ∀ a : (Subobject.underlying.obj Z : ModuleCat R),
          ∃ b : (Subobject.underlying.obj Z' : ModuleCat R),
            Z'.arrow b = e (Z.arrow a) ∧
            q.hom (cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE B Z h) a) =
              cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE B' Z' h') b := by
    have restrict (S : Subobject M) (T : Subobject N)
        (he : ∀ x, e x ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule N) T ↔ x ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule M) S) :
        ∃ w : Subobject.underlying.obj S ≅ Subobject.underlying.obj T,
          ∀ a, T.arrow (w.hom a) = e (S.arrow a) := by
      let a := LinearEquiv.ofInjective S.arrow.hom ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)
      let b := LinearEquiv.ofInjective T.arrow.hom ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)
      have hm : ((ModuleCat.subobjectModule M) S).map e.toLinearMap =
          (ModuleCat.subobjectModule N) T := by
        ext y
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
          exact (he x).2 hx
        · intro hy
          refine ⟨e.symm y, (he (e.symm y)).1 ?_, e.apply_symm_apply y⟩
          simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [e.apply_symm_apply] using hy
      let c := e.ofSubmodules ((ModuleCat.subobjectModule M) S) ((ModuleCat.subobjectModule N) T) hm
      refine ⟨((a.trans c).trans b.symm).toModuleIso, ?_⟩
      intro x
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (b.apply_symm_apply (c (a x)))
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := restrict B B' hB
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := restrict Z Z' hZ
    have comm : Subobject.ofLE B Z h ≫ z.hom = b.hom ≫ Subobject.ofLE B' Z' h' := by
      apply (cancel_mono Z'.arrow).1
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      change Z'.arrow (z.hom (Subobject.ofLE B Z h x)) =
        Z'.arrow (Subobject.ofLE B' Z' h' (b.hom x))
      rw [hz]
      have hs := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) (Subobject.ofLE_arrow h)
      have ht := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (b.hom x)) (Subobject.ofLE_arrow h')
      change Z.arrow (Subobject.ofLE B Z h x) = B.arrow x at hs
      change Z'.arrow (Subobject.ofLE B' Z' h' (b.hom x)) = B'.arrow (b.hom x) at ht
      rw [hs, ht, hb]
    let q := cokernel.mapIso (Subobject.ofLE B Z h) (Subobject.ofLE B' Z' h') b z comm
    refine ⟨q, fun a => ⟨z.hom a, hz a, ?_⟩⟩
    have hq : cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE B Z h) ≫ q.hom =
        z.hom ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE B' Z' h') := by
      simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [q, cokernel.mapIso_hom, cokernel.map, cokernel.π_desc]
    exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom a) hq
  let homotopyIso (m : ℤ) :
      AbstractAdamsTower.homotopy tmf m ≅ AbstractAdamsTower.homotopy model.auxiliary.detector m := {

      let Q : Prop := r ≤ two

      let D := E.sequence.ssData p
      let pageN : ℕ → A := fun n => D.page (n : WithTop ℕ)

      let hObjTwo : objTwo=objZero := @congrArg ℕ A nTwo nZero pageN hTwo
      let hObjTwoSymm : objZero=objTwo := @Eq.symm A objTwo objZero hObjTwo
      let hObj : objR=objTwo := @Eq.trans A objR objZero objTwo hObjR hObjTwoSymm
      eqToIso hObj

      rw [Category.assoc, (Subobject.isPullback (φ i) ((D' i).B ⊤)).w,

name: _private.KIP126.Literature.Standard.0.KIP126.Literature.Standard.projection_isIso_of_retained_labels
title: KIP126.Literature.Standard.projection_isIso_of_retained_labels
code:
private theorem projection_isIso_of_retained_labels
    {A B Q R : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ} (e : Q ≅ R) (f : A ⟶ Q)
    (label : B → A) (hlabel : Function.Bijective label)
    (hR : R = B) (hret : ∀ x : B, HEq (e.hom (f (label x))) x) :
    IsIso f := by
  subst R
  have hret' (x : B) : e.hom (f (label x)) = x := eq_of_heq (hret x)
  have he : Function.Bijective e.hom := ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hlabel.surjective a
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hlabel.surjective b
    apply congrArg label
    have hcxy := congrArg e.hom hab
    simpa only [hret'] using hcxy
  · intro b
    refine ⟨label (e.hom b), ?_⟩
    apply he.injective
    exact hret' (e.hom b)
statement:

    (label : B → A) (hlabel : Function.Bijective label)
    (hR : R = B) (hret : ∀ x : B, HEq (e.hom (f (label x))) x) :
    IsIso f

private theorem finiteQuotientRetainedImpl :
  ∀ (X : ClassicalObject) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n),
  ∀ (s t w : ℤ), 0 ≤ t-w ∧ t-w < n →
    IsIso ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) n).pageMap 2 (s,t,w)) := by
  intro X n hn s t w hstrip
  have hw : w ≤ t := by omega
  let zeroIso := SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.app
    (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
  let zeroPage := retainedLabelPageIso (model.family.functor.mapIso zeroIso) 2
    (s,t,t-(t-w).toNat)
  have hzero : Function.Bijective zeroPage.hom :=
    ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _
  have hlabel : Function.Bijective (nuWeightLabel model X s t w hw) := by
    change Function.Bijective (fun x => nuWeightLabel model X s t w hw x)
    dsimp only [nuWeightLabel, regradeE2, targetNuLabel]
    apply Function.Bijective.comp
    · exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _
    · apply Function.Bijective.comp
      · exact hzero
      · change Function.Bijective
          ((fun z : (model.family.obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).obj
              (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)))).E₂
                (s,t,t+0-(t-w).toNat) =>
            Eq.mp (by simp only [add_zero]) z) ∘
              (model.comparison.nuE2 X 0 s t (t-w).toNat))
        exact (Equiv.cast _).bijective.comp
          (model.comparison.nuE2 X 0 s t (t-w).toNat).bijective
  apply projection_isIso_of_retained_labels (finite_quotient_component X n hn s t w)
    ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) n).pageMap
      2 (s,t,w)) (nuWeightLabel model X s t w hw) hlabel
    (by
      change (if 0 ≤ t-w ∧ t-w < n then
        (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).Page 2 (s,t) else ModuleCat.of ℤ PUnit) = _
      exact if_pos hstrip)
  intro x
  exact finite_quotient_component_retained X n hn s t w hstrip x

name: KIP126.Literature.Standard.finite_quotient_vanishing
title: KIP126.Literature.Standard.finite_quotient_vanishing
code:
public theorem finite_quotient_vanishing :
  ∀ (X : ClassicalObject) (n : ℕ), 0 < n →
    ∀ (r : ℤ), 2 ≤ r → ∀ (s t w : ℤ), (t-w < 0 ∨ (n : ℤ) ≤ t-w) →
      IsZero ((model.family.quotient (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) n).Page r (s,t,w)) := by
  intro X n hn r hr s t w hout
  let E := (model.family.quotient (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) n).sequence
  let D := E.ssData (s,t,w)
  have hstrip : ¬ (0 ≤ t-w ∧ t-w < n) := by omega
  have hzero2 : IsZero (E.Page 2 (s,t,w)) := by
    apply (finite_quotient_component X n hn s t w).isZero_iff.mpr
    change IsZero (if 0 ≤ t-w ∧ t-w < n then
      (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).Page 2 (s,t) else ModuleCat.of ℤ PUnit)
    rw [if_neg hstrip]
    exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _
  have hfirst : E.r₀ = 2 :=
    (model.family.quotient (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) n).firstPage
  have hzero0 : IsZero (D.page (↑(0 : ℕ))) := by
    simpa only [D, Page, hfirst, sub_self, Int.toNat_zero] using hzero2
  have hBZ : D.B (↑(0 : ℕ)) = D.Z (↑(0 : ℕ)) :=
    D.eq_of_page_isZero _ hzero0
  change IsZero (D.page ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat)
  apply D.page_isZero_of_eq
  apply le_antisymm (D.B_le_Z _)
  calc
    D.Z ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat ≤ D.Z (↑(0 : ℕ)) := D.Z_anti (by exact bot_le)
    _ = D.B (↑(0 : ℕ)) := hBZ.symm
    _ ≤ D.B ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat := D.B_mono (by exact bot_le)
statement:

    ∀ (r : ℤ), 2 ≤ r → ∀ (s t w : ℤ), (t-w < 0 ∨ (n : ℤ) ≤ t-w) →
      IsZero ((model.family.quotient (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) n).Page r (s,t,w))

code:
private theorem infinityTransportedSquare
    {A B A' B' A₀ B₀ A₀' B₀' : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ}
    (iA : A₀=A) (iB : B₀=B) (jA : A'=A₀') (jB : B'=B₀')
    (eA : A ≅ A') (eB : B ≅ B')
    (f : A ⟶ B) (f' : A' ⟶ B') (g : A₀ ⟶ B₀) (g' : A₀' ⟶ B₀')
    (h : f ≫ eB.hom = eA.hom ≫ f')
    (hin : g ≫ eqToHom iB = eqToHom iA ≫ f)
    (hout : f' ≫ eqToHom jB = eqToHom jA ≫ g') :
    g ≫ (eqToHom iB ≫ eB.hom ≫ eqToHom jB) =
      (eqToHom iA ≫ eA.hom ≫ eqToHom jA) ≫ g' := by
  calc
    _ = (g ≫ eqToHom iB) ≫ eB.hom ≫ eqToHom jB := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (eqToHom iA ≫ f) ≫ eB.hom ≫ eqToHom jB := by rw [hin]
    _ = eqToHom iA ≫ (f ≫ eB.hom) ≫ eqToHom jB := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = eqToHom iA ≫ (eA.hom ≫ f') ≫ eqToHom jB := by rw [h]
    _ = eqToHom iA ≫ eA.hom ≫ (f' ≫ eqToHom jB) := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hout]; simp only [Category.assoc]
statement:
private theorem infinityTransportedSquare
    {A B A' B' A₀ B₀ A₀' B₀' : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ}
    (iA : A₀=A) (iB : B₀=B) (jA : A'=A₀') (jB : B'=B₀')
    (eA : A ≅ A') (eB : B ≅ B')
    (f : A ⟶ B) (f' : A' ⟶ B') (g : A₀ ⟶ B₀) (g' : A₀' ⟶ B₀')
    (h : f ≫ eB.hom = eA.hom ≫ f')
    (hin : g ≫ eqToHom iB = eqToHom iA ≫ f)
    (hout : f' ≫ eqToHom jB = eqToHom jA ≫ g') :
    g ≫ (eqToHom iB ≫ eB.hom ≫ eqToHom jB) =
      (eqToHom iA ≫ eA.hom ≫ eqToHom jA) ≫ g'

name: _private.KIP126.Literature.Standard.0.KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityGradedTransportComm
title: KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityGradedTransportComm
code:
private theorem infinityGradedTransportComm
    {A B A' B' : (ℤ × ℤ) → ModuleCat.{0} ℤ}
    {F : Filtration A} {G : Filtration B} {F' : Filtration A'} {G' : Filtration B'}
    {f : FilteredMorphism F G} {f' : FilteredMorphism F' G'}
    {p q : ℤ × ℤ} (e : FilteredMapTransport f f' p q) (s : ℤ) :
    f.inducedGrMap s p ≫ (e.target.gradedIso s).hom =
      (e.source.gradedIso s).hom ≫ f'.inducedGrMap s q := by
  have level_comm : (f.compat s p).choose ≫ (e.target.level s).hom =
      (e.source.level s).hom ≫ (f'.compat s q).choose := by
    apply (cancel_mono (G'.F s q).arrow).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [e.target.level_arrow, (f'.compat s q).choose_spec]
    rw [← Category.assoc, (f.compat s p).choose_spec, Category.assoc,
      ← e.map_comm]
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun a => a ≫ f'.map q)
      (e.source.level_arrow s).symm
  haveI : Epi (F.toAssociatedGraded s p) := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  apply (cancel_epi (F.toAssociatedGraded s p)).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, f.quotient_naturality, Category.assoc,
    e.target.projection_comm, ← Category.assoc, level_comm]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← f'.quotient_naturality, ← Category.assoc,
    ← e.source.projection_comm]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

    {P : SyntheticTowerPresentation unit F} {X Y : Syn} {g : X ⟶ Y}
    (cx : SyntheticTowerConvergence P X) (cy : SyntheticTowerConvergence P Y)
    (M : ConvergentMap F g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s : ℤ) :
    (F.map g).eInftyMap (s,p.1+s,p.2) ≫ (towerGradedIso cy p s).hom =
      (towerGradedIso cx p s).hom ≫ M.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s p := by
  let i : Tridegree := (s,p.1+s,p.2)
  let q : ℤ × ℤ := (p.1+s-s,p.2)
  have hp : q=p := Prod.ext (add_sub_cancel_right p.1 s) rfl
  have h := (M.infinity_action_graded i).symm
  change (F.map g).eInftyMap i ≫
      ((cy.identification i).hom ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun q => cy.filtration.associatedGraded s q) hp)) =
    ((cx.identification i).hom ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun q => cx.filtration.associatedGraded s q) hp)) ≫
      M.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s p
  rw [← Category.assoc, h, Category.assoc,
    infinityMapReindex (fun q => M.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s q) hp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

private theorem infinityTowerNatural
    {C : Type 1} [StableHomotopyCategory.{1,0} C]
    [HasFunctorialCofiber (C := C)]
    {Syn : Type 1} [SyntheticCategory.{1,0} Syn]
    [HasFunctorialCofiber (C := Syn)]
    (D : Model C Syn) (δ : ℤ × ℤ) (S : SyntheticESSShiftComparison D δ)
    (X Y : SyntheticObject)
    (f : X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s : ℤ) :
    (D.family.map f).eInftyMap (s,p.1+s,p.2) ≫
        (towerInfinityIso (D.convergence Y) (D.convergence (.shift δ Y))
          (S.filtered Y p) s).hom =
      (towerInfinityIso (D.convergence X) (D.convergence (.shift δ X))
          (S.filtered X p) s).hom ≫
        (D.family.map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map f)).eInftyMap
          (s,(p+δ).1+s,(p+δ).2) := by
  let M := D.convergentMap X Y f
  let M' := D.convergentMap (.shift δ X) (.shift δ Y)
    ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map f)
  have h := infinityGradedTransportComm (S.transport X Y f p) s
  change M.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s p ≫ ((S.filtered Y p).gradedIso s).hom =
    ((S.filtered X p).gradedIso s).hom ≫ M'.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s (p+δ) at h
  have hM' : M'.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s (p+δ) =
      (towerGradedIso (D.convergence (.shift δ X)) (p+δ) s).inv ≫
        (D.family.map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map f)).eInftyMap
          (s,(p+δ).1+s,(p+δ).2) ≫
        (towerGradedIso (D.convergence (.shift δ Y)) (p+δ) s).hom := by
    calc
      _ = (towerGradedIso (D.convergence (.shift δ X)) (p+δ) s).inv ≫
          ((towerGradedIso (D.convergence (.shift δ X)) (p+δ) s).hom ≫
            M'.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s (p+δ)) := by
        simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← infinityTowerGradedNatural (D.convergence (.shift δ X))
          (D.convergence (.shift δ Y)) M' (p+δ) s]
  apply (cancel_mono (towerGradedIso (D.convergence (.shift δ Y)) (p+δ) s).hom).mp
  simp only [towerInfinityIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [← Category.assoc, infinityTowerGradedNatural (D.convergence X) (D.convergence Y) M]
  rw [Category.assoc, h, hM']

private theorem infinityShiftNatural
    {C : Type 1} [StableHomotopyCategory.{1,0} C]
    [HasFunctorialCofiber (C := C)]
    {Syn : Type 1} [SyntheticCategory.{1,0} Syn]
    [HasFunctorialCofiber (C := Syn)]
    (D : Model C Syn) (K : ∀ k : ℕ, SyntheticESSShiftComparison D (0,-(k:ℤ)))
    (X Y : SyntheticObject) (f : X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)
    (k : ℕ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (w : ℤ) :
    (D.family.map f).eInftyMap (p.1,p.2,w) ≫ (infinityShift D K Y k p w).hom =
      (infinityShift D K X k p w).hom ≫
        (D.family.map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).map f)).eInftyMap
          (p.1,p.2,w-k) := by
  let a : Tridegree := (p.1,p.2,w)
  let b : Tridegree := (p.1,(p.2-p.1)+p.1,w)
  let c : Tridegree :=
    (p.1,((p.2-p.1,w)+(0,-(k:ℤ))).1+p.1,((p.2-p.1,w)+(0,-(k:ℤ))).2)
  let d : Tridegree := (p.1,p.2,w-k)
  have hab : a=b := Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext (sub_add_cancel p.2 p.1).symm rfl)
  have hcd : c=d := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · apply Prod.ext
      · change (p.2-p.1)+0+p.1=p.2
        omega
      · change w+(-(k:ℤ))=w-k
        omega
  have hin := infinityMapReindex (fun i => (D.family.map f).eInftyMap i) hab
  have hout := infinityMapReindex
    (fun i => (D.family.map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).map f)).eInftyMap i) hcd
  have h := infinityTowerNatural D (0,-(k:ℤ)) (K k) X Y f (p.2-p.1,w) p.1
  change (D.family.map f).eInftyMap a ≫
      (eqToHom (congrArg (fun i =>
          ((D.family.obj (Y.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData i).eInfty) hab) ≫
        (towerInfinityIso (D.convergence Y) (D.convergence (.shift (0,-(k:ℤ)) Y))
          ((K k).filtered Y (p.2-p.1,w)) p.1).hom ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun i =>
          ((D.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.shift (0,-(k:ℤ)) Y).obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData i).eInfty) hcd)) =
    (eqToHom (congrArg (fun i =>
          ((D.family.obj (X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData i).eInfty) hab) ≫
        (towerInfinityIso (D.convergence X) (D.convergence (.shift (0,-(k:ℤ)) X))
          ((K k).filtered X (p.2-p.1,w)) p.1).hom ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun i =>
          ((D.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.shift (0,-(k:ℤ)) X).obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData i).eInfty) hcd)) ≫
      (D.family.map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).map f)).eInftyMap d
  exact infinityTransportedSquare _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h hin hout

    [HasFunctorialCofiber (C := C)]

    [HasFunctorialCofiber (C := Syn)]
    (D : Model C Syn) (K : ∀ k : ℕ, SyntheticESSShiftComparison D (0,-(k:ℤ)))

private theorem nuCofiberCellExponents :
    normalizedExponent model.classicalTower model.auxiliary.nuRouteTriangle.g = 0 ∧
    normalizedExponent model.classicalTower model.auxiliary.nuRouteTriangle.h = 0 := by
  let B := KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Standard.closedBackground
  let H := model.coefficients.object
  let F := tensorRight H
  letI := B.tensorShift H
  letI := B.tensorExact H
  let T := F.mapTriangle.obj
    (Triangle.mk model.auxiliary.nuMap
      (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι model.auxiliary.nuMap)
      (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ model.auxiliary.nuMap))
  have hT : T ∈ distTriang Spectrum :=
    F.map_distinguished _ (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished _)
  have hF : MapFiltrationAtLeast model.classicalTower model.auxiliary.nuMap 1 := by
    classical
    have h := nuCofiber_nu_exponent
    change (if MapFiltrationAtLeast model.classicalTower model.auxiliary.nuMap 1
      then 1 else 0) = 1 at h
    by_contra hn
    simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [if_neg hn] at h
    contradiction
  have hf (i : ℤ) (x : HomotopyGroup i T.obj₁) : x ≫ T.mor₁ = 0 :=
    nuPositiveFiltrationZeroOnRightHomology _ hF i x
  have hbottom : ¬ MapFiltrationAtLeast model.classicalTower
      model.auxiliary.nuRouteTriangle.g 1 := by
    intro hg
    let a : HomotopyGroup 0 T.obj₂ :=
      model.coefficients.pi0Equiv.symm 1 ≫ (λ_ H).inv
    have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      have h0 : model.coefficients.pi0Equiv.symm 1 = 0 := by
        have hh := congrArg (fun z => z ≫ (λ_ H).hom) hz
        simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [a, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id,
          zero_comp] using hh
      have h10 : (1 : ZMod 2) = 0 := by
        simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_zero] using
          congrArg model.coefficients.pi0Equiv h0
      exact one_ne_zero h10
    have hag : a ≫ T.mor₂ = 0 :=
      nuPositiveFiltrationZeroOnRightHomology _ hg 0 a
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := T.coyoneda_exact₂ hT a hag
    exact ha (hb.trans (hf 0 b))
  have htop : ¬ MapFiltrationAtLeast model.classicalTower
      model.auxiliary.nuRouteTriangle.h 1 := by
    intro hh
    let a₃ : HomotopyGroup 3 T.obj₁ :=
      (shiftFunctor Spectrum (3 : ℤ)).map model.coefficients.unit ≫
        (B.sphereTensorShift 3 H).inv
    have ha₃ : a₃ ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      have hu : (shiftFunctor Spectrum (3 : ℤ)).map model.coefficients.unit = 0 := by
        have h := congrArg (fun z => z ≫ (B.sphereTensorShift 3 H).hom) hz
        simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [a₃, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id,
          zero_comp] using h
      apply nuCoefficientUnitNonzero
      apply (shiftFunctor Spectrum (3 : ℤ)).map_injective
      rw [Functor.map_zero]
      exact hu
    let a₄ : HomotopyGroup 4 (T.obj₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) :=
      (shiftFunctorAdd' Spectrum (3 : ℤ) 1 4 (by norm_num)).hom.app SphereSpectrum ≫
        (shiftFunctor Spectrum (1 : ℤ)).map a₃
    have ha₄ : a₄ ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      have h : (shiftFunctor Spectrum (1 : ℤ)).map a₃ = 0 := by
        apply (cancel_epi
          ((shiftFunctorAdd' Spectrum (3 : ℤ) 1 4 (by norm_num)).hom.app SphereSpectrum)).mp
        simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [a₄, comp_zero] using hz
      apply ha₃
      apply (shiftFunctor Spectrum (1 : ℤ)).map_injective
      rw [Functor.map_zero]
      exact h
    have haf : a₄ ≫ (shiftFunctor Spectrum (1 : ℤ)).map T.mor₁ = 0 := by
      dsimp only [a₄]
      rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, hf 3 a₃,
        Functor.map_zero, comp_zero]
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := T.coyoneda_exact₁ hT a₄ haf
    have hbh : b ≫ T.mor₃ = 0 := by
      change b ≫ ((model.auxiliary.nuRouteTriangle.h ▷ H) ≫ _) = 0
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      have hz := nuPositiveFiltrationZeroOnRightHomology
        model.auxiliary.nuRouteTriangle.h hh 4 b
      change b ≫ (model.auxiliary.nuRouteTriangle.h ▷ H) = 0 at hz
      rw [hz, zero_comp]
    exact ha₄ (hb.trans hbh)
  classical
  dsimp only [normalizedExponent]
  simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [if_neg hbottom, if_neg htop, and_self]

name: _private.KIP126.Literature.Standard.0.KIP126.Literature.Standard.absorbedTheta5Lift
title: KIP126.Literature.Standard.absorbedTheta5Lift
code:
private theorem absorbedTheta5Lift :
  ∃ a : BiHom 62 64 (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum),
    KIP126.Literature.Theta5Detected model a ∧ realizeSphere 62 64 a = theta5 := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hr⟩ := selected_realization_prescribed_lift .sphere 2 64
    (model.standardClasses.standardHiSquare 5) theta5
    h5Square_permanent theta5_detection
  change BiHom 62 64 (KIP126.Literature.nuZero model .sphere) at b
  change (realization_sphere 62 64).hom ≫ model.recovery.realization.map b ≫
      model.recovery.realization.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) ≫
      model.recovery.nuRealizationIso.hom.app SphereSpectrum = theta5 at hr
  let e : KIP126.Literature.nuZero model .sphere ≅ (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) :=
    SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.app _ ≪≫ model.nu.unitIso
  let a : BiHom 62 64 (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) := b ≫ e.hom
  have hq : quotientClass 1 a ≫ XModLambdaN.map e.inv 1 = quotientClass 1 b := by
    dsimp only [a, quotientClass]
    simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← XModLambdaN.incl_naturality]
    simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (model.firstQuotient .sphere 0 2 64)
      (quotientClass 1 a ≫ XModLambdaN.map e.inv 1) = _
    rw [hq]
    have hb' : quotientClass 1 b =
        (model.firstQuotient .sphere 0 2 64).symm
          (model.standardClasses.standardHiSquare 5) := hb
    rw [hb']
    exact (model.firstQuotient .sphere 0 2 64).apply_symm_apply _
  · have hu : model.recovery.realization.map e.hom ≫
        model.recovery.realization.map model.nu.unitIso.inv =
        model.recovery.realization.map
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app
            (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum)) := by
      have hu0 : e.hom ≫ model.nu.unitIso.inv =
          SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app
            (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum) :=
        (Category.assoc
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app
            (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum))
          model.nu.unitIso.hom model.nu.unitIso.inv).trans
          ((congrArg (fun k =>
              SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app
                (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum) ≫ k)
            model.nu.unitIso.hom_inv_id).trans (Category.comp_id _))
      exact (model.recovery.realization.map_comp e.hom model.nu.unitIso.inv).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun f => model.recovery.realization.map f) hu0)
    change (realization_sphere 62 64).hom ≫
      model.recovery.realization.map (b ≫ e.hom) ≫
      model.recovery.realization.map model.nu.unitIso.inv ≫
      model.recovery.nuRealizationIso.hom.app SphereSpectrum = theta5
    calc
      _ = (realization_sphere 62 64).hom ≫ model.recovery.realization.map b ≫
          (model.recovery.realization.map e.hom ≫
            model.recovery.realization.map model.nu.unitIso.inv) ≫
          model.recovery.nuRealizationIso.hom.app SphereSpectrum := by
        rw [Functor.map_comp]
        simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hu]; exact hr

name: _private.KIP126.Literature.Standard.0.KIP126.Literature.Standard.mossDetectionImpl
title: KIP126.Literature.Standard.mossDetectionImpl
code:
private theorem mossDetectionImpl : Moss.DetectionCompatible mapping mappingComposition := by
  intro X Y Z r hr i j a b α β hα hβ
  rcases hα with ⟨eα, ⟨zα, hza, hzeα⟩, fα, hfa, hgα⟩
  rcases hβ with ⟨eβ, ⟨zβ, hzb, hzeβ⟩, fβ, hfb, hgβ⟩
  subst eα
  subst eβ
  let P := mappingComposition.pairing X Y Z
  let z := P.cyclePairAtInfinity i j zα zβ
  refine ⟨_, ⟨z, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  · have hp := P.finitePagePair_compatible r i j
      (by
        change (model.classical.obj (mappingSpectrum closedTensor X.val Y.val)).r₀ ≤ r
        rw [model.classical.firstPage]
        exact hr)
      (by
        change (model.classical.obj (mappingSpectrum closedTensor Y.val Z.val)).r₀ ≤ r
        rw [model.classical.firstPage]
        exact hr)
      (by
        change (model.classical.obj (mappingSpectrum closedTensor X.val Z.val)).r₀ ≤ r
        rw [model.classical.firstPage]
        exact hr) zα zβ
    change infinityToPage (mapping.hom X Y).underlying.E r i zα = a at hza
    change infinityToPage (mapping.hom Y Z).underlying.E r j zβ = b at hzb
    rw [hza, hzb] at hp
    exact hp.symm
  · let F := (mapping.hom X Z).underlying.F
    have h : (i.1+j.1, Moss.stem i+Moss.stem j) = ((i+j).1, Moss.stem (i+j)) :=
      P.reindex_compatible i j
    let f : FiltrationPiece F (i.1+j.1) (Moss.stem i+Moss.stem j) :=
      P.filteredAbutmentPair i.1 j.1 (Moss.stem i) (Moss.stem j) fα fβ
    refine ⟨mossPieceCast F h f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine (mossPieceCast_arrow F h f).trans ?_
      have hf : (F.F (i.1+j.1) (Moss.stem i+Moss.stem j)).arrow f =
          P.abutmentPair (Moss.stem i) (Moss.stem j) α β :=
        (P.filteredAbutmentPair_compatible i.1 j.1
          (Moss.stem i) (Moss.stem j) fα fβ).trans
          (congrArg₂ (fun u v => P.abutmentPair (Moss.stem i) (Moss.stem j) u v) hfa hfb)
      refine (congrArg (fun x =>
        (eqToHom (congrArg (fun k : ℤ × ℤ => (mapping.hom X Z).underlying.A k.2) h)) x) hf).trans ?_
      apply (mappingHomotopyEquiv closedTensor (Moss.stem (i+j)) X.val Z.val).injective
      have hc := mossMappingDegreeCast X.val Z.val (congrArg Prod.snd h)
        (P.abutmentPair (Moss.stem i) (Moss.stem j) α β)
      refine hc.trans ?_
      have hcompat := mappingComposition.abutment_compatible X Y Z
        (Moss.stem i) (Moss.stem j) α β
      refine (congrArg (fun c =>
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun k => X.val⟦k⟧) (congrArg Prod.snd h).symm) ≫ c) hcompat).trans ?_
      delta Moss.abutmentComposition Moss.shiftMap Moss.abutmentMap
      simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Category.assoc]
    · apply mossGradedLiftOfTransport F h _ f
      have hp := P.eInfty_compatible i j
        ((((mapping.hom X Y).underlying.E).ssData i).pageπ ⊤ zα)
        ((((mapping.hom Y Z).underlying.E).ssData j).pageπ ⊤ zβ)
      rw [← P.eInftyPair_induced] at hp
      change F.transportGraded h.symm
          (((mapping.convergence X.val Z.val X.property Z.property).identification (i+j)).hom
            (((Moss.sequence mapping X Z).ssData (i+j)).pageπ ⊤ z)) =
          P.associatedGradedPair i.1 j.1 (Moss.stem i) (Moss.stem j)
            (((mapping.convergence X.val Y.val X.property Y.property).identification i).hom
              (((Moss.sequence mapping X Y).ssData i).pageπ ⊤ zα))
            (((mapping.convergence Y.val Z.val Y.property Z.property).identification j).hom
              (((Moss.sequence mapping Y Z).ssData j).pageπ ⊤ zβ)) at hp
      rw [hgα, hgβ] at hp
      exact hp.trans (P.associatedGradedPair_induced i.1 j.1
        (Moss.stem i) (Moss.stem j) fα fβ)

    (b : HomotopyGroup (C := Spectrum) ((t' : ℤ)-s') SphereSpectrum)
    (ha : ClassicalDetects (model.classicalConvergence .sphere) (s,t) x a)
    (hb : ClassicalDetects (model.classicalConvergence .sphere) (s',t') y b) :
    ClassicalDetects (model.classicalConvergence .sphere) ((s+s' : ℕ),(t+t' : ℕ))
      ((eqToHom (congrArg (model.classical.sphere.Page 2)
        (show ((s : ℤ),(t : ℤ)) + ((s' : ℤ),(t' : ℤ)) = (((s+s' : ℕ) : ℤ),((t+t' : ℕ) : ℤ)) by
          simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk,Nat.cast_add])))
        (model.sphereAlgebra.product (s,t) (s',t') x y))
      (eqToHom (congrArg (fun n : ℤ => Sphere (C := Spectrum) n)
        (by simp only [Nat.cast_add]; omega : ((t+t' : ℕ) : ℤ)-(s+s') =
          ((t : ℤ)-s)+((t' : ℤ)-s'))) ≫ classicalSphereProduct a b) := by
