code:
private theorem secondary_star_product (coh : BiShiftCoherence Syn)
    (eta : BiHom 1 2 (S_0_0 : Syn)) (theta : BiHom 62 64 (S_0_0 : Syn)) :
    sphereProduct (lambdaMultiply 2 eta) theta = lambdaMultiply 2 (sphereProduct eta theta) := by
  let shiftSwap (a b : ℤ × ℤ) (A : Syn) :
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift b).obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift b).obj A) :=
    (biShiftAddIso a b (a+b) rfl).app A ≪≫
      ((biShiftAddIso b a (a+b) (add_comm _ _)).app A).symm
  have shiftSwap_add (coh : BiShiftCoherence Syn)
      (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) (A : Syn) :
      (shiftSwap a (b+c) A).hom ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map ((biShiftAddIso b c (b+c) rfl).inv.app A) =
      (biShiftAddIso b c (b+c) rfl).inv.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift c).map (shiftSwap a b A).hom ≫
        (shiftSwap a c ((SyntheticCategory.biShift b).obj A)).hom := by
    let habc : (a+b)+c=a+(b+c) := add_assoc a b c
    let hbac : b+(a+c)=a+(b+c) := by abel
    have h₁ := coh.associativity a b c (a+b) (b+c) (a+(b+c)) rfl rfl habc rfl A
    have h₂ := coh.associativity b a c (a+b) (a+c) (a+(b+c))
      (add_comm _ _) rfl habc hbac A
    have h₃ := coh.associativity b c a (b+c) (a+c) (a+(b+c))
      rfl (add_comm _ _) (add_comm _ _) hbac A
    simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [shiftSwap,Iso.trans_hom,Iso.symm_hom,Iso.app_hom,Iso.app_inv]
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    apply (cancel_epi ((biShiftAddIso b c (b+c) rfl).hom.app
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A))).mp
    simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc]
    rw [← Category.assoc,← h₁]
    simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc]
    apply (cancel_epi ((SyntheticCategory.biShift c).map
      ((biShiftAddIso a b (a+b) rfl).hom.app A))).mpr
    -- Cancel the common left factor introduced by the first associativity square.
    apply (cancel_epi ((SyntheticCategory.biShift c).map
      ((biShiftAddIso b a (a+b) (add_comm _ _)).hom.app A))).mp
    simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app,CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,Category.id_comp]
    rw [← Category.assoc,h₂]
    simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc]
    apply (cancel_epi ((biShiftAddIso a c (a+c) rfl).hom.app
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift b).obj A))).mpr
    apply (cancel_epi ((biShiftAddIso c a (a+c) (add_comm _ _)).hom.app
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift b).obj A))).mp
    rw [← Category.assoc,← Category.assoc,← h₃]
    simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc,
      Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
    erw [CategoryTheory.Category.id_comp,←Functor.map_comp,Iso.hom_inv_id_app,CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    rfl
  have shiftSwap_add_eq (coh : BiShiftCoherence Syn)
      (a b c d : ℤ × ℤ) (h : b+c=d) (A : Syn) :
      (shiftSwap a d A).hom ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map ((biShiftAddIso b c d h).inv.app A) =
      (biShiftAddIso b c d h).inv.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift c).map (shiftSwap a b A).hom ≫
        (shiftSwap a c ((SyntheticCategory.biShift b).obj A)).hom := by
    subst d
    exact shiftSwap_add coh a b c A
  have shiftSwap_natural (a b : ℤ × ℤ) {A B : Syn} (f : A ⟶ B) :
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift b).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map f) ≫
        (shiftSwap a b B).hom =
      (shiftSwap a b A).hom ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift b).map f) := by
    exact ((biShiftAddIso a b (a+b) rfl) ≪≫
      (biShiftAddIso b a (a+b) (add_comm _ _)).symm).hom.naturality f
  have shiftSwap_hom_eq (a b d : ℤ × ℤ)
      (hab : a+b=d) (hba : b+a=d) (A : Syn) :
      (shiftSwap a b A).hom =
        (biShiftAddIso a b d hab).hom.app A ≫ (biShiftAddIso b a d hba).inv.app A := by
    subst d
    rfl
  have lambda_pow_shift (coh : BiShiftCoherence Syn)
      (n : ℕ) (a : ℤ × ℤ) (A : Syn) :
      lambdaPow n ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
        (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n) A).hom ≫
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (lambdaPow n A) := by
    induction n generalizing A with
    | zero =>
      change SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
        (shiftSwap a 0 A).hom ≫
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A)
      have h : SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
          (biShiftAddIso a 0 a (add_zero a)).hom.app A ≫
            (biShiftAddIso 0 a a (zero_add a)).inv.app A ≫
              (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) := by
        rw [←coh.left_unit a A,Iso.inv_hom_id_app,Category.comp_id]
        exact (coh.right_unit a A).symm
      rw [shiftSwap_hom_eq a 0 a (add_zero a) (zero_add a),Category.assoc]
      exact h
    | succ n ih =>
      have h1 : lambdaPow 1 ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
          (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree 1) A).hom ≫
            (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (lambdaPow 1 A) := by
        rw [lambdaPow_one coh,lambdaPow_one coh]
        change SyntheticCategory.lam.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
          (shiftSwap a (0,-1) A).hom ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (SyntheticCategory.lam.app A)
        rw [shiftSwap_hom_eq a (0,-1) (a+(0,-1)) rfl (add_comm _ _),Category.assoc]
        exact coh.lambda_comm a A
      have hn := shiftSwap_natural a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n) (lambdaPow 1 A)
      have hh := shiftSwap_add_eq coh a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree 1) (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n)
        (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree (n+1)) (by ext <;> simp [KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree]) A
      change (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree (n+1)) A).hom ≫
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map ((lambdaShiftAddIso 1 n (n+1) (by omega)).inv.app A) =
        (lambdaShiftAddIso 1 n (n+1) (by omega)).inv.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) ≫
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n)).map (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree 1) A).hom ≫
          (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n) ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree 1)).obj A)).hom at hh
      rw [lambdaPow_add coh 1 n (n+1) (by omega) ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A),
        lambdaPow_add coh 1 n (n+1) (by omega) A,h1,ih]
      simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Functor.map_comp,Category.assoc]
      rw [reassoc_of% hn]
      rw [reassoc_of% hh]
      rfl
  have shift_assoc_inv (coh : BiShiftCoherence Syn)
      (a b c ab bc total : ℤ × ℤ) (hab : a+b=ab) (hbc : b+c=bc)
      (habc : ab+c=total) (habc' : a+bc=total) (A : Syn) :
      (biShiftAddIso ab c total habc).inv.app A ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift c).map ((biShiftAddIso a b ab hab).inv.app A) =
      (biShiftAddIso a bc total habc').inv.app A ≫
        (biShiftAddIso b c bc hbc).inv.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) := by
    have he : ((SyntheticCategory.biShift c).mapIso ((biShiftAddIso a b ab hab).app A) ≪≫
        (biShiftAddIso ab c total habc).app A) =
      ((biShiftAddIso b c bc hbc).app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) ≪≫
        (biShiftAddIso a bc total habc').app A) :=
      Iso.ext (coh.associativity a b c ab bc total hab hbc habc habc' A)
    have hi := congrArg Iso.inv he
    exact hi
  have shuffle_lambda_left_two (coh : BiShiftCoherence Syn)
      (etaShuffle : BiHom 1 2 (S_0_0 : Syn))
      (a : BiHom 62 64 (S_0_0 : Syn)) :
      sphereAction (lambdaMultiply 2 etaShuffle) a = lambdaMultiply 2 (sphereAction etaShuffle a) := by
    let S := (S_0_0 : Syn)
    have h₁ := shift_assoc_inv coh (1,2) (62,64) (0,-2)
      (63,66) (62,62) (63,64) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) S
    have h₂ := shift_assoc_inv coh (1,2) (0,-2) (62,64)
      (1,0) (62,62) (63,64) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) S
    simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [biShiftAddIso,Iso.trans_inv,eqToIso.inv,
      eqToHom_refl,Category.id_comp] at h₁ h₂
    have hp :
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (63,66) (0,-2)).inv.app S ≫
        lambdaPow 2 (Smn 63 66) ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (1,2) (62,64)).inv.app S =
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (1,0) (62,64)).inv.app S ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (62,64)).map
          ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (1,2) (0,-2)).inv.app S) ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (62,64)).map (lambdaPow 2 (Smn 1 2)) := by
      rw [←lambdaPow_naturality]
      change (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (63,66) (0,-2)).inv.app S ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-2)).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (1,2) (62,64)).inv.app S) ≫
        lambdaPow 2 ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (62,64)).obj (Smn 1 2)) = _
      rw [lambda_pow_shift coh 2 (62,64) (Smn 1 2)]
      dsimp only [shiftSwap,KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree]
      simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Iso.trans_hom,Iso.trans_inv,Iso.symm_hom,Iso.app_hom,Iso.app_inv,biShiftAddIso,eqToIso.hom,eqToIso.inv,eqToHom_refl,
        Category.comp_id,Category.id_comp]
      simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc]
      erw [←Category.assoc ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (63,66) (0,-2)).inv.app S)]
      erw [h₁]
      simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc,Smn,S,Nat.cast_ofNat,Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
      simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc,Smn,S,Nat.cast_ofNat,Nat.cast_one,Int.natCast_one] using
        (congrArg (fun z => z ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (62,64)).map (lambdaPow 2 (Smn 1 2))) h₂.symm)
    delta sphereAction lambdaMultiply
    simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [eqToHom_refl,Category.id_comp,Functor.map_comp,Category.assoc]
    simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc,S,Smn,Int.reduceAdd,Int.reduceSub,Nat.cast_ofNat,Nat.cast_one,Int.natCast_one] using
      (congrArg (fun z => z ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (62,64)).map etaShuffle ≫ a) hp).symm
  change sphereAction (lambdaMultiply 2 eta) theta = lambdaMultiply 2 (sphereAction eta theta)
  exact shuffle_lambda_left_two coh eta theta

    (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1 : ℤ)).mapIso e₀ ≪≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_compat (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) 1).symm.app _ ≪≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp ((m:ℤ),wt-1) (1,0)).app S_0_0 ≪≫
      eqToIso (by congr 1 <;> simp (config := { congrConsts := false }))
  have hQ : ∀ q : U⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ T.obj₃, q = 0 := by
    intro q
    haveI : Subsingleton (model.classical.sphere.Page 2 (wt-(m:ℤ)-2,wt-1)) := by

private theorem secondary_lambda_powers_injective_at_degree (m : ℕ) (wt : ℤ) (hw : wt ≤ (m:ℤ)+2) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, Function.Injective (fun a : BiHom (m:ℤ) wt (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) => lambdaMultiply k a) := by
  let Syn := SyntheticSpectrum
  let X := (S_0_0 : Syn)
  let coh := model.quotients.coherence
  have one (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (fun a :
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k : ℤ))).obj (Smn (Syn := Syn) (m:ℤ) wt) ⟶ X =>
      SyntheticCategory.lam.app _ ≫ a) := by
    let e : Smn (Syn := Syn) (m:ℤ) (wt-k) ≅
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k : ℤ))).obj (Smn (m:ℤ) wt) :=
      eqToIso (by dsimp only [Smn]; congr 1 <;> simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) [sub_eq_add_neg]) ≪≫
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp ((m:ℤ),wt) (0,-(k : ℤ))).app S_0_0).symm
    intro a b hab
    apply (cancel_epi e.hom).mp
    apply secondary_lambda_precomp_injective_at_degree m (wt-k) (by omega)
    dsimp only
    dsimp only at hab
    have hn := SyntheticCategory.lam.naturality e.hom
    dsimp only [Functor.id_map] at hn
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ← hn]
    simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc] using
      congrArg (fun z => (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-1)).map e.hom ≫ z) hab
  have powers (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (fun a : BiHom (m:ℤ) wt X => lambdaPow k (Smn (m:ℤ) wt) ≫ a) := by
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro a b hab
      exact (cancel_epi (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app (Smn (m:ℤ) wt))).mp hab
    | succ k ih =>
      intro a b hab
      apply ih
      apply one k
      rw [lambdaPow_add coh k 1 (k+1) rfl, lambdaPow_one coh] at hab
      have hc := (cancel_epi ((lambdaShiftAddIso k 1 (k+1) rfl).inv.app (Smn (Syn := Syn) (m:ℤ) wt))).mp
        (by simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc] using hab)
      have hn := SyntheticCategory.lam.naturality (lambdaPow k (Smn (Syn := Syn) (m:ℤ) wt))
      dsimp only [Functor.id_map] at hn
      change (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-1)).map (lambdaPow k (Smn (m:ℤ) wt)) ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.lam.app (Smn (m:ℤ) wt) ≫ a) =
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-1)).map (lambdaPow k (Smn (m:ℤ) wt)) ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.lam.app (Smn (m:ℤ) wt) ≫ b) at hc
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, hn] at hc
      simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc] using hc
  intro k a b hab
  apply powers k
  dsimp only [lambdaMultiply] at hab
  have hc := (cancel_epi (eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> simp (config := { congrConsts := false })))).mp hab
  exact (cancel_epi ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp ((m:ℤ),wt) (0,-(k : ℤ))).inv.app S_0_0)).mp
    (by simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc] using hc)

    ∃ ε : S⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ S, (2 : ℕ) • 𝟙 M = p ≫ ε ≫ i := by

    have h := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₃₁ T hT
    change p ≫ ((2 : ℕ) • 𝟙 S)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = 0 at h
    simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only
      [Functor.map_nsmul, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
        Preadditive.comp_nsmul, Category.comp_id] using h
  have hp' : ((2 : ℕ) • 𝟙 M) ≫ p = 0 := by
    simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only
      [Preadditive.nsmul_comp, Category.id_comp] using hp
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := T.coyoneda_exact₃ hT ((2 : ℕ) • 𝟙 M) hp'
  change M ⟶ S at a
  change (2 : ℕ) • 𝟙 M = a ≫ i at ha
  have hi : (2 : ℕ) • i = 0 := by
    have h := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ T hT
    change ((2 : ℕ) • 𝟙 S) ≫ i = 0 at h
    simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only
      [Preadditive.nsmul_comp, Category.id_comp] using h
  have hai : i ≫ a = 0 := by
    apply htf
    have h : (2 : ℕ) • (i ≫ a) = 0 := by
      rw [← Preadditive.nsmul_comp, hi, zero_comp]
    simpa (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [two_nsmul] using h
  obtain ⟨ε, hε⟩ := T.yoneda_exact₃ hT a hai
  change S⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ S at ε
  change a = p ≫ ε at hε

    {X A Q Z W : C} (j : X ≅ A) (f : X ⟶ A)

  let T := Triangle.mk f i p

  change g = i ≫ gbar at hgbar
  have hibar : i ≫ gbar = g := hgbar.symm
  refine ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar, hibar, ?_⟩

    p ≫ (b ≫ g ≫ u) = (p ≫ b ≫ i) ≫ gbar ≫ u := by
      rw [← hibar]
      simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [Category.assoc]
    _ = ((2 : ℕ) • 𝟙 Q) ≫ gbar ≫ u := by rw [hQ]
    _ = gbar ≫ ((2 : ℕ) • u) := by
      simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only
        [Preadditive.nsmul_comp, Preadditive.comp_nsmul, Category.id_comp] <;> rfl

code:
public theorem composable {X Y Z W : C} {x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ W}
    (hx : Relation x f g h) : f ≫ g = 0 ∧ g ≫ h = 0 := by
  rcases hx with ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar, hg, hx⟩
  let T := Triangle.mk f i p
  have hfi : f ≫ i = 0 := by
    have h := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ T hT
    dsimp only [T, Triangle.mk] at h
    exact h
  have hip : i ≫ p = 0 := by
    have h := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₂₃ T hT
    dsimp only [T, Triangle.mk] at h
    exact h
  constructor
  · calc
      f ≫ g = (f ≫ i) ≫ gbar := by rw [← hg, Category.assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hfi, zero_comp]
  · calc
      g ≫ h = i ≫ (gbar ≫ h) := by rw [← hg, Category.assoc]
      _ = (i ≫ p) ≫ x := by rw [← hx, Category.assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hip, zero_comp]

public theorem exists_relation {X Y Z W : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (h : Z ⟶ W) (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) (hgh : g ≫ h = 0) :
    ∃ x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W, Relation x f g h := by
  obtain ⟨Q, i, p, hT⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle f
  let T := Triangle.mk f i p
  obtain ⟨gbar, hgbar⟩ := T.yoneda_exact₂ hT g hfg
  dsimp only [T, Triangle.mk] at hgbar
  have hzero : i ≫ (gbar ≫ h) = 0 := by
    calc
      i ≫ (gbar ≫ h) = (i ≫ gbar) ≫ h := by simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = g ≫ h := by rw [hgbar]
      _ = 0 := hgh
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := T.yoneda_exact₃ hT (gbar ≫ h) hzero
  exact ⟨x, Q, i, p, hT, gbar, hgbar.symm, hx.symm⟩

private theorem indeterminacy_left {X Y Z W : C} {x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ W}
    (hx : Relation x f g h) (y : Y⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W) :
    Relation (x + f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ y) f g h := by
  rcases hx with ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar, hg, hx⟩
  refine ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar, hg, ?_⟩
  have hpf : p ≫ f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = 0 :=
    comp_distTriang_mor_zero₃₁ (Triangle.mk f i p) hT
  calc
    p ≫ (x + f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ y) = p ≫ x + p ≫ (f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ y) := by
      simp only [Preadditive.comp_add]
    _ = p ≫ x + (p ≫ f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') ≫ y := by rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = p ≫ x := by rw [hpf, zero_comp, add_zero]
    _ = gbar ≫ h := hx

label: decl:702bc9503b05345d
name: _private.KIP126.Literature.Toda.0.KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.indeterminacy_right
title: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.indeterminacy_right
code:
private theorem indeterminacy_right {X Y Z W : C} {x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ W}
    (hx : Relation x f g h) (z : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ Z) :
    Relation (x + z ≫ h) f g h := by
  rcases hx with ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar, hg, hx⟩
  refine ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar + p ≫ z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hip : i ≫ p = 0 :=
      comp_distTriang_mor_zero₂₃ (Triangle.mk f i p) hT
    calc
      i ≫ (gbar + p ≫ z) = i ≫ gbar + i ≫ (p ≫ z) := by
        simp only [Preadditive.comp_add]
      _ = g + (i ≫ p) ≫ z := by rw [hg, Category.assoc]
      _ = g := by rw [hip, zero_comp, add_zero]
  · calc
      p ≫ (x + z ≫ h) = p ≫ x + p ≫ (z ≫ h) := by
        simp only [Preadditive.comp_add]
      _ = gbar ≫ h + (p ≫ z) ≫ h := by rw [hx, Category.assoc]
      _ = (gbar + p ≫ z) ≫ h := by simp only [Preadditive.add_comp]

label: decl:1de82c2f1606732f
name: _private.KIP126.Literature.Toda.0.KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.indeterminacy_complete
title: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.indeterminacy_complete
code:
private theorem indeterminacy_complete {X Y Z W : C}
    {x₁ x₂ : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ W}
    (hx₁ : Relation x₁ f g h) (hx₂ : Relation x₂ f g h) :
    ∃ (y : Y⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W) (z : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ Z),
      x₁ - x₂ = f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ y + z ≫ h := by
  rcases hx₁ with ⟨Q₁, i₁, p₁, hT₁, g₁, hg₁, hx₁⟩
  rcases hx₂ with ⟨Q₂, i₂, p₂, hT₂, g₂, hg₂, hx₂⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc₁, hc₂⟩ := complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism
    (Triangle.mk f i₁ p₁) (Triangle.mk f i₂ p₂) hT₁ hT₂
    (𝟙 X) (𝟙 Y) (by
      change f ≫ 𝟙 Y = 𝟙 X ≫ f
      simp only [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])
  dsimp only [Triangle.mk] at c hc₁ hc₂
  have hi : i₁ ≫ c = i₂ := by simpa using hc₁
  have hp : p₁ = c ≫ p₂ := by simpa using hc₂
  let δ : Q₁ ⟶ Z := g₁ - c ≫ g₂
  have hδ : i₁ ≫ δ = 0 := by
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [Preadditive.comp_sub, hg₁, ← Category.assoc, hi, hg₂, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (Triangle.mk f i₁ p₁).yoneda_exact₃ hT₁ δ hδ
  dsimp only [Triangle.mk] at z hz
  have hp₂x₂ : p₁ ≫ x₂ = (c ≫ g₂) ≫ h := by
    rw [hp, Category.assoc, hx₂, ← Category.assoc]
  have hpzh : p₁ ≫ (z ≫ h) = δ ≫ h := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← hz]
  let e : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W := x₁ - x₂ - z ≫ h
  have he : p₁ ≫ e = 0 := by
    dsimp [e]
    rw [Preadditive.comp_sub, Preadditive.comp_sub, hx₁, hp₂x₂, hpzh]
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [Preadditive.sub_comp]
    abel
  have hrot : (Triangle.mk f i₁ p₁).rotate ∈ distTriang C :=
    rot_of_distTriang (Triangle.mk f i₁ p₁) hT₁
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := (Triangle.mk f i₁ p₁).rotate.yoneda_exact₃ hrot e he
  dsimp only [Triangle.mk, Triangle.rotate] at y₀ hy₀
  refine ⟨-y₀, z, ?_⟩
  have hy₀' : e = f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ (-y₀) := by
    simpa [Triangle.rotate] using hy₀
  calc
    x₁ - x₂ = e + z ≫ h := by dsimp [e]; abel
    _ = f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ (-y₀) + z ≫ h := by rw [hy₀']

label: decl:20752d16d91e3211
name: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.relation_iff_indeterminacy
title: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.relation_iff_indeterminacy
code:
public theorem relation_iff_indeterminacy {X Y Z W : C}
    {x₀ x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ W}
    (hx₀ : Relation x₀ f g h) :
    Relation x f g h ↔
      ∃ (y : Y⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W) (z : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ Z),
        x - x₀ = f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ y + z ≫ h := by
  constructor
  · exact fun hx => indeterminacy_complete hx hx₀
  · rintro ⟨y, z, hx⟩
    have heq : x = (x₀ + f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ y) + z ≫ h := by
      calc
        x = (x - x₀) + x₀ := (sub_add_cancel x x₀).symm
        _ = (f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ y + z ≫ h) + x₀ := by rw [hx]
        _ = (x₀ + f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ y) + z ≫ h := by abel
    rw [heq]
    exact indeterminacy_right (indeterminacy_left hx₀ y) z

label: decl:e61e733a839e48fd
name: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.juggling
title: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.juggling
code:
public theorem juggling [IsTriangulated C]
    {X Y Z W V : C} {x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ W} {d : W ⟶ V}
    (hx : Relation x f g h) (hhd : h ≫ d = 0) :
    ∃ y : Y⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ V,
      Relation y g h d ∧ x ≫ d = (-f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') ≫ y := by
  rcases hx with ⟨Q, i, p, hTf, gbar, hg, hx⟩
  let Tf := Triangle.mk f i p
  have hTfi : Tf.rotate ∈ distTriang C := rot_of_distTriang Tf hTf
  obtain ⟨K, v, w, hTbar⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle gbar
  obtain ⟨Qg, j, q, hTg⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle g
  let Tbar := Triangle.mk gbar v w
  let Tg := Triangle.mk g j q
  let O := CategoryTheory.Triangulated.someOctahedron hg hTfi hTbar hTg
  dsimp only [Tf, Tbar, Tg, Triangle.mk, Triangle.rotate] at O
  have hpm : p ≫ O.m₁ = gbar ≫ j := by
    simpa [Tf, Tbar, Tg, O] using O.comm₁
  have hmq : O.m₁ ≫ q = -f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' := by
    exact O.comm₂
  have hgh : g ≫ h = 0 := (composable ⟨Q, i, p, hTf, gbar, hg, hx⟩).2
  obtain ⟨hbar₀, hhbar₀⟩ := Tg.yoneda_exact₂ hTg h hgh
  dsimp only [Tg, Triangle.mk] at hbar₀ hhbar₀
  let δ : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W := x - O.m₁ ≫ hbar₀
  have hpδ : p ≫ δ = 0 := by
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [Preadditive.comp_sub, hx, ← Category.assoc, hpm, Category.assoc,
      ← hhbar₀, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Tf.rotate.yoneda_exact₃ hTfi δ hpδ
  dsimp only [Tf, Triangle.mk, Triangle.rotate] at a ha
  let hbar : Qg ⟶ W := hbar₀ + q ≫ a
  have hjhbar : j ≫ hbar = h := by
    have hjq : j ≫ q = 0 := by
      have hzero := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₂₃ Tg hTg
      dsimp only [Tg, Triangle.mk] at hzero
      exact hzero
    dsimp [hbar]
    rw [Preadditive.comp_add, ← hhbar₀, ← Category.assoc, hjq, zero_comp, add_zero]
  have hmx : O.m₁ ≫ hbar = x := by
    dsimp [hbar]
    rw [Preadditive.comp_add, ← Category.assoc, hmq]
    rw [← ha]
    dsimp [δ]
    abel
  have hjhd : j ≫ (hbar ≫ d) = 0 := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hjhbar, hhd]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Tg.yoneda_exact₃ hTg (hbar ≫ d) hjhd
  dsimp only [Tg, Triangle.mk] at y hy
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨Qg, j, q, hTg, hbar, hjhbar, hy.symm⟩
  · calc
      x ≫ d = (O.m₁ ≫ hbar) ≫ d := by rw [hmx]
      _ = O.m₁ ≫ (hbar ≫ d) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = O.m₁ ≫ (q ≫ y) := by rw [← hy]
      _ = (O.m₁ ≫ q) ≫ y := by rw [Category.assoc]
      _ = (-f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') ≫ y := by rw [hmq]

label: decl:cf28a25e92a84db8
name: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.precompose
title: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.precompose
code:
public theorem precompose {A X Y Z W : C} {x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ W}
    (hx : Relation x f g h) (a : A ⟶ X) :
    Relation (a⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ x) (a ≫ f) g h := by
  obtain ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar, hg, hx⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨Q', i', p', hT'⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle (a ≫ f)
  obtain ⟨c, hi, hp⟩ := complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism
    (Triangle.mk (a ≫ f) i' p') (Triangle.mk f i p) hT' hT a (𝟙 Y) (by
      change (a ≫ f) ≫ 𝟙 Y = a ≫ f
      exact Category.comp_id _)
  dsimp only [Triangle.mk] at hi hp
  refine ⟨Q', i', p', hT', c ≫ gbar, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Category.assoc, hi]
    simpa using hg
  · rw [← Category.assoc, hp, Category.assoc, hx, Category.assoc]

label: decl:9b3379fe45fb28ec
name: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.postcompose
title: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.postcompose
code:
public theorem postcompose {X Y Z W V : C} {x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ W}
    (hx : Relation x f g h) (d : W ⟶ V) :
    Relation (x ≫ d) f g (h ≫ d) := by
  obtain ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar, hg, hx⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar, hg, ?_⟩
  rw [← Category.assoc, hx, Category.assoc]

label: decl:cb99c25779d4b42a
name: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.absorb_first
title: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.absorb_first
code:
public theorem absorb_first {X Y Z W V : C} {x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ V}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ W} {d : W ⟶ V}
    (hx : Relation x (f ≫ g) h d) :
    Relation x f (g ≫ h) d := by
  obtain ⟨Q, i, p, hT, hbar, hh, hx⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨Q', i', p', hT'⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle f
  obtain ⟨c, hi, hp⟩ := complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism
    (Triangle.mk f i' p') (Triangle.mk (f ≫ g) i p) hT' hT (𝟙 X) g (by
      change f ≫ g = 𝟙 X ≫ (f ≫ g)
      exact (Category.id_comp _).symm)
  dsimp only [Triangle.mk] at hi hp
  have hp' : p' = c ≫ p := by simpa using hp
  refine ⟨Q', i', p', hT', c ≫ hbar, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Category.assoc, hi, Category.assoc, hh]
  · rw [hp', Category.assoc, hx, Category.assoc]

label: decl:ff60e80ba27c864e
name: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.absorb_last
title: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.absorb_last
code:
public theorem absorb_last {X Y Z W V : C} {x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ V}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ W} {d : W ⟶ V}
    (hx : Relation x f g (h ≫ d)) :
    Relation x f (g ≫ h) d := by
  obtain ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar, hg, hx⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar ≫ h, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Category.assoc, hg]
  · simpa only [Category.assoc] using hx

label: decl:697aabbad3c79995
name: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.shuffle_iff
title: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.shuffle_iff
code:
public theorem shuffle_iff [IsTriangulated C] {X Y Z W V : C}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ W) (d : W ⟶ V)
    (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) (hgh : g ≫ h = 0) (hhd : h ≫ d = 0)
    (z : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ V) :
    (∃ x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W, Relation x f g h ∧ x ≫ d = z) ↔
      ∃ y : Y⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ V,
        Relation y g h d ∧ (-f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') ≫ y = z := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := juggling hx hhd
    exact ⟨y, hy, he.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := exists_relation f g h hfg hgh
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, hxy₀⟩ := juggling hx₀ hhd
    obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := indeterminacy_complete hy hy₀
    refine ⟨x₀ + f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ (-v), indeterminacy_left hx₀ (-v), ?_⟩
    have hzero : f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ g⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = 0 := by
      rw [← Functor.map_comp, hfg, Functor.map_zero]
    have he := congrArg (fun k => f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ k) huv
    simp only [Preadditive.comp_sub, Preadditive.comp_add, ← Category.assoc,
      hzero, zero_comp, zero_add] at he
    simp only [Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg, Preadditive.neg_comp]
    rw [hxy₀]
    simp only [Preadditive.neg_comp]
    rw [← he]
    abel
statement:
public theorem shuffle_iff [IsTriangulated C] {X Y Z W V : C}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ W) (d : W ⟶ V)
    (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) (hgh : g ≫ h = 0) (hhd : h ≫ d = 0)
    (z : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ V) :
    (∃ x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W, Relation x f g h ∧ x ≫ d = z) ↔
      ∃ y : Y⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ V,
        Relation y g h d ∧ (-f⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') ≫ y = z

label: decl:037dc546978d0288
name: _private.KIP126.Literature.Toda.0.KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.shifted_triangle_distinguished
title: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.shifted_triangle_distinguished
code:
private theorem shifted_triangle_distinguished (n : ℤ) {X Y Q : C}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (i : Y ⟶ Q) (p : Q ⟶ X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hT : Triangle.mk f i p ∈ distTriang C) :
    Triangle.mk (f⟦n⟧') (i⟦n⟧')
      (n.negOnePow • p⟦n⟧' ≫ (shiftFunctorComm C (1 : ℤ) n).hom.app X) ∈ distTriang C := by
  let e : Y⟦n⟧ ≅ Y⟦n⟧ :=
    { hom := n.negOnePow • 𝟙 _
      inv := n.negOnePow • 𝟙 _
      hom_inv_id := by simp [Linear.comp_units_smul, smul_smul]
      inv_hom_id := by simp [Linear.comp_units_smul, smul_smul] }
  apply isomorphic_distinguished _ (Triangle.shift_distinguished _ hT n)
  refine Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) e (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp [Triangle.shiftFunctor, Triangle.mk, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, e, Linear.comp_units_smul]
  · simp [Triangle.shiftFunctor, Triangle.mk, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, e, Linear.units_smul_comp, Linear.comp_units_smul, smul_smul]
  · simp [Triangle.shiftFunctor, Triangle.mk]
statement:
private theorem shifted_triangle_distinguished (n : ℤ) {X Y Q : C}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (i : Y ⟶ Q) (p : Q ⟶ X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hT : Triangle.mk f i p ∈ distTriang C) :
    Triangle.mk (f⟦n⟧') (i⟦n⟧')
      (n.negOnePow • p⟦n⟧' ≫ (shiftFunctorComm C (1 : ℤ) n).hom.app X) ∈ distTriang C

label: decl:0721828daf1cef26
name: _private.KIP126.Literature.Toda.0.KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.shifted_connecting_comp
title: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.shifted_connecting_comp
code:
private theorem shifted_connecting_comp (n : ℤ) {X Q W : C}
    (p : Q ⟶ X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W) :
    (n.negOnePow • p⟦n⟧' ≫ (shiftFunctorComm C (1 : ℤ) n).hom.app X) ≫
      (n.negOnePow • ((shiftFunctorComm C (1 : ℤ) n).inv.app X ≫ x⟦n⟧')) =
        (p ≫ x)⟦n⟧' := by
  simp only [Linear.units_smul_comp, Linear.comp_units_smul, smul_smul,
    Int.units_mul_self, one_smul, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc,
    Functor.map_comp]
statement:
private theorem shifted_connecting_comp (n : ℤ) {X Q W : C}
    (p : Q ⟶ X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W) :
    (n.negOnePow • p⟦n⟧' ≫ (shiftFunctorComm C (1 : ℤ) n).hom.app X) ≫
      (n.negOnePow • ((shiftFunctorComm C (1 : ℤ) n).inv.app X ≫ x⟦n⟧')) =
        (p ≫ x)⟦n⟧'

label: decl:c89844347bfbef40
name: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.suspension_iff
title: KIP126.StableHomotopy.Toda.suspension_iff
code:
public theorem suspension_iff (n : ℤ) {X Y Z W : C}
    {x : X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ W} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ W} :
    Relation
      (n.negOnePow • ((shiftFunctorComm C (1 : ℤ) n).inv.app X ≫ x⟦n⟧'))
      (f⟦n⟧') (g⟦n⟧') (h⟦n⟧') ↔ Relation x f g h := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨Q', i', p', hT', gbar', hg', hx'⟩
    obtain ⟨Q, i, p, hT⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle f
    let δ := n.negOnePow • p⟦n⟧' ≫ (shiftFunctorComm C (1 : ℤ) n).hom.app X
    obtain ⟨c, hi, hp⟩ := complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism
      (Triangle.mk (f⟦n⟧') (i⟦n⟧') δ) (Triangle.mk (f⟦n⟧') i' p')
      (shifted_triangle_distinguished n f i p hT) hT' (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by
        change f⟦n⟧' ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ f⟦n⟧'
        simp only [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])
    dsimp only [Triangle.mk] at hi hp
    have hi' : i⟦n⟧' ≫ c = i' := by simpa only [Category.id_comp] using hi
    have hp' : δ = c ≫ p' := by
      erw [(shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map_id, Category.comp_id] at hp
      exact hp
    let gbar := (shiftFunctor C n).preimage (c ≫ gbar')
    have hgbar : gbar⟦n⟧' = c ≫ gbar' := Functor.map_preimage _ _
    refine ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply (shiftFunctor C n).map_injective
      rw [Functor.map_comp, hgbar, ← Category.assoc, hi', hg']
    · apply (shiftFunctor C n).map_injective
      rw [← shifted_connecting_comp n p x]
      change δ ≫ _ = _
      rw [hp', Category.assoc, hx', Functor.map_comp, hgbar, Category.assoc]
  · rintro ⟨Q, i, p, hT, gbar, hg, hx⟩
    refine ⟨Q⟦n⟧, i⟦n⟧', n.negOnePow • p⟦n⟧' ≫

code:
private theorem only_d12_differential_reduction :
    (∀ (r : ℤ), 2 ≤ r → r ≠ 12 →
      ∀ y : model.classical.sphere.Page 2 (2+r,127+r),
        ¬ HasNonzeroDifferential model.classical.sphere r (2,128) (2+r,127+r)
          model.standardClasses.standardH6Square y) ∧
    ((∃ y : model.classical.sphere.Page 2 (14,139),
      HasNonzeroDifferential model.classical.sphere 12 (2,128) (14,139)
        model.standardClasses.standardH6Square y) ↔ H6SquareSupportsD12) ∧
    (¬ H6SquareSupportsD12 ↔ H6SquarePermanent) := by
  have hn : ¬ H6SquareSupportsD12 := fun hd => (d12_necessary hd).1 h6_sq_permanent
  refine ⟨fun r hr _ y => h6_square_no_outgoing r hr _ y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
      exact False.elim (h6_square_no_outgoing 12 (by decide) _ y hy)
    · intro hd
      exact False.elim (hn hd)
  · exact ⟨fun _ => h6_sq_permanent, fun _ => hn⟩

name: _private.KIP126.Main.Internal.AlphaOne.Coherence.0.KIP126.Main.Internal.AlphaOne.shiftSwap_add
title: KIP126.Main.Internal.AlphaOne.shiftSwap_add
code:
private theorem shiftSwap_add (coh : BiShiftCoherence SyntheticSpectrum)
    (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) (A : SyntheticSpectrum) :
    (shiftSwap a (b+c) A).hom ≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map ((biShiftAddIso b c (b+c) rfl).inv.app A) =
    (biShiftAddIso b c (b+c) rfl).inv.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) ≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift c).map (shiftSwap a b A).hom ≫
      (shiftSwap a c ((SyntheticCategory.biShift b).obj A)).hom := by
  classical
  let habc : (a+b)+c=a+(b+c) := add_assoc a b c
  let hbac : b+(a+c)=a+(b+c) := by abel
  have h₁ := coh.associativity a b c (a+b) (b+c) (a+(b+c)) rfl rfl habc rfl A
  have h₂ := coh.associativity b a c (a+b) (a+c) (a+(b+c))
    (add_comm _ _) rfl habc hbac A
  have h₃ := coh.associativity b c a (b+c) (a+c) (a+(b+c))
    rfl (add_comm _ _) (add_comm _ _) hbac A
  simp only [shiftSwap,Iso.trans_hom,Iso.symm_hom,Iso.app_hom,Iso.app_inv]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  apply (cancel_epi ((biShiftAddIso b c (b+c) rfl).hom.app
    ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A))).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc,← h₁]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  apply (cancel_epi ((SyntheticCategory.biShift c).map
    ((biShiftAddIso a b (a+b) rfl).hom.app A))).mpr
  -- Cancel the common left factor introduced by the first associativity square.
  apply (cancel_epi ((SyntheticCategory.biShift c).map
    ((biShiftAddIso b a (a+b) (add_comm _ _)).hom.app A))).mp
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app,CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,Category.id_comp]
  rw [← Category.assoc,h₂]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  apply (cancel_epi ((biShiftAddIso a c (a+c) rfl).hom.app
    ((SyntheticCategory.biShift b).obj A))).mpr
  apply (cancel_epi ((biShiftAddIso c a (a+c) (add_comm _ _)).hom.app
    ((SyntheticCategory.biShift b).obj A))).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc,← Category.assoc,← h₃]
  simp only [Category.assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Category.id_comp,←Functor.map_comp,Iso.hom_inv_id_app,CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]

code:
private theorem lambda_pow_shift (coh : BiShiftCoherence SyntheticSpectrum)
    (n : ℕ) (a : ℤ × ℤ) (A : SyntheticSpectrum) :
    lambdaPow n ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
      (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n) A).hom ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (lambdaPow n A) := by
  classical
  induction n generalizing A with
  | zero =>
    change SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
      (shiftSwap a 0 A).hom ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A)
    have h : SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
        (biShiftAddIso a 0 a (add_zero a)).hom.app A ≫
          (biShiftAddIso 0 a a (zero_add a)).inv.app A ≫
            (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) := by
      rw [←coh.left_unit a A,Iso.inv_hom_id_app,Category.comp_id]
      exact (coh.right_unit a A).symm
    rw [shiftSwap_hom_eq a 0 a (add_zero a) (zero_add a),Category.assoc]
    exact h
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 : lambdaPow 1 ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
        (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree 1) A).hom ≫
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (lambdaPow 1 A) := by
      rw [lambdaPow_one coh,lambdaPow_one coh]
      change SyntheticCategory.lam.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
        (shiftSwap a (0,-1) A).hom ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (SyntheticCategory.lam.app A)
      rw [shiftSwap_hom_eq a (0,-1) (a+(0,-1)) rfl (add_comm _ _),Category.assoc]
      exact coh.lambda_comm a A
    have hn := shiftSwap_natural a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n) (lambdaPow 1 A)
    have hh := shiftSwap_add_eq coh a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree 1) (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n)
      (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree (n+1)) (by ext <;> simp [KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree]) A
    change (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree (n+1)) A).hom ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map ((lambdaShiftAddIso 1 n (n+1) (by omega)).inv.app A) =
      (lambdaShiftAddIso 1 n (n+1) (by omega)).inv.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n)).map (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree 1) A).hom ≫
        (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n) ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree 1)).obj A)).hom at hh
    rw [lambdaPow_add coh 1 n (n+1) (by omega) ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A),
      lambdaPow_add coh 1 n (n+1) (by omega) A,h1,ih]
    simp only [Functor.map_comp,Category.assoc]
    rw [reassoc_of% hn]
    rw [reassoc_of% hh]
    rfl

    (n : ℕ) (a : ℤ × ℤ) (A : SyntheticSpectrum) :

      (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n) A).hom ≫

private theorem shift_assoc_inv (coh : BiShiftCoherence SyntheticSpectrum)
    (a b c ab bc total : ℤ × ℤ) (hab : a+b=ab) (hbc : b+c=bc)
    (habc : ab+c=total) (habc' : a+bc=total) (A : SyntheticSpectrum) :
    (biShiftAddIso ab c total habc).inv.app A ≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift c).map ((biShiftAddIso a b ab hab).inv.app A) =
    (biShiftAddIso a bc total habc').inv.app A ≫
      (biShiftAddIso b c bc hbc).inv.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) := by
  classical
  have he : ((SyntheticCategory.biShift c).mapIso ((biShiftAddIso a b ab hab).app A) ≪≫
      (biShiftAddIso ab c total habc).app A) =
    ((biShiftAddIso b c bc hbc).app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) ≪≫
      (biShiftAddIso a bc total habc').app A) :=
    Iso.ext (coh.associativity a b c ab bc total hab hbc habc habc' A)
  have hi := congrArg Iso.inv he
  exact hi

private theorem sphere_action_lambda_three
    (η : BiHom 1 2 (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum))
    (a : BiHom 123 132 (XModLambdaN (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) 11)) :
    sphereAction (lambdaMultiply 3 η) a = lambdaMultiply 3 (sphereAction η a) := by
  classical
  let S := (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum)
  have h₁ := shift_assoc_inv model.quotients.coherence (1,2) (123,132) (0,-3)
    (124,134) (123,129) (124,131) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) S
  have h₂ := shift_assoc_inv model.quotients.coherence (1,2) (0,-3) (123,132)
    (1,-1) (123,129) (124,131) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) S
  simp only [biShiftAddIso,Iso.trans_inv,eqToIso.inv,
    eqToHom_refl,Category.id_comp] at h₁ h₂
  have hp :
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (124,134) (0,-3)).inv.app S ≫
      lambdaPow 3 (Smn 124 134) ≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (1,2) (123,132)).inv.app S =
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (1,-1) (123,132)).inv.app S ≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (123,132)).map
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (1,2) (0,-3)).inv.app S) ≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (123,132)).map (lambdaPow 3 (Smn 1 2)) := by
    rw [←lambdaPow_naturality]
    change (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (124,134) (0,-3)).inv.app S ≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-3)).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (1,2) (123,132)).inv.app S) ≫
      lambdaPow 3 ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (123,132)).obj (Smn 1 2)) = _
    rw [lambda_pow_shift model.quotients.coherence 3 (123,132) (Smn 1 2)]
    dsimp only [shiftSwap,KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree]
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom,Iso.trans_inv,Iso.symm_hom,Iso.app_hom,Iso.app_inv,biShiftAddIso,eqToIso.hom,eqToIso.inv,eqToHom_refl,
      Category.comp_id,Category.id_comp]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    erw [←Category.assoc ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (124,134) (0,-3)).inv.app S)]
    erw [h₁]
    simp only [Category.assoc,Smn,S,Nat.cast_ofNat,Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
    simpa only [Category.assoc,Smn,S,Nat.cast_ofNat] using
      (congrArg (fun z => z ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (123,132)).map (lambdaPow 3 (Smn 1 2))) h₂.symm)
  unfold sphereAction lambdaMultiply
  simp only [eqToHom_refl,Category.id_comp,Functor.map_comp,Category.assoc]
  simpa only [Category.assoc,S,Smn,Int.reduceAdd,Int.reduceSub,Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    (congrArg (fun z => z ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (123,132)).map η ≫ a) hp).symm

private theorem lambda_one_division_of_quotient_zero
    {X : SyntheticSpectrum} (m w : ℤ) (z : BiHom m (w-1) X) (hz : quotientClass 1 z=0) :
    ∃ b : BiHom m w X, lambdaMultiply 1 b=z := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := (KIP126.Main.Internal.Selected.vanishesModLambda_iff_factors 1 z).mp hz
  let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-1)
  let e : F.obj (Smn m w : SyntheticSpectrum) ≅ Smn m (w-1) :=
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (m,w) (0,-1)).app S_0_0 ≪≫
      eqToIso (by congr 1; simp [sub_eq_add_neg])
  let b := (SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-1)).preimage (e.hom≫a)
  have hb : F.map b=e.hom≫a :=
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-1)).map_preimage _
  refine ⟨b,?_⟩
  have he : lambdaMultiply 1 b=e.inv≫lambdaPow 1 (Smn m w)≫b := by
    unfold lambdaMultiply
    change eqToHom (by congr 1; simp) ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (m,w) (0,-1)).inv.app S_0_0 ≫
      lambdaPow 1 (Smn m w) ≫ b =
      (eqToHom (by congr 1; simp) ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (m,w) (0,-1)).inv.app S_0_0) ≫
      lambdaPow 1 (Smn m w) ≫ b
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  rw [he]

private theorem stem123_weight130_finite_quotients_boundary_of_zero_representative
    {r : ℤ} {p : ℤ×ℤ} {x : Normalized.sphere.Page 2 p}
    (hx : RepresentsOnPage (Normalized.sphere) r p x 0) :
    x ∈ boundaries (r-1) p := by
  classical
  let E := Normalized.sphere
  let P := E.ssData p
  obtain ⟨hr,z,hz,hzero⟩ := hx
  change (Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ↑(r-2).toNat) (P.Z 0) _ ≫ P.pageπ 0) z=x at hz
  change P.pageπ ↑(r-2).toNat z=0 at hzero
  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := (cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff_mem_range
    (Subobject.ofLE (P.B ↑(r-2).toNat) (P.Z ↑(r-2).toNat) (P.B_le_Z _)) z).mp hzero
  have hrindex : r-1-1=r-2 := by omega
  change ∃ y, boundaryMap ↑(r-1-1).toNat p y=x
  rw [hrindex]
  refine ⟨y,?_⟩
  have hf : Subobject.ofLE (P.B ↑(r-2).toNat) (P.Z ↑(r-2).toNat) (P.B_le_Z _) ≫
      cycleMap ↑(r-2).toNat p = boundaryMap ↑(r-2).toNat p := by
    dsimp only [boundaryMap,cycleMap,boundaryMapFor,cycleMapFor,P,E]
    rw [←Category.assoc,Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
  rw [←hf,CategoryTheory.comp_apply,hy]
  exact hz

private theorem stem123_weight130_finite_quotients_cycle_quotient_zero_of_page
    (r c b : ℤ) (p : ℤ×ℤ) (hr : 2≤r) (hc : r≤c+1) (hb : r-1≤b)
    (hz : Subsingleton ((Normalized.sphere).Page r p)) :
    Subsingleton (CycleQuotient c b p) := by
  apply quotient_subsingleton_of_le
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨x',hx'⟩ := (cycles_reaches c p (by omega) x).mp hx
  obtain ⟨xr,hxr⟩ := represents_before hr hc hx'
  rw [hz.elim xr 0] at hxr
  exact boundaries_monotone p hb
    (stem123_weight130_finite_quotients_boundary_of_zero_representative hxr)

        exact_mod_cast (show (2 - E.r₀).toNat ≤ (r - E.r₀).toNat by omega))) ≫

      ((f.pageMap p (↑(2 - E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ) ≫ eqToHom
        (congrArg (fun a : ℤ => (E'.ssData (τ p)).page
          (↑(2 - a).toNat : WithTop ℕ)) hstart)) x)
      ((f.pageMap p (↑(r - E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ) ≫ eqToHom
        (congrArg (fun a : ℤ => (E'.ssData (τ p)).page
          (↑(r - a).toNat : WithTop ℕ)) hstart)) y) := by
  rcases E with ⟨⟨r₀, D, δ, d⟩, dd, Zs, Bs⟩
  rcases E' with ⟨⟨r₀', D', δ', d'⟩, dd', Zs', Bs'⟩
  dsimp at hstart
  subst r₀'
  obtain ⟨hr, z, hx, hy⟩ := h
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2 - r₀).toNat
  let m : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r - r₀).toNat

    have heq :

        f.cycleMap p m ≫

            ((D' (τ p)).Z_anti hnm) ≫ (D' (τ p)).pageπ n := by
      rw [Category.assoc, hp]
      exact hs

private theorem finite_last_nonzero_last_cycle_infinity_lift
    (E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) Tridegree)
    (r : ℤ) (hr : E.r₀ ≤ r) (p : Tridegree)
    (z : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((E.ssData p).Z ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
    (hz : E.d r p ((E.ssData p).pageπ ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat z) = 0)
    (hout : ∀ j : ℤ, r+1 ≤ j → E.d j p = 0) :
    ∃ zi : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((E.ssData p).Z ⊤) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((E.ssData p).Z_anti le_top)) zi = z := by
  classical
  let D := E.ssData p
  let n := (r-E.r₀).toNat
  have hsucc : (↑n : WithTop ℕ) ≤ ↑(n+1) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n
  let i := Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ↑(n+1)) (D.Z ↑n) (D.Z_anti hsucc)
  have hker : D.pageπ ↑n z ∈ LinearMap.ker (E.d r p).hom := hz
  rw [←subobjectModule_kernel,E.Z_succ r p hr,subobjectModule_image] at hker
  obtain ⟨z',hz'⟩ := hker
  change D.pageπ ↑n (i z') = D.pageπ ↑n z at hz'
  have hzero : D.pageπ ↑n (z-i z')=0 := by rw [map_sub,hz',sub_self]
  have hb : ∃ b : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.B ↑n) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE (D.B ↑n) (D.Z ↑n) (D.B_le_Z _)) b = z-i z' :=
    (cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff_mem_range _ _).mp hzero
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hb
  have hBZ : D.B ↑n ≤ D.Z ↑(n+1) := (D.B_mono hsucc).trans (D.B_le_Z _)
  let zn : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z ↑(n+1)) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) :=
    z' + (Subobject.ofLE (D.B ↑n) (D.Z ↑(n+1)) hBZ) b
  have hnz : i zn=z := by
    dsimp only [zn]
    rw [map_add]
    change i z' + (Subobject.ofLE (D.B ↑n) (D.Z ↑(n+1)) hBZ ≫ i) b = z
    dsimp only [i]
    rw [Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE,hb]
    abel
  have hn1 : (r+1-E.r₀).toNat=n+1 := by dsimp only [n]; omega
  have hZ : D.Z ⊤ = D.Z ↑(n+1) := by
    have hh := cycles_top_eq_of_d_eq_zero E (r+1) (by omega) p hout
    simpa only [hn1] using hh
  let zi := (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ↑(n+1)) (D.Z ⊤) hZ.ge) zn
  refine ⟨zi,?_⟩
  dsimp only [zi]
  rw [←CategoryTheory.comp_apply,Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
  exact hnz

    (z : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((E.ssData p).Z ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))

private theorem finite_last_nonzero_normalized_last_cycle_infinity
    (A : SyntheticAdamsSS.{v}) (r : ℤ) (i : Tridegree)
    (x : A.E₂ i) (xr : A.Page r i)
    (hx : SyntheticRepresentsOnPage A r i x xr)
    (hd : A.d r i xr = 0)
    (hout : ∀ j : ℤ, r+1 ≤ j → A.d j i = 0) :
    ∃ e, HasInfinityRepresentative A 2 i x e := by
  classical
  rcases A with ⟨⟨⟨r₀,S,deg,d⟩,dd,Zs,Bs⟩,hf,hdeg⟩
  dsimp only at hf
  subst r₀
  have hdg : deg=syntheticAdamsRawShift := funext hdeg
  subst deg
  let E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) Tridegree :=
    ⟨⟨2,S,syntheticAdamsRawShift,d⟩,dd,Zs,Bs⟩
  obtain ⟨hr,z,hz,hzr⟩ := hx
  simp only [SyntheticAdamsSS.d,eqToHom_refl,Category.comp_id] at hd hout
  have hz0 : E.d r i ((E.ssData i).pageπ ↑(r-2).toNat z) = 0 := by
    rw [hzr]
    exact hd
  have ho : ∀ j : ℤ, r+1≤j → E.d j i=0 := hout
  obtain ⟨zi,hzi⟩ := finite_last_nonzero_last_cycle_infinity_lift E r hr i z hz0 ho
  refine ⟨(S i).pageπ ⊤ zi,by norm_num,zi,?_,rfl⟩
  change ((Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((S i).Z_anti le_top)) ≫ (S i).pageπ 0) zi=x
  rw [←hz,←hzi]
  rw [←CategoryTheory.comp_apply]
  dsimp only [E]
  rw [Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE_assoc]
  rfl

private theorem finite_last_nonzero_classical_to_finite_equation
    (q r k : ℕ) (hr : 2≤r) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : model.classical.sphere.Page 2 (s,t)) (y : model.classical.sphere.Page 2 (s+r,t+r-1))

      (model.family.quotient (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q) r
      (s,t,t-k) (s+r,t+r-1,(t+r-1)-(k+(r-1):ℕ))
      (quotientLabel q s t k x)
      (quotientLabel q (s+r) (t+r-1) (k+(r-1)) y) := by
  classical
  let f : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).obj (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum) ⟶
      (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) :=
    SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum) ≫ model.nu.unitIso.hom
  let nx : (model.family.obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).obj (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum))).E₂ (s,t,t-k) := by
    simpa only [ClassicalObject.obj,add_zero] using model.comparison.nuE2 .sphere 0 s t k x
  let ny : (model.family.obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).obj (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum))).E₂
      (s+r,t+r-1,(t+r-1)-(k+(r-1):ℕ)) := by
    simpa only [ClassicalObject.obj,add_zero] using model.comparison.nuE2 .sphere 0 (s+r) (t+r-1) (k+(r-1)) y
  have hnx : familyPageMap model.family f 2 (s,t,t-k) nx = model.comparison.sphereE2 s t k x := by
    exact model.comparison.sphere_nu s t k x
  have hny : familyPageMap model.family f 2 (s+r,t+r-1,(t+r-1)-(k+(r-1):ℕ)) ny =
      model.comparison.sphereE2 (s+r) (t+r-1) (k+(r-1)) y := by
    exact model.comparison.sphere_nu (s+r) (t+r-1) (k+(r-1)) y
  have hs := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_differentials .sphere 0 s t r k hr x y).mp h
  have hx : familyPageMap model.family (f ≫ XModLambdaN.incl S_0_0 q) 2 (s,t,t-k)
      nx = quotientLabel q s t k x := by
    rw [finite_last_nonzero_quotient_family_map_comp]
    change familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl S_0_0 q) 2 (s,t,t-k)

      ny =
      quotientLabel q (s+r) (t+r-1) (k+(r-1)) y := by
    rw [finite_last_nonzero_quotient_family_map_comp]
    change familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl S_0_0 q) 2 _

    rw [hny]

  have hs' : SyntheticHasDifferential
      (model.family.obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).obj (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum))) r
      (s,t,t-k) (s+r,t+r-1,(t+r-1)-(k+(r-1):ℕ))
      nx
      ny := by
    convert hs using 1 <;> simp [nx,ny,ClassicalObject.obj]

    (s,t,t-k) (s+r,t+r-1,(t+r-1)-(k+(r-1):ℕ)) _ _ hs'

    (E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ))
    (r t : ℤ) (p : ℤ×ℤ) (_hr : E.r₀ ≤ r) (hrt : r≤t)
    (hzero : Subsingleton (E.Page r p)) : Subsingleton (E.Page t p) := by
  let A := E.ssData p
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat
  let m : WithTop ℕ := ↑(t-E.r₀).toNat

    dsimp only [n,m]
    exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_le_toNat (by omega : r-E.r₀≤t-E.r₀)
  have hz (z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (A.Z m) : ModuleCat ℤ)) : A.pageπ m z=0 := by
    let i := Subobject.ofLE (A.Z m) (A.Z n) (A.Z_anti hnm)
    have hzn : A.pageπ n (i z)=0 := hzero.elim _ _
    have hb := (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (A.B n) (A.Z n) (A.B_le_Z n) (i z)).mp hzn
    change (i ≫ (A.Z n).arrow) z ∈ _ at hb
    simp only [i,Subobject.ofLE_arrow] at hb
    apply (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (A.B m) (A.Z m) (A.B_le_Z m) z).mpr
    exact (ModuleCat.subobjectModule A.V).monotone (A.B_mono hnm) hb
  haveI : Epi (A.pageπ m) := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  have hall (x : E.Page t p) : x=0 := by
    obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective (A.pageπ m)).mp inferInstance x
    exact hz z
  exact ⟨fun x y => (hall x).trans (hall y).symm⟩

  change (∃ z, cycleMap (↑(c-1).toNat) p z=x) ↔
    ∃ y : (Normalized.sphere.ssData p).page ↑(c+1-2).toNat,

          (Subobject.ofLE ((Normalized.sphere.ssData p).Z ↑(c+1-2).toNat)
            ((Normalized.sphere.ssData p).Z 0) ((Normalized.sphere.ssData p).Z_anti bot_le) ≫
            (Normalized.sphere.ssData p).pageπ 0) z=x ∧
            (Normalized.sphere.ssData p).pageπ ↑(c+1-2).toNat z=y

  · rintro ⟨z,hz⟩

      ((Normalized.sphere.ssData p).Z 0) _) ≫ (Normalized.sphere.ssData p).pageπ 0 ≫ 𝟙 _) z=x at hz

      ((Normalized.sphere.ssData p).Z 0) _) ≫ (Normalized.sphere.ssData p).pageπ 0 ≫ 𝟙 _) z=x

private theorem frame_actual (c b : ℤ) (p : ℤ×ℤ)
    (x : model.classical.sphere.Page 2 p)
    (h : ∃ z : cycles c p, z.val=Normalized.label p x ∧
      ∀ q : CycleQuotient c b p, q=0 ∨ q=subquotientClass (cycles c p) (boundaries b p) z) :
    ∃ z : KIP126.Literature.cycles model .sphere c p, z.val=x ∧
      ∀ q : KIP126.Literature.CycleQuotient model .sphere c b p,
        q=0 ∨ q=subquotientClass (KIP126.Literature.cycles model .sphere c p) (KIP126.Literature.boundaries model .sphere b p) z := by
  let Z (E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ)) (hr : E.r₀=2) :=
    LinearMap.range (cycleMapFor E hr (↑(c-1).toNat) p).hom
  let B (E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ)) (hr : E.r₀=2) :=
    LinearMap.range (boundaryMapFor E hr (↑(b-1).toNat) p).hom
  let Frame (E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ))
      (hr : E.r₀=2) (x : E.Page 2 p) : Prop :=
    ∃ z : Z E hr, z.val=x ∧ ∀ q : E2Subquotient (Z E hr) (B E hr),
      q=0 ∨ q=subquotientClass (Z E hr) (B E hr) z
  have tr (E E' : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ))
      (he : E=E') (hr : E.r₀=2) (x : E.Page 2 p)
      (h : Frame E' (he ▸ hr) ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun A => A.Page 2 p) he)) x)) :
      Frame E hr x := by
    cases he
    exact h
  exact tr _ _ Normalized.sphere_eq.symm (model.classical.firstPage _) x h

      simp only [sphereProduct,Functor.map_add,Preadditive.add_comp,Preadditive.comp_add]

private theorem detects_of_difference_in_next_filtration
    {H' : SyntheticSpectrum} {unit : S_0_0 ⟶ H'}
    {F : SyntheticAdamsFamily SyntheticSpectrum} {X : SyntheticSpectrum}
    {T : SyntheticTowerPresentation unit F}
    (c : SyntheticTowerConvergence T X) (i : Tridegree)
    {x : (F.obj X).E₂ i} {a b : BiHom (i.2.1-i.1) i.2.2 X}
    (ha : Detects c i x a) (hb : FiltrationAtLeast T (i.1+1) (b-a)) :
    Detects c i x b := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e,he,a',ha',hga⟩ := ha
  let P := T.filtration X
  let p := (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2)
  have hmem : b-a∈(ModuleCat.subobjectModule (syntheticHomotopy X p)) (P.F (i.1+1) p) := by
    simpa only [P,p,FiltrationAtLeast,SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hb
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hmem
  let j := Subobject.ofLE (P.F (i.1+1) p) (P.F i.1 p) (P.mono i.1 p)
  refine ⟨e,he,a'+j z,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [map_add]
    have hj : (P.F i.1 p).arrow (j z)=(P.F (i.1+1) p).arrow z :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Subobject.ofLE_arrow (P.mono i.1 p)) z
    rw [hj,ha',hz]
    abel
  · rw [map_add]
    have hj : P.toAssociatedGraded i.1 p (j z)=0 :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (cokernel.condition j) z
    rw [hj,add_zero]
    exact hga

    {H' : SyntheticSpectrum} {unit : S_0_0 ⟶ H'}
    {F : SyntheticAdamsFamily SyntheticSpectrum} {X : SyntheticSpectrum}
    {T : SyntheticTowerPresentation unit F} (c : SyntheticTowerConvergence T X)
    (s m w : ℤ) (hzero : IsZero ((F.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,m+s,w)).eInfty)
    (a : BiHom m w X) (ha : FiltrationAtLeast T s a) :
    FiltrationAtLeast T (s+1) a := by
  let P := T.filtration X
  have hz : IsZero (P.associatedGraded s (m,w)) := by
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using
      (c.identification (s,m+s,w)).isZero_iff.mp hzero
  have hmem : a ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule (syntheticHomotopy X (m,w))) (P.F s (m,w)) := by
    simpa only [P, FiltrationAtLeast, SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,
      OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using ha
  obtain ⟨a',ha'⟩ := hmem
  have hgrade : P.toAssociatedGraded s (m,w) a' = 0 :=
    (ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz).elim _ _
  have hnext := (P.toAssociatedGraded_eq_zero_iff s (m,w) a').mp hgrade
  rw [ha'] at hnext
  simpa only [P, FiltrationAtLeast, SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,
    OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hnext

private theorem permanentQuotient_zero_of_page_zero
    (X : ClassicalObject) (r b : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hb : r-1 ≤ b)
    (hpage : Subsingleton ((model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).Page r p)) :
    Subsingleton (KIP126.Literature.PermanentQuotient model X b p) := by
  let E := (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).ssData p
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r-(model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).r₀).toNat
  have hn : (↑(r-1-1).toNat : WithTop ℕ) = n := by
    dsimp only [n]
    rw [model.classical.firstPage]
    congr 2
    omega
  have hcycles : KIP126.Literature.permanentCycles model X p ≤
      KIP126.Literature.boundaries model X (r-1) p := by
    rintro x ⟨z,hz⟩
    let zf := (Subobject.ofLE (E.Z ⊤) (E.Z n) (E.Z_anti le_top)) z
    have hzero : E.pageπ n zf = 0 := hpage.elim _ _
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := (cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff_mem_range
      (Subobject.ofLE (E.B n) (E.Z n) (E.B_le_Z n)) zf).mp hzero
    change ∃ y, KIP126.Literature.boundaryLabel model X (↑(r-1-1).toNat) p y = x
    rw [hn]
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    have hfactor : Subobject.ofLE (E.B n) (E.Z n) (E.B_le_Z n) ≫
        KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel model X n p =
        KIP126.Literature.boundaryLabel model X n p := by
      simp only [KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel,KIP126.Literature.boundaryLabel,E,
        ←Category.assoc,Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
    rw [←hfactor,ModuleCat.comp_apply,hy]
    have htop : Subobject.ofLE (E.Z ⊤) (E.Z n) (E.Z_anti le_top) ≫
        KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel model X n p =
        KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel model X ⊤ p := by
      simp only [KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel,E,←Category.assoc,Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
    exact (congrArg (fun f => f z) htop).trans hz
  have hle : KIP126.Literature.permanentCycles model X p ≤
      KIP126.Literature.boundaries model X b p :=
    hcycles.trans (KIP126.Literature.boundaries_monotone model X p hb)
  exact subquotient_subsingleton_of_le _ _ hle

private theorem lambda_powers_injective_of_lower_weights
    (coh : BiShiftCoherence SyntheticSpectrum) (m wt : ℤ) (X : SyntheticSpectrum)
    (h : ∀ wt' : ℤ, wt' ≤ wt → LambdaInjectiveAt m wt' X) :
    LambdaPowersInjectiveAt m wt X := by
  have one (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (fun a :
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k : ℤ))).obj (Smn (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) m wt) ⟶ X =>
      SyntheticCategory.lam.app _ ≫ a) := by
    let e : Smn (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) m (wt-k) ≅
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k : ℤ))).obj (Smn m wt) :=
      eqToIso (by dsimp only [Smn]; congr 1; simp [sub_eq_add_neg]) ≪≫
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (m,wt) (0,-(k : ℤ))).app S_0_0).symm
    intro a b hab
    apply (cancel_epi e.hom).mp
    apply h (wt-k) (by omega)
    dsimp only [lambdaAction]
    have hc : SyntheticCategory.lam.app (Smn (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) m (wt-k)) ≫ (e.hom ≫ a) =
        SyntheticCategory.lam.app (Smn (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) m (wt-k)) ≫ (e.hom ≫ b) := by
      have hn := SyntheticCategory.lam.naturality e.hom
      dsimp only [Functor.id_map] at hn
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ← hn]
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using
        congrArg (fun z => (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-1)).map e.hom ≫ z) hab
    exact congrArg (fun z => _ ≫ _ ≫ z) hc
  have powers (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (fun a : BiHom m wt X =>
      lambdaPow k (Smn m wt) ≫ a) := by
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro a b hab
      exact (cancel_epi (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app (Smn m wt))).mp hab
    | succ k ih =>
      intro a b hab
      apply ih
      apply one k
      rw [lambdaPow_add coh k 1 (k+1) rfl, lambdaPow_one coh] at hab
      have hc := (cancel_epi ((lambdaShiftAddIso k 1 (k+1) rfl).inv.app (Smn (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) m wt))).mp
        (by simpa only [Category.assoc] using hab)
      have hn := SyntheticCategory.lam.naturality (lambdaPow k (Smn (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) m wt))
      dsimp only [Functor.id_map] at hn
      change (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-1)).map (lambdaPow k (Smn m wt)) ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.lam.app (Smn m wt) ≫ a) =
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-1)).map (lambdaPow k (Smn m wt)) ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.lam.app (Smn m wt) ≫ b) at hc
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc] at hc
      rw [hn] at hc
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using hc
  intro k a b hab
  apply powers k
  dsimp only [lambdaMultiply] at hab
  have hc := (cancel_epi (eqToHom (by congr 1; simp))).mp hab
  exact (cancel_epi ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (m,wt) (0,-(k : ℤ))).inv.app S_0_0)).mp
    (by simpa only [Category.assoc] using hc)

private theorem lambda_shifted_finite_high_filtration_zero

    (hs : (q:ℤ) ≤ (m-δ.1)+s-(w-δ.2))

      (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q)))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s a) : a=0 := by
  let p : ℤ × ℤ := (m-δ.1,w-δ.2)
  have hp : p+δ=(m,w) := by ext <;> simp [p]
  let e : FilteredPieceIso (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))).filtration
      (model.convergence (.shift δ (.quotient q (.nu X)))).filtration p (m,w) :=
    hp ▸ (KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Standard.essShift δ).filtered (.quotient q (.nu X)) p
  have hmem : a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _
      ((model.convergence (.shift δ (.quotient q (.nu X)))).filtration.F s (m,w)) := by
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerConvergence.filtration,
      SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,
      FiltrationAtLeast,SyntheticObject.obj] using ha
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hmem
  have hcomm := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (e.symm.level_arrow s) x
  simp only [ModuleCat.comp_apply, FilteredPieceIso.symm] at hcomm
  have hm : e.ambient.inv a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _
      ((model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))).filtration.F s p) := by
    refine ⟨(e.level s).inv x,?_⟩
    change ((model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))).filtration.F s p).arrow
      ((e.level s).inv x) = e.ambient.inv a
    simpa only [hx,Iso.symm_hom] using hcomm
  have hb : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s (e.ambient.inv a) := by
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerConvergence.filtration,
      SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,
      FiltrationAtLeast] using hm
  have hz := KIP126.ProofTools.Operations.finite_high_filtration_zero X q hq p.1 p.2 s hs
    (e.ambient.inv a) hb
  apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective e.ambient.inv).mp inferInstance
  simpa only [map_zero] using hz

private theorem lambda_boundary_no_return (X : ClassicalObject) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0<q)
    (m w : ℤ)
    (c : BiHom m w ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-(q:ℤ))).obj
      (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))))
    (z : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-(q:ℤ))).obj
      (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) ⟶
        XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q) : c ≫ z = 0 := by
  let A : SyntheticObject := .shift (1,-(q:ℤ)) (.nu X)
  let B : SyntheticObject := .quotient q (.nu X)
  let L : ℤ := w-m+1+q
  have hzA (k : ℤ) (hk : k<L) :
      IsZero (((model.family.obj (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData (k,m+k,w)).eInfty) := by
    haveI : Subsingleton (nuEInftyModel model X (k,m-1+k) (w+q)) := by
      simp only [nuEInftyModel,show ¬ w+(q:ℤ)≤(k,m-1+k).2 by dsimp [L] at hk ⊢; omega,ite_false]
      infer_instance
    haveI : Subsingleton (((model.family.obj (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).sequence.ssData
        (k,m-1+k,w+q)).eInfty) :=
      (KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_nu X (k,m-1+k) (w+q)).injective.subsingleton
    have hz := ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton (((model.family.obj
      (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).sequence.ssData (k,m-1+k,w+q)).eInfty)
    let e := towerInfinityIso (model.convergence (.nu X)) (model.convergence A)
      ((KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.Standard.essShift (1,-(q:ℤ))).filtered (.nu X) (m-1,w+q)) k
    have he := hz.of_iso e.symm
    simpa only [e,A,Prod.fst_add,Prod.snd_add,sub_add_cancel,add_neg_cancel_right] using he
  have hc0 : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower 0 c := by
    refine ⟨c ≫ (model.syntheticTower.tower _).zeroIso.inv, ?_⟩
    change (c ≫ (model.syntheticTower.tower _).zeroIso.inv) ≫
      (model.syntheticTower.tower _).projection 0 = c
    simp only [AbstractAdamsTower.projection,Int.toNat_zero,AbstractAdamsTower.map_self]
    erw [Category.assoc,Category.id_comp,Iso.inv_hom_id,Category.comp_id]

    by_cases hL : L≤0

    · exact (filtration_iff_of_infinity_zero (model.convergence A) 0 L m w
        (by omega) (fun k _ hk => hzA k hk) c).mp hc0
  have hcz := map_preserves_filtration (model.convergentMap A B z) (m,w) L c hcL
  exact finite_high_filtration_zero X q hq m w L (by dsimp [L]; omega) (c≫z) hcz

private theorem lambda_quotient_maps_equal_on_spheres
    (X : ClassicalObject) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0<q)
    (f g : XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q ⟶
      XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q)
    (hfg : XModLambdaN.incl _ q ≫ f = XModLambdaN.incl _ q ≫ g)
    (m w : ℤ) (c : BiHom m w (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q)) :
    c ≫ f = c ≫ g := by
  let Y := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  have hzero : XModLambdaN.incl Y q ≫ (f-g) = 0 := by
    rw [Preadditive.comp_sub,hfg,sub_self]
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (XModLambdaN.cofiberTriangle Y q).yoneda_exact₃
    (XModLambdaN.cofiberTriangle_distinguished Y q) (f-g) hzero
  let e := (KIP126.ProofTools.Operations.biSuspensionIso (q:ℤ) Y).symm
  have hn := lambda_boundary_no_return X q hq m w
    ((c ≫ XModLambdaN.proj Y q) ≫ e.hom) (e.inv ≫ z)
  have hn' : (c ≫ XModLambdaN.proj Y q) ≫ z = 0 := by
    simpa only [Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc] using hn
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [←Preadditive.comp_sub,hz,←Category.assoc]

private theorem lambda_first_quotient_delta_evaluation
    (X : ClassicalObject) (i j : ℕ)
    (T : LambdaRhoDeltaTriangle (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i j)
    (m w : ℤ)
    (a : BiHom m w (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i)) :
    a ≫ T.delta = a ≫ XModLambdaN.proj (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i ≫
      (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map
          (XModLambdaN.incl (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (j-i))) := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hδ⟩ := complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism
    (XModLambdaN.cofiberTriangle A i) (Triangle.mk T.lambdaMap T.rho T.delta)
    (XModLambdaN.cofiberTriangle_distinguished A i) T.distinguished
    ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl A (j-i)))
    (XModLambdaN.incl A j) T.lambda_quotient.symm
  change XModLambdaN A i ⟶ XModLambdaN A i at c
  change XModLambdaN.incl A i ≫ c = XModLambdaN.incl A j ≫ T.rho at hc
  have hc' : XModLambdaN.incl A i ≫ c = XModLambdaN.incl A i ≫ 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [hc,T.rho_quotient,Category.comp_id]
  have hac : a ≫ c = a := by
    simpa only [Category.comp_id] using
      lambda_quotient_maps_equal_on_spheres X i T.i_pos c (𝟙 _) hc' m w a
  change XModLambdaN.proj A i ≫ (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl A (j-i))) =
    c ≫ T.delta at hδ
  calc
    a ≫ T.delta = (a ≫ c) ≫ T.delta := by rw [hac]
    _ = a ≫ XModLambdaN.proj A i ≫ (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl A (j-i))) := by
      rw [Category.assoc,←hδ]

    (X : ClassicalObject) (i j : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hij : i < j) (m w : ℤ)
    (a : BiHom m w (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) i)) :

    a ≫ XModLambdaN.proj (nuZero model X) i ≫
      (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map

    ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).mapIso eQ)

      (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.map e.hom (j-i))) = _

  rw [←Category.assoc (XModLambdaN.map e.hom i),XModLambdaN.proj_naturality]

      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map f))
    (XModLambdaN.incl_naturality e.hom (j-i))

    (fun f => a ≫ XModLambdaN.proj (nuZero model X) i ≫ f) hmap

private theorem paper_boundaries_step (X : ClassicalObject) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hd : (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).d r
      (p-(model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).diffDeg r) = 0) :
    boundaries model X r p = boundaries model X (r-1) p := by
  let E := model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  have hb := boundaries_succ_of_zero E r (by dsimp only [E]; rw [model.classical.firstPage]; exact hr)
    (p-E.diffDeg r) hd
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at hb
  have hfirst : E.r₀ = 2 := model.classical.firstPage _
  rw [hfirst] at hb
  have hi : (r-1).toNat = (r-2).toNat+1 := by omega
  have hi' : (r-1-1).toNat = (r-2).toNat := by congr 1; omega
  unfold boundaries boundaryLabel
  dsimp only
  rw [hi,hi']
  let q0 : (E.ssData p).page 0 ⟶ E.Page 2 p :=
    eqToHom (by simp only [Page,hfirst,sub_self,Int.toNat_zero,Nat.cast_zero])
  have hcongr (B B' : Subobject (E.ssData p).V)
      (hB : B ≤ (E.ssData p).Z 0) (hB' : B' ≤ (E.ssData p).Z 0)
      (heq : B=B') :
      LinearMap.range (Subobject.ofLE B _ hB ≫ (E.ssData p).pageπ 0 ≫
        q0).hom =
      LinearMap.range (Subobject.ofLE B' _ hB' ≫ (E.ssData p).pageπ 0 ≫
        q0).hom := by
    subst B'
    rfl
  exact hcongr _ _ _ _ hb

private theorem nu_lambda_injective_from_source (X : ClassicalObject) (m wt : ℤ)

      (wt-m-2) (wt-1)) :
    LambdaInjectiveAt m wt (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) := by
  have lambda_action_injective_of_actual_map
      (Y : SyntheticSpectrum) (m w : ℤ)
      (hinj : Function.Injective (syntheticHomotopyMap (SyntheticCategory.lam.app Y) (m,w-1))) :
      LambdaInjectiveAt m w Y := by
    let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-1)
    let e : Smn (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) m (w-1) ≅ F.obj (Smn m w) :=
      eqToIso (by dsimp only [Smn]; congr 1; simp [sub_eq_add_neg]) ≪≫
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (m,w) (0,-1)).app S_0_0).symm
    intro a b hab
    have hc : SyntheticCategory.lam.app (Smn (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) m w) ≫ a =
        SyntheticCategory.lam.app (Smn (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) m w) ≫ b := by
      dsimp only [lambdaAction] at hab
      have hc := (cancel_epi (eqToHom (by congr 1; simp))).mp hab
      exact (cancel_epi ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (m,w) (0,-1)).inv.app S_0_0)).mp
        (by simpa only [Category.assoc] using hc)
    apply (SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-1)).map_injective
    apply (cancel_epi e.hom).mp
    apply hinj
    change (e.hom ≫ F.map a) ≫ SyntheticCategory.lam.app Y =
      (e.hom ≫ F.map b) ≫ SyntheticCategory.lam.app Y
    rw [Category.assoc,Category.assoc,SyntheticCategory.lam.naturality,
      SyntheticCategory.lam.naturality]
    simpa only [Functor.id_map,Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun z => e.hom ≫ z) hc
  apply lambda_action_injective_of_actual_map
  intro a b hab
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply lambda_kernel_zero_of_first_quotient_lifts
    (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) m (wt-1)

theorem finite_sphere_infinity_cycle_label_exists
    (q k : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hkq : k < q) (s t : ℤ)
    (e : ((model.family.quotient (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q).sequence.ssData (s,t,t-k)).eInfty) :
    ∃ x : model.classical.sphere.Page 2 (s,t),
      x ∈ cycles model .sphere ((q:ℤ)-k) (s,t) ∧
      HasInfinityRepresentative (model.family.quotient (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q) 2 (s,t,t-k)
        (quotientLabel q s t k x) e := by
  let P := KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityFiniteWindow .sphere q hq (s,t) (t-k)
    (by constructor <;> omega)
  let f := XModLambdaN.map model.nu.unitIso.hom q
  let g := XModLambdaN.map model.nu.unitIso.inv q
  have hgf : g ≫ f = 𝟙 _ := by
    dsimp only [f,g]
    rw [←model.quotients.functoriality.map_comp,Iso.inv_hom_id,model.quotients.functoriality.map_id]
  have heq : (model.family.map f).eInftyMap (s,t,t-k)
      ((model.family.map g).eInftyMap (s,t,t-k) e) = e := by
    change ((model.family.map g).eInftyMap (s,t,t-k) ≫
      (model.family.map f).eInftyMap (s,t,t-k)) e = e
    rw [←SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_comp,←SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_comp,hgf,
      SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_id,SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_id]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep (P ((model.family.map g).eInftyMap (s,t,t-k) e))
  have hn := (finite_target_label_iff .sphere q hq s t k hkq c _).mpr hc.symm
  have h := family_infinity_representative_map f (s,t,t-k) _ _ hn
  rw [sphere_quotient_label_from_nu,heq] at h
  refine ⟨c.val,?_,h⟩
  have hc' := c.property
  change c.val ∈ cycles model .sphere ((q:ℤ)-t+(t-k)) (s,t) at hc'
  exact (congrArg (fun j : ℤ => c.val ∈ cycles model .sphere j (s,t))
    (show (q:ℤ)-t+(t-k)=(q:ℤ)-k by omega)).mp hc'
statement:

    (q k : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hkq : k < q) (s t : ℤ)
    (e : ((model.family.quotient (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q).sequence.ssData (s,t,t-k)).eInfty) :
    ∃ x : model.classical.sphere.Page 2 (s,t),

      HasInfinityRepresentative (model.family.quotient (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q) 2 (s,t,t-k)
        (quotientLabel q s t k x) e

theorem finite_sphere_filtration_has_cycle_label
    (q k : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hkq : k < q) (s t : ℤ)
    (a : BiHom (t-s) (t-k) (XModLambdaN (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s a) :
    ∃ x : model.classical.sphere.Page 2 (s,t),
      x ∈ cycles model .sphere ((q:ℤ)-k) (s,t) ∧
      Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q .sphere)) (s,t,t-k) (quotientLabel q s t k x) a := by
  let F := model.syntheticTower.filtration (XModLambdaN (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q)
  obtain ⟨a',ha'⟩ := filtration_representative_exists model.syntheticTower _ (t-s,t-k) s a ha
  let gr := F.toAssociatedGraded s (t-s,t-k) a'
  let e := ((model.convergence (.quotient q .sphere)).identification (s,t,t-k)).inv gr
  have he : ((model.convergence (.quotient q .sphere)).identification (s,t,t-k)).hom e = gr :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ((model.convergence (.quotient q .sphere)).identification (s,t,t-k)).inv_hom_id gr
  obtain ⟨x,hc,hx⟩ := finite_sphere_infinity_cycle_label_exists q k hq hkq s t e
  exact ⟨x,hc,e,hx,a',ha',he⟩

theorem permanent_cycle_iff_mem (X : ClassicalObject) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (x : (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).Page 2 p) :
    IsPermanentCycle (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) p x ↔
      x ∈ permanentCycles model X p := by
  let E := model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let P := E.ssData p
  have normalize (P : SSData (ModuleCat ℤ)) (n : WithTop ℕ) (hn : n=0) :
      Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ⊤) (P.Z n) (P.Z_anti le_top) ≫ P.pageπ n =
        Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ⊤) (P.Z 0) (P.Z_anti le_top) ≫ P.pageπ 0 ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg P.page hn.symm) := by
    subst n
    simp only [eqToHom_refl,Category.comp_id]
  have h := normalize P (↑(2-E.r₀).toNat) (by dsimp only [E]; rw [model.classical.firstPage]; rfl)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z,hz⟩
    refine ⟨z,?_⟩
    exact (congrArg (fun f => f z) h).symm.trans hz
  · rintro ⟨z,hz⟩
    refine ⟨z,?_⟩
    exact (congrArg (fun f => f z) h).trans hz

theorem sphere_permanent_first_quotient_lift (s t : ℤ)
    (x : model.classical.sphere.Page 2 (s,t))
    (hx : IsPermanentCycle model.classical.sphere (s,t) x) :
    ∃ a : BiHom (t-s) t (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum),
      (KIP126.Literature.sphereFirstQuotient model) s t (quotientClass 1 a) = x := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.selected_permanent_lift .sphere s t x).mp hx
  let f := SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum) ≫ model.nu.unitIso.hom
  refine ⟨a ≫ f,?_⟩
  have hc : quotientClass 1 (a ≫ f) = quotientClass 1 a ≫ XModLambdaN.map f 1 := by
    unfold quotientClass
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    exact congrArg (fun h => a ≫ h) (XModLambdaN.incl_naturality f 1)
  rw [hc,ha]
  exact sphere_first_quotient_label s t x

theorem sphere_quotient_high_filtration_zero (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (m w s : ℤ) (hs : (q:ℤ) ≤ m+s-w)
    (a : BiHom m w (XModLambdaN (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s a) : a = 0 := by
  let g : XModLambdaN (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q ⟶ XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum) q :=
    XModLambdaN.map model.nu.unitIso.inv q
  let f : XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum) q ⟶ XModLambdaN (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q :=
    XModLambdaN.map model.nu.unitIso.hom q
  have hm := map_preserves_filtration
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient q .sphere) (.quotient q (.nu .sphere)) g)
    (m,w) s a ha
  have hz := finite_high_filtration_zero .sphere q hq m w s hs (a ≫ g) hm
  have hgf : g ≫ f = 𝟙 _ := by
    dsimp only [f,g]
    rw [←model.quotients.functoriality.map_comp,Iso.inv_hom_id,model.quotients.functoriality.map_id]
    rfl
  have he := congrArg (fun z => z ≫ f) hz
  change (a ≫ g) ≫ f = 0 ≫ f at he
  rw [Category.assoc,hgf,Category.comp_id,zero_comp] at he
  exact he

theorem finite_sphere_frame (q k : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hkq : k < q) (s t : ℤ)
    (c : cycles model .sphere ((q:ℤ)-t+(t-k)) (s,t))
    (hframe : ∀ y : CycleQuotient model .sphere ((q:ℤ)-t+(t-k)) (1+t-(t-k)) (s,t),
      y = 0 ∨ y = subquotientClass _ _ c) :
    ∀ e : ((model.family.quotient (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q).sequence.ssData (s,t,t-k)).eInfty,
      e = 0 ∨ HasInfinityRepresentative (model.family.quotient (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q)
        2 (s,t,t-k) (quotientLabel q s t k c.val) e := by
  intro e
  let P := KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityFiniteWindow .sphere q hq (s,t) (t-k)
    (by constructor <;> omega)
  let f := XModLambdaN.map model.nu.unitIso.hom q
  let g := XModLambdaN.map model.nu.unitIso.inv q
  have hgf : g ≫ f = 𝟙 _ := by
    dsimp only [f,g]
    rw [←model.quotients.functoriality.map_comp,Iso.inv_hom_id,model.quotients.functoriality.map_id]
  have heq : (model.family.map f).eInftyMap (s,t,t-k)
      ((model.family.map g).eInftyMap (s,t,t-k) e) = e := by
    change ((model.family.map g).eInftyMap (s,t,t-k) ≫
      (model.family.map f).eInftyMap (s,t,t-k)) e = e
    rw [←SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_comp,←SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_comp,hgf,
      SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_id,SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_id]
    rfl
  rcases hframe (P ((model.family.map g).eInftyMap (s,t,t-k) e)) with hz | hz
  · left
    have hzero : (model.family.map g).eInftyMap (s,t,t-k) e = 0 :=
      P.injective (hz.trans (map_zero P).symm)
    rw [hzero,map_zero] at heq
    exact heq.symm
  · right
    have hn := (finite_target_label_iff .sphere q hq s t k hkq c _).mpr hz
    have h := family_infinity_representative_map f (s,t,t-k) _ _ hn
    rw [sphere_quotient_label_from_nu,heq] at h
    exact h
