theorem finite_detection_peel (q : ℕ) (i : Tridegree)
    (x : (model.family.quotient (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q).E₂ i)
    (hframe : ∀ e : ((model.family.quotient (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q).sequence.ssData i).eInfty,
      e = 0 ∨ HasInfinityRepresentative (model.family.quotient (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q) 2 i x e)
    (c : BiHom (i.2.1-i.1) i.2.2 (XModLambdaN (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q))
    (hc : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q .sphere)) i x c)
    (a : BiHom (i.2.1-i.1) i.2.2 (XModLambdaN (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower i.1 a) :
    ∃ b : Bool, FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (i.1+1) (a-(if b then c else 0)) := by
  let F := model.syntheticTower.filtration (XModLambdaN (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q)
  obtain ⟨a',ha'⟩ := filtration_representative_exists model.syntheticTower _
    (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) i.1 a ha
  let gr := F.toAssociatedGraded i.1 (i.2.1-i.1,i.2.2) a'
  let e := ((model.convergence (.quotient q .sphere)).identification i).inv gr
  have he : ((model.convergence (.quotient q .sphere)).identification i).hom e = gr :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ((model.convergence (.quotient q .sphere)).identification i).inv_hom_id gr
  rcases hframe e with hz | hz
  · refine ⟨false,?_⟩
    have hdet : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q .sphere)) i 0 a :=
      ⟨0,HasInfinityRepresentative.zero _ 2 (by decide) i,a',ha',by rw [←hz]; exact he⟩
    simpa only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,sub_zero] using
      detects_zero_filtration (model.convergence (.quotient q .sphere)) i hdet
  · refine ⟨true,?_⟩
    have hdet : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q .sphere)) i x a := ⟨e,hz,a',ha',he⟩
    simpa only [↓reduceIte] using detects_sub_filtration
      (model.convergence (.quotient q .sphere)) i hdet hc

    dsimp only [zf]

    apply hne
    exact (D.infinity_projection_eq_of_page_projection_eq n z 0
      (by simpa only [zf,map_zero,ModuleCat.comp_apply] using hzero)).trans (map_zero _)

private theorem lambda_multiply_compose {m w : ℤ} {X : SyntheticSpectrum}
    (k n : ℕ) (a : BiHom m w X) :
    HEq (lambdaMultiply n (lambdaMultiply k a)) (lambdaMultiply (k+n) a) := by
  let v := w-(k:ℤ)
  let u := v-(n:ℤ)
  let hk : (m,w)+(0,-(k:ℤ))=(m,v) := by ext <;> dsimp [v] <;> omega
  let hn : (m,v)+(0,-(n:ℤ))=(m,u) := by ext <;> dsimp [u] <;> omega
  let hkn : (m,w)+(0,-((k+n:ℕ):ℤ))=(m,u) := by ext <;> dsimp [u,v] <;> omega
  have ha := shift_assoc_inv model.quotients.coherence (m,w) (0,-(k:ℤ)) (0,-(n:ℤ))
    (m,v) (0,-((k+n:ℕ):ℤ)) (m,u)
    hk (by ext <;> dsimp <;> omega) hn hkn (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum)
  have heq : lambdaAt m n v u hn (lambdaAt m k w v hk a) =
      lambdaAt m (k+n) w u hkn a := by
    unfold lambdaAt
    erw [←reassoc_of% (lambdaPow_naturality n
      ((biShiftAddIso (m,w) (0,-(k:ℤ)) (m,v) hk).inv.app (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum)))]
    erw [←reassoc_of% (lambdaPow_naturality n (lambdaPow k (Smn m w)))]
    erw [←Category.assoc,ha]
    erw [lambdaPow_add model.quotients.coherence k n (k+n) rfl (Smn m w)]
    simp only [lambdaShiftAddIso, lambdaDegree, Category.assoc]
    rfl
  have houter := lambdaAt_heq m n v u hn (lambdaAt m k w v hk a)
  have hinner := multiply_heq n (by rfl : v=w-(k:ℤ)) (lambdaAt_heq m k w v hk a)
  exact (houter.trans hinner).symm.trans ((heq_of_eq heq).trans (lambdaAt_heq m (k+n) _ _ hkn a))

title: KIP126.Main.Internal.High125.infinite_realization_odd
code:
private theorem infinite_realization_odd {m w : ℤ}
    (a : BiHom m w (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum))
    (ha : ∀ q : ℕ, FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower q a) :
    IsOddTorsionMap (Standard.realizeSphere m w a) := by
  by_contra hnot
  let α := Standard.realizeSphere m w a
  obtain ⟨s,t,hm,x,hx,hdet⟩ := sphere_nonodd_detection m α hnot
  subst m
  have hdet' : ClassicalDetects (model.classicalConvergence .sphere) (s,t) x α := by
    simpa only [eqToHom_refl,Category.id_comp] using hdet
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hr⟩ := prescribed_sphere_lift s t x α hx hdet'
  let v := min w t
  let ka := (w-v).toNat
  let kb := (t-v).toNat
  have hka : (ka:ℤ)=w-v := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by dsimp [v]; omega)
  have hkb : (kb:ℤ)=t-v := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by dsimp [v]; omega)
  have hwa : w-(ka:ℤ)=v := by omega
  have hwb : t-(kb:ℤ)=v := by omega
  let a0 : BiHom (t-s) v (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) :=
    homotopyRegrade rfl hwa (lambdaMultiply ka a)
  let b0 : BiHom (t-s) v (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) :=
    homotopyRegrade rfl hwb (lambdaMultiply kb b)
  have ha0 : ∀ q : ℕ, FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower q a0 :=
    infinite_regrade hwa _ (lambda_preserves_infinite a ha ka)
  have hra : Standard.realizeSphere (t-s) v a0=α :=
    (realize_regrade hwa _).trans (bridge_realize_lambda ka a)
  have hrb : Standard.realizeSphere (t-s) v b0=α :=
    (realize_regrade hwb _).trans ((bridge_realize_lambda kb b).trans hr)
  have hdiff : Standard.realizeSphere (t-s) v (a0-b0)=0 := by
    rw [map_sub,hra,hrb,sub_self]
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := (Standard.selected_realization_kernel .sphere (t-s) v (a0-b0)).mp
    ((realize_zero_iff _).mp hdiff)
  have heq : lambdaMultiply N a0=lambdaMultiply N b0 := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    simpa only [lambdaMultiply,Preadditive.comp_sub] using hN
  have hh := lambda_preserves_infinite a0 ha0 N
  rw [heq] at hh
  have hcomp : HEq (lambdaMultiply N b0) (lambdaMultiply (kb+N) b) :=
    (multiply_heq N hwb.symm (regrade_heq hwb _)).trans (lambda_multiply_compose kb N b)
  have hall : ∀ q : ℕ, FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower q (lambdaMultiply (kb+N) b) :=
    infinite_heq (by push_cast; omega : v-(N:ℤ)=t-((kb+N:ℕ):ℤ)) hcomp hh
  have hbdet := model.sphereDetectionCompatible.homotopy_lambda s t (kb+N) b
  change KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.sphereFirstQuotient model.nu model.quotients.functoriality
    model.firstQuotient s t (quotientClass 1 b)=_ at hb
  rw [hb] at hbdet
  exact sphere_detected_survival_not_infinite s t (kb+N) x hx _ hbdet hall
statement:
private theorem infinite_realization_odd {m w : ℤ}
    (a : BiHom m w (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum))
    (ha : ∀ q : ℕ, FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower q a) :
    IsOddTorsionMap (Standard.realizeSphere m w a)

private theorem route_mem_top_cycles (D : SSData (ModuleCat ℤ)) (a : D.V)
    (ha : ∀ n : ℕ, a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ (D.Z n)) :
    a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ (D.Z ⊤) := by
  have hspan : (ModuleCat.subobjectModule _).symm (Submodule.span ℤ {a}) ≤ D.Z ⊤ := by
    apply D.Z_top_greatest
    intro n
    apply (ModuleCat.subobjectModule _).le_iff_le.mp
    simp only [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply, Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact ha n
  have h := (ModuleCat.subobjectModule D.V).monotone hspan
  apply h
  rw [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
  exact Submodule.subset_span (by simp)

private theorem route_common_cycle_of_finite_cycles
    (D : SSData (ModuleCat ℤ)) (x : D.page 0)
    (hx : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z n) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z n) (D.Z 0) (D.Z_anti bot_le) ≫ D.pageπ 0) z = x) :
    ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ⊤) (D.Z 0) (D.Z_anti bot_le) ≫ D.pageπ 0) z = x := by
  obtain ⟨z₀,hz₀⟩ := hx 0
  have hz₀' : D.pageπ 0 z₀ = x := by
    change (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z 0) (D.Z 0) (le_refl _) ≫ D.pageπ 0) z₀ = x at hz₀
    simpa only [Subobject.ofLE_refl, Category.id_comp] using hz₀
  have hall (n : ℕ) : (D.Z 0).arrow z₀ ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ (D.Z n) := by
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hx n
    let j := Subobject.ofLE (D.Z n) (D.Z 0) (D.Z_anti bot_le)
    have hkernel : D.pageπ 0 (z₀-j z)=0 := by
      rw [map_sub, hz₀']
      change x - (j ≫ D.pageπ 0) z = 0
      rw [hz, sub_self]
    have hk := (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (D.B 0) (D.Z 0) (D.B_le_Z 0) _).mp hkernel
    have hk' : (D.Z 0).arrow (z₀-j z) ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ (D.Z n) :=
      (ModuleCat.subobjectModule D.V).monotone
        ((D.B_mono le_top).trans ((D.B_le_Z ⊤).trans (D.Z_anti le_top))) hk
    have hj : (D.Z 0).arrow (j z) = (D.Z n).arrow z :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Subobject.ofLE_arrow (D.Z_anti bot_le)) z
    have he : (D.Z 0).arrow z₀ =
        (D.Z 0).arrow (z₀-j z) + (D.Z n).arrow z := by
      rw [map_sub,hj]
      abel
    rw [he]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hk' ⟨z,rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨zInf,hzInf⟩ := route_mem_top_cycles D ((D.Z 0).arrow z₀) hall
  have he : (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ⊤) (D.Z 0) (D.Z_anti bot_le)) zInf = z₀ := by
    apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (D.Z 0).arrow).mp inferInstance
    exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Subobject.ofLE_arrow (D.Z_anti (show (0:WithTop ℕ)≤⊤ from le_top))) zInf).trans hzInf
  refine ⟨zInf,?_⟩
  rw [ModuleCat.comp_apply,he,hz₀']

code:
private theorem route_permanent_of_all_reaches
    (X : ClassicalObject) (p : ℤ×ℤ)
    (x : (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).Page 2 p)
    (hx : ∀ n : ℕ, ReachesPage (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      ((n:ℤ)+2) p x) : ClassicalPermanentCycle model X p x := by
  let E := model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let D := E.ssData p
  let e : D.page 0 ≅ E.Page 2 p := eqToIso (by
    dsimp only [Page, D, E]
    rw [model.classical.firstPage]
    rfl)
  have hall (n : ℕ) : ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z n) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z n) (D.Z 0) (D.Z_anti bot_le) ≫ D.pageπ 0) z = e.inv x := by
    have hc := ((KIP126.ProofTools.isCycle_iff_reaches model X ((n:ℤ)+2)
      (by omega) p x).mpr (hx n)).2
    have hn : (((n:ℤ)+2-1)-1).toNat=n := by omega
    change x ∈ LinearMap.range (cycleLabel model X (↑(((n:ℤ)+2-1)-1).toNat) p).hom at hc
    rw [hn] at hc
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hc
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    apply e.toLinearEquiv.injective
    change e.hom ((Subobject.ofLE (D.Z n) (D.Z 0) (D.Z_anti bot_le) ≫ D.pageπ 0) z) = e.hom (e.inv x)
    rw [show e.hom (e.inv x)=x from e.toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply x]
    exact hz
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := route_common_cycle_of_finite_cycles D (e.inv x) hall
  let n₀ : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2-E.r₀).toNat
  have hn₀ : n₀=0 := by dsimp [n₀,E]; rw [model.classical.firstPage]; rfl
  have normalize (n : WithTop ℕ) (hn : n=0) :
      Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ⊤) (D.Z n) (D.Z_anti le_top) ≫ D.pageπ n =
      Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ⊤) (D.Z 0) (D.Z_anti bot_le) ≫ D.pageπ 0 ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg D.page hn.symm) := by
    subst n
    simp only [eqToHom_refl,Category.comp_id]
  refine ⟨z,?_⟩
  change (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ⊤) (D.Z n₀) (D.Z_anti le_top) ≫ D.pageπ n₀) z=x
  rw [normalize n₀ hn₀]
  change (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ⊤) (D.Z 0) (D.Z_anti bot_le) ≫ D.pageπ 0 ≫ e.hom) z=x
  have hz' := congrArg (fun y => e.hom y) hz
  simpa only [ModuleCat.comp_apply,show e.hom (e.inv x)=x from e.toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply x] using hz'

    (x : (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).Page 2 p)

      ((n:ℤ)+2) p x) : ClassicalPermanentCycle model X p x

private theorem route_invisible_lambda_kernel_nuzero
    (X : ClassicalObject) (m w : ℤ)
    (a : BiHom m w ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-1)).obj (nuZero model X)))
    (halambda : a ≫ SyntheticCategory.lam.app _ = 0)
    (haQ : ∀ n : ℕ, a ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-1)).map
      (XModLambdaN.incl (nuZero model X) n) = 0) : a=0 := by
  let V := nuZero model X
  let F := shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)
  let G := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-1)
  have hshift : F.map a ≫ F.map (lambdaPow 1 V) = 0 := by
    rw [←Functor.map_comp,lambdaPow_one model.quotients.coherence,halambda,Functor.map_zero]
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := (XModLambdaN.cofiberTriangle V 1).coyoneda_exact₁
    (XModLambdaN.cofiberTriangle_distinguished V 1) (F.map a) hshift
  let eS : Smn (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (m+1) w ≅ F.obj (Smn m w) :=
    ((biShiftAddIso (m,w) (1,0) (m+1,w) (by ext <;> dsimp <;> omega)).app S_0_0).symm ≪≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_compat 1).app (Smn m w)
  let c : BiHom (m+1) w (XModLambdaN V 1) := eS.hom ≫ b
  have hboundary : c ≫ XModLambdaN.proj V 1 = eS.hom ≫ F.map a := by
    simpa [c,F,XModLambdaN.cofiberTriangle,Category.assoc] using
      congrArg (fun f => eS.hom ≫ f) hb.symm
  let s : ℤ := w-(m+1)
  let c' : BiHom (w-s) w (XModLambdaN V 1) := homotopyRegrade (by dsimp[s]; omega) rfl c
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := Choice.nu_first_quotient_label_surjective X s w c'
  have hreach (n : ℕ) : ReachesPage
      (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) ((n:ℤ)+2) (s,w) x := by
    cases n with
    | zero => simpa using (show ReachesPage _ 2 (s,w) x from ⟨x,RepresentsOnPage.self_two x⟩)
    | succ n =>
      let T := (model.quotients.tower V).triangle (by decide : 0<1)
        (show 1<n+2 by omega)
      have hproj : c' ≫ XModLambdaN.proj V 1 ≫
          F.map (G.map (XModLambdaN.incl V (n+2-1))) = 0 := by
        have h : c ≫ XModLambdaN.proj V 1 ≫
            F.map (G.map (XModLambdaN.incl V (n+2-1))) = 0 := by
          rw [←Category.assoc,hboundary,Category.assoc,←Functor.map_comp,haQ,Functor.map_zero,comp_zero]
        exact (route_regrade_comp_zero_iff (by dsimp[s]; omega) rfl c _).mpr h
      have hd : c' ≫ T.delta = 0 := by
        rw [Choice.lambda_zero_shift_delta_evaluation X 1 (n+2) (by decide) (by omega) (w-s) w c']
        exact hproj
      obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := (Triangle.mk T.lambdaMap T.rho T.delta).coyoneda_exact₃ T.distinguished c' hd
      have hreach' := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_finite_lift X (n+2) (by omega) s w x).mpr
        ⟨d,by simpa only [T,Triangle.mk,(model.quotients.tower V).triangle_rho] using hd.symm.trans hx.symm⟩
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat,Nat.cast_one,add_assoc,Int.reduceAdd] using hreach'
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.selected_permanent_lift X s w x).mp
    (route_permanent_of_all_reaches X (s,w) x hreach)
  have hzero' : c' ≫ XModLambdaN.proj V 1 = 0 := by
    change z ≫ XModLambdaN.incl V 1 = firstLabel model X s w x at hz
    rw [←hx,←hz,Category.assoc,XModLambdaN.incl_comp_proj,comp_zero]
  have hzero : c ≫ XModLambdaN.proj V 1 = 0 := by
    exact (route_regrade_comp_zero_iff (by dsimp[s]; omega) rfl c _).mp hzero'
  have haz : F.map a = 0 := by
    apply (cancel_epi eS.hom).mp
    rw [←hboundary,hzero,comp_zero]
  exact F.map_injective (by simpa only [Functor.map_zero] using haz)
statement:
private theorem route_invisible_lambda_kernel_nuzero
    (X : ClassicalObject) (m w : ℤ)

    (a : BiHom 125 130 (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum))

  let b : BiHom 125 150 (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) := b0 ≫ f

    have hc : quotientClass 1 b=quotientClass 1 b0 ≫ XModLambdaN.map f 1 := by
      unfold quotientClass

    rw [hc,hb0]

    change KIP126.AdamsSynthetic.sphereFirstQuotient model.nu model.quotients.functoriality
      model.firstQuotient 25 150 (quotientClass 1 b)=_ at hb
    rw [hb] at hbdet
    have hdiff : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower 26 (a-(show BiHom 125 130 (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) from lambdaMultiply 20 b)) :=
      detects_sub_filtration (model.convergence .sphere) (25,150,130) hd.1 hbdet

      simpa only [Category.assoc,Standard.tmfUnit_agrees,zero_comp] using hzero
    have hr : Standard.realizeSphere 125 130 (lambdaMultiply 20 b)=Standard.high125 :=

        · exact KIP126.Literature.Standard.sphereVanishing _ _ (by omega) (by omega)
      exact sphere_infinity_zero_of_permanent_quotient j (1+j) 3 (by omega)
        (permanent_quotient_zero_of_page_zero .sphere 2 _ (by decide) (by omega) _ hp)
    · haveI : Subsingleton (nuEInftyModel model .sphere (j,1+j) 3) := by
        simp only [nuEInftyModel,hw,ite_false]; infer_instance
      haveI : Subsingleton (((model.family.nu model.nu SphereSpectrum).sequence.ssData (j,1+j,3)).eInfty) :=
        (KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_nu .sphere (j,1+j) 3).injective.subsingleton
      have hn := ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton (((model.family.nu model.nu SphereSpectrum).sequence.ssData (j,1+j,3)).eInfty)
      let f := (model.family.map model.nu.unitIso.hom).eInftyMap (j,1+j,3)
      let g := (model.family.map model.nu.unitIso.inv).eInftyMap (j,1+j,3)
      have hgf:g≫f=𝟙 _ := by
        dsimp only [f,g]
        rw [←SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_comp,←SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_comp,
          Iso.inv_hom_id,SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_id,SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_id]
      apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
      exact hgf.symm.trans (by
        have hf:f=0 := hn.eq_of_src f 0
        rw [hf,comp_zero])
  have h0 : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower 0 z := by
    refine ⟨z≫(model.syntheticTower.tower _).zeroIso.inv,?_⟩
    change (z≫(model.syntheticTower.tower _).zeroIso.inv)≫(model.syntheticTower.tower _).projection 0=z

    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (eta : BiHom 1 2 (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum))
    {k l : ℤ} (x : BiHom k l (XModLambdaN (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) n))
    (a : Smn (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) (1+k) (2+l) ≅ Smn (1+k) (2+l)) :
    a.hom ≫ sphereAction eta x = sphereAction eta x := by
  let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) (k,l)
  let ff := SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) (k,l)
  let d : Smn (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) (1+k) (2+l) ≅ F.obj (Smn 1 2) :=
    ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (1,2) (k,l)).app (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum)).symm
  let b := ff.preimageIso (d.symm ≪≫ a ≪≫ d)
  have hb : F.map b.hom = d.inv ≫ a.hom ≫ d.hom := ff.map_preimage _
  have hh : sphereAction (b.hom ≫ eta) x = sphereAction eta x := by
    rw [← KIP126.Literature.Standard.quotientAlgebra_sphere_action n hn 1 2 k l (b.hom ≫ eta) x,
      ← KIP126.Literature.Standard.quotientAlgebra_sphere_action n hn 1 2 k l eta x,
      eta_source_iso_fixed_in_finite_quotient n eta b]
  change d.hom ≫ F.map (b.hom ≫ eta) ≫ x = d.hom ≫ F.map eta ≫ x at hh
  rw [Functor.map_comp, hb] at hh
  change a.hom ≫ (d.hom ≫ F.map eta ≫ x) = d.hom ≫ F.map eta ≫ x
  simpa only [Category.assoc, d.hom_inv_id_assoc] using hh

        ((tensorRight H).map_isZero ih).of_iso (β_ H (T.stage n))
      have hc : IsZero (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib (T.map (Nat.le_succ n))) :=
        hh.of_iso (T.layerIso n)

    apply Triangle.isZero₃_of_isZero₁₂ _
      (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished (T.mapAt (show p.1 ≤ p.1+1 by omega)))
    · exact hz (p.1+1).toNat

  haveI : Subsingleton (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z 0) : ModuleCat ℤ) :=
    Function.Injective.subsingleton ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (D.Z 0).arrow).mp inferInstance)
  letI : Epi (D.pageπ 0) := coequalizer.π_epi
  haveI : Subsingleton (D.page 0) :=
    Function.Surjective.subsingleton ((ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective (D.pageπ 0)).mp inferInstance)

    Int.toNat_zero,Nat.cast_zero] using (inferInstance : Subsingleton (D.page 0))

  let g : XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum) q ⟶ XModLambdaN (S_0_0:SyntheticSpectrum) q := XModLambdaN.map model.nu.unitIso.hom q
  have hfg : f≫g=𝟙 (XModLambdaN (S_0_0:SyntheticSpectrum) q) := by
    dsimp only [f,g]

    rfl

      (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (XModLambdaN.incl A q) ≫ e.hom =
      XModLambdaN.incl ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) q := by

  letI := model.exactness.shiftExact a

    (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι (lambdaPow q A))
    (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ (lambdaPow q A))
  let U := Triangle.mk (lambdaPow q ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A))
    (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι (lambdaPow q ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A)))
    (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ (lambdaPow q ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A)))
  let c : ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).mapTriangle.obj T).obj₁ ≅ U.obj₁ :=
    (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree q) A).symm

private theorem desuspend_bijective (X : C) (n : ℤ) :

  let e := (shiftFunctorAdd' C n (-1) (n - 1) (by omega)).app SphereSpectrum

    apply (cancel_mono d.hom).mp
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using h

    (model.classicalSuspension X).desuspendFirstPage s t a ∈
      (model.classicalTower.tower (X.obj model.auxiliary)).cycles r hr (s,t-1) := by
  let S := model.classicalSuspension X
  let T := model.classicalTower.tower (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := (raw_cycles_iff _ r hr s t a).mp ha
  let R := shiftFunctorComm Spectrum (1:ℤ) (1:ℤ)
  let e := c≫(S.tower (s+r)).hom⟦(1:ℤ)⟧'≫R.inv.app (T.stageAt (s+r))
  have he : e≫(T.mapAt (show s+1≤s+r by omega))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧'⟦(1:ℤ)⟧' =
      -(a≫(S.layer s).hom≫(HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ
        (T.mapAt (show s≤s+1 by omega)))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧') := by
    dsimp only [e]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    erw [←R.inv.naturality]
    simp only [Functor.comp_map]
    rw [←Functor.map_comp_assoc,S.tower_comm,Functor.map_comp]
    simp only [←Category.assoc]
    erw [hc]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    have hs := S.layer_connecting s
    have hs' := congrArg (fun f=>f≫R.inv.app (T.stageAt (s+1))) hs
    dsimp only [T,AbstractAdamsTower.layer] at hs'
    simp only [R,Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id_app,Preadditive.neg_comp] at hs'
    erw [Category.comp_id] at hs'
    erw [hs']
    simp only [Preadditive.comp_neg,neg_neg]
    rfl
  apply (raw_cycles_iff T r hr s (t-1) _).mpr
  let j := eqToHom (congrArg (Sphere (C:=Spectrum)) (show (t-1)-s=(t-s)-1 by omega))
  refine ⟨-(j≫AbstractAdamsTower.desuspend ((T.stageAt (s+r))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧) (t-s) e),?_⟩
  rw [Preadditive.neg_comp,Category.assoc,←desuspend_postcompose,he,map_neg]
  simp only [Preadditive.comp_neg,neg_neg]
  rw [←Category.assoc a]
  erw [desuspend_postcompose]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

theorem nonzero_differential_not_permanent {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)} {r : ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ} {q : ℤ × ℤ} {x : E.Page 2 p} {y : E.Page 2 q} (hr0 : E.r₀ ≤ r)
    (h : HasNonzeroDifferential E r p q x y) : ¬ NonzeroSurvival E p x := by
  classical
  rintro ⟨z, hz, _⟩
  let A := E.ssData p
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r + 1 - E.r₀).toNat
  let z' := (Subobject.ofLE (A.Z ⊤) (A.Z n) (A.Z_anti le_top)) z
  obtain ⟨hdeg, xr, yr, hx, hy, hd, hne⟩ := h
  have hr2 := hx.1
  have hlater : ReachesPage E (r + 1) p x := by
    refine ⟨A.pageπ n z', by omega, z', ?_, rfl⟩
    dsimp only [z']
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
    exact hz
  have hd0 := represents_d_zero_of_later hr0 (by omega : r < r + 1) hx hlater
  rw [ModuleCat.comp_apply, hd0, map_zero] at hd
  exact hne hd.symm

theorem next_nonzero_of_not_hit {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)} {r : ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ} {x : E.Page 2 p}
    (hr0 : E.r₀ ≤ r) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    {a : E.Page (r+1) p} {b : E.Page r p}
    (ha : RepresentsOnPage E (r+1) p x a) (hb : RepresentsOnPage E r p x b)
    (hne : b ≠ 0) (hnot : ¬ HitOnPage E r p x) : a ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  generalize hq : p-E.diffDeg r=q
  have hp : p=q+E.diffDeg r := by rw [←hq]; abel
  subst p
  obtain ⟨_,z,hz,hza⟩ := ha
  let A := E.ssData (q+E.diffDeg r)
  have hi : (r+1-E.r₀).toNat=(r-E.r₀).toNat+1 := by omega
  have hnm : (↑(r-E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ) ≤ ↑(r+1-E.r₀).toNat := by
    exact_mod_cast (show (r-E.r₀).toNat≤(r+1-E.r₀).toNat by omega)
  let br := (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (A.Z_anti hnm) ≫ A.pageπ ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat) z
  have hbr : RepresentsOnPage E r (q+E.diffDeg r) x br := by
    refine ⟨hr, (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (A.Z_anti hnm)) z, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
    exact hz
  have heb : br=b := represents_unique hbr hb
  intro ha0
  have hv := next_projection_zero_iff_incoming E r hr0 q
  have hv' : ∀ zz : (Subobject.underlying.obj (A.Z ↑(r+1-E.r₀).toNat) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      A.pageπ ↑(r+1-E.r₀).toNat zz=0 ↔
        (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (A.Z_anti hnm) ≫ A.pageπ ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat) zz∈
          LinearMap.range (E.d r q).hom := by
    have transport (m : ℕ) (hm : m=(r-E.r₀).toNat+1)
        (hge : (↑(r-E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ)≤↑m) :
        ∀ zz : (Subobject.underlying.obj (A.Z ↑m) : ModuleCat ℤ),
          A.pageπ ↑m zz=0 ↔
            (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (A.Z_anti hge) ≫ A.pageπ ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat) zz∈
              LinearMap.range (E.d r q).hom := by
      subst m
      exact hv
    exact transport _ hi hnm
  have hmem : br∈LinearMap.range (E.d r q).hom := by
    exact (hv' z).mp (hza.trans ha0)
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := hmem
  apply hnot
  refine ⟨q, rfl, c,b,hb,hne,?_⟩
  simpa only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id] using hc.trans heb

theorem permanent_survives_of_no_early_hit {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)} {p : ℤ × ℤ} {x : E.Page 2 p}
    (hstart : E.r₀≤2) (N : ℕ) (hN : 2≤N)
    (hperm : IsPermanentCycle E p x) (hne : x≠0)
    (hnot : ∀ r : ℤ, 2≤r → r<N → ¬HitOnPage E r p x) :
    SurvivesTo E N p x := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hperm
  let A := E.ssData p
  have hrep (r : ℤ) (hr : 2≤r) : ReachesPage E r p x := by
    let zr := (Subobject.ofLE (A.Z ⊤) (A.Z ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat) (A.Z_anti le_top)) z
    refine ⟨A.pageπ _ zr,hr,zr,?_,rfl⟩
    dsimp only [zr]
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
    exact hz
  have hall (n : ℕ) : n+2≤N → SurvivesTo E ((n:ℤ)+2) p x := by
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro hn
      obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hrep 2 (by omega)
      change SurvivesTo E 2 p x
      exact ⟨a,ha,by rw [←ha.eq_on_page_two]; exact hne⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      intro hn
      obtain ⟨b,hb,hbn⟩ := ih (by omega)
      obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hrep ((n:ℤ)+2+1) (by omega)
      have han := next_nonzero_of_not_hit (by omega) (by omega) ha hb hbn
        (hnot _ (by omega) (by omega))
      have he : ((n+1:ℕ):ℤ)+2=(n:ℤ)+2+1 := by omega
      rw [he]
      exact ⟨a,ha,han⟩
  have h := hall (N-2) (by omega)
  have he : ((N-2:ℕ):ℤ)+2=N := by omega
  rwa [he] at h

theorem cycle_successor_lift
    (E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ))
    (r : ℤ) (hr : E.r₀ ≤ r) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (z : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((E.ssData p).Z ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
    (hz : E.d r p ((E.ssData p).pageπ ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat z) = 0) :
    ∃ zn : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((E.ssData p).Z ↑((r-E.r₀).toNat+1)) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((E.ssData p).Z_anti (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ (r-E.r₀).toNat))) zn = z := by
  classical
  let D := E.ssData p
  let n := (r-E.r₀).toNat
  have hsucc : (↑n : WithTop ℕ) ≤ ↑(n+1) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n
  let i := Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ↑(n+1)) (D.Z ↑n) (D.Z_anti hsucc)
  have hker : D.pageπ ↑n z ∈ LinearMap.ker (E.d r p).hom := hz
  rw [←subobjectModule_kernel,E.Z_succ r p hr,subobjectModule_image] at hker
  obtain ⟨z',hz'⟩ := hker
  change D.pageπ ↑n (i z') = D.pageπ ↑n z at hz'
  have hzero : D.pageπ ↑n (z-i z')=0 := by rw [map_sub,hz',sub_self]
  have hb : ∃ b : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.B ↑n) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE (D.B ↑n) (D.Z ↑n) (D.B_le_Z _)) b = z-i z' :=
    (cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff_mem_range _ _).mp hzero
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hb
  have hBZ : D.B ↑n ≤ D.Z ↑(n+1) := (D.B_mono hsucc).trans (D.B_le_Z _)
  let zn : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z ↑(n+1)) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) :=
    z' + (Subobject.ofLE (D.B ↑n) (D.Z ↑(n+1)) hBZ) b
  have hnz : i zn=z := by
    dsimp only [zn]
    rw [map_add]
    change i z' + (Subobject.ofLE (D.B ↑n) (D.Z ↑(n+1)) hBZ ≫ i) b = z
    dsimp only [i]
    rw [Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE,hb]
    abel
  exact ⟨zn,hnz⟩

theorem later_page_frame_of_earlier {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)} {r : ℤ} {t : ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ} {x : E.Page 2 p}
    (hr : 2≤r) (hrt : r≤t)
    (hframe : ∃ a : E.Page r p, RepresentsOnPage E r p x a ∧ ∀ y:E.Page r p,y=0∨y=a)
    (ht : ReachesPage E t p x) :
    ∃ a : E.Page t p, RepresentsOnPage E t p x a ∧ ∀ y:E.Page t p,y=0∨y=a := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ar,har,hall⟩ := hframe
  obtain ⟨at',htrep⟩ := ht
  have htrep' := htrep
  obtain ⟨ht2,z,hzt,hat⟩ := htrep'
  let A := E.ssData p
  let nr : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat
  let nt : WithTop ℕ := ↑(t-E.r₀).toNat
  have hrt' : nr≤nt := by
    dsimp only [nr,nt]
    exact_mod_cast (show (r-E.r₀).toNat≤(t-E.r₀).toNat by omega)
  let i := Subobject.ofLE (A.Z nt) (A.Z nr) (A.Z_anti hrt')
  have har' : RepresentsOnPage E r p x (A.pageπ nr (i z)) := by
    refine ⟨hr,i z,?_,rfl⟩
    dsimp only [i]
    rw [←CategoryTheory.comp_apply,←Category.assoc,Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
    exact hzt
  have hzr : A.pageπ nr (i z)=ar := represents_unique har' har
  have hzero (w : (Subobject.underlying.obj (A.Z nt) : ModuleCat ℤ))
      (hw : A.pageπ nr (i w)=0) : A.pageπ nt w=0 := by
    apply (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (A.B nt) (A.Z nt) (A.B_le_Z _) _).mpr
    have hh := (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (A.B nr) (A.Z nr) (A.B_le_Z _) _).mp hw
    have he : (A.Z nr).arrow (i w)=(A.Z nt).arrow w :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Subobject.ofLE_arrow (A.Z_anti hrt')) w
    rw [he] at hh
    exact (ModuleCat.subobjectModule A.V).monotone (A.B_mono hrt') hh
  refine ⟨at',htrep,?_⟩
  intro y
  haveI : Epi (A.pageπ nt) := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective (A.pageπ nt)).mp inferInstance y
  rcases hall (A.pageπ nr (i w)) with h0|ha
  · left
    rw [←hw]
    exact hzero w h0
  · right
    have hh : A.pageπ nr (i (w-z))=0 := by rw [map_sub,map_sub,ha,hzr,sub_self]
    have hh' := hzero (w-z) hh
    rw [map_sub,hw,hat,sub_eq_zero] at hh'
    exact hh'

private theorem reaches_next_of_zero
    {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)}
    {r : ℤ} (hr0 : E.r₀ ≤ r) (hr : 2 ≤ r) {p : ℤ × ℤ}
    {x : E.Page 2 p} {a : E.Page r p}
    (ha : RepresentsOnPage E r p x a) (hzero : E.d r p a=0) :
    ReachesPage E (r+1) p x := by
  obtain ⟨_,z,hz2,hza⟩ := ha
  have hz : E.d r p ((E.ssData p).pageπ ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat z)=0 := by
    rw [hza]
    exact hzero
  obtain ⟨zn,hnz⟩ := cycle_successor_lift E r hr0 p z hz
  let A := E.ssData p
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat
  let m : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r+1-E.r₀).toNat
  have he : (↑((r-E.r₀).toNat+1) : WithTop ℕ)=m := by
    dsimp only [m]
    congr 1
    omega
  have hnm : n≤m := by dsimp only [n,m]; exact_mod_cast (show (r-E.r₀).toNat≤(r+1-E.r₀).toNat by omega)
  have cast_lift (m' : WithTop ℕ) (h : m'=m)
      (v : (Subobject.underlying.obj (A.Z m') : ModuleCat ℤ))
      (hn : n≤m')
      (hv : Subobject.ofLE (A.Z m') (A.Z n) (A.Z_anti hn) v=z) :
      ∃ w : (Subobject.underlying.obj (A.Z m) : ModuleCat ℤ),
        Subobject.ofLE (A.Z m) (A.Z n) (A.Z_anti hnm) w=z := by
    subst m'
    exact ⟨v,hv⟩
  obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := cast_lift _ he zn
    (by dsimp only [n]; exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ (r-E.r₀).toNat) hnz
  refine ⟨A.pageπ m w,by omega,w,?_,rfl⟩
  calc
    (Subobject.ofLE (A.Z m) (A.Z _) _ ≫ A.pageπ _) w =
      (Subobject.ofLE (A.Z n) (A.Z ↑(2-E.r₀).toNat)
        (A.Z_anti (by dsimp only [n]; exact_mod_cast
          (show (2-E.r₀).toNat≤(r-E.r₀).toNat by omega))) ≫ A.pageπ _)
        ((Subobject.ofLE (A.Z m) (A.Z n) (A.Z_anti hnm)) w) := by
          rw [←CategoryTheory.comp_apply,←Category.assoc,Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
    _ = x := by rw [hw]; exact hz2

private theorem vanishesModLambda_iff_factors {m n : ℤ} {X : SyntheticSpectrum} (r : ℕ)
    (x : BiHom m n X) :
    VanishesModLambda r x ↔
      ∃ y : Smn m n ⟶ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0, -(r : ℤ))).obj X,
        y ≫ lambdaPow r X = x := by
  let T := XModLambdaN.cofiberTriangle X r
  have hT : T ∈ distTriang SyntheticSpectrum := HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished _
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := T.coyoneda_exact₂ hT x hx
    exact ⟨y, hy.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    change (y ≫ lambdaPow r X) ≫ XModLambdaN.incl X r = 0
    rw [Category.assoc,XModLambdaN.lambdaPow_comp_incl,Limits.comp_zero]

private theorem vanishes_mod_lambda_iff_multiple
    (n : ℕ) {X : SyntheticSpectrum} (m w : ℤ) (z : BiHom m (w-(n:ℤ)) X) :
    VanishesModLambda n z ↔ ∃ b : BiHom m w X, lambdaMultiply n b=z := by
  classical
  let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(n:ℤ))
  let e : F.obj (Smn m w : SyntheticSpectrum) ≅ Smn m (w-(n:ℤ)) :=
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (m,w) (0,-(n:ℤ))).app S_0_0 ≪≫
      eqToIso (by congr 1; simp [sub_eq_add_neg])
  have he (b : BiHom m w X) : lambdaMultiply n b=e.inv≫F.map b≫lambdaPow n X := by
    have he' : lambdaMultiply n b=e.inv≫lambdaPow n (Smn m w)≫b := by
      unfold lambdaMultiply
      change eqToHom (by congr 1; simp) ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (m,w) (0,-(n:ℤ))).inv.app S_0_0 ≫
        lambdaPow n (Smn m w) ≫ b =
        (eqToHom (by congr 1; simp) ≫
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (m,w) (0,-(n:ℤ))).inv.app S_0_0) ≫
        lambdaPow n (Smn m w) ≫ b
      exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    rw [he',←lambdaPow_naturality n b]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := (vanishesModLambda_iff_factors n z).mp hz
    let b := (SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(n:ℤ))).preimage (e.hom≫a)
    have hb : F.map b=e.hom≫a :=
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(n:ℤ))).map_preimage _
    refine ⟨b,?_⟩
    rw [he,hb]
    simp only [Category.assoc,e.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    exact ha
  · rintro ⟨b,rfl⟩
    apply (vanishesModLambda_iff_factors n (lambdaMultiply n b)).mpr
    exact ⟨e.inv≫F.map b,by rw [Category.assoc,←he]⟩

private theorem map_filtration (A B : SyntheticObject)
    (f : A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
    {m w s : ℤ} (a : BiHom m w (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s a) :
    FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s (a ≫ f) := by
  let M := model.convergentMap A B f
  let FA := model.syntheticTower.filtration (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
  let FB := model.syntheticTower.filtration (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
  have ham : a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule (syntheticHomotopy
      (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (m,w)) (FA.F s (m,w)) := by
    simpa only [FA,SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,FiltrationAtLeast] using ha
  obtain ⟨a',ha'⟩ := ham
  have hb : a ≫ f ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule (syntheticHomotopy
      (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (m,w)) (FB.F s (m,w)) := by
    refine ⟨(M.filteredMap.compat s (m,w)).choose a',?_⟩
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (M.filteredMap.compat s (m,w)).choose_spec a'
    have hf := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (M.filteredMap_map (m,w)) ((FA.F s (m,w)).arrow a')
    change M.filteredMap.map (m,w) ((FA.F s (m,w)).arrow a') = (FA.F s (m,w)).arrow a' ≫ f at hf
    change (FB.F s (m,w)).arrow ((M.filteredMap.compat s (m,w)).choose a') =
      M.filteredMap.map (m,w) ((FA.F s (m,w)).arrow a') at h
    exact h.trans (hf.trans (congrArg (fun z => z ≫ f) ha'))
  simpa only [FB,SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,FiltrationAtLeast] using hb

    (f : A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
    {m w s : ℤ} (a : BiHom m w (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s a) :
    FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s (a ≫ f)

title: KIP126.Main.Internal.Selected.Normalized.result
code:
private theorem result (c : Raw.Claim) (hc : c ∈ Raw.claims) : Statement c := by
  let stmt (E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ))
      (b : (s t i : ℕ) → E.Page 2 (s,t)) : Prop :=
    let dec (s t : ℕ) (indices : List ℕ) : Option (E.Page 2 (s,t)) :=
      if Raw.coordinatesValid Raw.degrees c.spectrum s t indices then some ((indices.map (b s t)).sum) else none
    ∃ x, dec c.s c.t c.x=some x ∧
      match c.kind with
      | .reaches => ReachesPage E c.r (c.s,c.t) x
      | .boundaryBy => IsBoundaryBy E c.r (c.s,c.t) x
      | .equation => ∃ y, dec c.ts c.tt c.y=some y ∧ HasDifferential E c.r (c.s,c.t) (c.ts,c.tt) x y
      | .refutation => ∃ y, dec c.ts c.tt c.y=some y ∧ ¬HasDifferential E c.r (c.s,c.t) (c.ts,c.tt) x y
  have transport (E E' : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ)) (h : E=E')
      (b : (s t i : ℕ) → E.Page 2 (s,t)) (hb : stmt E b) :
      stmt E' (fun s t i => (eqToHom (congrArg (fun A => A.Page 2 (s,t)) h)) (b s t i)) := by
    subst E'
    simpa only [eqToHom_refl,ModuleCat.id_apply] using hb
  exact transport _ _ (sequence_eq c.spectrum).symm
    (KIP126.Computation.Table.basis c.spectrum) (KIP126.Computation.Table.result c hc)

private theorem middle_expand {N : ℕ} (f : Fin N →₀ F2) :
    f = ∑ i : Fin N, if f i=0 then 0 else Finsupp.single i 1 := by
  ext i
  simp only [Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · generalize f i=b
    fin_cases b <;> simp
  · intro j hj hji
    by_cases hf : f j=0
    · simp [hf]
    · simp [hf,hji]
  · simp

          Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ⊤) (P.Z 0) (P.Z_anti le_top) ≫ P.pageπ 0 ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg P.page hn.symm) := by

    have hn := norm (model.classical.sphere.ssData (s,t)) (↑(2-model.classical.sphere.r₀).toNat)
      (by rw [model.classical.firstPage]; rfl)

private theorem stem63_no_late_differentials
    (q : ℤ) (hq : q≤6) (r : ℤ) (hr : 3≤r)
    (a : (Normalized.sphere).Page r (q,q+63)) :
    (Normalized.sphere).d r (q,q+63) a=0 := by
  have represents_unique {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)}
        {r : ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ} {x : E.Page 2 p} {a b : E.Page r p}
      (ha : RepresentsOnPage E r p x a) (hb : RepresentsOnPage E r p x b) : a = b := by
    obtain ⟨hr, z, hz, hza⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨_, z', hz', hzb⟩ := hb
    let D' := E.ssData p
    let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2 - E.r₀).toNat
    let m : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r - E.r₀).toNat
    have hnm : n ≤ m := by
      dsimp only [n, m]
      exact_mod_cast (show (2-E.r₀).toNat ≤ (r-E.r₀).toNat by omega)
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    rw [← hza, ← hzb, ← map_sub]
    apply (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (D'.B m) (D'.Z m) (D'.B_le_Z m) _).mpr
    have heq : D'.pageπ n ((Subobject.ofLE _ _ (D'.Z_anti hnm)) (z-z')) = 0 := by
      change (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (D'.Z_anti hnm) ≫ D'.pageπ n) (z-z') = 0
      rw [map_sub, hz, hz', sub_self]
    have hh := (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (D'.B n) (D'.Z n) (D'.B_le_Z n) _).mp heq
    have he : (D'.Z n).arrow ((Subobject.ofLE _ _ (D'.Z_anti hnm)) (z-z')) =
        (D'.Z m).arrow (z-z') := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Subobject.ofLE_arrow (D'.Z_anti hnm)) _
    rw [he] at hh
    exact (ModuleCat.subobjectModule D'.V).monotone (D'.B_mono hnm) hh
  have represents_d_zero_of_later {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)}
        {r : ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ} {x : E.Page 2 p} {t : ℤ} (hr0 : E.r₀ ≤ r) (hrt : r < t)
      {a : E.Page r p} (ha : RepresentsOnPage E r p x a)
      (ht : ReachesPage E t p x) : E.d r p a = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨b, ht2, z, hz, _⟩ := ht
    let D' := E.ssData p
    let nt : WithTop ℕ := ↑(t-E.r₀).toNat
    let nr : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat
    let ns : WithTop ℕ := ↑((r-E.r₀).toNat+1)
    have hrs : nr ≤ ns := by
      dsimp only [nr, ns]
      exact_mod_cast (show (r-E.r₀).toNat ≤ (r-E.r₀).toNat+1 by omega)
    have hst : ns ≤ nt := by
      dsimp only [ns, nt]
      exact_mod_cast (show (r-E.r₀).toNat+1 ≤ (t-E.r₀).toNat by omega)
    let zr := (Subobject.ofLE (D'.Z nt) (D'.Z nr) (D'.Z_anti (hrs.trans hst))) z
    have hrep : RepresentsOnPage E r p x (D'.pageπ nr zr) := by
      refine ⟨ha.1, zr, ?_, rfl⟩
      dsimp only [zr]
      rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
      exact hz
    rw [represents_unique ha hrep]
    change D'.pageπ nr zr ∈ LinearMap.ker (E.d r p).hom
    rw [← subobjectModule_kernel, E.Z_succ r p hr0, subobjectModule_image]
    refine ⟨(Subobject.ofLE (D'.Z nt) (D'.Z ns) (D'.Z_anti hst)) z, ?_⟩
    change (Subobject.ofLE (D'.Z ns) (D'.Z nr) (D'.Z_anti hrs) ≫ D'.pageπ nr)
      ((Subobject.ofLE (D'.Z nt) (D'.Z ns) (D'.Z_anti hst)) z) = D'.pageπ nr zr
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
    rfl
  have permanent_reaches {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ)}
      {p : ℤ×ℤ} {x : E.Page 2 p} (hx : IsPermanentCycle E p x)
      (r : ℤ) (hr : 2≤r) : ReachesPage E r p x := by
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hx
    let A := E.ssData p
    let zr := (Subobject.ofLE (A.Z ⊤) (A.Z ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat) (A.Z_anti le_top)) z
    refine ⟨A.pageπ _ zr,hr,zr,?_,rfl⟩
    dsimp only [zr]
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply,← Category.assoc,Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
    exact hz
  have rep2_self {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ)}
      {p : ℤ×ℤ} (x : E.Page 2 p) : RepresentsOnPage E 2 p x x := by
    let A := E.ssData p
    haveI : Epi (A.pageπ ↑(2-E.r₀).toNat) := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
    obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective (A.pageπ ↑(2-E.r₀).toNat)).mp inferInstance x
    exact ⟨by decide,z,by simp only [Subobject.ofLE_refl,Category.id_comp]; rfl,rfl⟩
  have permanent_zero {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ)}
      {p : ℤ×ℤ} : IsPermanentCycle E p 0 := ⟨0,map_zero _⟩
  have late_zero_of_kernel_permanent
      (E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ)) (hE : E.r₀≤2) (p : ℤ×ℤ)
      (hker : ∀ x : E.Page 2 p, E.d 2 p x=0 → IsPermanentCycle E p x)
      (r : ℤ) (hr : 3≤r) (a : E.Page r p) : E.d r p a=0 := by
    let A := E.ssData p
    haveI : Epi (A.pageπ ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat) := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective (A.pageπ ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat)).mp inferInstance a
    let x : E.Page 2 p := (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (A.Z_anti (by
      exact_mod_cast (show (2-E.r₀).toNat≤(r-E.r₀).toNat by omega))) ≫ A.pageπ _) z
    have hx : RepresentsOnPage E r p x a := ⟨by omega,z,rfl,hz⟩
    have hd : E.d 2 p x=0 := represents_d_zero_of_later hE (by omega) (rep2_self x) ⟨a,hx⟩
    exact represents_d_zero_of_later (by omega) (by omega : r<r+1) hx
      (permanent_reaches (hker x hd) (r+1) (by omega))
  have kernel_perm_fin1
      {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ)} {p : ℤ×ℤ}
      (e : E.Page 2 p ≃ₗ[ℤ] (Fin 1 →₀ KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2))
      (hn : E.d 2 p (e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 1)) ≠ 0)
      (x : E.Page 2 p) (hx : E.d 2 p x=0) : IsPermanentCycle E p x := by
    have he : e x = Finsupp.single 0 (e x 0) := by
      apply Finsupp.ext
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      simp
    have hxe : x=e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 (e x 0)) := by rw [← he,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    generalize hc : e x 0 = a at hxe
    fin_cases a
    · simp only [show (⟨0,by decide⟩:KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2)=0 from rfl,Finsupp.single_zero,map_zero] at hxe

    rw [(SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) (m,n)).map_id S]

    rw [lambdaPow_one graded_coherence] at hshift
    simp only [F, eqToHom_refl, Functor.map_comp,
      Category.id_comp, Category.assoc] at hshift
    apply (cancel_epi ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (m,n)).map

        (Smn 0 1) ≫ (biShiftAddIso (0,-1) (m,n) ((m,n)+(0,-1)) (add_comm _ _)).inv.app
        (Smn 0 1) ≫ z) hpre
  have hraw : lambdaPow 1 (Smn (0+m) (1+n)) ≫ sphereProduct h₀ x = 0 := by

private theorem multiplied_indeterminacy_of_two_torsion
    (theta : BiHom 62 64 S) (htheta : theta + theta = 0)
    (b : BiHom 62 70 S) (hb : b + b = 0) :
    ThetaBMultipliedIndeterminacy h₀ theta b ∧ SymmetricTwoMultipliedIndeterminacy b := by

  · intro a c
    apply lambda_h0_of_two_torsion
    have hleft : sphereProduct theta a + sphereProduct theta a = 0 := by
      simpa [sphereProduct, Functor.map_add, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp]
        using congrArg (fun z => sphereProduct z a) htheta
    have hright : sphereProduct c b + sphereProduct c b = 0 := by
      simpa [sphereProduct, Preadditive.comp_add] using congrArg (fun z => sphereProduct c z) hb
    rw [add_add_add_comm, hleft, hright, zero_add]
  · intro a c
    have hleft : sphereProduct syntheticTwo a = a + a := by
      have hc := graded_coherence.left_unit (63,64) S
      have hc' : (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (0,0) (63,64)).hom.app S =
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift (63,64)).map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app S) := by
        change (biShiftAddIso (0,0) (63,64) (63,64) (by decide)).hom.app S = _ at hc
        simpa only [biShiftAddIso, Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app,
          eqToIso.hom, eqToHom_app, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id] using hc
      dsimp only [sphereProduct, syntheticTwo]
      simp only [Functor.id_obj, Functor.map_comp, two_smul, Functor.map_add, Category.assoc,
        Preadditive.add_comp]
      rw [(SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn := SyntheticSpectrum) (63,64)).map_id S]
      simp only [Category.id_comp]
      rw [← hc']
      simp
    have hright : sphereProduct c syntheticTwo = c + c := by
      have hc := graded_coherence.right_unit (63,64) S
      have hc' : (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (63,64) (0,0)).hom.app S =
          SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app (Smn 63 64) := by
        change (biShiftAddIso (63,64) (0,0) (63,64) (by decide)).hom.app S = _ at hc
        simpa only [biShiftAddIso, Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app,
          eqToIso.hom, eqToHom_app, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Smn] using hc
      have hnat := SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.naturality c
      dsimp only [Functor.id_map] at hnat
      dsimp only [sphereProduct, syntheticTwo]
      rw [← Category.assoc (f := (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).map c), hnat]
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← hc']
      simp [two_smul, Preadditive.comp_add]
    have hz : sphereProduct ((show BiHom 63 64 S from sphereProduct syntheticTwo a) +

          simp only [sphereProduct, Functor.map_add, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp]
          abel
        _ = 0 := by rw [hb]; simp [sphereProduct]
    rw [hz]
    simp [lambdaMultiply]

private theorem binary_expansion {N : ℕ} (f : Fin N →₀ ZMod 2) :
    f = ∑ i : Fin N, if f i = 0 then 0 else Finsupp.single i 1 := by
  classical
  ext i
  simp only [Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · generalize f i = b
    fin_cases b
    · change (0 : ZMod 2) = (if (0 : ZMod 2)=0 then 0 else Finsupp.single i 1) i
      simp
    · change (1 : ZMod 2) = (if (1 : ZMod 2)=0 then 0 else Finsupp.single i 1) i
      simp
  · intro j hj hji
    by_cases hf : f j = 0
    · simp [hf]
    · simp [hf,hji]
  · simp

private theorem two_coordinate_cosets {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℤ V]
    (e : V ≃ₗ[ℤ] (Fin 2 →₀ ZMod 2)) (B : Submodule ℤ V)
    (hB : e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 1) + e.symm (Finsupp.single 1 1) ∈ B)

    congr 1

  change x = (if c 0=0 then 0 else e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 1)) +
    ((if c 1=0 then 0 else e.symm (Finsupp.single 1 1))+0) at hx
  simp only [add_zero] at hx
  by_cases h0 : c 0=0 <;> by_cases h1 : c 1=0
  · left
    rw [hx]
    simpa only [h0,h1,if_true,zero_add] using B.zero_mem
  · right
    rw [hx]
    simp only [h0,h1,if_false,if_true,zero_add,sub_self]
    exact B.zero_mem
  · right
    rw [hx]
    simpa only [h0,h1,if_false,if_true,add_zero,sub_eq_add_neg,hn] using hB

private theorem three_coordinate_cosets {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℤ V]
    (e : V ≃ₗ[ℤ] (Fin 3 →₀ ZMod 2)) (B : Submodule ℤ V)
    (h1 : e.symm (Finsupp.single 1 1) ∈ B)
    (h2 : e.symm (Finsupp.single 2 1) ∈ B) (x : V) :
    x ∈ B ∨ x-e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 1) ∈ B := by
  classical
  have hif (c : ZMod 2) {a : V} (h : a ∈ B) : (if c=0 then 0 else a) ∈ B := by
    split
    · exact B.zero_mem
    · exact h
  let c : Fin 3 → ZMod 2 := e x
  have hx := congrArg e.symm (binary_expansion (e x))
  simp only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,map_sum,map_add,Fin.sum_univ_succ,apply_ite,map_zero] at hx
  change x = (if c 0=0 then 0 else e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 1)) +
    ((if c 1=0 then 0 else e.symm (Finsupp.single 1 1)) +
    ((if c 2=0 then 0 else e.symm (Finsupp.single 2 1))+0)) at hx
  simp only [add_zero] at hx

  · right

      y-x ∈ boundaries model .sphere (1+k) (s,t))

    (hc0 : (KIP126.Literature.sphereFirstQuotient model) s t (quotientClass 1 c0) = x)
    (a : BiHom (t-s) (t-k) (XModLambdaN (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) q))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s a) :
    ∃ b : Bool, FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+1)
      (a-(if b then quotientClass q (lambdaMultiply k c0) else 0)) := by

    ⟨x,permanentCycles_le_cycles model .sphere (s,t) _ ((permanent_cycle_iff_mem .sphere (s,t) x).mp hx)⟩
  have hframe : ∀ z : CycleQuotient model .sphere ((q:ℤ)-t+(t-k)) (1+t-(t-k)) (s,t),

    intro z
    obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep z
    change subquotientClass _ _ z = 0 ∨ subquotientClass _ _ z = subquotientClass _ _ c
    rcases hcoset z.val with hz | hz
    · left
      apply (subquotientClass_eq_zero_iff _ _ _).mpr
      exact (congrArg (fun j : ℤ => z.val ∈ boundaries model .sphere j (s,t))
        (show (1:ℤ)+k=1+t-(t-k) by omega)).mp hz
    · right
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      rw [←map_sub]
      apply (subquotientClass_eq_zero_iff _ _ _).mpr
      exact (congrArg (fun j : ℤ => (z-c).val ∈ boundaries model .sphere j (s,t))
        (show (1:ℤ)+k=1+t-(t-k) by omega)).mp hz
  have frame := finite_sphere_frame q k hq hk s t c hframe
  have hc := model.sphereDetectionCompatible.homotopy_lambda s t k c0
  change Detects (model.convergence .sphere) (s,t,t-k)
    (sphereLabel s t k ((KIP126.Literature.sphereFirstQuotient model) s t (quotientClass 1 c0))) (lambdaMultiply k c0) at hc

  have h₁ := coh.associativity a b c (a+b) (b+c) (a+(b+c)) rfl rfl habc rfl A
  have h₂ := coh.associativity b a c (a+b) (a+c) (a+(b+c))
    (add_comm _ _) rfl habc hbac A
  have h₃ := coh.associativity b c a (b+c) (a+c) (a+(b+c))
    rfl (add_comm _ _) (add_comm _ _) hbac A
  simp only [shiftSwap,Iso.trans_hom,Iso.symm_hom,Iso.app_hom,Iso.app_inv]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  apply (cancel_epi ((biShiftAddIso b c (b+c) rfl).hom.app
    ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A))).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc,← h₁]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

  -- Cancel the common left factor introduced by the first associativity square.
  apply (cancel_epi ((SyntheticCategory.biShift c).map
    ((biShiftAddIso b a (a+b) (add_comm _ _)).hom.app A))).mp
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app,CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,Category.id_comp]
  rw [← Category.assoc,h₂]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  apply (cancel_epi ((biShiftAddIso a c (a+c) rfl).hom.app
    ((SyntheticCategory.biShift b).obj A))).mpr
  apply (cancel_epi ((biShiftAddIso c a (a+c) (add_comm _ _)).hom.app
    ((SyntheticCategory.biShift b).obj A))).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc,← Category.assoc,← h₃]
  simp only [Category.assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Category.id_comp,←Functor.map_comp,Iso.hom_inv_id_app,CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]

theorem lambda_pow_shift (coh : BiShiftCoherence SyntheticSpectrum)
    (n : ℕ) (a : ℤ × ℤ) (A : SyntheticSpectrum) :
    lambdaPow n ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
      (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n) A).hom ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (lambdaPow n A) := by
  induction n generalizing A with
  | zero =>
    change SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
      (shiftSwap a 0 A).hom ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A)
    have h : SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
        (biShiftAddIso a 0 a (add_zero a)).hom.app A ≫
          (biShiftAddIso 0 a a (zero_add a)).inv.app A ≫
            (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) := by
      rw [←coh.left_unit a A,Iso.inv_hom_id_app,Category.comp_id]
      exact (coh.right_unit a A).symm
    rw [shiftSwap_hom_eq a 0 a (add_zero a) (zero_add a),Category.assoc]
    exact h
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 : lambdaPow 1 ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
        (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree 1) A).hom ≫
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (lambdaPow 1 A) := by
      rw [lambdaPow_one coh,lambdaPow_one coh]
      change SyntheticCategory.lam.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) =
        (shiftSwap a (0,-1) A).hom ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (SyntheticCategory.lam.app A)
      rw [shiftSwap_hom_eq a (0,-1) (a+(0,-1)) rfl (add_comm _ _),Category.assoc]
      exact coh.lambda_comm a A
    have hn := shiftSwap_natural a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n) (lambdaPow 1 A)
    have hh := shiftSwap_add_eq coh a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree 1) (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n)
      (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree (n+1)) (by ext <;> simp [KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree]) A
    change (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree (n+1)) A).hom ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map ((lambdaShiftAddIso 1 n (n+1) (by omega)).inv.app A) =
      (lambdaShiftAddIso 1 n (n+1) (by omega)).inv.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A) ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n)).map (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree 1) A).hom ≫
        (shiftSwap a (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree n) ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree 1)).obj A)).hom at hh
    rw [lambdaPow_add coh 1 n (n+1) (by omega) ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj A),
      lambdaPow_add coh 1 n (n+1) (by omega) A,h1,ih]
    simp only [Functor.map_comp,Category.assoc]
    rw [reassoc_of% hn]
    rw [reassoc_of% hh]
    rfl

private theorem nCycle_iff_reaches (r : ℤ) (hr : 2≤r) (p : ℤ×ℤ) (x : Normalized.sphere.Page 2 p) :
    (2≤r ∧ x∈nCycles (r-1) p) ↔ ReachesPage Normalized.sphere r p x := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_,hx⟩
    have h := normalized_reaches r p (denormalize p x)
      ((KIP126.ProofTools.isCycle_iff_reaches model .sphere r hr p _).mp ⟨by omega,hx⟩)
    have heq : Normalized.label p (denormalize p x)=x := by
      dsimp only [Normalized.label,denormalize]
      rw [←ModuleCat.comp_apply,eqToHom_trans,eqToHom_refl]
      rfl
    rwa [heq] at h
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨hr,nCycle_of_reaches r hr p x hx⟩

theorem tower_extension_iff
    (M : ConvergentMap F g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n : ℤ)
    (x : ((F.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty) :
    TowerExtensionEquation M p s n x y ↔
      0 ≤ n ∧ ∃ (a : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
        (b : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
        ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow a ≫ g = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow b ∧
        (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p a = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x ∧
        (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p b = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y := by
  unfold TowerExtensionEquation
  rw [M.extensionEquation_iff]
  simp only [toGraded_element]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hn,a,b,ha,hb,he⟩
    refine ⟨hn,a (ULift.up 1),b (ULift.up 1),?_,?_,?_⟩
    · exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom he (ULift.up 1)
    · simpa [elementMap, one_smul] using ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ha (ULift.up (1 : ℤ))
    · simpa [elementMap, one_smul] using ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hb (ULift.up (1 : ℤ))
  · rintro ⟨hn,a,b,he,ha,hb⟩
    refine ⟨hn,elementMap a,elementMap b,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [← elementMap_comp,ha]
    · rw [← elementMap_comp,hb]
    · rw [← Category.assoc,← elementMap_comp,← elementMap_comp,← elementMap_comp]
      exact congrArg elementMap he

theorem map_preserves_filtration
    (M : ConvergentMap F g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s : ℤ) (a : BiHom p.1 p.2 X)
    (ha : a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X s p) :
    a ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y s p := by
  obtain ⟨a',ha'⟩ := filtration_representative_exists P X p s a ha
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (M.filteredMap.compat s p).choose_spec a'
  have hm : a ≫ g ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration Y).F s p) := by
    refine ⟨(M.filteredMap.compat s p).choose a',?_⟩
    change ((P.filtration Y).F s p).arrow ((M.filteredMap.compat s p).choose a') = a ≫ g
    change ((P.filtration Y).F s p).arrow ((M.filteredMap.compat s p).choose a') =
      M.filteredMap.map p (((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow a') at h
    have hh := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (M.filteredMap_map p)
      (((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow a')
    change M.filteredMap.map p (((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow a') =
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow a' ≫ g at hh
    exact h.trans (hh.trans (congrArg (fun z => z ≫ g) ha'))
  simpa [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration, syntheticHomotopy] using hm

theorem infinity_graded_naturality
    (M : ConvergentMap F g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s : ℤ) :
    (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom ≫ M.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s p =
      (F.functor.map g).eInftyMap (s,p.1+s,p.2) ≫ (infinityGradedIso cy p s).hom := by
  have h := M.infinity_action_graded (s,p.1+s,p.2)
  have transport {ι : Type} (A B : ι → ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)
      (f : ∀ i, A i ⟶ B i) {i j : ι} (hij : i=j)
      {U V : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ} (a : U ⟶ A i) (b : V ⟶ B i)
      (q : U ⟶ V) (hq : a ≫ f i = q ≫ b) :
      (a ≫ eqToHom (congrArg A hij)) ≫ f j =
        q ≫ (b ≫ eqToHom (congrArg B hij)) := by
    subst j
    simpa only [eqToHom_refl,Category.comp_id] using hq
  exact transport
    (fun p => (P.filtration X).associatedGraded s p)
    (fun p => (P.filtration Y).associatedGraded s p)
    (fun p => M.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s p)
    (show (p.1+s-s,p.2)=p by ext <;> simp) _ _ _ h

theorem infinity_image_iff_lift
    (M : ConvergentMap F g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s : ℤ)
    (x : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)) :
    (infinityGradedIso cy p s).inv ((P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded s p x) ∈
      Set.range ((F.functor.map g).eInftyMap (s,p.1+s,p.2)).hom ↔
    ∃ a : BiHom p.1 p.2 X, a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X s p ∧
      @HSub.hSub (BiHom p.1 p.2 Y) (BiHom p.1 p.2 Y) (BiHom p.1 p.2 Y)
        inferInstance (((P.filtration Y).F s p).arrow x) (a ≫ g) ∈
        P.filtrationSubmodule Y (s+1) p := by
  have hn := infinity_graded_naturality M p s
  have hi : (∃ z, (F.functor.map g).eInftyMap (s,p.1+s,p.2) z =
      (infinityGradedIso cy p s).inv ((P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded s p x)) ↔
      ∃ z, M.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s p z = (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded s p x := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z,hz⟩
      refine ⟨(infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom z,?_⟩
      have he := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hn z
      change M.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s p ((infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom z) =
        (infinityGradedIso cy p s).hom ((F.functor.map g).eInftyMap (s,p.1+s,p.2) z) at he
      rw [hz] at he
      exact he.trans ((infinityGradedIso cy p s).toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _)
    · rintro ⟨z,hz⟩
      refine ⟨(infinityGradedIso cx p s).inv z,?_⟩
      apply (infinityGradedIso cy p s).toLinearEquiv.injective
      have he := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hn ((infinityGradedIso cx p s).inv z)
      simp only [ModuleCat.comp_apply] at he
      have ha := (infinityGradedIso cx p s).toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply z
      change (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom ((infinityGradedIso cx p s).inv z) = z at ha
      rw [ha,hz] at he
      exact he.symm.trans ((infinityGradedIso cy p s).toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).symm
  change (∃ z, _ = _) ↔ _
  refine hi.trans ((graded_image_iff_lift M.filteredMap s p x).trans ?_)
  simp only [ConvergentMap.filteredMap_map,SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,
    OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

theorem next_filtration_of_infinity_injective
    (M : ConvergentMap F g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s : ℤ)
    (hf : Function.Injective ((F.functor.map g).eInftyMap (s,p.1+s,p.2)).hom)
    (a : BiHom p.1 p.2 X) (ha : a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X s p)
    (hb : a ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (s+1) p) :
    a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X (s+1) p := by
  have hn := infinity_graded_naturality M p s
  have hmono : Mono (M.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s p) := by
    rw [ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective]
    intro x y hxy
    have he (z : (P.filtration X).associatedGraded s p) :

theorem graded_image_iff_lift (f : FilteredMorphism F G) (s : ℤ) (i : ι)
    (x : (Subobject.underlying.obj (G.F s i) : ModuleCat R)) :
    (∃ z : F.associatedGraded s i,
      f.inducedGrMap s i z = G.toAssociatedGraded s i x) ↔
    ∃ a : A i, a ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule (A i)) (F.F s i) ∧
      (G.F s i).arrow x - f.map i a ∈
        (ModuleCat.subobjectModule (B i)) (G.F (s+1) i) := by
  have hc (a : (Subobject.underlying.obj (F.F s i) : ModuleCat R)) :
      f.map i ((F.F s i).arrow a) = (G.F s i).arrow ((f.compat s i).choose a) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (f.compat s i).choose_spec a).symm
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    haveI : Epi (F.toAssociatedGraded s i) := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective (F.toAssociatedGraded s i)).mp inferInstance z
    refine ⟨(F.F s i).arrow a, ⟨a, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hc]
    apply (element_grade_equal_iff G s i x _).mp
    rw [← graded_map_representative f s i a, ha, hz]
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, ha⟩
    refine ⟨F.toAssociatedGraded s i a, ?_⟩
    rw [hc] at ha
    rw [graded_map_representative]
    exact ((element_grade_equal_iff G s i x _).mpr ha).symm

theorem next_filtration_mem_of_graded_mono (f : FilteredMorphism F G)
    (s : ℤ) (i : ι) [Mono (f.inducedGrMap s i)]
    (a : A i) (ha : a ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule (A i)) (F.F s i))
    (hb : f.map i a ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule (B i)) (G.F (s+1) i)) :
    a ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule (A i)) (F.F (s+1) i) := by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ha
  have hy : (G.F s i).arrow ((f.compat s i).choose x) =
      f.map i ((F.F s i).arrow x) :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (f.compat s i).choose_spec x
  have hzero : G.toAssociatedGraded s i ((f.compat s i).choose x) = 0 := by
    apply (G.toAssociatedGraded_eq_zero_iff s i _).mpr
    rwa [hy]
  have hsource : F.toAssociatedGraded s i x = 0 := by
    apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (f.inducedGrMap s i)).mp inferInstance
    rw [map_zero, graded_map_representative, hzero]
  exact (F.toAssociatedGraded_eq_zero_iff s i x).mp hsource

public theorem finite_filtration_correction
    {A A' B : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup A'] [AddCommGroup B]
    (ρ : A' →+ A) (g : A →+ B)
    (E : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) (L : ℤ → AddSubgroup A')
    (T : AddSubgroup B) (hL : Antitone L)
    (s : ℤ) (N : ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ k : ℤ, s ≤ k → k < s + N → ∀ δ : A, δ ∈ E k →
      (∃ ε : A', ε ∈ L k ∧ δ - ρ ε ∈ E (k + 1)) ∨ g δ ∈ T)
    (hend : ∀ δ : A, δ ∈ E (s + N) → g δ ∈ T)
    (α₀ : A) (α : A') (hδ : α₀ - ρ α ∈ E s) :
    ∃ α' : A', α' - α ∈ L s ∧ g (α₀ - ρ α') ∈ T := by
  induction N generalizing s α with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨α, ?_, hend _ ?_⟩
    · simpa only [sub_self] using (L s).zero_mem
    · simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using hδ
  | succ N ih =>
    rcases hstep s le_rfl (by omega) _ hδ with hcorrect | hstop
    · obtain ⟨ε, hε, hδε⟩ := hcorrect
      have hδ' : α₀ - ρ (α + ε) ∈ E (s + 1) := by
        simpa only [map_add, sub_add_eq_sub_sub] using hδε
      obtain ⟨α', hα', hfinal⟩ := ih (s + 1)
        (fun k hk hkn δ hδ => hstep k (by omega) (by omega) δ hδ)
        (fun δ hδ => hend δ (by simpa only [Nat.cast_succ, add_assoc,
          add_comm, add_left_comm] using hδ)) (α + ε) hδ'
      refine ⟨α', ?_, hfinal⟩
      have hmem := (L s).add_mem (hL (by omega) hα') hε
      convert hmem using 1
      abel
    · exact ⟨α, by simpa only [sub_self] using (L s).zero_mem, hstop⟩

public theorem finite_filtration_correction

    (ρ : A' →+ A) (g : A →+ B)
    (E : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) (L : ℤ → AddSubgroup A')
    (T : AddSubgroup B) (hL : Antitone L)
    (s : ℤ) (N : ℕ)

      (∃ ε : A', ε ∈ L k ∧ δ - ρ ε ∈ E (k + 1)) ∨ g δ ∈ T)
    (hend : ∀ δ : A, δ ∈ E (s + N) → g δ ∈ T)

public theorem finite_filtration_reflection
    {B' B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B'] [AddCommGroup B]
    (ρ : B' →+ B) (L : ℤ → AddSubgroup B') (E : ℤ → AddSubgroup B)
    (hE : Antitone E) (s : ℤ) (N : ℕ)
    (hgraded : ∀ k : ℤ, s ≤ k → k < s + N → ∀ b : B', b ∈ L k →
      ρ b ∈ E (k + 1) → b ∈ L (k + 1))
    (b : B') (hb : b ∈ L s) (hρb : ρ b ∈ E (s + N)) :
    b ∈ L (s + N) := by
  have h : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → b ∈ L (s + k) := by
    intro k hk
    induction k with
    | zero => simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using hb
    | succ k ih =>
      have hkN : k ≤ N := by omega
      have hnext := hgraded (s + k) (by omega) (by omega) b (ih hkN)
        (hE (by omega) hρb)
      simpa only [Nat.cast_succ, add_assoc] using hnext
  exact h N le_rfl

      ρ b ∈ E (k + 1) → b ∈ L (k + 1))

code:
public theorem first_nonzero_filtration_grade
    {B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B] (E : ℤ → AddSubgroup B)
    (s : ℤ) (N : ℕ) (b : B) (hb : b ∈ E s) (hnot : b ∉ E (s + N)) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, s ≤ k ∧ k < s + N ∧ b ∈ E k ∧ b ∉ E (k + 1) := by
  induction N generalizing s with
  | zero => exact (hnot (by simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using hb)).elim
  | succ N ih =>
    by_cases hnext : b ∈ E (s + 1)
    · have hnot' : b ∉ E ((s + 1) + N) := by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_succ, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hnot
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hkN, hb, hnot⟩ := ih (s + 1) hnext hnot'
      exact ⟨k, by omega, by omega, hb, hnot⟩
    · exact ⟨s, le_rfl, by omega, hb, hnext⟩

public theorem generalizedLeibniz
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary) :
    GeneralizedLeibnizLaw model X Y f := by
  intro page r m l s t x y xInfinity yInfinity hpage hpr hm hmUpper hl
    hx hy hxInfinity hyInfinity hdx hf hfInfinity hsourceCrossing htargetCrossing
  let WFinite := Classical.choice hf
  let WInfinity := Classical.choice hfInfinity
  let LeftEdge : Prop := TowerExtensionEquation
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (Internal.Leibniz.absoluteBoundary
        ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (page-1)))
    (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s r WFinite.source
    (Internal.Leibniz.glBottomSource X Y f page r l s t hpage hpr WInfinity)
  let SourceNoCrossing : Prop :=
    Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (Internal.Leibniz.absoluteBoundary
        ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (page-1)))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s r ∨
    Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (page-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (page-1)))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s m
  let BottomNoCrossing : Prop := Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing
    (model.convergentMap
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu Y))
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ))).map (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map))
    (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+r) l
  have hsourceReady : SourceNoCrossing ∨ FiniteNoCrossing model X Y f page m s t := by
    rcases hsourceCrossing with hδcross | hfcross
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl
        (Internal.Leibniz.classical_noCrossing_shifted_absolute_boundary X page
          (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) r s t hδcross))
    · by_cases hmmin : m ≤ normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr
          (Internal.Leibniz.minimal_length_finite_tower_no_crossing X Y f
            (page-1) (by omega) s t m hmmin))
      · exact Or.inr hfcross
  have boundary_regrade (m0 m1 w0 w1 : ℤ) (hm0 : m0=m1) (hw0 : w0=w1)
      (a0 : BiHom m0 w0 (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) (page-1))) :
      Internal.Mahowald.biSuspensionHomEquiv m1 w1 (page-1:ℕ) _
        (homotopyRegrade hm0 hw0 a0 ≫ XModLambdaN.proj _ (page-1)) =
      homotopyRegrade (congrArg (fun z => z-1) hm0) (congrArg (fun z : ℤ => z+((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) hw0)
        (Internal.Mahowald.biSuspensionHomEquiv m0 w0 (page-1:ℕ) _
          (a0 ≫ XModLambdaN.proj _ (page-1))) := by
    subst m1; subst w1; rfl
  obtain ⟨hbottom,hbottomSource,hbottomTarget⟩ :=
    Internal.Leibniz.infinite_extension_lambda_boundary_shift X Y f
      (r-page).toNat (page-1) l (s+r) (t+r-1) xInfinity yInfinity WInfinity
  have hbottomPoint := Internal.Leibniz.gl_bottom_point page r s t
    (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) hpage hpr
  have hR : 2 ≤ r + l - m := by omega
  have hy_later : IsCycle model Y (r + l - m - 1)
      (s + m, t + m) y := by
    by_cases hlmin : l = (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f : ℤ)
    · convert hy using 1
      omega
    have hlstrict : (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f : ℤ) < l := lt_of_le_of_ne hl (Ne.symm hlmin)
    let k : ℕ := (r - 1).toNat
    have hkZ : (k : ℤ) = r - 1 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    have hindex : (s + r, t + r - 1) = (s + k + 1, t + k) := by
      ext <;> omega
    let xInfinity' : Ambient model X (s + k + 1, t + k) :=
      (eqToHom (congrArg (fun p => Ambient model X p) hindex)) xInfinity
    have transport {p p' : ℤ × ℤ} (hp : p = p') (z : Ambient model X p)
        (hz : IsPermanent model X p z)
        (hd : HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) r (s,t) p x z) :
        IsPermanent model X p' ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun q => Ambient model X q) hp)) z) ∧

      ((towerInfinityIso (model.convergence A) (model.convergence (.shift (0,-(k:ℤ)) A))

private theorem lambdaRawInfinity_zero (A : SyntheticObject) (p : ℤ×ℤ) (s : ℤ)
    (e : ((model.family.obj (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty) :
    HEq (lambdaRawInfinity A 0 p s e) e := by
  let F := model.syntheticTower.filtration (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
  haveI : Epi (F.toAssociatedGraded s p) := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  obtain ⟨ar,har⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective (F.toAssociatedGraded s p)).mp
    inferInstance ((infinityGradedIso (model.convergence A) p s).hom e)
  obtain ⟨br,hbr,hgbr⟩ := shift_frame A (0,0) p s e ar har
  obtain ⟨cr,hcr,hgcr⟩ := tower_map_frame
    (model.convergentMap (.shift (0,0) A) A (lambdaPow 0 (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)))
    (p+(0,0)) s _ br hgbr
  have hactual := shift_zero_lambda (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) p ((F.F s p).arrow ar)
  rw [hbr] at hcr
  have hh : homotopyRegrade (by simp) (by simp)
      (((model.syntheticTower.filtration (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).F s (p+(0,0))).arrow cr) =
      (F.F s p).arrow ar := by
    rw [←hcr,regrade_comp]
    exact hactual
  have transport_frame (p q : ℤ×ℤ) (h : p=q)
      (a : (Subobject.underlying.obj (F.F s p) : ModuleCat ℤ))
      (b : (Subobject.underlying.obj (F.F s q) : ModuleCat ℤ))
      (ha : homotopyRegrade (congrArg Prod.fst h.symm) (congrArg Prod.snd h.symm)
        ((F.F s q).arrow b) = (F.F s p).arrow a) :
      HEq (F.toAssociatedGraded s q b) (F.toAssociatedGraded s p a) := by
    subst q
    have hb : b=a := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (F.F s p).arrow).mp inferInstance ha
    subst b
    rfl
  have hgr := transport_frame p (p+(0,0)) (by simp) ar cr hh
  rw [har,hgcr] at hgr
  have transport_grade (p q : ℤ×ℤ) (h : p=q)
      (z : ((model.family.obj (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
      (z' : ((model.family.obj (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData (s,q.1+s,q.2)).eInfty)
      (hz : HEq ((infinityGradedIso (model.convergence A) q s).hom z')
        ((infinityGradedIso (model.convergence A) p s).hom z)) : HEq z' z := by
    subst q
    exact heq_of_eq ((infinityGradedIso (model.convergence A) p s).toLinearEquiv.injective (eq_of_heq hz))
  exact transport_grade p (p+(0,0)) (by simp) e _ hgr

private theorem gl_bottom_target_representative (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (page : ℕ) (r l s t : ℤ) (hpage : 2≤page) (hpr : (page:ℤ)≤r)
    {xInfinity : Ambient model X (s+r,t+r-1)}
    {yInfinity : Ambient model Y (s+r+l,t+r-1+l)}
    (W : InfiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f l (s+r) (t+r-1) xInfinity yInfinity)
    (target : (model.family.nu model.nu (Y.obj model.auxiliary)).E₂
      (s+r+l,(t-s)-1+(s+r+l),t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f+(page-1:ℕ)))
    (htarget : HEq target (nuWeightLabel model Y (s+r+l) (t+r-1+l)
      (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f+(page-1:ℕ))
      (by have := W.length_lower; omega) yInfinity)) :
    HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2
      (s+r+l,(t-s)+(s+r+l),t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
      (regradeE2 (by ext <;> dsimp <;> omega)
        (((essShift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ))).page (.nu Y) 2 (by decide)
          ((t-s)-1,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f+(page-1:ℕ)) (s+r+l)).hom target))
      (glBottomTarget X Y f page r l s t hpage hpr W) := by
  let e := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
  let k := (r-page).toNat
  let q := page-1
  let p : ℤ×ℤ := ((t+r-1)-(s+r),(t+r-1)+e)
  let p' : ℤ×ℤ := ((t-s)-1,t+e+(q:ℤ))
  have hk : (k:ℤ)=r-page := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
  have hq : (q:ℤ)=(page:ℤ)-1 := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hp : p+(0,-(k:ℤ))=p' := by ext <;> dsimp [p,p'] <;> omega
  let targetRaw : (model.family.obj (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary))).E₂
      (s+r+l,(p+(0,-(k:ℤ))).1+(s+r+l),(p+(0,-(k:ℤ))).2) :=
    regradeE2 (by ext <;> dsimp [p,e,q] <;> omega) target
  have htargetRaw : HEq targetRaw
      (nuWeightLabel model Y (s+r+l) (t+r-1+l) (p.2-k) (by have := W.length_lower; dsimp [p,e]; omega) yInfinity) := by
    apply (regradeE2_heq _ target).trans
    apply htarget.trans
    exact nuWeight_label_heq Y _ _ _ _ _ _ rfl rfl (by dsimp [p,e,q]; omega) _ _ _ _ (HEq.rfl)
  have hsource := infinite_target_nuWeight_heq X Y f l (s+r) (t+r-1) W.length_lower yInfinity
  let iRaw : Tridegree := (s+r+l,(p+(0,-(k:ℤ))).1+(s+r+l),(p+(0,-(k:ℤ))).2)
  let eRaw : ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.nu Y).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData iRaw).eInfty :=
    lambdaRawInfinity (.nu Y) k p (s+r+l) W.target
  have hRaw : HEq eRaw (lambdaRawInfinity (.nu Y) k p (s+r+l) W.target) := HEq.rfl
  have hiRaw : iRaw=(s+r+l,t+r-1+l,p.2-k) := by ext <;> dsimp [iRaw,p] <;> omega
  have hraw : HasInfinityRepresentative
      (model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.nu Y).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)) 2 iRaw targetRaw eRaw := by
    exact lambdaRawInfinity_nu_representative_regraded Y k p (s+r+l) (t+r-1+l)
      (by dsimp [p]; omega) (by dsimp [p,e]; have := W.length_lower; omega) yInfinity
      (infiniteTargetForExtension model X Y f l (s+r) (t+r-1) W.length_lower yInfinity)
      hsource W.target W.target_rep iRaw hiRaw targetRaw htargetRaw eRaw hRaw
  have hbound := ((essShift (1,-(q:ℤ))).representative_iff (.nu Y) 2 (by decide)
    (p+(0,-(k:ℤ))) (s+r+l) targetRaw (lambdaRawInfinity (.nu Y) k p (s+r+l) W.target)).mp hraw
  have hpoint : (s+r+l,(lambdaBoundaryPoint k q p).1+(s+r+l),(lambdaBoundaryPoint k q p).2) =
      (s+r+l,(t-s)+(s+r+l),t+e) := by
    have h := gl_bottom_point page r s t e hpage hpr
    exact congrArg (fun v : ℤ×ℤ => (s+r+l,v.1+(s+r+l),v.2)) h
  have hbound := representative_transport hpoint _ _ hbound
  have hshift (a b : ℤ×ℤ) (hab : a=b)
      (x : (model.family.nu model.nu (Y.obj model.auxiliary)).E₂ (s+r+l,a.1+(s+r+l),a.2))
      (y : (model.family.nu model.nu (Y.obj model.auxiliary)).E₂ (s+r+l,b.1+(s+r+l),b.2)) (hxy : HEq x y) :
      HEq (((essShift (1,-(q:ℤ))).page (.nu Y) 2 (by decide) a (s+r+l)).hom x)
        (((essShift (1,-(q:ℤ))).page (.nu Y) 2 (by decide) b (s+r+l)).hom y) := by
    subst b
    cases hxy
    rfl
  let labelA := ((essShift (1,-(q:ℤ))).page (.nu Y) 2 (by decide) (p+(0,-(k:ℤ))) (s+r+l)).hom targetRaw
  let labelB := ((essShift (1,-(q:ℤ))).page (.nu Y) 2 (by decide) p' (s+r+l)).hom target
  have hshiftxy := hshift (p+(0,-(k:ℤ))) p' hp targetRaw target (regradeE2_heq _ target)
  have hlabel := (regradeE2_heq hpoint labelA).trans hshiftxy
  have hcan : (s+r+l,(p'+(1,-(q:ℤ))).1+(s+r+l),(p'+(1,-(q:ℤ))).2) =
      (s+r+l,(t-s)+(s+r+l),t+e) := by ext <;> dsimp [p'] <;> omega
  let finalLabel : (model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.shift (1,-(q:ℤ)) (.nu Y)).obj

    regradeE2 hcan labelB
  have hfinal : HEq finalLabel labelB := regradeE2_heq hcan labelB
  have hlabel' := hlabel.trans hfinal.symm
  have hlabelEq := eq_of_heq hlabel'
  rw [hlabelEq] at hbound
  exact hbound

    (page : ℕ) (r l s t : ℤ) (hpage : 2≤page) (hpr : (page:ℤ)≤r)

private theorem adjacent_absolute_boundary (X : ClassicalObject)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0<k) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (y : Ambient model X (s+k+1,t+k))
    (hd : HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      (k+1) (s,t) (s+k+1,t+k) x y) :
    ∃ a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) k),
      a ≫ (model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 k hk =
        firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1 ∧
      (homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl
        (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t k (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
          (a ≫ XModLambdaN.proj _ k))) ≫ XModLambdaN.incl _ 1 =
        firstLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) y ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1 := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  obtain ⟨a,ha,had⟩ := adjacent_mahowald_case X k hk s t x y hd
  dsimp only at had
  let δ : XModLambdaN A k ⟶ ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).obj (XModLambdaN A 1))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧ := by
    simpa only [show k.succ-k=1 by omega] using ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hk (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).delta
  have hp : biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t k (XModLambdaN A 1) (a≫δ) =
      biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t k A (a≫XModLambdaN.proj A k) ≫ XModLambdaN.incl A 1 := by
    have h := cofiber_boundary_projection X k (k+1) hk (Nat.lt_succ_self k) (t-s) t a
    have transport (q : ℕ) (hq : q=1)
        (d : XModLambdaN A k ⟶ ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).obj (XModLambdaN A q))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)
        (he : (XModLambdaN A k ⟶ ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).obj (XModLambdaN A q))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧) =
          (XModLambdaN A k ⟶ ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).obj (XModLambdaN A 1))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧))
        (hd : biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t k (XModLambdaN A q) (a≫d) =
          biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t k A (a≫XModLambdaN.proj A k) ≫ XModLambdaN.incl A q) :
        biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t k (XModLambdaN A 1) (a≫he.mp d) =
          biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t k A (a≫XModLambdaN.proj A k) ≫ XModLambdaN.incl A 1 := by
      subst q
      exact hd
    exact transport (k+1-k) (by omega) _ _ h
  let b := firstLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) y ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) 1
  have hb := first_label_detects_unshifted X 1 (by omega) (s+k+1) (t+k) y b (by
    rw [(model.quotients.tower _).rho_id,Category.comp_id])
  have heq := finite_top_detection_unique X 1 (by omega) (s+k+1) (t+k) (t+k) (by omega)
    _ _ b had hb
  have hdet : homotopyRegrade (show (t-s)-1=(t+k)-(s+k+1) by omega) rfl
      (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t k (XModLambdaN A 1) (a≫δ)) = b := heq
  rw [hp,regrade_comp] at hdet
  exact ⟨a,ha,hdet⟩

private theorem nu_lambda_detects (X : ClassicalObject) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (s t : ℤ) (y : Ambient model X (s,t))
