      XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1) :
    Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s,t,t-k)
      (nuWeightLabel model X s t (t-k) (by omega) y) (lambdaMultiply k α) := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  have ha := nu_first_label_detects X s t y hy α hα
  have hsource : (s,t,t)=(s,(t-s)+s,t) := by simp
  have hstem := detects_transport hsource _ _ ha
  let L : ((SyntheticObject.shift (0,-(k:ℤ)) (.nu X)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) ⟶ A := lambdaPow k A
  have hmap := shifted_map_detects (.nu X) (.nu X) (0,-(k:ℤ)) (t-s,t) s L
    (regradeE2 hsource (nuWeightLabel model X s t t (by omega) y)) α hstem
  have hindex : (s,((t-s,t)+(0,-(k:ℤ))).1+s,((t-s,t)+(0,-(k:ℤ))).2) =
      (s,t,t-k) := by ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hmap := detects_transport hindex _ _ hmap
  obtain ⟨e,he,b,hb,hgb⟩ := hmap
  obtain ⟨e0,he0,_⟩ := ha
  have heStem := representative_transport hsource _ _ he0
  have heMap := shifted_representative_map (.nu X) (.nu X)
    (0,-(k:ℤ)) (t-s,t) s L _ _ heStem
  have heMap := representative_transport hindex _ _ heMap
  have heq := he.unique heMap
  have heq' : e = KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityLambda (.nu X) k (s,t) t e0 := by
    convert heq using 1
    simp only [KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityLambda,
      InfinityShiftCoordinates.lambdaMap, show k ≠ 0 by omega, ↓reduceDIte,
      InfinityShiftCoordinates.shift, infinityShift, Iso.trans_hom, ModuleCat.comp_apply,
      eqToIso.hom, KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityShiftData,
      KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityShift_comparison]
    exact (infinity_map_regrade L hindex _).symm
  have hlabel : HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,t,t-k)
      (nuWeightLabel model X s t (t-k) (by omega) y)
      (KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityLambda (.nu X) k (s,t) t e0) := by
    apply (KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_nu_labels X s t (t-k) (by omega) y _).mpr
    refine ⟨hy,?_⟩
    rw [KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_lambda_nu X k (s,t) t (by omega)]
    have he0' := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_nu_labels X s t t (by omega) y e0).mp he0
    rw [he0'.2]
    rfl
  have heFinal : HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,t,t-k)
      (nuWeightLabel model X s t (t-k) (by omega) y) e := by
    rw [heq']
    exact hlabel
  refine ⟨e,heFinal,b,?_,hgb⟩
  convert hb using 1
  simp only [regrade_precomp, L, shiftHomotopyClass, lambdaMultiply,
    Category.assoc]
  simp only [A]
  erw [lambdaPow_naturality k α]
  simp only [←Category.assoc,eqToHom_trans]

    (q : ℕ) (m w v : ℤ)

    FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower v
        (a ≫ absoluteBoundary (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q) ↔
      FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower v
        (biSuspensionHomEquiv m w q (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
          (a ≫ XModLambdaN.proj _ q)) := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)

    have h := congrArg (fun z => z ≫ (biSuspensionIso q A).inv)
      (bi_susp_symm_eq m w q A α)
    simpa [α, absoluteBoundary, shiftHomotopyClass, susp_invariance,
      Iso.homCongr] using h
  rw [he,regrade_filtration_iff]
  exact shift_filtration_iff (.nu X) (1,-(q:ℤ)) (m-1,w+q) v α

code:
private theorem no_crossing_differential_zero (X : ClassicalObject)
    (r page s t u v : ℤ) (hnc : NoCrossingOn model X r page (s,t))
    (hu : s < u) (hu' : u-s ≤ page-2) (hv : s+page ≤ v) (hv' : v ≤ s+r)
    (x : Ambient model X (u,t+(u-s)))
    (y : Ambient model X (v,t+(v-s)-1))
    (hd : HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      (v-u) (u,t+(u-s)) (v,t+(v-s)-1) x y) :
    HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      (v-u) (u,t+(u-s)) (v,t+(v-s)-1) x 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hdeg,xr,yr,hx,hy,hd⟩ := hd
  have hz : yr = 0 := by
    by_contra hz
    apply hnc.2.2
    refine ⟨u-s,s+r-v,by omega,hu',by omega,by omega,?_⟩
    have he : HasNonzeroDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
        (v-u) (u,t+(u-s)) (v,t+(v-s)-1) x y := ⟨hdeg,xr,yr,hx,hy,hd,hz⟩
    have h₁ : s+(u-s)=u := by omega
    have h₂ : s+r-(s+r-v)=v := by omega
    have h₃ : t+r-(s+r-v)-1=t+(v-s)-1 := by omega

private theorem boundary_crossing_correction (X : ClassicalObject)
    (q : ℕ) (r s t u v : ℤ) (hnc : NoCrossingOn model X r (q+1) (s,t))
    (hu : s < u) (hv' : v ≤ s+r)
    (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower u a)
    (hδ : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower v
      (a ≫ absoluteBoundary (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q)) :
    ∃ a0 : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q),
      FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower u a0 ∧
      FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (u+1) (a-a0) ∧
      FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (v+1)
        (a0 ≫ absoluteBoundary (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q) := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  have hq : 0 < q := by have := hnc.1; omega
  by_cases hv : s+(q:ℤ)+1 ≤ v
  swap
  · refine ⟨a,ha,?_,?_⟩
    · simpa only [FiltrationAtLeast,sub_self] using
        (model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule _ (u+1) (t-s,t)).zero_mem
    · apply (absolute_boundary_filtration_iff X q (t-s) t (v+1) a).mpr
      let α := biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t q A (a ≫ XModLambdaN.proj A q)
      have hα := nu_bottom_filtration X (s+q+1) (t+q)
        (homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl α)
      have hα := (regrade_filtration_iff _ _ _ _).mp hα
      exact model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule_antitone _ _ (by omega) hα
  by_cases hui : (q:ℤ) ≤ u-s
  · have haz := finite_high_filtration_zero X q hq (t-s) t u (by omega) a ha
    subst a
    refine ⟨0,?_,?_,?_⟩ <;>
      simp only [FiltrationAtLeast,sub_self,zero_comp] <;> exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  let i : ℕ := (u-s).toNat
  have hiZ : (i:ℤ)=u-s := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hi : 0 < i := by omega
  have hiq : i < q := by omega
  let T := (model.quotients.tower A).triangle hi hiq
  obtain ⟨bS,hbS⟩ := finite_source_division X i q hi hiq (t-s) t u (by omega) a ha
  let e := verticalShiftEquiv (XModLambdaN A (q-i)) i (t-s) t
  let b := e.symm bS
  have hb : e b = bS := e.apply_symm_apply bS
  have hfilb : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower v (b ≫ absoluteBoundary A (q-i)) := by
    have h := (divided_boundary_filtration_iff X i q hi hiq (t-s) t v bS).mp (by
      rw [←Category.assoc,hbS]
      exact hδ)
    rw [←hb,vertical_shift_comp] at h
    exact (vertical_shift_filtration_iff (.shift (1,-((q-i:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu X))
      i (t-s) t v (b ≫ absoluteBoundary A (q-i))).mp h
  have H := divided_boundary_correction X r (q+1) s t u v hnc hu (by omega)
    (by omega) hv' (q-i) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hw : t+(i:ℤ)=t+(u-s) := by omega
  have hm : t-s=(t+(i:ℤ))-u := by omega
  rw [←hw,←hm] at H
  obtain ⟨b0,hb0,hδ0⟩ := H b hfilb
  let a0 := e b0 ≫ T.lambdaMap
  have hdiff : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (u+1) (a-a0) := by
    have hshift := (vertical_shift_filtration_iff (.quotient (q-i) (.nu X))
      i (t-s) t (u+1) (b-b0)).mpr hb0
    have hmap := map_preserves_filtration (model.convergentMap
      (.shift (0,-(i:ℤ)) (.quotient (q-i) (.nu X))) (.quotient q (.nu X)) T.lambdaMap)
      (t-s,t) (u+1) _ hshift
    change FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (u+1) (e (b-b0) ≫ T.lambdaMap) at hmap
    rw [map_sub,Preadditive.sub_comp,hb] at hmap
    change FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (u+1) (bS ≫ T.lambdaMap - a0) at hmap
    rwa [hbS] at hmap
  refine ⟨a0,?_,hdiff,?_⟩
  · have hdiff' := model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule_antitone _ (t-s,t)
      (show u ≤ u+1 by omega) hdiff
    have H := (model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule _ u (t-s,t)).sub_mem ha hdiff'
    simpa only [FiltrationAtLeast,sub_sub_cancel] using H
  · dsimp only [a0]
    rw [Category.assoc]
    apply (divided_boundary_filtration_iff X i q hi hiq (t-s) t (v+1) (e b0)).mpr
    rw [vertical_shift_comp]
    exact (vertical_shift_filtration_iff (.shift (1,-((q-i:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu X))
      i (t-s) t (v+1) (b0 ≫ absoluteBoundary A (q-i))).mpr hδ0

        (model.syntheticTower.filtration B) p q)
      (a : BiHom p.1 p.2 A) (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s a) :
      FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s (e.ambient.hom a) := by
    obtain ⟨ar,har⟩ := filtration_representative_exists model.syntheticTower A p s a ha
    have hh := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (e.level_arrow s) ar

      simpa only [ModuleCat.comp_apply,har] using hh

    have he : e.ambient.inv (e.ambient.hom a) = a :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom e.ambient.hom_inv_id a

  obtain ⟨_,ar,br,hab,hax,hby⟩ := (tower_extension_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp hrel

    have hm : α ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F u p) := ⟨ar,rfl⟩

private theorem shifted_boundary_crossing_correction (X : ClassicalObject)
    (q : ℕ) (e r s t u v : ℤ) (hnc : NoCrossingOn model X r (q+1) (s,t))
    (hu : s < u) (hv : v ≤ s+r)
    (a : BiHom (t-s) (t+e) (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj
      (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower u a)
    (hδ : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower v
      (a ≫ absoluteBoundary ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q)) :
    ∃ a0 : BiHom (t-s) (t+e) (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q),
      FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower u a0 ∧
      FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (u+1) (a-a0) ∧
      FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (v+1)
        (a0 ≫ absoluteBoundary ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj
          (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q) := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,e)
  obtain ⟨eQ,eD,hsquare⟩ := quotient_boundary_shift_exists A e q
  let E := verticalTranslate (XModLambdaN A q) e (t-s) t
  let ED := verticalTranslate ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-(q:ℤ))).obj A) e (t-s) t
  let b := E.symm (a ≫ eQ.hom)
  have hb : E b = a ≫ eQ.hom := E.apply_symm_apply _
  have hfil : ∀ (k : ℤ) (z : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN A q)),
      FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower k (E z ≫ eQ.inv) ↔
        FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower k z := by
    intro k z
    exact (iso_filtration_iff (.shift (0,e) (.quotient q (.nu X)))
      (.quotient q (.shift (0,e) (.nu X))) eQ.symm (t-s) (t+e) k (E z)).trans
        (vertical_translate_filtration_iff (.quotient q (.nu X)) e (t-s) t k z)
  have hboundary : ∀ z : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN A q),
      (E z ≫ eQ.inv) ≫ absoluteBoundary (F.obj A) q =
        ED (z ≫ absoluteBoundary A q) ≫ eD.hom := by
    intro z
    rw [←hsquare]
    simp only [Category.assoc,Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [←Category.assoc,vertical_translate_comp]
  have hboundary_fil : ∀ (k : ℤ) (z : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN A q)),
      FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower k
          ((E z ≫ eQ.inv) ≫ absoluteBoundary (F.obj A) q) ↔
        FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower k (z ≫ absoluteBoundary A q) := by
    intro k z
    rw [hboundary]
    exact (iso_filtration_iff (.shift (0,e) (.shift (1,-(q:ℤ)) (.nu X)))
      (.shift (1,-(q:ℤ)) (.shift (0,e) (.nu X))) eD (t-s) (t+e) k _).trans
        (vertical_translate_filtration_iff (.shift (1,-(q:ℤ)) (.nu X)) e (t-s) t k _)
  have hba : E b ≫ eQ.inv = a := by rw [hb]; simp
  obtain ⟨b0,hb0,hdiff,hδ0⟩ := boundary_crossing_correction X q r s t u v hnc hu hv b
    ((hfil u b).mp (by rwa [hba])) ((hboundary_fil v b).mp (by rwa [hba]))
  refine ⟨E b0 ≫ eQ.inv,(hfil u b0).mpr hb0,?_,(hboundary_fil (v+1) b0).mpr hδ0⟩
  have h := (hfil (u+1) (b-b0)).mpr hdiff
  simpa only [map_sub,Preadditive.sub_comp,hba] using h

    (a : BiHom (t-s) (t+e) (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj
      (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q))

private theorem finite_quotient_lambda_detects (X : ClassicalObject)
    (q d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d < q) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (b : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (q-d)))
    (hb : b ≫ (model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 (q-d) (by omega) =
      firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1) :
    Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))) (s,t,t-d)
      (finiteTargetLabel model X q s t d x) (finiteLambdaClass X q d hd hdq s t b) := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let n := q-d
  have hn : 0 < n := by dsimp [n]; omega
  have ha := first_label_detects_unshifted X n hn s t x b hb
  have hx := first_label_lift_cycles X n hn s t x b hb
  have hsource : (s,t,t)=(s,(t-s)+s,t) := by simp
  have hstem := detects_transport hsource _ _ ha

      ((SyntheticObject.quotient q (.nu X)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) :=
    ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hd hdq).lambdaMap
  have hmap := shifted_map_detects (.quotient n (.nu X)) (.quotient q (.nu X))
    (0,-(d:ℤ)) (t-s,t) s L
    (regradeE2 hsource (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model X n s t 0 x))) b hstem
  have hindex : (s,((t-s,t)+(0,-(d:ℤ))).1+s,((t-s,t)+(0,-(d:ℤ))).2) =
      (s,t,t-d) := by ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hmap := detects_transport hindex _ _ hmap
  obtain ⟨e,he,ar,har,hgar⟩ := hmap
  obtain ⟨e0,he0,_⟩ := ha
  have heStem := representative_transport hsource _ _ he0
  have heMap := shifted_representative_map (.quotient n (.nu X)) (.quotient q (.nu X))
    (0,-(d:ℤ)) (t-s,t) s L _ _ heStem
  have heMap := representative_transport hindex _ _ heMap
  have heq := he.unique heMap
  have heq' : e = KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityFiniteLambda X q d hdq (s,t) t e0 := by
    convert heq using 1
    simp only [KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityFiniteLambda,
      InfinityShiftCoordinates.finiteLambdaMap, show d ≠ 0 by omega, ↓reduceDIte,
      InfinityShiftCoordinates.shift, infinityShift, Iso.trans_hom, ModuleCat.comp_apply,
      eqToIso.hom, KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityShiftData,
      KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityShift_comparison]
    rw [infinity_map_regrade L hindex]
    rfl

      (finiteTargetLabel model X q s t d x)
      (KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityFiniteLambda X q d hdq (s,t) t e0) := by

    ∃ b, b ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X s p ∧
      a-b ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X (s+1) p ∧
      b ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (s+n+1) p := by
  obtain ⟨ar, har⟩ := filtration_representative_exists P X p s a ha
  obtain ⟨br, hbr⟩ := filtration_representative_exists P Y p (s+n) (a≫g) hfa
  let x := (infinityGradedIso cx p s).inv ((P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar)
  let y := (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).inv ((P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br)
  have hx : (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x :=
    ((infinityGradedIso cx p s).toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).symm
  have hy : (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y :=
    ((infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).symm
  have he : TowerExtensionEquation M p s n x y :=
    (tower_extension_iff M p s n x y).mpr ⟨hn, ar, br, by rw [har,hbr], hx,hy⟩
  have he0 : TowerExtensionEquation M p s n x 0 := by
    by_contra hz
    exact hnot x y ((tower_essential_iff_no_zero M p s n x y he).mpr hz)
  obtain ⟨_,ar',br',he',hx',hy'⟩ := (tower_extension_iff M p s n x 0).mp he0
  let b := ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar'
  refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hh : b ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration X).F s p) := ⟨ar',rfl⟩
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hh
  · have hh := (element_grade_equal_iff (P.filtration X) s p ar ar').mp (hx.trans hx'.symm)
    rw [har] at hh
    simpa only [b,SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hh
  · have hh := (element_grade_equal_iff (P.filtration Y) (s+n) p br' 0).mp (by
      rw [hy']; simp only [map_zero])
    have hz : ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow (0 : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)) = 0 := map_zero _
    rw [hz,sub_zero,←he'] at hh
    simpa only [b,SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hh

private theorem tower_image_same_target_of_no_crossing
    (M : ConvergentMap E g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n)
    (hnot : ∀ u v : ℤ, s < u → u ≤ v → v ≤ s+n →
      ∀ x y, ¬TowerEssentialExtension M p u (v-u) x y)
    (a a₀ : BiHom p.1 p.2 X)
    (ha : a-a₀ ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X (s+1) p) :
    a≫g - a₀≫g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (s+n+1) p := by
  let F : ℤ → AddSubgroup (BiHom p.1 p.2 X) := fun s => (P.filtrationSubmodule X s p).toAddSubgroup
  let G : ℤ → AddSubgroup (BiHom p.1 p.2 Y) := fun s => (P.filtrationSubmodule Y s p).toAddSubgroup
  let f : BiHom p.1 p.2 X →+ BiHom p.1 p.2 Y := (syntheticHomotopyMap g p).hom.toAddMonoidHom
  apply image_same_target_of_no_crossing f F G
    (fun i j hij a ha => P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone Y p hij ha)
    (fun u a ha => map_preserves_filtration M p u a ha) s n hn ?_ a a₀ ha
  intro u v hsu huv hvs a ha hfa
  have huv' : u + (v-u) = v := by omega
  change a ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y v p at hfa
  change ∃ b, b ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X u p ∧ a-b ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X (u+1) p ∧ b ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (v+1) p
  have hh := tower_correction_of_nonessential M p u (v-u) (by omega)
    (hnot u v hsu huv hvs) a ha (by simpa only [huv', f, G, syntheticHomotopyMap] using hfa)
  simpa only [huv',f,F,G,syntheticHomotopyMap] using hh

private theorem tower_target_of_any_source_frame
    (M : ConvergentMap E g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n : ℤ)
    (x : ((E.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)
    (he : TowerExtensionEquation M p s n x y)
    (hnot : ∀ u v : ℤ, s < u → u ≤ v → v ≤ s+n →
      ∀ x y, ¬TowerEssentialExtension M p u (v-u) x y)
    (ar : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
    (har : (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x) :
    ∃ br : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ),
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ g = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ∧
      (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y := by
  obtain ⟨hn,ar₀,br₀,he₀,hx₀,hy₀⟩ := (tower_extension_iff M p s n x y).mp he
  have hsource := (element_grade_equal_iff (P.filtration X) s p ar ar₀).mp (har.trans hx₀.symm)
  have hsource' : ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar -
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar₀ ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X (s+1) p := by
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hsource
  have hdiff := tower_image_same_target_of_no_crossing M p s n hn hnot _ _ hsource'
  rw [he₀] at hdiff
  have hb₀ : ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br₀ ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (s+n) p := by
    have hh : ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br₀ ∈
        ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) := ⟨br₀,rfl⟩
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hh
  have hb : ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (s+n) p := by
    have hh := (P.filtrationSubmodule Y (s+n) p).add_mem
      (P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone Y p (show s+n≤s+n+1 by omega) hdiff) hb₀
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hh
  obtain ⟨br,hbr⟩ := filtration_representative_exists P Y p (s+n) _ hb
  refine ⟨br,hbr.symm,?_⟩
  have hdiff' : ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br -
      ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br₀ ∈
        ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n+1) p) := by
    rw [hbr]
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hdiff
  exact ((element_grade_equal_iff (P.filtration Y) (s+n) p br br₀).mpr hdiff').trans hy₀

private theorem tower_no_crossing_of_correction
    (M : ConvergentMap E g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n : ℤ)
    (hcorrect : ∀ u v : ℤ, s < u → u ≤ v → v ≤ s+n →
      ∀ a : BiHom p.1 p.2 X, a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X u p →
        a ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y v p →
        ∃ b, b ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X u p ∧
          a-b ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X (u+1) p ∧
          b ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (v+1) p) :
    TowerNoCrossing M p s n := by
  intro u v hsu huv hvs x y hess
  have he : TowerExtensionEquation M p u (v-u) x y := hess.1
  apply (tower_essential_iff_no_zero M p u (v-u) x y he).mp hess
  obtain ⟨hn,ar,br,heq,hx,hy⟩ := (tower_extension_iff M p u (v-u) x y).mp he
  let a := ((P.filtration X).F u p).arrow ar
  have ha : a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X u p := by
    have hm : a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration X).F u p) := ⟨ar,rfl⟩
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hm
  have hfa : a ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (u+(v-u)) p := by
    have hm : a ≫ g ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration Y).F (u+(v-u)) p) :=
      ⟨br,heq.symm⟩
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hm
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hab,hbg⟩ := hcorrect u (u+(v-u)) hsu (by omega) (by omega) a ha hfa
  obtain ⟨ar',har'⟩ := filtration_representative_exists P X p u b hb
  have hbg' := P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone Y p (show u+(v-u)≤u+(v-u)+1 by omega) hbg
  obtain ⟨br',hbr'⟩ := filtration_representative_exists P Y p (u+(v-u)) (b≫g) hbg'
  apply (tower_extension_iff M p u (v-u) x 0).mpr
  refine ⟨hn,ar',br',by rw [har',hbr'],?_,?_⟩
  · have hdiff : ((P.filtration X).F u p).arrow ar -
        ((P.filtration X).F u p).arrow ar' ∈
        ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration X).F (u+1) p) := by
      rw [har']
      simpa only [a,SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hab
    exact ((element_grade_equal_iff (P.filtration X) u p ar ar').mpr hdiff).symm.trans hx
  · rw [map_zero]
    have hdiff : ((P.filtration Y).F (u+(v-u)) p).arrow br' -
        ((P.filtration Y).F (u+(v-u)) p).arrow
          (0 : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (u+(v-u)) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)) ∈
        ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration Y).F (u+(v-u)+1) p) := by
      rw [hbr',map_zero,sub_zero]
      simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hbg
    have hgrade := (element_grade_equal_iff (P.filtration Y) (u+(v-u)) p br' 0).mpr hdiff
    simpa only [map_zero] using hgrade

private theorem square_frames
    {Z W : Syn}
    {cz : SyntheticTowerConvergence P Z} {cw : SyntheticTowerConvergence P W}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {h : X ⟶ Z} {j : Z ⟶ W} {k : Y ⟶ W}
    (Mf : ConvergentMap E f cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (Mh : ConvergentMap E h cx.toConvergence cz.toConvergence)
    (Mj : ConvergentMap E j cz.toConvergence cw.toConvergence)
    (hcomm : f ≫ k = h ≫ j)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n m l : ℤ)
    (x : ((E.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)
    (z : ((E.obj Z).sequence.ssData (s+m,p.1+(s+m),p.2)).eInfty)
    (w : ((E.obj W).sequence.ssData (s+m+l,p.1+(s+m+l),p.2)).eInfty)
    (hf : TowerExtensionEquation Mf p s n x y)
    (hh : TowerExtensionEquation Mh p s m x z)
    (hj : TowerExtensionEquation Mj p (s+m) l z w)
    (hnc : TowerNoCrossing Mf p s n ∨ TowerNoCrossing Mh p s m)
    (hncj : TowerNoCrossing Mj p (s+m) l) :
    ∃ (ar : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (br : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (cr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (dr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
      (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x ∧
      (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y ∧
      (P.filtration Z).toAssociatedGraded (s+m) p cr = (infinityGradedIso cz p (s+m)).hom z ∧
      (P.filtration W).toAssociatedGraded (s+m+l) p dr = (infinityGradedIso cw p (s+m+l)).hom w ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ f = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ h = ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr ∧
      ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr ≫ j = ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p).arrow dr ∧
      ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ≫ k = ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p).arrow dr := by
  have hthree : ∃ (ar : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (br : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (cr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
      (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x ∧
      (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y ∧
      (P.filtration Z).toAssociatedGraded (s+m) p cr = (infinityGradedIso cz p (s+m)).hom z ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ f = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ h = ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr := by
    rcases hnc with hnf | hnh
    · obtain ⟨_,ar,cr,he,ha,hc⟩ := (tower_extension_iff Mh p s m x z).mp hh
      obtain ⟨br,he',hb⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame Mf p s n x y hf hnf ar ha
      exact ⟨ar,br,cr,ha,hb,hc,he',he⟩
    · obtain ⟨_,ar,br,he,ha,hb⟩ := (tower_extension_iff Mf p s n x y).mp hf
      obtain ⟨cr,he',hc⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame Mh p s m x z hh hnh ar ha
      exact ⟨ar,br,cr,ha,hb,hc,he,he'⟩
  obtain ⟨ar,br,cr,ha,hb,hc,haf,hah⟩ := hthree
  obtain ⟨dr,hcj,hd⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame Mj p (s+m) l z w hj hncj cr hc
  refine ⟨ar,br,cr,dr,ha,hb,hc,hd,haf,hah,hcj,?_⟩
  rw [←haf,Category.assoc,hcomm,←Category.assoc,hah,hcj]

    {f : X ⟶ Y} {h : X ⟶ Z} {j : Z ⟶ W} {k : Y ⟶ W}
    (Mf : ConvergentMap E f cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)

    (Mj : ConvergentMap E j cz.toConvergence cw.toConvergence)

      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ f = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ h = ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr ∧

    (M : ConvergentMap E g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)

    (ar : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
    (ha : (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x) :
    ∃ br : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ),
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ g = ((P.filtration Y).F s p).arrow br ∧
      (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded s p br = (infinityGradedIso cy p s).hom
        ((E.functor.map g).eInftyMap (s,p.1+s,p.2) x) := by
  let br := (M.filteredMap.compat s p).choose ar
  have hab : ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ g = ((P.filtration Y).F s p).arrow br := by
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (M.filteredMap.compat s p).choose_spec ar
    change ((P.filtration Y).F s p).arrow br = M.filteredMap.map p (((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar) at h
    rw [ConvergentMap.filteredMap_map] at h
    exact h.symm
  refine ⟨br,hab,?_⟩
  have h := representative_grade_naturality M p s ar br hab
  rw [ha] at h
  have hx : (infinityGradedIso cx p s).inv ((infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x) = x :=
    (infinityGradedIso cx p s).toLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply x
  rw [hx] at h
  exact ((infinityGradedIso cy p s).toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).symm.trans
    (congrArg (infinityGradedIso cy p s).hom h)

    (hab : a ≫ (model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 k hk =
      b ≫ (model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 k hk)
    (y z : Ambient model X (s+k+1,t+k))
    (hy : boundaryRepresentative X k s t a ≫ XModLambdaN.incl _ 1 =
      firstLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) y ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1)
    (hz : boundaryRepresentative X k s t b ≫ XModLambdaN.incl _ 1 =
      firstLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) z ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1) :
    y-z ∈ boundaries model X k (s+k+1,t+k) := by
  have hfirst : boundaryRepresentative X k s t (a-b) ≫ XModLambdaN.incl _ 1 =
      firstLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) (y-z) ≫
        XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1 := by
    rw [boundaryRepresentative_sub,Preadditive.sub_comp,hy,hz,firstLabel_sub,Preadditive.sub_comp]
  by_cases hk1 : k=1
  · subst k
    have hab' : a=b := by simpa only [(model.quotients.tower _).rho_id,Category.comp_id] using hab
    have hzero : y-z=0 := first_label_zero X (s+(1:ℕ)+1) (t+(1:ℕ)) (y-z) (by
      rw [←hfirst,hab',sub_self]
      simp only [boundaryRepresentative,zero_comp,map_zero,regrade_precomp,comp_zero])
    rw [hzero]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  have hmul := first_restriction_kernel_boundary_lambda_zero X k hk s t (a-b) (by
    rw [Preadditive.sub_comp,hab,sub_self])
  have hb := first_label_lambda_zero_boundary X (s+k+1) (t+k) (k-1) (by omega) (y-z)
    (boundaryRepresentative X k s t (a-b)) hfirst hmul
  simpa only [Nat.cast_sub hk,Nat.cast_one,sub_add_cancel] using hb

    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (y : Ambient model X (s+k+1,t+k))
    (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) k))
    (ha : a ≫ (model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 k hk =
      firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1)
    (hy : boundaryRepresentative X k s t a ≫ XModLambdaN.incl _ 1 =
      firstLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) y ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1) :
    HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      (k+1) (s,t) (s+k+1,t+k) x y := by
  have hx := first_label_lift_cycles X k hk s t x a ha
  have hreach := (isCycle_iff_reaches model X (k+1) (by omega) (s,t) x).mp
    ⟨by omega,by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hx⟩
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hdb⟩ := KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_bockstein X k hk s t x hreach

  have hcong := adjacent_boundary_labels_congruent X k hk s t a a0 (ha.trans ha0.symm) y z hy hz
  exact (differentialAt_of_congruent model X
    (⟨by omega,hdb⟩ : DifferentialAt model X (k+1) (s,t) (s+k+1,t+k) x z)
    ⟨by omega,by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hcong⟩).2

    (α : BiHom (t-s) w (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)))
    (hy : Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s,t,w) (nuWeightLabel model X s t w hw y) α)
    (hz : Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s,t,w) (nuWeightLabel model X s t w hw z) α) :
    y-z ∈ boundaries model X (1+t-w) (s,t) := by
  obtain ⟨ey,hey,a,ha,hga⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨ez,hez,b,hb,hgb⟩ := hz

    ((model.syntheticTower.filtration (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).F s (t-s,w)).arrow).mp
      inferInstance (ha.trans hb.symm)
  have heq : ey = ez := ((model.convergence (.nu X)).identification (s,t,w)).toLinearEquiv.injective (by
    change ((model.convergence (.nu X)).identification (s,t,w)).hom ey =
      ((model.convergence (.nu X)).identification (s,t,w)).hom ez
    rw [hga,hgb,hab])
  obtain ⟨hyp,hycl⟩ := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_nu_labels X s t w hw y ey).mp hey
  obtain ⟨hzp,hzcl⟩ := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_nu_labels X s t w hw z ez).mp hez
  have hequal : subquotientClass (permanentCycles model X (s,t)) (boundaries model X (1+t-w) (s,t)) ⟨y,hyp⟩ =
      subquotientClass (permanentCycles model X (s,t)) (boundaries model X (1+t-w) (s,t)) ⟨z,hzp⟩ := by
    rw [←hycl,←hzcl,heq]
  have hzero : subquotientClass (permanentCycles model X (s,t)) (boundaries model X (1+t-w) (s,t))
      (⟨y,hyp⟩ - ⟨z,hzp⟩) = 0 := by rw [map_sub,hequal,sub_self]
  exact (CrossingLabels.subquotient_zero_iff _ _ _).mp hzero

code:
private theorem boundary_detects_differential (X : ClassicalObject)
    (i k : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hik : i ≤ k) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (y : Ambient model X (s+k+1,t+k))
    (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i))
    (ha : a ≫ (model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 i hi =
      firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1)
    (hy : Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s+k+1,t+k,t+i)
      (nuWeightLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) (t+i) (by omega) y)
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl
        (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t i (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
          (a ≫ XModLambdaN.proj _ i)))) :
    HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      (k+1) (s,t) (s+k+1,t+k) x y := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  have hfil : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+k+1)
      (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t i A (a ≫ XModLambdaN.proj A i)) := by
    have hf := detects_filtration (.nu X) (s+k+1,t+k,t+i) _ _ hy
    have transport (m m' w s : ℤ) (hm : m=m') (a : BiHom m w A) :
        FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s (homotopyRegrade hm rfl a) ↔
          FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s a := by subst m'; rfl
    exact (transport _ _ _ _ _ _).mp hf
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ : ∃ b : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN A k),
      b ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho i k hik = a := by
    rcases hik.eq_or_lt with rfl | hlt
    · exact ⟨a,by rw [(model.quotients.tower A).rho_id,Category.comp_id]⟩
    · exact absolute_boundary_filtration_lift X i k hi hlt s t a hfil
  have hbfirst : b ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho 1 k (by omega) =
      firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) 1 := by
    rw [←(model.quotients.tower A).rho_comp hi hik,←Category.assoc,hb]
    exact ha
  let β := boundaryRepresentative X k s t b
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := nu_first_label_exists X (s+k+1) (t+k) β
  have hp := first_label_lift_permanent X (s+k+1) (t+k) z β hz
  have hdz := adjacent_boundary_differential X k (by omega) s t x z b hbfirst hz
  have hzdet : Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s+k+1,t+k,t+i)
      (nuWeightLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) (t+i) (by omega) z)
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl
        (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t i A (a ≫ XModLambdaN.proj A i))) := by
    rw [←hb]
    by_cases hik' : i=k
    · subst i
      simpa only [β,boundaryRepresentative,A,(model.quotients.tower A).rho_id,Category.comp_id] using
        nu_first_label_detects X (s+k+1) (t+k) z hp β hz
    have hlam := nu_lambda_detects X (k-i) (by omega) (s+k+1) (t+k) z hp β hz
    have hind : (s+k+1,t+k,(t+k)-(k-i:ℕ))=(s+k+1,t+k,t+i) :=
      Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext rfl (by dsimp; omega))
    have hlam := detects_transport hind _ _ hlam
    convert hlam using 1
    · have transport (w w' : ℤ) (hw : w=w') (hw₁ : w≤t+k) (hw₂ : w'≤t+k)
          (h : (s+k+1,t+k,w)=(s+k+1,t+k,w')) :
          regradeE2 h (nuWeightLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) w hw₁ z) =
            nuWeightLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) w' hw₂ z := by subst w'; rfl
      exact (transport _ _ (by omega) _ _ hind).symm
    · rw [absolute_boundary_restriction]
      dsimp only [β,boundaryRepresentative]
      rw [lambda_regrade]
      simp only [regrade_precomp,←Category.assoc,eqToHom_trans]
  have hcong := nu_detected_labels_congruent X (s+k+1) (t+k) (t+i) (by omega) y z _ hy hzdet
  have hboundary : y-z ∈ boundaries model X k (s+k+1,t+k) :=
    boundaries_monotone model X (s+k+1,t+k) (by omega) hcong
  exact (differentialAt_of_congruent model X
    (⟨by omega,hdz⟩ : DifferentialAt model X (k+1) (s,t) (s+k+1,t+k) x z)
    ⟨by omega,by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hboundary⟩).2

    (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i))

private theorem rho_lift_detects (X : ClassicalObject)
    (i j : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hij : i ≤ j) (s t w : ℤ)
    (hw : 0 ≤ t-w ∧ t-w < i) (y : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (a : BiHom (t-s) w (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i))
    (ha : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu X))) (s,t,w)
      ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i).pageMap 2 (s,t,w)
        (nuWeightLabel model X s t w (by omega) y)) a)
    (b : BiHom (t-s) w (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) j))
    (hb : b ≫ (model.quotients.tower _).rho i j hij = a) :
    Detects (model.convergence (.quotient j (.nu X))) (s,t,w)
      ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) j).pageMap 2 (s,t,w)
        (nuWeightLabel model X s t w (by omega) y)) b := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let ρ := (model.quotients.tower A).rho i j hij
  let p : ℤ × ℤ := (t-s,w)
  have haf : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s a :=
    detects_filtration (.quotient i (.nu X)) (s,t,w) _ a ha
  have hbf : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s b := by
    have hb0 := filtration_at_zero model.syntheticTower _ (t-s) w b
    by_cases hs : s ≤ 0
    · exact model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule_antitone _ p hs hb0
    · let L : ℤ → AddSubgroup (BiHom (t-s) w (XModLambdaN A j)) :=
        fun k => (model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule (XModLambdaN A j) k p).toAddSubgroup
      let E : ℤ → AddSubgroup (BiHom (t-s) w (XModLambdaN A i)) :=
        fun k => (model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule (XModLambdaN A i) k p).toAddSubgroup
      have hsN : (0:ℤ) + (s.toNat:ℤ) = s := by omega
      have hρb : (syntheticHomotopyMap ρ p).hom.toAddMonoidHom b ∈ E (0+s.toNat) := by
        change b ≫ ρ ∈ E (0+s.toNat)
        rw [hsN,hb]
        exact haf
      have hh := finite_filtration_reflection (syntheticHomotopyMap ρ p).hom.toAddMonoidHom L E
        (fun k l hkl z hz => model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule_antitone _ p hkl hz)
        0 s.toNat (fun k hk hks z hz hρz =>
          next_filtration_of_infinity_injective
            (model.convergentMap (.quotient j (.nu X)) (.quotient i (.nu X)) ρ)
            p k (rho_infty_injective X i j hi hij k (p.1+k) p.2 (by dsimp [p]; omega))
            z hz hρz) b hb0 hρb
      rw [hsN] at hh
      exact hh
  obtain ⟨e,he,a',ha',hga⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨b',hb'⟩ := filtration_representative_exists model.syntheticTower
    (XModLambdaN A j) p s b hbf
  let e' := ((model.convergence (.quotient j (.nu X))).identification (s,t,w)).inv
    ((model.syntheticTower.filtration (XModLambdaN A j)).toAssociatedGraded s p b')
  have hg := grade_natural (.quotient j (.nu X)) (.quotient i (.nu X)) ρ (s,t,w) b' a'
    (by exact (congrArg (fun z => z ≫ ρ) hb').trans (hb.trans ha'.symm))
  have heq : (model.family.map ρ).eInftyMap (s,t,w) e' = e := by
    have hiGrade : ((model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu X))).identification (s,t,w)).inv
        ((model.syntheticTower.filtration (XModLambdaN A i)).toAssociatedGraded s p a') = e := by
      exact (congrArg ((model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu X))).identification (s,t,w)).inv hga.symm).trans
        (((model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu X))).identification (s,t,w)).toLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply e)
    exact hg.symm.trans hiGrade
  obtain ⟨hy,hycl⟩ := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_finite_labels X i hi s t w hw y e).mp he
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := CrossingLabels.subquotient_rep
    (cycles model X (j-t+w) (s,t)) (boundaries model X (1+t-w) (s,t))
    (KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityFiniteWindow X j (by omega) (s,t) w (by constructor <;> omega) e')
  have hr := KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_rho_finite X i j hi hij (s,t) w hw e'
  rw [heq,hycl,←hz] at hr
  have hzold : z.val ∈ cycles model X (i-t+w) (s,t) :=
    cycles_antitone model X (s,t) (by omega : (i:ℤ)-t+w ≤ (j:ℤ)-t+w) z.property
  have hclass : subquotientClass (cycles model X (i-t+w) (s,t))
      (boundaries model X (1+t-w) (s,t)) ⟨y,hy⟩ =
    subquotientClass (cycles model X (i-t+w) (s,t))
      (boundaries model X (1+t-w) (s,t)) ⟨z.val,hzold⟩ := hr
  have hzero : subquotientClass (cycles model X (i-t+w) (s,t))
      (boundaries model X (1+t-w) (s,t)) (⟨y,hy⟩-⟨z.val,hzold⟩) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub,hclass,sub_self]
  have hboundary : y-z.val ∈ boundaries model X (1+t-w) (s,t) :=
    (CrossingLabels.subquotient_zero_iff _ _ _).mp hzero
  have hdiff := boundaries_le_cycles model X (s,t) (1+t-w) (j-t+w) hboundary
  have hylater : y ∈ cycles model X (j-t+w) (s,t) := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using
      (cycles model X (j-t+w) (s,t)).add_mem hdiff z.property
  have hyz : subquotientClass (cycles model X (j-t+w) (s,t))
      (boundaries model X (1+t-w) (s,t)) ⟨y,hylater⟩ =
      subquotientClass (cycles model X (j-t+w) (s,t))
        (boundaries model X (1+t-w) (s,t)) z := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    rw [←map_sub]
    exact (CrossingLabels.subquotient_zero_iff _ _ _).mpr hboundary
  have he' : HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,t,w)
      ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) j).pageMap 2 (s,t,w)
        (nuWeightLabel model X s t w (by omega) y)) e' := by
    apply (KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_finite_labels X j (by omega) s t w
      (by constructor <;> omega) y e').mpr
    exact ⟨hylater,hz.symm.trans hyz.symm⟩
  refine ⟨e',he',b',hb',?_⟩
  exact ((model.convergence (.quotient j (.nu X))).identification (s,t,w)).toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _

    (i j : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hij : i ≤ j) (s t w : ℤ)
    (hw : 0 ≤ t-w ∧ t-w < i) (y : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (a : BiHom (t-s) w (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i))

    (b : BiHom (t-s) w (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) j))

private theorem finite_extension_target_weight_label (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (q : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ) (hn : (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ n)
    (y : Ambient model Y (s+n,t+n)) :
    regradeE2 (by ext <;> dsimp <;> omega)
      (finiteTargetForExtension model X Y f q n s t hn y) =

private theorem additive_automorphism_f2_identity {A : Type*} [AddGroup A]
    (e : A ≃+ ZMod 2) (f : A ≃+ A) (x : A) : f x=x := by
  let g : ZMod 2 ≃+ ZMod 2 := e.symm.trans (f.trans e)
  have hcases : ∀ z : ZMod 2, z=0 ∨ z=1 := by decide
  have h1 : g 1=1 := by
    rcases hcases (g 1) with h | h
    · have hz : (1:ZMod 2)=0 := g.injective (h.trans (map_zero g).symm)
      exact False.elim (by norm_num at hz)
    · exact h
  have hh : ∀ z : ZMod 2, g z=z := by
    intro z
    rcases hcases z with rfl | rfl
    · exact map_zero g
    · exact h1
  apply e.injective
  simpa only [g,AddEquiv.trans_apply,AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using hh (e x)

private theorem bigraded_sphere_automorphism_first_quotient (m w : ℤ)
    (u : Smn (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) m w ≅ Smn m w) :
    u.hom ≫ XModLambdaN.incl (Smn m w) 1 = XModLambdaN.incl (Smn m w) 1 := by
  let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (m,w)
  let ff := SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (m,w)
  let u0 : (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) ≅ S_0_0 := ff.preimageIso u
  have hu : F.map u0.hom = u.hom := ff.map_preimage _
  have h0 := sphere_automorphism_first_quotient u0 (XModLambdaN.incl S_0_0 1)
  letI := model.exactness.shiftCommShift (m,w)
  letI := model.exactness.shiftExact (m,w)
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,_⟩ := KIP126.ProofTools.Internal.quotient_shift_exists
    model.quotients.coherence (m,w) 1 (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum)
  apply (cancel_mono Q.hom).mp
  dsimp only [Smn] at u ⊢
  rw [Category.assoc,hQ,←hu,←F.map_comp,h0]

private theorem detects_of_shift (A : SyntheticObject) (δ p : ℤ × ℤ) (s : ℤ)
    (x : (model.family.obj (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).E₂ (s,p.1+s,p.2))
    (a : BiHom p.1 p.2 (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
    (ha : Detects (model.convergence (.shift δ A)) (s,(p+δ).1+s,(p+δ).2)
      (((essShift δ).page A 2 (by decide) p s).hom x)
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl (shiftHomotopyClass δ p a))) :
    Detects (model.convergence A) (s,p.1+s,p.2) x
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl a) := by
  obtain ⟨eS,heS,b,hb,hgb⟩ := frame_of_source_detects
    (model.convergence (.shift δ A)) (p+δ) s _ (shiftHomotopyClass δ p a) ha
  let S := (essShift δ).filtered A p
  let I := towerInfinityIso (model.convergence A) (model.convergence (.shift δ A)) S s
  let e := I.inv eS
  let ar := (S.level s).inv b
  have har : ((model.syntheticTower.filtration (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).F s p).arrow ar = a := by
    apply S.ambient.toLinearEquiv.injective
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (S.level_arrow s) ar
    have hlevel : (S.level s).hom ar=b := (S.level s).toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply b
    simp only [ModuleCat.comp_apply] at h
    rw [hlevel] at h
    exact h.symm.trans (hb.trans ((essShift δ).ambient_eq A p a).symm)
  have hgar : (model.syntheticTower.filtration (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).toAssociatedGraded s p ar =
      (infinityGradedIso (model.convergence A) p s).hom e := by
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (S.projection_inv_comm s) b
    simp only [ModuleCat.comp_apply] at h
    rw [hgb] at h
    rw [←h]
    change (S.gradedIso s).inv
        ((towerGradedIso (model.convergence (.shift δ A)) (p+δ) s).hom eS) =
      (towerGradedIso (model.convergence A) p s).hom
        ((towerInfinityIso (model.convergence A) (model.convergence (.shift δ A)) S s).inv eS)
    simp only [towerInfinityIso,Iso.trans_inv,Iso.symm_inv,←ModuleCat.comp_apply,
      Category.assoc,Iso.inv_hom_id,Category.comp_id]
  have he : HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,p.1+s,p.2) x e := by
    apply ((essShift δ).representative_iff A 2 (by decide) p s x e).mpr
    have hI : I.hom e=eS := I.toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply eS
    change HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 _ _ (I.hom e)
    rw [hI]
    exact heS
  have hdet := source_frame_detects (model.convergence A) p s e x he ar hgar
  rw [har] at hdet
  exact hdet

private theorem gl_bottom_extension (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)

    (W : InfiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f l (s+r) (t+r-1) xInfinity yInfinity) :
    TowerExtensionEquation
      (model.convergentMap
        (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
        (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu Y))
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ))).map (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+r) l
      (glBottomSource X Y f page r l s t hpage hpr W)
      (glBottomTarget X Y f page r l s t hpage hpr W) := by
  obtain ⟨hbottom,_,_⟩ := infinite_extension_lambda_boundary_shift X Y f
    (r-page).toNat (page-1) l (s+r) (t+r-1) xInfinity yInfinity W
  let A := SyntheticObject.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)
  let B := SyntheticObject.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu Y)
  let g := (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ))).map (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map
  have transport (p p' : ℤ×ℤ) (hp : p=p')
      (x : ((model.family.obj (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
        (s+r,p.1+(s+r),p.2)).eInfty)
      (y : ((model.family.obj (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
        (s+r+l,p.1+(s+r+l),p.2)).eInfty)
      (he : TowerExtensionEquation (model.convergentMap A B g) p (s+r) l x y) :
      TowerExtensionEquation (model.convergentMap A B g) p' (s+r) l
        ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun p : ℤ×ℤ => ((model.family.obj (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
          (s+r,p.1+(s+r),p.2)).eInfty) hp)) x)
        ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun p : ℤ×ℤ => ((model.family.obj (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData

          (sf+n,((tf+n)-(sf+n))+(sf+n),tf+n+eg)
          (finiteSourceForExtension model T.Y T.Z T.g q (sf+n) (tf+n) y)
          (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl ag) →
        ag ≫ finiteExtensionMap model T.Y T.Z T.g q = boundary aZ →
        (∃ c : BiHom (tf-sf) tf (XModLambdaN (nuZero model T.X) Q),
          c ≫ (model.quotients.tower (nuZero model T.X)).rho 1 Q hQ = firstLabel model T.X sf tf x) ∧
        ∃ y' : Ambient model T.Y ((sf+n),(tf+n)),
          y'-y ∈ boundaries model T.Y (n+m+l-(m-eg)) (sf+n,tf+n) ∧
          ∃ (af : BiHom (tf-sf) (tf+ef)
                ((SyntheticObject.quotient Q (extensionSourceObject model T.X T.Y T.f)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
            (bf : BiHom (tf-sf) (tf+ef)
                (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (T.Y.obj model.auxiliary)) Q)),
            Detects (model.convergence (.quotient Q (extensionSourceObject model T.X T.Y T.f)))
              (sf,(tf-sf)+sf,tf+ef) (finiteSourceForExtension model T.X T.Y T.f Q sf tf x)
              (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl af) ∧
            Detects (model.convergence (.quotient Q (.nu T.Y)))
              (sf+n,(tf-sf)+(sf+n),tf+ef) (finiteTargetForExtension model T.X T.Y T.f Q n sf tf hnf y')
              (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl bf) ∧
            af ≫ finiteExtensionMap model T.X T.Y T.f Q = bf := by
    intro ag hag hstrict
    let Wh : FiniteExtensionWitness model T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h
        (i+1) l s t xBar suspendedX := by
      convert (Classical.choice hh) using 1
      dsimp only [eg] at hiZ
      omega
    obtain ⟨aZSelected,haZSelected,hδSelected,hSelectedH⟩ :=
      select_finite_extension_source T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h
        (i+1) q hq l s t xBar suspendedX Wh aZ haZ
    have hSelectedBoundary : boundary aZSelected = boundary aZ := by
      dsimp only [boundary]
      rw [hδSelected]
    have hSelectedBoundaryStable
        (hnc : NoCrossingOn model T.Z (n+m+l) (n+m+l-(m-eg)) (s,t))
        (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i))
        (ha : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.Z))) (s,t,t)
          (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.Z i s t 0 xBar)) a) :
        boundary a = boundary aZSelected :=
      (hboundaryStable hnc a ha).trans hSelectedBoundary.symm
    have hstrictSelected : ag ≫ finiteExtensionMap model T.Y T.Z T.g q =
        boundary aZSelected := hstrict.trans hSelectedBoundary.symm
    let aZ := aZSelected
    have haZ := haZSelected
    have hstrict := hstrictSelected
    have hboundaryStable := hSelectedBoundaryStable
    have hSourceReady :
        (FiniteNoCrossing model T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h (i+1) l s t ∧ eh+1<l) ∨
        FiniteExtensionAtSource T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h (i+1) l s t
          xBar suspendedX Wh aZ := by
      rcases hcross with hhcross | hδcross
      · have hncFinite : FiniteNoCrossing model T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h (i+1) l s t := by
          convert hhcross using 1
          dsimp only [eg] at hiZ
          omega
        by_cases hlShort : l≤eh+1
        · right
          exact KIP126.ProofTools.Internal.Leibniz.finite_extension_at_source_short
            T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h (i+1) l s t xBar suspendedX Wh
            (by exact hlShort) hncFinite aZ haZ
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hncFinite,by omega⟩
      · right
        apply hSelectedH
        convert hδcross using 1 <;> dsimp only [eg] at hiZ hqZ <;> omega
    have hSourceShort (hlShort : l≤eh+1) :
        FiniteExtensionAtSource T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h (i+1) l s t
          xBar suspendedX Wh aZ := by
      rcases hSourceReady with ⟨_,hlong⟩ | hsource
      · omega
      · exact hsource
    have hstrictSameSource
        (hnc : NoCrossingOn model T.Z (n+m+l) (n+m+l-(m-eg)) (s,t))
        (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i))
        (ha : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.Z))) (s,t,t)
          (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.Z i s t 0 xBar)) a) :
        ag ≫ finiteExtensionMap model T.Y T.Z T.g q = boundary a := by
      rw [hboundaryStable hnc a ha]
      exact hstrict
    have hagNeg := finite_source_detects_neg T.Y T.Z T.g q (sf+n) (tf+n) y _ hag
    let G := (model.normalizedMap T.Y T.Z T.g).map
    obtain ⟨ug,hugIncl,hugProj,lamg,vg,wg,hlamgIncl,hlamgProj,hvgIncl,hvgProj,hwgIncl,hgTriangle⟩ :=
      quotient_octahedron_fill G q
    have hugFixed := normalized_quotient_maps_equal_on_spheres T.Y T.Z
      (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g)
      (normalizedExponent_le_one model.classicalTower T.g) q hq ug (XModLambdaN.map G q)
      (hugIncl.trans (XModLambdaN.incl_naturality G q))
    have hugStrict : ag ≫ ug = boundary aZ := (hugFixed _ _ ag).trans hstrict
    let Cg := HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib G
    let jg : Zν ⟶ Cg := HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι G
    let eCg := normalized_g_cofiber_iso T he htriangle
    let eCgShift := normalized_g_shifted_cofiber_iso T he htriangle
    have heCgIncl := normalized_g_shifted_cofiber_inclusion T he htriangle
    have heCgProj := normalized_g_shifted_cofiber_boundary T he htriangle
    have hGj : G ≫ jg = 0 :=
      comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished G)
    let ag' : BiHom (t-s-1) (t+i)
        (XModLambdaN ((extensionSourceObject model T.Y T.Z T.g).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) q) :=
      homotopyRegrade (by dsimp [tf,sf]; omega) (by dsimp [tf]; omega) ag
    have hstrict' : ag' ≫ XModLambdaN.map G q =
        biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t i (XModLambdaN Zν q)
          (by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using
            aZ ≫ ((model.quotients.tower Zν).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)).delta) := by
      have regrade_comp {m m' w w' : ℤ} {A B : SyntheticSpectrum}
          (hm : m=m') (hw : w=w') (a : BiHom m w A) (f : A ⟶ B) :
          homotopyRegrade hm hw (a ≫ f) = homotopyRegrade hm hw a ≫ f := by
        subst m'; subst w'; rfl
      have regrade_back {m m' w w' : ℤ} {A : SyntheticSpectrum}
          (hm : m=m') (hw : w=w') (hm' : m'=m) (hw' : w'=w)
          (a : BiHom m w A) : homotopyRegrade hm' hw' (homotopyRegrade hm hw a) = a := by
        subst m'; subst w'; rfl
      have H := congrArg (homotopyRegrade
        (show (tf+n)-(sf+n)=t-s-1 by dsimp [tf,sf]; omega)
        (show tf+n+eg=t+i by dsimp [tf]; omega)) hstrict
      dsimp only [boundary] at H
      rw [regrade_comp,regrade_back] at H
      exact H
    let hg : Cg ⟶
        ((extensionSourceObject model T.Y T.Z T.g).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧ :=
      HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ G
    have hjghg : jg ≫ hg = 0 :=
      comp_distTriang_mor_zero₂₃ _ (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished G)
    obtain ⟨pGeometry,vGeometry,hpGeometry,hvGeometry,hvSecond⟩ :=
      finite_quotient_octahedral_pullback_desuspended G i q hi hq (t-s) t aZ ag' hstrict'
    obtain ⟨φGeometry,KGeometry,hφGeometry,hKGeometry,hρGeometry⟩ :=
      normalized_octahedral_comparison T.X T.Y Zν Cg _ ef eg
        (by dsimp [ef]; omega) eCg G jg hg hGj hjghg i q hi hq pGeometry hpGeometry
    let cGeometry : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Cg (i+q)) := vGeometry ≫ φGeometry
    have hcGeometry : cGeometry ≫ (model.quotients.tower Cg).rho i (i+q) (by omega) =
        aZ ≫ XModLambdaN.map jg i := by
      change (vGeometry ≫ φGeometry) ≫ _ = _
      rw [Category.assoc,hρGeometry,←Category.assoc,hvGeometry]
    let compositeGeometry :=
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(i:ℤ))).map
        (XModLambdaN.map G (i+q-i)) ≫
          ((model.quotients.tower Zν).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)).lambdaMap
    have hsecondGeometry : cGeometry ≫ XModLambdaN.map hg (i+q) =
        (vGeometry ≫ HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ compositeGeometry) ≫ KGeometry := by
      dsimp only [cGeometry,compositeGeometry]
      rw [Category.assoc,←hKGeometry,←Category.assoc]
    obtain ⟨dGeometry,tGeometry,hEdgeGeometry⟩ :=
      quotient_unquotiented_boundary_defect G i q hi hq
        φGeometry KGeometry hφGeometry hKGeometry
    obtain ⟨bGeometry,hbGeometry⟩ := quotient_lift_image_division jg hg hjghg
      i (i+q) hi (by omega) aZ cGeometry hcGeometry
    let cShift : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,ef+eg)).obj
          (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary))) (i+q)) :=
      cGeometry ≫ XModLambdaN.map eCg.hom (i+q)
    have hcShift : cShift ≫ (model.quotients.tower
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,ef+eg)).obj
          (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary)))).rho i (i+q) (by omega) =
        aZ ≫ XModLambdaN.map (jg ≫ eCg.hom) i := by
      dsimp only [cShift]
      rw [Category.assoc, ← (model.quotients.natural eCg.hom).rho_naturality (by omega),
        ← Category.assoc, hcGeometry, Category.assoc,
        ← model.quotients.functoriality.map_comp]
    letI := model.exactness.shiftCommShift (1,ef+eg)
    letI := model.exactness.shiftExact (1,ef+eg)
    obtain ⟨eQi,heQi,_⟩ := quotient_shift_exists model.quotients.coherence (1,ef+eg) i
      (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary))
    obtain ⟨eQr,heQr,_⟩ := quotient_shift_exists model.quotients.coherence (1,ef+eg) (i+q)
      (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary))
    let cNu : BiHom (t-s-1) (t-(ef+eg))
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+q)) :=
      quotientShiftDesuspend T.X (1,ef+eg) (i+q) eQr (t-s) t cShift
    let aNu : BiHom (t-s-1) (t-(ef+eg))
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary)) i) :=
      quotientShiftDesuspend T.X (1,ef+eg) i eQi (t-s) t
        (aZ ≫ XModLambdaN.map (jg ≫ eCg.hom) i)
    have hcNu : cNu ≫ (model.quotients.tower
        (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary))).rho i (i+q) (by omega) = aNu :=
      quotient_shift_desuspend_restriction T.X (1,ef+eg) i (i+q) hi (by omega)
        eQi eQr heQi heQr (t-s) t _ cShift hcShift
    let k : ℕ := (l-eh).toNat
    have hkZ : (k:ℤ)=l-eh := by
      have := Wh.length_lower
      dsimp only [k,eh]
      exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    have hki : k < i := by
      have hh := Wh.length_upper
      dsimp only [eh] at hkZ
      omega
    have hweight : t-(ef+eg)=tf-k := by
      have hsum : ef+eg+eh=1 := he
      dsimp only [tf]
      omega
    let aNuNative : BiHom (tf-sf) (tf-k)
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary)) i) :=
      homotopyRegrade (by dsimp [tf,sf]; omega) hweight aNu
    let cNuNative : BiHom (tf-sf) (tf-k)
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+q)) :=
      homotopyRegrade (by dsimp [tf,sf]; omega) hweight cNu
    have hcNuNative : cNuNative ≫ (model.quotients.tower
        (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary))).rho i (i+q) (by omega) = aNuNative := by
      dsimp only [cNuNative,aNuNative]
      rw [←regrade_comp,hcNu]
    have hTargetReady :
        FiniteNoCrossing model T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h (i+1) l s t ∨
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.X))) (sf,tf,tf-k)
          (finiteTargetLabel model T.X i sf tf k x) aNuNative := by
      rcases hSourceReady with ⟨hnc,_⟩ | hsource
      · exact Or.inl hnc
      · right
        exact normalized_h_target_detects_native T he htriangle i l s t xBar x suspendedX
          Wh hsusp aZ hsource eQi heQi
    have hTargetShort (hlShort : l≤eh+1) :
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.X))) (sf,tf,tf-k)
          (finiteTargetLabel model T.X i sf tf k x) aNuNative :=
      normalized_h_target_detects_native T he htriangle i l s t xBar x suspendedX
        Wh hsusp aZ (hSourceShort hlShort) eQi heQi
    have hActualFSource
        (htarget : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.X))) (sf,tf,tf-k)
          (finiteTargetLabel model T.X i sf tf k x) aNuNative) :=
      normalized_f_raw_source_unshift_detects T he htriangle (i+q) k (by omega)
        sf tf (t-s) t x (by dsimp [tf,sf]; omega) hweight eQr heQr cGeometry
        (finite_target_rho_detects T.X i (i+q) k hki (by omega)
          sf tf x aNuNative htarget cNuNative hcNuNative)
    have hActualFSourceReady := hTargetReady.imp (fun h => h) hActualFSource
    have hDividedSourceReady :
        FiniteNoCrossing model T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h (i+1) l s t ∨
        ∃ b : BiHom (tf-sf) tf
            (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+q-k)),
          b ≫ (model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 (i+q-k) (by omega) =
            firstLabel model T.X sf tf x ≫
              XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1 ∧
          Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (i+q-k) (.nu T.X))) (sf,tf,tf)
            (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.X (i+q-k) sf tf 0 x)) b ∧
          KIP126.ProofTools.Internal.Leibniz.finiteLambdaDivisionClass T.X (i+q) k
            (by omega) sf tf b = cNuNative := by
      rcases hTargetReady with hnc | htarget
      · exact Or.inl hnc
      · right
        have hcDetected := finite_target_rho_detects T.X i (i+q) k hki (by omega)
          sf tf x aNuNative htarget cNuNative hcNuNative
        exact finite_target_source_division_exact T.X (i+q) k (by omega)
          sf tf x cNuNative hcDetected
    have hSurvivalReady :
        FiniteNoCrossing model T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h (i+1) l s t ∨
        (∃ c : BiHom (tf-sf) tf (XModLambdaN (nuZero model T.X) Q),
          c ≫ (model.quotients.tower (nuZero model T.X)).rho 1 Q hQ =
            firstLabel model T.X sf tf x) := by
      rcases hDividedSourceReady with hnc | hdivided
      · exact Or.inl hnc
      · right
        have hQk : i+q-k=Q := by omega
        obtain ⟨b,hb,_,_⟩ := hdivided
        let f : model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary) ⟶ nuZero model T.X :=
          SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.inv.app _
        have hlift : ∃ c : BiHom (tf-sf) tf (XModLambdaN (nuZero model T.X) (i+q-k)),
            c ≫ (model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 (i+q-k) (by omega) =
              firstLabel model T.X sf tf x := by
          refine ⟨b≫XModLambdaN.map f (i+q-k),?_⟩
          rw [Category.assoc,←(model.quotients.natural f).rho_naturality (by omega),
            ←Category.assoc,hb]
          simp only [f,Category.assoc,←model.quotients.functoriality.map_comp,
            Iso.hom_inv_id_app,model.quotients.functoriality.map_id,Category.comp_id]
        have transport (q₁ q₂ : ℕ) (h : q₁=q₂) (hq₁ : 0<q₁) (hq₂ : 0<q₂)
            (hh : ∃ c : BiHom (tf-sf) tf (XModLambdaN (nuZero model T.X) q₁),
              c ≫ (model.quotients.tower (nuZero model T.X)).rho 1 q₁ hq₁ =
                firstLabel model T.X sf tf x) :
            ∃ c : BiHom (tf-sf) tf (XModLambdaN (nuZero model T.X) q₂),
              c ≫ (model.quotients.tower (nuZero model T.X)).rho 1 q₂ hq₂ =
                firstLabel model T.X sf tf x := by
          subst q₂
          exact hh
        exact transport _ _ hQk (by omega) hQ hlift
    -- MH2, MainPaper lines 1875–1917: vGeometry is constructed from the
    -- prescribed pair aZ/ag'; hvGeometry and hvSecond fix both of its images.
    -- The same cGeometry=vGeometry≫φGeometry lies in the fixed λ^(i+q)
    -- quotient. Finite no-return proves its strict ρ equation hcGeometry.
    -- hsecondGeometry factors its second image through the fixed KGeometry
    -- evaluated on the prescribed ag' (via hvSecond). It remains to identify
    -- this K evaluation with the required signed λ_i image of ag'.
    -- hEdgeGeometry now records the actual unquotiented edge defect for
    -- these same φGeometry/KGeometry, retaining both dGeometry and tGeometry.
    -- Passing that defect to the prescribed finite source still requires
    -- the filtered correction; its two residual terms are not set to zero.
    -- hbGeometry independently retains membership in the actual λ_i image;
    -- its arbitrary preimage bGeometry is not identified with ag'.
    -- cShift transports that same lift to the specified shifted νX;
    -- heCgIncl/heCgProj retain the normalized h map and rotated −f map.
    -- cNu is that same lift in the unshifted νX quotient; hcNu preserves
    -- its restriction after the chosen quotient/shift comparison.
    -- ug and its complementary lamg filling are selected by three actual
    -- octahedra. hgTriangle retains the signed triangle on Cg, cone(ug)
    -- and cone(F_q G)[1], with hlamgIncl/hlamgProj and hvgIncl/hvgProj/hwgIncl
    -- recording its actual comparison maps. hugStrict identifies the
    -- action of ug on ag with the fixed quotient map, including exponent one.
    -- aZ is selected from the actual h witness in the differential
    -- no-crossing branch, with the same unshifted label and δ image.
    -- hSourceReady retains either the finite h no-crossing hypothesis or
    -- that actual h-source/target detection and its strict inverse transport.
    -- The source comparison uses the registered positive-shift compatibility.
    -- hTargetReady identifies the actual aNu with the prescribed weighted
    -- x label in the differential no-crossing or short h branch (k<=1).
    -- hTargetShort gives this detection directly under the short length
    -- bound, with the excluded branch retaining its strict k>=2 range.
    -- hSurvivalReady then
    -- supplies the required Q_Q firstLabel lift via the actual cNu restriction.
    -- hDividedSourceReady also divides that same cNuNative by lambda^k
    -- while preserving its strict lambda image and the exact original x
    -- first label, using a torsion lift of the source boundary ambiguity.
    -- The target filtration of its actual f image remains to be proved.
    -- hActualFSourceReady transports the same original cGeometry to the
    -- actual signed normalized f source, retaining the native lambda^k x
    -- detection after inverse ef transport, with internally chosen quotient
    -- comparisons and no equality between independent commShift choices.
    -- The remaining common-lift comparison must impose the second May
    -- equation, finish the finite h no-crossing branch, and
    -- retain the finite B_(n+m+l-(m-e(g))) ambiguity after λ division.
    -- The proved label sign comparison applies only after detection;
    -- no exponent-two assertion is made for synthetic homotopy groups.
    sorry
  obtain ⟨ag,hag,hagDetect⟩ := finite_top_extension_preimage
    T.Y T.Z T.g pg m (sf+n) (tf+n) y yBar Wg (by dsimp [pg,eg]; omega)
    (boundary aZ) hdelta
  obtain ⟨⟨c,hc⟩,y',hcong,af,bf,haf,hbf,hfstrict⟩ := may_boundary_lift ag hagDetect hag
  have hxLater : IsCycle model T.X (n+m+eh) (sf,tf) x := by
    refine ⟨by dsimp [ef,eg,eh] at *; omega,?_⟩
    have hcR := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_finite_lift T.X Q hQ sf tf x).mpr ⟨c,hc⟩
    have hc' := ((isCycle_iff_reaches model T.X (Q+1) (by omega) (sf,tf) x).mpr hcR).2
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right,hQZ] using hc'
  have hyLater : IsCycle model T.Y
      (((Q+1:ℕ):ℤ)-1-n+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f) (sf+n,tf+n) y' := by
    have hlevel : ((Q+1:ℕ):ℤ)-1-n+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f = m-eg+1 := by
      simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,hQZ]
      dsimp [ef,eg,eh] at *
      omega
    rw [hlevel]
    refine ⟨by dsimp [eg]; omega,?_⟩
    have hby := boundaries_le_cycles model T.Y (sf+n,tf+n)
      (n+m+l-(m-eg)) (m-eg+1) hcong
    have hadd := (cycles model T.Y (m-eg+1) (sf+n,tf+n)).add_mem hby hy.2
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hadd
  obtain ⟨xf,yf,hxf,hyf,heq⟩ := extension_equation_of_detected_pair
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient Q (extensionSourceObject model T.X T.Y T.f))
      (.quotient Q (.nu T.Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model T.X T.Y T.f Q))
    (tf-sf,tf+ef) sf n hn0 _ _ af bf haf hbf hfstrict
  refine ⟨hxLater,y',?_,⟨by dsimp [ef,eg,eh] at *; omega,hcong⟩⟩
  have hpage : (n+m+1+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.h).toNat = Q+1 := by
    dsimp [Q,eh,ef,eg] at *
    omega
  rw [hpage]
  refine ⟨{
    page_ge_two := by omega
    length_lower := hnf
    length_upper := by simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,hQZ]; dsimp [ef,eg,eh] at *; omega
    source_cycle := (isCycle_iff_reaches model T.X ((Q+1:ℕ):ℤ) (by omega) (sf,tf) x).mp
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,add_sub_cancel_right,hQZ] using hxLater)
    target_cycle := (isCycle_iff_reaches model T.Y
      (((Q+1:ℕ):ℤ)-n+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f)
      (by have hp := hyLater.1; omega) (sf+n,tf+n) y').mp
      (by
        rw [show ((Q+1:ℕ):ℤ)-n+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f-1 =
          ((Q+1:ℕ):ℤ)-1-n+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f by omega]
        exact hyLater)
    source := xf
    target := yf
    source_rep := hxf
    target_rep := hyf
    equation := heq }⟩
