private theorem adjacent_bockstein_coordinates
    (X : ClassicalObject)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (s t : ℤ) (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (hx : x ∈ KIP126.Literature.cycles model X i (s,t)) :
    ∃ (aZero : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) i))
      (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i)),
      a = aZero ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) i ∧
      a ≫ (model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).rho 1 i hi =
        firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1 ∧
      KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.HasDifferential
        (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+1)
        (s,t) (s+i+1,t+i) x (bocksteinLabel model X i hi s t aZero) ∧
      (homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl
          (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (i:ℤ)
            (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+1-i))
            (a ≫ ((model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).triangle hi
              (Nat.lt_succ_self i)).delta) ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg (fun n => XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) n)
              (show i+1-i=1 by omega)))) =
        firstLabel model X (s+i+1) (t+i) (bocksteinLabel model X i hi s t aZero) ≫
          XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1 := by
  have bockstein_arrow_eq_biSuspensionIso_inv
      (X : ClassicalObject) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
      bocksteinArrow model X q hq =
        ((model.quotients.tower (nuZero model X)).triangle hq (Nat.lt_succ_self q)).delta ≫
          (biSuspensionIso (q : ℤ) (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) (q+1-q))).inv ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg (fun n => (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-(q:ℤ))).obj
              (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) n)) (show q+1-q=1 by omega)) := by
    have hcast {A A' B : Syn} (h : A=A') (e : A ≅ B)
        (he : (A ≅ B) = (A' ≅ B)) :
        (he.mp e).inv = e.inv ≫ eqToHom h := by
      subst A'
      change e.inv = e.inv ≫ 𝟙 A
      exact (Category.comp_id _).symm
    simp only [bocksteinArrow, biSuspensionIso]
    rw [hcast (congrArg (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => (SyntheticCategory.biShift p).obj
      (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) (q+1-q))) (by ext <;> simp))]
    simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.app_inv, Iso.symm_inv, Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans]


  have biSuspensionHomEquiv_eq_inverse_susp (n w q : ℤ) (Q : Syn)
      (a : BiHom n w (((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-q)).obj Q)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)) :
      biSuspensionHomEquiv n w q Q a =
        (susp_invariance (n-1) (w+q) 1 (-q) Q).symm
          (homotopyRegrade (by omega) (by omega) (a ≫ (biSuspensionIso q Q).inv)) := by
    have hc (n' w' : ℤ) (hn : n' = n) (hw : w' = w)
        (e : BiHom (n-1) (w+q) Q ≃
          BiHom n' w' (((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-q)).obj Q)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧))
        (he : (BiHom (n-1) (w+q) Q ≃
            BiHom n' w' (((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-q)).obj Q)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)) =
          (BiHom (n-1) (w+q) Q ≃
            BiHom n w (((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-q)).obj Q)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧))) :
        (he.mp e).symm a = e.symm (homotopyRegrade hn.symm hw.symm a) := by
      subst n'
      subst w'
      rfl
    have regrade_comp {n' w' : ℤ} (hn : n=n') (hw : w=w') {A B : Syn}
        (a : BiHom n w A) (f : A ⟶ B) :
        homotopyRegrade hn hw (a ≫ f) = homotopyRegrade hn hw a ≫ f := by
      subst n'
      subst w'
      rfl
    change biSuspensionHomEquivRaw n w q Q a = _
    simp only [biSuspensionHomEquivRaw]
    rw [hc (n-1+1) (w+q+-q) (by omega) (by omega)]
    simp only [Equiv.symm_trans_apply, Iso.homCongr_symm, Iso.homCongr_apply,
      Iso.symm_hom, Iso.symm_inv, Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, regrade_comp]


  have firstLabel_bocksteinLabel_eq
      (X : ClassicalObject) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (s t : ℤ)
      (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) q)) :
      firstLabel model X (s+q+1) (t+q) (bocksteinLabel model X q hq s t a) =
        homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl
          ((susp_invariance (t-s-1) (t+q) 1 (-(q:ℤ)) _).symm
            (homotopyRegrade (by omega) (by omega) (a ≫ bocksteinArrow model X q hq))) := by
    have regrade_cast {a b c d m n : ℤ} {Q : Syn}
        (h1 : a=m) (h2 : b=n) (h3 : a=c) (h4 : b=d)
        (he : BiHom m n Q = BiHom c d Q) (x : BiHom a b Q) :
        he.mp (homotopyRegrade h1 h2 x) = homotopyRegrade h3 h4 x := by
      subst m; subst n; subst c; subst d
      rfl
    simp only [firstLabel, bocksteinLabel, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact regrade_cast _ _ _ _ _ _


  have firstLabel_bocksteinLabel_eq_actual_delta
      (X : ClassicalObject) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (s t : ℤ)
      (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) q)) :
      firstLabel model X (s+q+1) (t+q) (bocksteinLabel model X q hq s t a) =
        homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl
          (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (q:ℤ) (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) (q+1-q))
            (a ≫ ((model.quotients.tower (nuZero model X)).triangle hq (Nat.lt_succ_self q)).delta) ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg (fun n => XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) n)
              (show q+1-q=1 by omega))) := by
    have regrade_comp {n w n' w' : ℤ} (hn : n=n') (hw : w=w') {A B : Syn}
        (a : BiHom n w A) (f : A ⟶ B) :
        homotopyRegrade hn hw (a ≫ f) = homotopyRegrade hn hw a ≫ f := by
      subst n'; subst w'
      rfl
    have inverse_susp_cast {A B : Syn} (h : A=B) (n w k l : ℤ)
        (b : BiHom (n+k) (w+l) ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (k,l)).obj A)) :
        (susp_invariance n w k l B).symm
          (b ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (SyntheticCategory.biShift (k,l)).obj h)) =
          (susp_invariance n w k l A).symm b ≫ eqToHom h := by
      subst B
      simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id]
    rw [firstLabel_bocksteinLabel_eq, bockstein_arrow_eq_biSuspensionIso_inv,
      biSuspensionHomEquiv_eq_inverse_susp]
    simp only [regrade_comp, ←Category.assoc]
    rw [inverse_susp_cast (congrArg (fun n => XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) n)
      (show q+1-q=1 by omega))]
    rw [regrade_comp]


  have biSuspensionIso_natural (i : ℤ) {A B : Syn} (f : A ⟶ B) :
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-i)).map f ≫ (biSuspensionIso i B).hom =
        (biSuspensionIso i A).hom ≫
          (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).map f) := by
    let e : (SyntheticCategory.biShift ((0,-i)+(1,0)) : Syn ⥤ Syn) ≅
        SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i) ⋙ shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ) :=
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (0,-i) (1,0)).symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)) (SyntheticCategory.biShift_compat 1)
    have cast_natural (p p' : ℤ×ℤ) (hp : p=p')
        (E : (SyntheticCategory.biShift p : Syn ⥤ Syn) ≅
          SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i) ⋙ shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ))
        (hA : ((SyntheticCategory.biShift p).obj A ≅
          (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).obj A)) =
          ((SyntheticCategory.biShift p').obj A ≅
          (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).obj A)))
        (hB : ((SyntheticCategory.biShift p).obj B ≅
          (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).obj B)) =
          ((SyntheticCategory.biShift p').obj B ≅
          (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).obj B))) :
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift p').map f ≫ (cast hB (E.app B)).hom =
          (cast hA (E.app A)).hom ≫
            (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).map f) := by
      subst p'
      exact E.hom.naturality f
    unfold biSuspensionIso
    exact cast_natural ((0,-i)+(1,0)) (1,-i) (by ext <;> simp) e _ _


  have biSuspensionHomEquiv_natural (n w q : ℤ) {A B : Syn} (f : A ⟶ B)
      (a : BiHom n w (((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-q)).obj A)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)) :
      biSuspensionHomEquiv n w q B
          (a ≫ (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-q)).map f)) =
        biSuspensionHomEquiv n w q A a ≫ f := by
    have susp_nat (n w k l : ℤ) (b : BiHom n w A) :
        susp_invariance n w k l A b ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (k,l)).map f =
          susp_invariance n w k l B (b ≫ f) := by
      change ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (n,w) (k,l)).inv.app S_0_0 ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (k,l)).map b ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫ _ =
        _ ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (k,l)).map (b ≫ f) ≫ 𝟙 _
      simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.comp_id, Category.assoc, Iso.app_inv]
    have inv_susp_nat (n w k l : ℤ)
        (b : BiHom (n+k) (w+l) ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (k,l)).obj A)) :
        (susp_invariance n w k l B).symm (b ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (k,l)).map f) =
          (susp_invariance n w k l A).symm b ≫ f := by
      apply (susp_invariance n w k l B).injective
      rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ←susp_nat, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have hi : (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-q)).map f) ≫
        (biSuspensionIso q B).inv =
        (biSuspensionIso q A).inv ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-q)).map f := by
      apply (cancel_mono (biSuspensionIso q B).hom).mp
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
      rw [biSuspensionIso_natural]
      simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    have regrade_comp {n w n' w' : ℤ} (hn : n=n') (hw : w=w') {A B : Syn}
        (a : BiHom n w A) (f : A ⟶ B) :
        homotopyRegrade hn hw (a ≫ f) = homotopyRegrade hn hw a ≫ f := by
      subst n'; subst w'
      rfl
    rw [biSuspensionHomEquiv_eq_inverse_susp, biSuspensionHomEquiv_eq_inverse_susp]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [hi, ←Category.assoc, regrade_comp, inv_susp_nat]
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let f : nuZero model X ⟶ A := SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A
  obtain ⟨aZero,haZero,hdiff⟩ := KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_bockstein X i hi s t x
    ((isCycle_iff_reaches model X ((i:ℤ)+1) (by omega) (s,t) x).mp ⟨by omega, by simpa using hx⟩)
  let a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN A i) := aZero ≫ XModLambdaN.map f i
  have hfirst : a ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho 1 i hi =
      firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map f 1 := by
    dsimp only [a]
    have hn : (model.quotients.tower (nuZero model X)).rho 1 i hi ≫ XModLambdaN.map f 1 =
        XModLambdaN.map f i ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho 1 i hi :=
      (model.quotients.natural f).rho_naturality hi
    rw [Category.assoc, ←hn, ←Category.assoc, haZero]
  refine ⟨aZero,a,rfl,hfirst,hdiff,?_⟩
  let y := bocksteinLabel model X i hi s t aZero
  let b : BiHom ((t+i)-(s+i+1)) (t+i) (XModLambdaN A 1) :=
    homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl
      (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (i:ℤ) (XModLambdaN A (i+1-i))
        (a ≫ ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hi (Nat.lt_succ_self i)).delta) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun n => XModLambdaN A n) (show i+1-i=1 by omega)))
  have hb : b = firstLabel model X (s+i+1) (t+i) y ≫ XModLambdaN.map f 1 := by
    have hdelta : XModLambdaN.map f i ≫
        ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hi (Nat.lt_succ_self i)).delta =
      ((model.quotients.tower (nuZero model X)).triangle hi (Nat.lt_succ_self i)).delta ≫
        (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map
          (XModLambdaN.map f (i+1-i))) :=
      (model.quotients.natural f).delta_naturality hi (Nat.lt_succ_self i)
    have map_cast (n m : ℕ) (h : n=m) :
        XModLambdaN.map f n ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun k => XModLambdaN A k) h) =
          eqToHom (congrArg (fun k => XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) k) h) ≫ XModLambdaN.map f m := by
      subst m
      simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    have regrade_comp {n w n' w' : ℤ} (hn : n=n') (hw : w=w') {A B : Syn}
        (a : BiHom n w A) (f : A ⟶ B) :
        homotopyRegrade hn hw (a ≫ f) = homotopyRegrade hn hw a ≫ f := by
      subst n'; subst w'
      rfl
    dsimp only [b,a,y]
    rw [firstLabel_bocksteinLabel_eq_actual_delta]
    rw [Category.assoc aZero,hdelta,←Category.assoc aZero,
      biSuspensionHomEquiv_natural]
    simp only [Category.assoc, regrade_comp]
    rw [map_cast (i+1-i) 1 (by omega)]
  exact hb

private theorem adjacent_bockstein_coordinates
    (X : ClassicalObject)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (s t : ℤ) (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (hx : x ∈ KIP126.Literature.cycles model X i (s,t)) :
    ∃ (aZero : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) i))
      (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i)),
      a = aZero ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) i ∧
      a ≫ (model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).rho 1 i hi =
        firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1 ∧
      KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.HasDifferential
        (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+1)
        (s,t) (s+i+1,t+i) x (bocksteinLabel model X i hi s t aZero) ∧
      (homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl
          (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (i:ℤ)
            (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+1-i))
            (a ≫ ((model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).triangle hi
              (Nat.lt_succ_self i)).delta) ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg (fun n => XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) n)
              (show i+1-i=1 by omega)))) =
        firstLabel model X (s+i+1) (t+i) (bocksteinLabel model X i hi s t aZero) ≫
          XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1

private theorem zero_target_actual_lift
    (X : ClassicalObject)
    (i q : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hq : 0 < q) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (hd : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.HasDifferential
      (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+q)
      (s,t) (s+i+q,t+i+q-1) x 0) :
    ∃ a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i),
      a ≫ (model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).rho 1 i hi =
        firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1 ∧
      a ≫ ((model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).triangle hi
        (show i < i+q by omega)).delta = 0 := by
  let E := model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let r : ℤ := i+q
  have hr : 2 ≤ r := by dsimp [r]; omega
  obtain ⟨hdeg,xr,yr,hxr,hyr,hdiff⟩ := hd
  have hy0 : yr=0 := represents_unique hyr (RepresentsOnPage.zero hr)
  have hz : E.d r (s,t) xr=0 := by
    apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (eqToHom (congrArg (E.Page r) hdeg))).mp inferInstance
    simpa only [ModuleCat.comp_apply,hy0,map_zero] using hdiff
  obtain ⟨_,z,hx,hzr⟩ := hxr
  let P := E.ssData (s,t)
  let n : ℕ := (r-E.r₀).toNat
  have hE : E.r₀ = 2 := model.classical.firstPage _
  have hnEq : n = (r-2).toNat := by dsimp only [n]; rw [hE]
  change (Subobject.underlying.obj (P.Z ↑n) : ModuleCat ℤ) at z
  change P.pageπ ↑n z=xr at hzr
  have hn : (↑n:WithTop ℕ) ≤ ↑(n+1) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n
  let down := Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ↑(n+1)) (P.Z ↑n) (P.Z_anti hn)
  have hk : xr ∈ LinearMap.ker (E.d r (s,t)).hom := hz
  rw [←subobjectModule_kernel,E.Z_succ r (s,t) (by rw [hE]; exact hr),subobjectModule_image] at hk
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hk
  change (Subobject.underlying.obj (P.Z ↑(n+1)) : ModuleCat ℤ) at v
  change P.pageπ ↑n (down v)=xr at hv
  have hb : (P.Z ↑n).arrow (z-down v) ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule P.V) (P.B ↑n) := by
    apply (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (P.B ↑n) (P.Z ↑n) (P.B_le_Z _) _).mp
    change P.pageπ ↑n (z-down v)=0
    rw [map_sub,hzr,hv,sub_self]
  have hb' : (P.Z ↑n).arrow (z-down v) ∈
      (ModuleCat.subobjectModule P.V) (P.Z ↑(n+1)) :=
    (ModuleCat.subobjectModule P.V).monotone ((P.B_mono hn).trans (P.B_le_Z _)) hb
  have hv' : (P.Z ↑n).arrow (down v) ∈
      (ModuleCat.subobjectModule P.V) (P.Z ↑(n+1)) := by
    change (down ≫ (P.Z ↑n).arrow) v ∈ _
    dsimp only [down]
    rw [Subobject.ofLE_arrow]
    exact ⟨v,rfl⟩
  have hz' := ((ModuleCat.subobjectModule P.V) (P.Z ↑(n+1))).add_mem hb' hv'
  rw [map_sub,sub_add_cancel] at hz'
  obtain ⟨z',hz'⟩ := hz'
  have hxnext : x ∈ KIP126.Literature.cycles model X (i+q:ℕ) (s,t) := by
    have hn' : ((i+q:ℕ):ℤ)-1 = (n+1:ℕ) := by rw [hnEq]; dsimp only [r]; omega
    change ∃ v', (KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel model X ↑(((i+q:ℕ):ℤ)-1).toNat (s,t)) v'=x
    rw [hn',Int.toNat_natCast]
    refine ⟨z',?_⟩
    have heq : (Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ↑(n+1)) (P.Z 0) (P.Z_anti bot_le)) z' =
        (Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ↑n) (P.Z 0) (P.Z_anti bot_le)) z := by
      apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (P.Z 0).arrow).mp inferInstance
      simpa only [←ModuleCat.comp_apply,Subobject.ofLE_arrow] using hz'
    change KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel model X (↑(n+1)) (s,t) z' = x
    rw [initialProjection_eq_cycleLabel model X r hr (s,t)] at hx
    dsimp only [KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel]
    have heq' := congrArg (fun z => (P.pageπ 0 ≫ eqToHom
      (show P.page 0 = E.Page 2 (s,t) by simp [P,Page,hE])) z) heq
    exact heq'.trans hx
  obtain ⟨cZero,hcZero⟩ := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_finite_lift X (i+q) (by omega) s t x).mp
    ((isCycle_iff_reaches model X ((i+q:ℕ)+1) (by omega) (s,t) x).mp
      ⟨by omega,by simpa using hxnext⟩)
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let f : nuZero model X ⟶ A := SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A
  let c : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN A (i+q)) := cZero ≫ XModLambdaN.map f (i+q)
  refine ⟨c ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho i (i+q) (by omega),?_,?_⟩
  · rw [Category.assoc,(model.quotients.tower A).rho_comp hi (by omega)]
    dsimp only [c]
    have hnatur : (model.quotients.tower (nuZero model X)).rho 1 (i+q) (by omega) ≫
          XModLambdaN.map f 1 =
        XModLambdaN.map f (i+q) ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho 1 (i+q) (by omega) :=
      (model.quotients.natural f).rho_naturality (by omega)
    rw [Category.assoc,←hnatur,←Category.assoc,hcZero]
  · have hzero : (model.quotients.tower A).rho i (i+q) (by omega) ≫
        ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)).delta = 0 := by
      rw [← (model.quotients.tower A).triangle_rho hi (show i < i+q by omega)]
      exact comp_distTriang_mor_zero₂₃ _ ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)).distinguished
    rw [Category.assoc,hzero,comp_zero]

        firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) 1 ∧
      Detects (model.convergence (.quotient 1 (.nu X))) (s+i+1,t+i,t+i)
        (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model X 1 (s+i+1) (t+i) 0 y))
        (homotopyRegrade (by change t-s-1 = (t+i)-(s+i+1); omega) rfl

        ⟨y-y0,by
          rw [show (1:ℤ)-(t+i)+((t+i)-(1-1:ℕ))=1 by omega]
          exact boundaries_le_cycles model X (s+i+1,t+i) (d+1:ℕ) 1 hdiff⟩
      have hyd : yd.val ∈ KIP126.Literature.boundaries model X (d+1:ℕ) (s+i+1,t+i) := hdiff
      let c : BiHom ((t+i)-(s+i+1)) ((t+i)-(1-1:ℕ)) (XModLambdaN A 1) :=

      have hc : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient 1 (.nu X)))

            (a : BiHom (v-u) w' (XModLambdaN A 1))
            (ha : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient 1 (.nu X))) (u,v,w')
              (regradeE2 (by rw [h]) x) a) :
            Detects (model.convergence (.quotient 1 (.nu X))) (u,v,w) x
              (homotopyRegrade rfl h.symm a) := by
          subst w'
          simpa only [regradeE2,eqToHom_refl,ModuleCat.id_apply,homotopyRegrade] using ha
        change Detects (model.convergence (.quotient 1 (.nu X)))
          (s+i+1,t+i,(t+i)-(0:ℤ))
          (finiteTargetLabel model X 1 (s+i+1) (t+i) 0 (y-y0))
          (homotopyRegrade rfl (by change t+i = t+i-0; omega) (b-boundary a0))
        exact back _ _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ hsub
      have hpre := actual_rho_kernel_correction X
        d 1 (by omega) (by omega) (s+i+1) (t+i) yd hyd c hc
      dsimp only at hpre
      have reindex (n w v : ℤ) (hn : n=t-s) (hw : w=t) (hv : v=t+i)
          (hm : n-1=(t+i)-(s+i+1)) (he : w+i=v)
          (hp : ∃ a : BiHom n w (XModLambdaN A i),
            a ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho 1 i (by dsimp [i]; omega) = 0 ∧
            homotopyRegrade hm he
              (biSuspensionHomEquiv n w (i:ℤ) (XModLambdaN A 1) (a ≫ δ)) =
              homotopyRegrade rfl hv.symm (b-boundary a0)) :

    intro a b

      (Iso.homCongr (Iso.refl _) (biSuspensionIso q Q))
    have h0 : e0 (a + b) = e0 a + e0 b := by
      simp [e0, susp_invariance_add, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp]
    have hc (n' w' : ℤ) (hn : n' = n) (hw : w' = w)

          BiHom n' w' (((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0, -q)).obj Q)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧))
        (he' : e' (a + b) = e' a + e' b)
        (ht : (BiHom (n - 1) (w + q) Q ≃
          BiHom n' w' (((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0, -q)).obj Q)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)) =
          (BiHom (n - 1) (w + q) Q ≃
          BiHom n w (((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0, -q)).obj Q)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧))) :
        (cast ht e') (a + b) = (cast ht e') a + (cast ht e') b := by
      subst n'
      subst w'

    dsimp only [e, biSuspensionHomEquivRaw, Equiv.symm_symm]
    exact hc (n - 1 + 1) (w + q + -q) (sub_add_cancel n 1)
      (add_neg_cancel_right w q) e0 h0 _
  apply e.symm.injective
  rw [h]

theorem biSuspensionIso_natural (i : ℤ) {A B : Syn} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-i)).map f ≫ (biSuspensionIso i B).hom =
      (biSuspensionIso i A).hom ≫
        (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).map f) := by
  let e : (SyntheticCategory.biShift ((0,-i)+(1,0)) : Syn ⥤ Syn) ≅
      SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i) ⋙ shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ) :=
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (0,-i) (1,0)).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)) (SyntheticCategory.biShift_compat 1)
  have cast_natural (p p' : ℤ×ℤ) (hp : p=p')
      (E : (SyntheticCategory.biShift p : Syn ⥤ Syn) ≅
        SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i) ⋙ shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ))
      (hA : ((SyntheticCategory.biShift p).obj A ≅
        (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).obj A)) =
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift p').obj A ≅
        (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).obj A)))
      (hB : ((SyntheticCategory.biShift p).obj B ≅
        (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).obj B)) =
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift p').obj B ≅
        (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).obj B))) :
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift p').map f ≫ (cast hB (E.app B)).hom =
        (cast hA (E.app A)).hom ≫
          (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).map f) := by
    subst p'
    exact E.hom.naturality f
  unfold biSuspensionIso
  exact cast_natural ((0,-i)+(1,0)) (1,-i) (by ext <;> simp) e _ _

    (L : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).obj Q ⟶ B)
    (c : BiHom (n-1) (w+i) Q) :
    (biSuspensionHomEquiv n w i Q).symm c ≫ (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).map L = 0 ↔
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).map c ≫ L = 0 := by
  let e0 := (susp_invariance (n-1) (w+i) 1 (-i) Q).trans
    (Iso.homCongr (Iso.refl _) (biSuspensionIso i Q))
  have h0 : e0 c ≫ (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).map L = 0 ↔
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-i)).map c ≫ L = 0 := by
    change (𝟙 _ ≫ ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (n-1,w+i) (1,-i)).inv.app S_0_0 ≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-i)).map c ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫ (biSuspensionIso i Q).hom) ≫
        (shiftFunctor Syn (1:ℤ)).map L = 0 ↔ _
    simp only [Category.id_comp,Category.comp_id,Category.assoc]

  have he : E.ambient.hom (commonTargetUnshift δ p _ a) = a := by
    rw [(essShift δ).ambient_eq,common_target_shift_unshift]
  have hi : E.ambient.inv a = commonTargetUnshift δ p _ a := by
    exact (congrArg E.ambient.inv he.symm).trans (E.ambient.toLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply _)
  have hc := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (E.symm.level_arrow s) b
  change ((model.syntheticTower.filtration _).F s p).arrow ((E.level s).inv b) =
    E.ambient.inv (((model.syntheticTower.filtration _).F s (p+δ)).arrow b) at hc
  erw [hb,hi] at hc

    (a b c m w : ℤ) (hab : a+b=c) (V : SyntheticSpectrum)
    (v : BiHom ((m,w)+(0,a)).1 ((m,w)+(0,a)).2 ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,a)).obj V)) :
    commonTargetUnshift (0,c) (m,w) V
      (homotopyRegrade (by simp) (by dsimp; omega)
        (shiftHomotopyClass (0,b) ((m,w)+(0,a)) v ≫
          (biShiftAddIso (0,a) (0,b) (0,c) (by ext <;> dsimp; omega)).hom.app V)) =
      commonTargetUnshift (0,a) (m,w) V v := by
  let z := commonTargetUnshift (0,a) (m,w) V v

    common_target_shift_unshift (0,a) (m,w) V v

        (by simp) (by dsimp; omega)
        (shiftHomotopyClass (0,b) ((m,w)+(0,a)) v ≫
          (biShiftAddIso (0,a) (0,b) (0,c) (by ext <;> dsimp; omega)).hom.app V) =
      shiftHomotopyClass (0,c) (m,w) z := by

    have h := shift_hom_associativity model.quotients.coherence
      (m,w) (0,a) (0,b) ((m,w)+(0,a)) (0,c) ((m,w)+(0,c))
      rfl (by ext <;> dsimp; omega) (by ext <;> dsimp <;> omega) rfl z
    have h' := congrArg (fun v => v ≫
      (biShiftAddIso (0,a) (0,b) (0,c) (by ext <;> dsimp; omega)).hom.app V) h.symm
    simp only [Category.assoc,Iso.inv_hom_id_app,Category.comp_id] at h'
    simpa [shiftHomotopyClass,biShiftAddIso,Category.assoc] using h'
  rw [hshift,common_target_unshift_shift]

  have hur := homotopy_regrade_filtration
    (show p.1=(p.1+s)-s by omega) rfl (s+1) _ hu
  rw [homotopy_regrade_sub] at hur
  exact detects_of_high_difference A (s,p.1+s,p.2) _ _ _ hbx hur

    (eA : XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,a)).obj V) (i+q) ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,a)).obj (XModLambdaN V (i+q)))
    (hesusp : XModLambdaN.incl _ (i+q)≫esusp.hom =
      (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ (i+q)))
    (heA : XModLambdaN.incl _ (i+q)≫eA.hom =
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,a)).map (XModLambdaN.incl V (i+q))) :
    XModLambdaN.incl _ (i+q)≫(commonTotalQuotientIso V a i q esusp eA).hom =
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,a)).map (XModLambdaN.incl V (i+q)) := by
  have hfactor := common_edge_flat_iso_factor V a i q esusp eA
  simp only [Functor.comp_obj] at hfactor ⊢
  have hD : XModLambdaN.incl _ (i+q)≫(commonEdgeTargetFlatIso V a i q esusp eA).hom =
      (commonRawSuspensionTransport a i).hom.app V ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-(i:ℤ))).map
          ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,(i:ℤ)+a)).map (XModLambdaN.incl V (i+q))) := by
    simp only [Functor.comp_obj] at hfactor ⊢
    rw [hfactor,←Category.assoc,hesusp]
    have hx := congrArg (fun z => (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map z ≫
      (commonRawSuspensionTransport a i).hom.app (XModLambdaN V (i+q))) heA
    have hy := (commonRawSuspensionTransport a i).hom.naturality (XModLambdaN.incl V (i+q))
    simpa only [Functor.map_comp,Functor.comp_map,Category.assoc] using hx.trans hy
  simp only [commonTotalQuotientIso,Iso.trans_hom,Functor.mapIso_hom,
    LambdaQuotientFunctoriality.functor,Functor.comp_obj]
  rw [←Category.assoc,←XModLambdaN.incl_naturality,Category.assoc]
  erw [←Category.assoc (XModLambdaN.incl _ (i+q)),hD]
  have he := (biShiftAddIso (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,(i:ℤ)+a) (1,-(i:ℤ)) (1,a)
    (by ext <;> dsimp; omega)).hom.naturality (XModLambdaN.incl V (i+q))
  change (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-(i:ℤ))).map
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,(i:ℤ)+a)).map _) ≫ _ =
    _ ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,a)).map _ at he
  simp only [Category.assoc,Iso.app_hom]
  rw [he]
  simp [commonTotalSuspensionTransport,Category.assoc]

private theorem double_pure_unshift_up_to_source_automorphism
    (α β δ : ℤ×ℤ)
    (E : SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) α ⋙
      SyntheticCategory.biShift β ≅ SyntheticCategory.biShift δ)
    (m w : ℤ) (V Sα Sβ : SyntheticSpectrum)
    (Cα : (SyntheticCategory.biShift α).obj (Smn m w) ≅ Sα)
    (Cβ : (SyntheticCategory.biShift β).obj Sα ≅ Sβ)
    (Cδ : (SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj (Smn m w) ≅ Sβ)
    (a : Sβ ⟶ (SyntheticCategory.biShift β).obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift α).obj V)) :
    let ffα := SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) α
    let ffβ := SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) β
    let ffδ := SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) δ
    ∃ u : Smn (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) m w ≅ Smn m w,
      ffα.preimage (Cα.hom≫ffβ.preimage (Cβ.hom≫a)) =
        u.hom≫ffδ.preimage (Cδ.hom≫a≫E.hom.app V) := by
  dsimp only
  let ffα := SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) α
  let ffβ := SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) β
  let ffδ := SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) δ
  let b := ffα.preimage (Cα.hom≫ffβ.preimage (Cβ.hom≫a))
  let c := ffδ.preimage (Cδ.hom≫a≫E.hom.app V)
  let U := (E.app (Smn m w)).symm ≪≫
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift β).mapIso Cα ≪≫ Cβ ≪≫ Cδ.symm
  let u := ffδ.preimageIso U
  refine ⟨u,?_⟩
  change b=u.hom≫c
  apply ffδ.map_injective
  have hb : (SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map b =
      E.inv.app (Smn m w)≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift β).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift α).map b)≫E.hom.app V := by
    have hn := E.hom.naturality b
    exact ((Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc E (Smn m w)
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map b)).symm).trans
        (congrArg (fun z => E.inv.app (Smn m w)≫z) hn.symm)
  rw [hb]
  simp only [b,u,c,U,Functor.map_comp,Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage,
    Functor.FullyFaithful.preimageIso_hom,Iso.trans_hom,Iso.symm_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom,Category.assoc,Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,Iso.app_inv]

private theorem common_total_native_detection
    (Y : ClassicalObject) (e : ℤ) (i q k : ℕ) (hk : k < i+q)
    (s t : ℤ) (y : Ambient model Y (s,t))
    (esusp : XModLambdaN (((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj
      (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧) (i+q) ≅
      (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary))) (i+q))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)
    (eA : XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj
      (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary))) (i+q) ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+q)))
    (Sα Sβ : SyntheticSpectrum)
    (Cα : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,(i:ℤ)+e)).obj (Smn (t-s) (t-k)) ≅ Sα)
    (Cβ : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-(i:ℤ))).obj Sα ≅ Sβ)
    (Cδ : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,e)).obj (Smn (t-s) (t-k)) ≅ Sβ)
    (a : Sβ ⟶ XModLambdaN (((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj
      (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧) (i+q))
    (ha : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (i+q) (.nu Y))) (s,t,t-k)
      (finiteTargetLabel model Y (i+q) s t k y)
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (0,(i:ℤ)+e)).preimage
        (Cα.hom≫(SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (1,-(i:ℤ))).preimage
          (Cβ.hom≫a≫(commonEdgeTargetFlatIso _ e i q esusp eA).hom)))) :
    Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (i+q) (.nu Y))) (s,t,t-k)
      (finiteTargetLabel model Y (i+q) s t k y)
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (1,e)).preimage
        (Cδ.hom≫a≫XModLambdaN.map
          ((commonTotalSuspensionTransport e i).hom.app _) (i+q)≫
            (commonTotalQuotientIso _ e i q esusp eA).hom)) := by
  let V := model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)
  let E := biShiftAddIso (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,(i:ℤ)+e) (1,-(i:ℤ)) (1,e)
    (by ext <;> dsimp; omega)
  let b := a≫(commonEdgeTargetFlatIso V e i q esusp eA).hom
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := double_pure_unshift_up_to_source_automorphism
    (0,(i:ℤ)+e) (1,-(i:ℤ)) (1,e) E (t-s) (t-k)
    (XModLambdaN V (i+q)) Sα Sβ Cα Cβ Cδ b
  let c := (SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (1,e)).preimage
    (Cδ.hom≫b≫E.hom.app (XModLambdaN V (i+q)))
  have hc : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (i+q) (.nu Y))) (s,t,t-k)
      (finiteTargetLabel model Y (i+q) s t k y) (u.hom≫c) := by
    rw [←hu]
    exact ha
  have hc0 := sphere_automorphism_finite_detects Y (i+q) k hk s t y u.symm (u.hom≫c) hc
  have h0 : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (i+q) (.nu Y))) (s,t,t-k)
      (finiteTargetLabel model Y (i+q) s t k y) c := by
    simpa only [Iso.symm_hom,Category.assoc,Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc] using hc0
  have heq := common_total_quotient_sphere_equation V Sβ e i q esusp eA a
  have hrepr : (SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (1,e)).preimage
      (Cδ.hom≫a≫XModLambdaN.map ((commonTotalSuspensionTransport e i).hom.app V) (i+q)≫
        (commonTotalQuotientIso V e i q esusp eA).hom) = c := by
    simpa only [c,b,E,Category.assoc] using congrArg
      (fun z => (SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (1,e)).preimage
        (Cδ.hom≫z)) heq
  exact (congrArg (fun z => Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (i+q) (.nu Y))) (s,t,t-k)
    (finiteTargetLabel model Y (i+q) s t k y) z) hrepr).mpr h0

private theorem cumulative_boundary_permanent (X : ClassicalObject) (b : ℤ)
    (p : Bidegree) (y : Ambient model X p)
    (hy : y ∈ boundaries model X b p) : ClassicalPermanentCycle model X p y := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hy
  let E := model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let P := E.ssData p
  let n₀ : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2-E.r₀).toNat
  have hn₀ : n₀=0 := by dsimp [n₀,E]; rw [model.classical.firstPage]; rfl
  let j := Subobject.ofLE (P.B (↑(b-1).toNat)) (P.Z ⊤)
    ((P.B_mono le_top).trans (P.B_le_Z ⊤))
  refine ⟨j z,?_⟩
  change (j ≫ Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ⊤) (P.Z n₀) (P.Z_anti le_top) ≫ P.pageπ n₀) z=y
  rw [normalizeInitialProjection P n₀ ⊤ hn₀ le_top]
  change ((j ≫ Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ⊤) (P.Z 0) (P.Z_anti bot_le)) ≫ P.pageπ 0 ≫ _) z=y
  rw [show j ≫ Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ⊤) (P.Z 0) (P.Z_anti bot_le) =
    Subobject.ofLE (P.B (↑(b-1).toNat)) (P.Z 0) _ by simp only [j,Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]]
  exact hz

code:
private theorem cumulative_boundary_hit (X : ClassicalObject)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (p : Bidegree) (y : Ambient model X p)
    (hy : y ∈ boundaries model X r p)
    (hprev : y ∉ boundaries model X (r-1) p) :
    HitOnPage (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) r p y := by
  let E := model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let P := E.ssData p
  let n : ℕ := ((r:ℤ)-E.r₀).toNat
  let n₀ : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2-E.r₀).toNat
  have hn₀ : n₀=0 := by dsimp [n₀,E]; rw [model.classical.firstPage]; rfl
  have hn' : ((r:ℤ)-1).toNat=n+1 := by dsimp [n,E]; rw [model.classical.firstPage]; omega
  change y ∈ LinearMap.range (boundaryLabel model X (↑((r:ℤ)-1).toNat) p).hom at hy
  rw [hn'] at hy
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hy
  let j := Subobject.ofLE (P.B ↑(n+1)) (P.Z ↑n)
    ((P.B_le_Z _).trans (P.Z_anti (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n)))
  let yr : E.Page r p := P.pageπ ↑n (j z)
  have hyr : RepresentsOnPage E r p y yr := by
    refine ⟨by omega,j z,?_,rfl⟩
    change (j ≫ Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ↑n) (P.Z n₀) _ ≫ P.pageπ n₀) z=y
    rw [normalizeInitialProjection P n₀ ↑n hn₀ (by rw [hn₀]; exact bot_le)]
    change ((j ≫ Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ↑n) (P.Z 0) _) ≫ P.pageπ 0 ≫ _) z=y
    rw [show j ≫ Subobject.ofLE (P.Z ↑n) (P.Z 0) _ =
      Subobject.ofLE (P.B ↑(n+1)) (P.Z 0) _ by simp only [j,Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]]
    exact hz
  have hyrne : yr ≠ 0 := by
    intro hyrzero
    exact hprev (represents_zero_mem_boundary model X r p y (by simpa only [E,hyrzero] using hyr))
  let q := p-E.diffDeg r
  have hqp : q+E.diffDeg r=p := by dsimp [q]; abel
  have himage : yr ∈ LinearMap.range (E.d r q ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (E.Page r) hqp)).hom := by
    have h := congrArg (ModuleCat.subobjectModule (E.Page r (q+E.diffDeg r)))
      (E.B_succ r q (by dsimp [E]; rw [model.classical.firstPage]; omega))
    simp only [subobjectModule_image] at h
    have transport (p' : Bidegree) (hp : p'=p)
        (d : E.Page r q ⟶ E.Page r p')
        (hd : LinearMap.range d.hom = LinearMap.range
          (Subobject.ofLE ((E.ssData p').B ↑(n+1)) ((E.ssData p').Z ↑n)
            (((E.ssData p').B_le_Z _).trans ((E.ssData p').Z_anti
              (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n))) ≫
            (E.ssData p').pageπ ↑n).hom) :
        yr ∈ LinearMap.range (d ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (E.Page r) hp)).hom := by
      subst p'
      simp only [eqToHom_refl,Category.comp_id,hd]
      exact ⟨z,rfl⟩
    exact transport _ hqp (E.d r q) h
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := himage
  exact ⟨q,hqp,a,yr,hyr,hyrne,ha⟩

code:
private theorem cumulative_boundary_torsion_lift (X : ClassicalObject)
    (k : ℕ) (s t : ℤ) (y : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (hy : y ∈ boundaries model X (k+1) (s,t)) :
    ∃ a : BiHom (t-s) t (nuZero model X),
      quotientClass 1 a=firstLabel model X s t y ∧ lambdaMultiply k a=0 := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have hyzero : y=0 := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_zero,zero_add,boundaries_one,Submodule.mem_bot] using hy
    subst y
    refine ⟨0,?_,?_⟩
    · have cast_zero (m w w' : ℤ) (A : SyntheticSpectrum) (hw : w=w')
          (he : BiHom m w A = BiHom m w' A) : he.mp 0=0 := by subst w'; rfl
      simp only [quotientClass,zero_comp,firstLabel,map_zero]
      rw [cast_zero _ _ _ _ (Int.add_zero t)]
    · simp only [lambdaMultiply,comp_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hprev : y ∈ boundaries model X (k+1) (s,t)
    · obtain ⟨a,ha,hak⟩ := ih hprev
      exact ⟨a,ha,lambdaMultiply_zero_of_le (t-s) t k (k+1) (by omega) a hak⟩
    · have hy' : y ∈ boundaries model X (k+2) (s,t) := by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_succ,add_assoc,Int.reduceAdd] using hy
      have hhit := cumulative_boundary_hit X (k+2) (by omega) (s,t) y hy'
        (by simpa only [show ((k+2:ℕ):ℤ)-1=(k:ℤ)+1 by omega] using hprev)
      obtain ⟨a,ha,hak⟩ := KIP126.Literature.Standard.selected_realization_boundary_lift X s t

code:
theorem first_label_detects_unshifted
    (X : ClassicalObject) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q))
    (ha : a ≫ (model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).rho 1 q hq =
      firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1) :
    Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))) (s,t,t)
      (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model X q s t 0 x)) a := by
  have first_label_detects
      (X : ClassicalObject) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (s t : ℤ)
      (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
      (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) q))
      (ha : a ≫ (model.quotients.tower (nuZero model X)).rho 1 q hq = firstLabel model X s t x) :
      Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))) (s,t,t)
        (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model X q s t 0 x))
        (a ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) q) := by
    let Z := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
    let f : nuZero model X ⟶ Z := SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _
    have h0 : (s,t,t+0-(0:ℕ))=(s,t,t) := by simp
    let x0 : (model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ (s,t,t) :=
      (congrArg (fun i => ((model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ i : Type)) h0).mp
        (model.comparison.nuE2 X 0 s t 0 x)
    let xq0 (n : ℕ) := familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl (nuZero model X) n) 2 (s,t,t) x0
    let xq (n : ℕ) := familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl Z n) 2 (s,t,t)
      (familyPageMap model.family f 2 (s,t,t) x0)
    have map_label (n : ℕ) :
        familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.map f n) 2 (s,t,t) (xq0 n) = xq n := by
      dsimp only [xq0,xq]
      rw [←ModuleCat.comp_apply,family_page_comp,←XModLambdaN.incl_naturality]
      rw [←family_page_comp,ModuleCat.comp_apply]
    have rho_label :
        familyPageMap model.family ((model.quotients.tower Z).rho 1 q hq) 2 (s,t,t) (xq q) = xq 1 := by
      dsimp only [xq]
      rw [←ModuleCat.comp_apply,family_page_comp,(model.quotients.tower Z).rho_quotient]
    have hxR := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_finite_lift X q hq s t x).mpr ⟨a,ha⟩
    have hx : x ∈ KIP126.Literature.cycles model X q (s,t) := by
      have h := ((isCycle_iff_reaches model X (q+1) (by omega) (s,t) x).mpr hxR).2
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using h
    have transport_infinity {A : SyntheticAdamsSS.{0}} {i j : Tridegree}
        (h : i=j) (x : A.E₂ i)
        (hx : ∃ e : (A.sequence.ssData i).eInfty, HasInfinityRepresentative A 2 i x e) :
        ∃ e : (A.sequence.ssData j).eInfty,
          HasInfinityRepresentative A 2 j
            ((congrArg (fun k => (A.E₂ k : Type)) h).mp x) e := by
      subst j
      exact hx
    have map_cast {A B : SyntheticSpectrum} (g : A ⟶ B) {i j : Tridegree} (h : i=j)
        (x : (model.family.obj A).E₂ i) :
        (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj B).E₂ k : Type)) h).mp
          (familyPageMap model.family g 2 i x) =
        familyPageMap model.family g 2 j
          ((congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj A).E₂ k : Type)) h).mp x) := by
      subst j
      rfl
    have hex : ∃ e0 : ((model.family.obj (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) q)).sequence.ssData
        (s,t,t)).eInfty, HasInfinityRepresentative (model.family.obj (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) q)) 2 (s,t,t) (xq0 q) e0 := by
      have hh := transport_infinity h0 (finiteNuLabel model X q 0 s t 0 x)
        (shifted_finite_source_exists X q hq 0 s t x hx)
      have hl : (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) q)).E₂ k : Type)) h0).mp
          (finiteNuLabel model X q 0 s t 0 x) = xq0 q :=
        map_cast (XModLambdaN.incl (nuZero model X) q) h0 (model.comparison.nuE2 X 0 s t 0 x)
      exact (congrArg (fun z => ∃ e0 : ((model.family.obj (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) q)).sequence.ssData
        (s,t,t)).eInfty, HasInfinityRepresentative (model.family.obj (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) q)) 2 (s,t,t) z e0) hl).mp hh
    obtain ⟨e0,he0⟩ := hex
    have he := family_infinity_representative_map (XModLambdaN.map f q) (s,t,t) _ e0 he0
    have he' : HasInfinityRepresentative (model.family.obj (XModLambdaN Z q)) 2 (s,t,t) (xq q)
        ((model.family.functor.map (XModLambdaN.map f q)).eInftyMap (s,t,t) e0) :=
      (congrArg (fun z => HasInfinityRepresentative (model.family.obj (XModLambdaN Z q)) 2 (s,t,t) z
        ((model.family.functor.map (XModLambdaN.map f q)).eInftyMap (s,t,t) e0)) (map_label q)).mp he
    have hb0 : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient 1 (.shift (0,0) (.nu X))))
        (s,t,t) (xq0 1) (firstLabel model X s t x) := by
      have transport_detects {A : SyntheticObject} {i j : Tridegree} (h : i=j)
          (x : (model.family.obj (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).E₂ i)
          (a : BiHom (i.2.1-i.1) i.2.2 (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
          (ha : Detects (model.convergence A) i x a) :
          Detects (model.convergence A) j
            ((congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).E₂ k : Type)) h).mp x)
            ((congrArg (fun k : Tridegree => BiHom (k.2.1-k.1) k.2.2 (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)) h).mp a) := by
        subst j
        exact ha
      have h1 : (s,t,t+0)=(s,t,t) := by simp
      have h01 : (s,t,t+0-(0:ℕ))=(s,t,t+0) := by simp only [Nat.cast_zero,sub_zero]
      let x1 : (model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ (s,t,t+0) :=
        (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ k : Type)) h01).mp
          (model.comparison.nuE2 X 0 s t 0 x)
      let a1 : BiHom (t-s) (t+0) (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) 1) :=
        (model.firstQuotient X 0 s t).symm x
      have hr : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient 1 (.shift (0,0) (.nu X)))) (s,t,t+0)
          (familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl (nuZero model X) 1) 2 (s,t,t+0) x1) a1 :=
        model.comparisonCompatible.first_quotient X 0 s t x
      have hh := transport_detects h1 _ _ hr
      have cast_comp {A B C : Type} (hAB : A=B) (hBC : B=C) (hAC : A=C) (a : A) :
          hBC.mp (hAB.mp a) = hAC.mp a := by
        subst B
        subst C
        rfl
      have hx1 : (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ k : Type)) h1).mp x1 = x0 := by
        exact cast_comp
          (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ k : Type)) h01)
          (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ k : Type)) h1)
          (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ k : Type)) h0)
          (model.comparison.nuE2 X 0 s t 0 x)
      have hlabel : (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) 1)).E₂ k : Type)) h1).mp
          (familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl (nuZero model X) 1) 2 (s,t,t+0) x1) = xq0 1 :=
        (map_cast _ h1 x1).trans (congrArg (familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl (nuZero model X) 1)
          2 (s,t,t)) hx1)
      have halabel : (congrArg (fun k : Tridegree => BiHom (k.2.1-k.1) k.2.2
          (XModLambdaN (nuZero model X) 1)) h1).mp a1 = firstLabel model X s t x := by
        rfl
      exact (congrArg₂ (fun z a => Detects (model.convergence (.quotient 1 (.shift (0,0) (.nu X))))
        (s,t,t) z a) hlabel halabel).mp hh
    have hb := detects_map (.quotient 1 (.shift (0,0) (.nu X))) (.quotient 1 (.nu X))
      (XModLambdaN.map f 1) (s,t,t) _ _ hb0
    have hb' : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient 1 (.nu X))) (s,t,t) (xq 1)
        (firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map f 1) :=
      (congrArg (fun z => Detects (model.convergence (.quotient 1 (.nu X))) (s,t,t) z
        (firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map f 1)) (map_label 1)).mp hb
    have hactual :
        (a ≫ XModLambdaN.map f q) ≫ (model.quotients.tower Z).rho 1 q hq =
          firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map f 1 := by
      rw [Category.assoc,←(model.quotients.natural f).rho_naturality,
        ←Category.assoc,ha]
    have hinj : Function.Injective ((model.family.functor.map ((model.quotients.tower Z).rho 1 q hq)).eInftyMap
        (s,t,t)).hom :=
      rho_infty_injective X 1 q (by decide) hq s t t (by omega)
    have hdet := detects_reflect (.quotient q (.nu X)) (.quotient 1 (.nu X))
      ((model.quotients.tower Z).rho 1 q hq) (s,t,t) hinj (xq q) _ he'
      (a ≫ XModLambdaN.map f q) (finite_bottom_filtration X q hq s t _)
      ((congrArg₂ (fun z b => Detects (model.convergence (.quotient 1 (.nu X))) (s,t,t) z b)
        rho_label hactual).mpr hb')
    have htarget : regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model X q s t 0 x) = xq q := by
      have h2 : (s,t,t-(0:ℕ))=(s,t,t) := by simp
      have h02 : (s,t,t+0-(0:ℕ))=(s,t,t-(0:ℕ)) := by simp only [add_zero]
      let x2 : (model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ (s,t,t-(0:ℕ)) :=
        (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ k : Type)) h02).mp
          (model.comparison.nuE2 X 0 s t 0 x)
      have cast_comp {A B C : Type} (hAB : A=B) (hBC : B=C) (hAC : A=C) (a : A) :
          hBC.mp (hAB.mp a) = hAC.mp a := by
        subst B
        subst C
        rfl
      have hx2 : (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ k : Type)) h2).mp x2 = x0 :=
        cast_comp
          (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ k : Type)) h02)
          (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ k : Type)) h2)
          (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj (nuZero model X)).E₂ k : Type)) h0)
          (model.comparison.nuE2 X 0 s t 0 x)
      have regrade_cast {A : SyntheticAdamsSS.{0}} {i j : Tridegree} (h : i=j) (x : A.E₂ i) :
          regradeE2 h x = (congrArg (fun k => (A.E₂ k : Type)) h).mp x := by
        subst j
        rfl
      rw [regrade_cast]
      exact (map_cast (XModLambdaN.incl Z q) h2 _).trans (congrArg
        (familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl Z q) 2 (s,t,t))
        ((map_cast f h2 x2).trans (congrArg (familyPageMap model.family f 2 (s,t,t)) hx2)))
    exact (congrArg (fun z => Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))) (s,t,t) z
      (a ≫ XModLambdaN.map f q)) htarget).mpr hdet

  let Z := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let f : nuZero model X ⟶ Z := SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _
  let g : Z ⟶ nuZero model X := SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.inv.app _
  have hfg : f ≫ g = 𝟙 _ := Iso.hom_inv_id_app _ _
  have hgf : g ≫ f = 𝟙 _ := Iso.inv_hom_id_app _ _
  have hfirst : (a ≫ XModLambdaN.map g q) ≫ (model.quotients.tower (nuZero model X)).rho 1 q hq =
      firstLabel model X s t x := by
    rw [Category.assoc,←(model.quotients.natural g).rho_naturality,
      ←Category.assoc,ha,Category.assoc,←model.quotients.functoriality.map_comp,hfg,
      model.quotients.functoriality.map_id,Category.comp_id]
  have h := first_label_detects X q hq s t x (a ≫ XModLambdaN.map g q) hfirst
  have hback : (a ≫ XModLambdaN.map g q) ≫ XModLambdaN.map f q = a := by
    rw [Category.assoc,←model.quotients.functoriality.map_comp,hgf,
      model.quotients.functoriality.map_id,Category.comp_id]
  exact (congrArg (fun a => Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))) (s,t,t)
    (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model X q s t 0 x)) a) hback).mp h

private theorem infinity_zero_no_incoming (A : SyntheticAdamsSS) (p : Tridegree)
    (hin : ∀ r : ℤ, 2 ≤ r → A.sequence.d r (p-A.sequence.diffDeg r)=0)
    (x : A.E₂ p) (hx : HasInfinityRepresentative A 2 p x 0) : x=0 := by
  obtain ⟨_,z,hz,hz0⟩ := hx
  let D := A.sequence.ssData p
  let k : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2-A.sequence.r₀).toNat
  have hB : D.B ⊤ = D.B k := boundaries_top_eq_of_d_eq_zero A.sequence 2
    (by rw [A.firstPage]) p hin
  have hb := (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (D.B ⊤) (D.Z ⊤) (D.B_le_Z _) z).mp hz0
  rw [hB] at hb
  rw [← hz]
  let z' := (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ⊤) (D.Z k) (D.Z_anti le_top)) z
  change D.pageπ k z' = 0
  apply (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (D.B k) (D.Z k) (D.B_le_Z _) z').mpr
  change ((Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ⊤) (D.Z k) (D.Z_anti le_top)) ≫ (D.Z k).arrow) z ∈ _
  rwa [Subobject.ofLE_arrow]

private theorem finite_bottom_high_label_zero (Y : ClassicalObject) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0<q)
    (s t w : ℤ) (hw : t ≤ w)
    (x : (model.family.obj (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) q)).E₂ (s,t,w))
    (a : BiHom (t-s) w (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) q))
    (ha : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu Y))) (s,t,w) x a)
    (hhigh : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+1) a) : x=0 := by
  apply infinity_zero_no_incoming _ (s,t,w) _ x
    (detects_high_infinity_zero (.quotient q (.nu Y)) (s,t,w) x a ha hhigh)
  intro r hr
  have hdeg : (s,t,w)-(model.family.obj
      (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) q)).sequence.diffDeg r =
      (s-r,t-r+1,w) := by
    change (s,t,w)-(model.family.functor.obj _).diffDeg r = _
    rw [model.family.differentialDegree]
    simp only [syntheticAdamsRawShift,Prod.mk_sub_mk,sub_zero]
    congr 2
    omega
  have hzero := KIP126.Literature.Standard.finite_quotient_vanishing Y q hq r hr
    (s-r) (t-r+1) w (Or.inl (by omega))
  have hzero' : IsZero ((model.family.obj
      (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) q)).Page r
      ((s,t,w)-(model.family.obj
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) q)).sequence.diffDeg r)) := by
    rw [hdeg]
    exact hzero
  exact hzero'.eq_of_src _ _

    (hT : NormalizedTriangleCompatible model T he)

      (1,(normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f : ℤ)+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g)).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary))) r ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift
        (1,(normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f : ℤ)+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g)).obj
          (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary)) r))
    (hεmain : XModLambdaN.incl _ r≫εmain.hom =
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift
        (1,(normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f : ℤ)+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g)).map
          (XModLambdaN.incl _ r))
    (cGeometry : BiHom
      ((t-s,t-k)+(1,(normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f : ℤ)+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g)).1
      ((t-s,t-k)+(1,(normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f : ℤ)+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g)).2
      (XModLambdaN (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib (model.normalizedMap T.Y T.Z T.g).map) r))
    (hc : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient r (.nu T.X))) (s,t,t-k)

      XModLambdaN.incl _ r≫εe.hom=(SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,ef)).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ r) ∧
      XModLambdaN.incl _ r≫εs.hom=(SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,0)).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ r) ∧
      let aRaw := homotopyRegrade
        (show (((p+(1,ef+eg))+(0,-eg)).1)=(((p+(0,ef))+(1,0)).1) by dsimp; omega)
        (show (((p+(1,ef+eg))+(0,-eg)).2)=(((p+(0,ef))+(1,0)).2) by dsimp; omega)
        (shiftHomotopyClass (0,-eg) (p+(1,ef+eg)) cGeometry≫εRaw.inv)

          XModLambdaN.map (E.hom.app A) r) := by
    simpa only [raw,a,regrade_comp,Category.assoc] using
      congrArg (homotopyRegrade (congrArg Prod.fst hdegree) (congrArg Prod.snd hdegree)) hraw0
  have hκ : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient r (.nu T.X))) (s,t,t-k)

    rw [hfixed]
    exact shifted_quotient_total_unshift_detects T.X old β total

      εmain εβ εtotal hεmain hεβ hεtotal _ hc
  have hχ := quotient_unshift_two_natural_transports_detects T.X
    (fSourceRawFunctor eg eh) total χ κ r k hkr s t x εtotal hεtotal raw hκ
  have hsigned : a≫XModLambdaN.map (-(normalized_f_suspended_source_iso T he hT).hom) r≫
      XModLambdaN.map ((biShiftAddIso (0,ef) (1,0) total (by ext <;> simp [total])).hom.app A) r =
      raw≫XModLambdaN.map (χ.hom.app A) r := by
    rw [←model.quotients.functoriality.map_comp,

    (E : SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) α ⋙
      SyntheticCategory.biShift β ≅ SyntheticCategory.biShift δ)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0<q)
    (εα : XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift α).obj
      (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift α).obj
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q))
    (εβ : XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift β).obj
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift α).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)))) q ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift β).obj
        (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift α).obj
          (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q))
    (εδ : XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj
      (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q))
    (hεα : XModLambdaN.incl _ q≫εα.hom =
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift α).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ q))
    (hεβ : XModLambdaN.incl _ q≫εβ.hom =
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift β).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ q))
    (hεδ : XModLambdaN.incl _ q≫εδ.hom =
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ q))
    (m w : ℤ)
    (a : BiHom m w (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift β).obj
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift α).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)))) q)) :
    a≫εβ.hom≫(SyntheticCategory.biShift β).map εα.hom≫E.hom.app _ =
      a≫XModLambdaN.map (E.hom.app _) q≫εδ.hom := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let Q := model.quotients.functoriality.functor q
  let b := a≫XModLambdaN.map (E.hom.app A) q
  let f := XModLambdaN.map (E.inv.app A) q≫εβ.hom≫
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift β).map εα.hom≫E.hom.app (XModLambdaN A q)
  have hf : XModLambdaN.incl _ q≫f = XModLambdaN.incl _ q≫εδ.hom := by
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [←Category.assoc,←XModLambdaN.incl_naturality,Category.assoc,
      ←Category.assoc (XModLambdaN.incl _ q)]
    erw [hεβ]
    rw [←Category.assoc ((SyntheticCategory.biShift β).map _),←Functor.map_comp,hεα]
    have hn := E.hom.naturality (XModLambdaN.incl A q)
    change (SyntheticCategory.biShift β).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift α).map
      (XModLambdaN.incl A q)) ≫ E.hom.app (XModLambdaN A q) =
        E.hom.app A≫(SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map (XModLambdaN.incl A q) at hn
    rw [hn,Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
    exact hεδ.symm

    f εδ.hom hf m w b

    rw [←model.quotients.functoriality.map_comp,Iso.hom_inv_id_app,
      model.quotients.functoriality.map_id]
  simpa only [b,f,Category.assoc,←Category.assoc (XModLambdaN.map (E.hom.app A) q),
    hc,Category.id_comp] using hh

private theorem homotopySeparated_shift (D : Model C Syn) (X : SyntheticObject) (δ : ℤ × ℤ)
    (S : SyntheticESSShiftComparison D δ)
    (hsep : HomotopySeparated D.syntheticTower (X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)) :
    HomotopySeparated D.syntheticTower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj
      (X.obj D.nu D.auxiliary)) := by
  intro m w a ha
  let p : ℤ × ℤ := (m-δ.1,w-δ.2)
  have hp : p+δ=(m,w) := by ext <;> simp [p]
  let e : FilteredPieceIso (D.convergence X).filtration
      (D.convergence (.shift δ X)).filtration p (m,w) :=
    hp ▸ S.filtered X p
  have hb : e.ambient.inv a = 0 := by
    apply hsep p.1 p.2 (e.ambient.inv a)
    intro s
    have hmem : a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _
        ((D.convergence (.shift δ X)).filtration.F s (m,w)) := by
      simpa only [SyntheticTowerConvergence.filtration,
        SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,
        FiltrationAtLeast, SyntheticObject.obj] using ha s
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hmem
    have hcomm := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (e.symm.level_arrow s) x
    simp only [ModuleCat.comp_apply, FilteredPieceIso.symm] at hcomm
    have hm : e.ambient.inv a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _
        ((D.convergence X).filtration.F s p) := by
      refine ⟨(e.level s).inv x,?_⟩
      change ((D.convergence X).filtration.F (s:ℤ) p).arrow ((e.level s).inv x) = e.ambient.inv a
      simpa only [hx, Iso.symm_hom] using hcomm
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerConvergence.filtration,
      SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,
      FiltrationAtLeast] using hm
  apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective e.ambient.inv).mp inferInstance
  simpa only [map_zero] using hb

      ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (q-k)).pageMap 2 (s,t,w)
        (nuWeightLabel model X s t w (by omega) y)) b) :

      ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q).pageMap 2 (s,t,w-k)
        (nuWeightLabel model X s t (w-k) (by omega) y))
      (finiteWeightedLambdaClass X q k hk hkq s t w b) := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let L : ((SyntheticObject.shift (0,-(k:ℤ)) (.quotient (q-k) (.nu X))).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) ⟶
      ((SyntheticObject.quotient q (.nu X)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) :=
    ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hk hkq).lambdaMap
  have hs : (s,t,w)=(s,(t-s)+s,w) := by simp
  have hbStem := detects_transport hs _ _ hb
  have hm := shifted_map_detects (.quotient (q-k) (.nu X)) (.quotient q (.nu X))
    (0,-(k:ℤ)) (t-s,w) s L _ b hbStem
  have hp : (s,((t-s,w)+(0,-(k:ℤ))).1+s,((t-s,w)+(0,-(k:ℤ))).2) =
      (s,t,w-k) := by ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hm := detects_transport hp _ _ hm
  obtain ⟨e,he,br,hbr,hge⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨e0,he0,_⟩ := hb
  have heMap := shifted_representative_map (.quotient (q-k) (.nu X)) (.quotient q (.nu X))
    (0,-(k:ℤ)) (t-s,w) s L _ _ (representative_transport hs _ _ he0)
  have heMap := representative_transport hp _ _ heMap
  have heq := he.unique heMap
  have heq' : e = KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityFiniteLambda X q k hkq (s,t) w e0 := by

    simp only [KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityFiniteLambda,
      InfinityShiftCoordinates.finiteLambdaMap, show k ≠ 0 by omega, ↓reduceDIte,
      InfinityShiftCoordinates.shift, infinityShift, Iso.trans_hom, ModuleCat.comp_apply,
      eqToIso.hom, KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityShiftData,
      KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityShift_comparison]
    rw [infinity_map_regrade L hp]
    rfl

      ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q).pageMap 2 (s,t,w-k)

    apply (KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_finite_labels X q (by omega)
      s t (w-k) (by omega) y _).mpr

      convert hy using 1
      congr 1
      omega
    refine ⟨hy',?_⟩
    rw [KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_lambda_finite X q k hkq (s,t) w hw,hye]
    rfl

  · subst k

        ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q).pageMap 2 (s,t,w)

                (nuWeightLabel model X s t v' hv₂ y)) := by subst v'; rfl

private theorem final_f_division_target (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (q k : ℕ) (hkq : k<q) (n s t : ℤ)
    (hn : (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f : ℤ)≤n)
    (hw : n-normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f<(q-k:ℕ))
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (y : Ambient model Y (s+n,t+n))
    (af : BiHom (t-s) (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
      ((SyntheticObject.quotient (q-k) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
    (haf : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (q-k) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)))
      (s,(t-s)+s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
      (finiteSourceForExtension model X Y f (q-k) s t x)
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl af))
    (hfil : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+n)
      (af≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-k)))
    (hMay : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu Y)))
      (s+n,t+n,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f-k)
      ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) q).pageMap 2
        (s+n,t+n,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f-k)
        (nuWeightLabel model Y (s+n) (t+n)
          (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f-k) (by omega) y))
      (finiteWeightedLambdaDivisionClass Y q k hkq (s+n) (t+n)
        (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
        (homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl (af≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-k))))) :
    ∃ y' : Ambient model Y (s+n,t+n),
      y'-y∈boundaries model Y (1+n-normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f+k) (s+n,t+n) ∧
      ∃ (a : BiHom (t-s) (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
          ((SyntheticObject.quotient (q-k) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
        (b : BiHom (t-s) (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
          (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) (q-k))),
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (q-k) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)))
          (s,(t-s)+s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
          (finiteSourceForExtension model X Y f (q-k) s t x)
          (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl a) ∧
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (q-k) (.nu Y)))
          (s+n,(t-s)+(s+n),t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
          (finiteTargetForExtension model X Y f (q-k) n s t hn y')
          (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl b) ∧
        a≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-k)=b := by

  let b' := homotopyRegrade (by omega : t-s=(t+n)-(s+n)) rfl b
  have hfil' : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+n) b' := by
    exact (regrade_filtration_iff _ _ _ _).mpr hfil
  obtain ⟨y',hy',hcong⟩ := finite_lambda_target_label_congruent_uniform Y q k hkq
    (s+n) (t+n) (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (by omega)
    y b' hfil' hMay
  refine ⟨y',?_,af,b,haf,?_,rfl⟩
  · convert hcong using 1
    congr 1
    omega
  · have hp : (s+n,(t-s)+(s+n),t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)=
        (s+n,t+n,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · rfl
      · apply Prod.ext
        · dsimp
          omega
        · rfl
    have ht := detects_transport hp.symm _ _ hy'
    have hl := finite_extension_target_weight_label X Y f (q-k) n s t hn y'
    have hregrade {E : SyntheticAdamsSS} {p p' : Tridegree} (h : p=p') (z : E.E₂ p) :
        regradeE2 h.symm (regradeE2 h z)=z := by subst p'; rfl
    rw [←hl,hregrade] at ht
    convert ht using 1
    dsimp only [b']
    simp only [regrade_precomp,←Category.assoc,eqToHom_trans]

      ((SyntheticObject.quotient (q-k) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
    (haf : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (q-k) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)))
      (s,(t-s)+s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
      (finiteSourceForExtension model X Y f (q-k) s t x)
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl af))
    (hfil : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+n)
      (af≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-k)))
    (hMay : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu Y)))

        (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)

private theorem finite_detected_source_division_exact_uniform (X : ClassicalObject)
    (q k : ℕ) (hkq : k<q) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (a : BiHom (t-s) (t-k) (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q))
    (ha : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))) (s,t,t-k)
      ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q).pageMap 2 (s,t,t-k)
        (nuWeightLabel model X s t (t-k) (by omega) x)) a) :
    ∃ b : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (q-k)),
      b≫(model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 (q-k) (by omega)=
        firstLabel model X s t x≫XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1 ∧
      Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (q-k) (.nu X))) (s,t,t)
        (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model X (q-k) s t 0 x)) b ∧
      finiteLambdaDivisionClass X q k hkq s t b=a := by
  by_cases hk : k=0
  · subst k
    let b := homotopyRegrade rfl (by simp : t-(0:ℕ)=t) a
    have hp : (s,t,t-(0:ℕ))=(s,t,t) := by simp
    have ht := detects_transport hp _ _ ha
    have hbdet : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))) (s,t,t)
        ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q).pageMap 2 (s,t,t)
          (nuWeightLabel model X s t t (by omega) x)) b := by
      convert ht using 1
      · have transport (v v' : ℤ) (hv : v=v') (hv₁ : v≤t) (hv₂ : v'≤t)
            (h : (s,t,v)=(s,t,v')) :
            regradeE2 h
              ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q).pageMap 2 (s,t,v)
                (nuWeightLabel model X s t v hv₁ x)) =
              ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q).pageMap 2 (s,t,v')
                (nuWeightLabel model X s t v' hv₂ x)) := by subst v'; rfl
        exact (transport _ t (by simp) _ _ hp).symm
    have hbfirst := finite_detected_bottom_first X q hkq s t x b hbdet
    refine ⟨b,hbfirst,first_label_detects_unshifted X q hkq s t x b hbfirst,?_⟩
    simp only [finiteLambdaDivisionClass,↓reduceDIte,b]
    have cancel (A : SyntheticSpectrum) (m v v' : ℤ) (hv : v=v') (hv' : v'=v)
        (c : BiHom m v A) :
        homotopyRegrade rfl hv' (homotopyRegrade rfl hv c)=c := by subst v'; rfl
    exact cancel _ _ _ _ _ _ a
  · obtain ⟨b,hb,hbd,hbl⟩ := finite_detected_source_division_exact X q k (by omega) hkq s t x a ha
    refine ⟨b,hb,hbd,?_⟩
    simpa only [finiteLambdaDivisionClass,dif_neg hk] using hbl

private theorem lambdaPow_shift_comm (a : ℤ × ℤ) (n : ℕ) (X : SyntheticSpectrum) :
    lambdaPow n ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj X) =
      (shiftCommIso a (lambdaDegree n)).hom.app X ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (lambdaPow n X) := by
  induction n generalizing X with
  | zero =>
    change SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj X) =
      (shiftCommIso a 0).hom.app X ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app X)
    rw [shiftCommIso_eq a 0 a (add_zero a)]
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom,Iso.symm_hom,NatTrans.comp_app]
    rw [model.quotients.coherence.right_unit]
    have hl := model.quotients.coherence.left_unit a X
    rw [←hl]
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 : (shiftCommIso a (0,-1)).hom.app X ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (SyntheticCategory.lam.app X) =
        SyntheticCategory.lam.app ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj X) := by
      simpa [shiftCommIso,Category.assoc] using (model.quotients.coherence.lambda_comm a X).symm
    apply (cancel_epi ((lambdaShiftAddIso 1 n (n+1) (by omega)).hom.app
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift a).obj X))).mp
    rw [lambdaPow_succ_comparison]
    rw [shift_comm_add a (lambdaDegree 1) (lambdaDegree n) (lambdaDegree (n+1))
      (by ext <;> simp [lambdaDegree,Nat.cast_add]) X]
    simp only [lambdaShiftAddIso,Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc]
    rw [←Functor.map_comp]
    erw [lambdaPow_succ_comparison]
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    have hn := (shiftCommIso a (lambdaDegree n)).hom.naturality (SyntheticCategory.lam.app X)
    have hn' := congrArg (fun h => h ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift a).map (lambdaPow n X)) hn
    simp only [Functor.comp_map,Category.assoc] at hn'
    dsimp only [lambdaDegree,Functor.id_obj] at hn' ⊢
    erw [←hn']
    rw [←Category.assoc,←Functor.map_comp]
    erw [h1,ih]
    rfl

private theorem finite_lambda_maps_equal_on_spheres
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (q d : ℕ) (hdq : d < q)
    (f g : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(d:ℤ))).obj
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (q-d)) ⟶
      XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) q)
    (hfg : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(d:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ (q-d)) ≫ f =
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(d:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ (q-d)) ≫ g) :
    ∀ (m w : ℤ) (c : BiHom m w ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(d:ℤ))).obj
      (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (q-d)))), c ≫ f = c ≫ g := by
  letI := model.exactness.shiftCommShift (0,-(d:ℤ))
  letI := model.exactness.shiftExact (0,-(d:ℤ))
  let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(d:ℤ))
  let V := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let T := XModLambdaN.cofiberTriangle V (q-d)
  have hzero : (F.mapTriangle.obj T).mor₂ ≫ (f-g) = 0 := by
    change F.map (XModLambdaN.incl V (q-d)) ≫ (f-g) = 0
    rw [Preadditive.comp_sub,hfg,sub_self]
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₃ (F.mapTriangle.obj T)
    (F.map_distinguished T (XModLambdaN.cofiberTriangle_distinguished V (q-d))) (f-g) hzero
  intro m w c
  let ε : (F.obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-((q-d:ℕ):ℤ))).obj V))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧ ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(q:ℤ)-1)).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj ((ClassicalObject.shift 1 X).obj model.auxiliary)) :=
    (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).mapIso
      ((lambdaShiftAddIso (q-d) d q (Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega))).app V) ≪≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_compat (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) 1).symm.app _ ≪≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (0,-(q:ℤ)) (1,0)).app V ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun p => (SyntheticCategory.biShift p).obj V)
        (show (0,-(q:ℤ))+(1,0)=(1,1)+(0,-(q:ℤ)-1) by ext <;> simp)) ≪≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (1,1) (0,-(q:ℤ)-1)).symm.app V ≪≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(q:ℤ)-1)).mapIso (model.nu.suspensionIso _).symm
  have h := negative_shift_nu_to_quotient_zero (.shift 1 X) Y q (by omega) m w
    ((c ≫ (F.mapTriangle.obj T).mor₃) ≫ ε.hom) (ε.inv ≫ z)
  have hcz : (c ≫ (F.mapTriangle.obj T).mor₃) ≫ z = 0 := by
    simpa only [Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc] using h
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [←Preadditive.comp_sub,hz,←Category.assoc]
  exact hcz

private theorem quotient_shift_lambda_on_spheres
    (X : ClassicalObject) (δ : ℤ × ℤ) (q d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d < q)
    (εn : XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) (q-d) ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (q-d)))
    (εq : XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q))
    (hεn : XModLambdaN.incl _ (q-d) ≫ εn.hom =
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ (q-d)))
    (hεq : XModLambdaN.incl _ q ≫ εq.hom =
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ q))
    (m w : ℤ) (c : BiHom m w ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(d:ℤ))).obj
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (q-d))))) :
    c ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(d:ℤ))).map εn.inv ≫
        ((model.quotients.tower _).triangle hd hdq).lambdaMap ≫ εq.hom =
      c ≫ (shiftCommIso δ (0,-(d:ℤ))).hom.app _ ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map ((model.quotients.tower _).triangle hd hdq).lambdaMap := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) δ
  let K := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(d:ℤ))
  let L := ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hd hdq).lambdaMap
  let L' := ((model.quotients.tower (F.obj A)).triangle hd hdq).lambdaMap
  let ff := SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) δ
  let C := shiftCommIso δ (0,-(d:ℤ))
  let v : K.obj (XModLambdaN A (q-d)) ⟶ XModLambdaN A q :=
    ff.preimage (C.inv.app _ ≫ K.map εn.inv ≫ L' ≫ εq.hom)
  have hv : F.map v = C.inv.app _ ≫ K.map εn.inv ≫ L' ≫ εq.hom := ff.map_preimage _
  have hbase : K.map (XModLambdaN.incl A (q-d)) ≫ v =
      K.map (XModLambdaN.incl A (q-d)) ≫ L := by
    apply ff.map_injective
    rw [Functor.map_comp,Functor.map_comp,hv]
    have hn := C.inv.naturality (XModLambdaN.incl A (q-d))
    change F.map (K.map (XModLambdaN.incl A (q-d))) ≫ C.inv.app _ =
      C.inv.app A ≫ K.map (F.map (XModLambdaN.incl A (q-d))) at hn
    rw [←Category.assoc,hn,Category.assoc,←hεn,Functor.map_comp,Category.assoc]
    rw [←Category.assoc (K.map εn.hom),←Functor.map_comp,Iso.hom_inv_id,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,Category.id_comp]
    rw [←Category.assoc (K.map (XModLambdaN.incl (F.obj A) (q-d))),
      ((model.quotients.tower (F.obj A)).triangle hd hdq).lambda_quotient,
      Category.assoc,hεq]
    have hc := lambdaPow_shift_comm δ d A
    change lambdaPow d (F.obj A) = C.hom.app A ≫ F.map (lambdaPow d A) at hc
    rw [←Category.assoc,hc]
    simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
    rw [←Functor.map_comp,←Functor.map_comp]
    exact congrArg F.map (((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hd hdq).lambda_quotient.symm)
  have hb := finite_lambda_maps_equal_on_spheres X X q d hdq v L hbase
  have hh := shift_preserves_sphere_congruence _ _ δ v L hb m w (c ≫ C.hom.app _)
  rw [hv] at hh
  simpa only [C,F,K,L,L',Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc] using hh

    ∃ c : BiHom m w (XModLambdaN C (i+q)),

        (may_relative_unit_rotated i q hi hq).Z) =
      b ≫ ((may_normalized_rotated T he hT).Y ◁
        (may_relative_unit_rotated i q hi hq).g)) :
    let N := KIP126.Literature.normalizedTriangle model T he
    let L := (model.quotients.tower (𝟙_ SyntheticSpectrum)).triangle hi
      (show i < i+q by omega)
    let U := may_relative_unit_rotated i q hi hq
    letI := KIP126.Literature.Standard.may_leftShift
    letI := KIP126.Literature.Standard.may_rightShift

    (may_normalized_rotated T he hT) (may_relative_unit_rotated i q hi hq)

        ((SyntheticObject.quotient (r-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary),

            (show 0<r-1 by have := W.page_ge_two; omega)
            (show r-1<r-1+q by omega)).delta =

              (show 0<r-1 by have := W.page_ge_two; omega)
              (show r-1<r-1+q by omega)).delta ∧

private theorem finite_cycle_image_infinity
    (Y X : ClassicalObject) (q r : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r)
    (a b s t : ℤ) (hgap : (r:ℤ) ≤ q+b-a)
    (d : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,a)).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) ⟶
      XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,b)).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) r)
    (y : Ambient model Y (s,t)) (hy : y ∈ cycles model Y q (s,t)) :
    ∃ e, HasInfinityRepresentative
      (model.family.obj (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,b)).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) r)) 2 (s,t,t+a-(0:ℕ))
      (familyPageMap model.family d 2 (s,t,t+a-(0:ℕ))
        (model.comparison.nuE2 Y a s t 0 y)) e := by
  let E := model.classical.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)
  have hpage : 2 ≤ (q+1:ℕ) := by omega
  have hy' : ReachesPage E (q+1) (s,t) y := by
    apply (isCycle_iff_reaches model Y (q+1) (by omega) (s,t) y).mp
    refine ⟨by omega,?_⟩
    simpa using hy
  obtain ⟨yr,hyr⟩ := hy'
  have hdeg : (s,t)+E.diffDeg (q+1:ℕ) = (s+(q+1:ℕ),t+(q+1:ℕ)-1) := by
    rw [model.classical.differentialDegree]
    ext <;> first | rfl | (dsimp; omega)
  let zr := (E.d (q+1:ℕ) (s,t) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (E.Page (q+1:ℕ)) hdeg)) yr
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := FinitePageCalculus.page_has_initial_representative (by omega : (2:ℤ)≤(q+1:ℕ)) zr
  have hc : HasDifferential E (q+1:ℕ) (s,t) (s+(q+1:ℕ),t+(q+1:ℕ)-1) y z :=
    ⟨hdeg,yr,zr,hyr,hz,rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨_,ys,zs,hys,hzs,hds⟩ :=
    (KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_differentials Y a s t (q+1) 0 hpage y z).mp hc
  have hm := syntheticRep_map (model.family.map d) hys
  apply syntheticRep_infty _ (q+1:ℕ) (s,t,t+a-(0:ℕ)) _ _ hm
  intro n hn
  have hdeg' : (s,t,t+a-(0:ℕ))+(model.family.obj (XModLambdaN
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,b)).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) r)).sequence.diffDeg n =
      (s+n,t+n-1,t+a-(0:ℕ)) := by
    change (s,t,t+a-(0:ℕ)) + (model.family.functor.obj _).diffDeg n = _
    rw [model.family.differentialDegree]
    simp only [syntheticAdamsRawShift,Prod.mk_add_mk,add_zero]
    ext <;> first | rfl | (dsimp; omega)
  have hs := shiftedFinitePageVanishing X r hr b n (s+n) (t+n-1) (t+a-(0:ℕ))
    (by omega) (Or.inr (by omega))
  have hsub : Subsingleton ((model.family.obj (XModLambdaN
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,b)).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) r)).Page n
      ((s,t,t+a-(0:ℕ))+(model.family.obj (XModLambdaN
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,b)).obj
          (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) r)).sequence.diffDeg n)) := by
    rw [hdeg']
    exact hs
  ext v
  exact @Subsingleton.elim _ hsub _ _

      (c : BiHom (t-s) (t+a-(0:ℕ)) (C.obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
      (beta : (model.family.obj (D.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).E₂ (s,t,t+a-(0:ℕ))),

      let J₀ := ff.preimage ((biSuspensionIso (i:ℤ) A).hom ≫
        (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map (lambdaPow i A) ≫
          XModLambdaN.incl (A⟦(1:ℤ)⟧) (i+q) ≫ eD.hom)

    (model.convergence (.quotient (r-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))) p s

  have htarget := source_frame_detects (model.convergence (.quotient (r-1) (.nu Y))) p (s+n)
    W.target _ W.target_rep br hby

    (s,(t-s)+s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)

  · exact Leibniz.minimal_length_finite_tower_no_crossing X Y f (r-1)
