private theorem octahedron_common_lift
    {A B C D E V S : SyntheticSpectrum}
    {u : A ⟶ B} {l : B ⟶ C} {f : A ⟶ C} {hcomp : u≫l=f}
    {j : B ⟶ D} {h : D ⟶ A⟦(1:ℤ)⟧}
    {rho : C ⟶ E} {delta : E ⟶ B⟦(1:ℤ)⟧}
    {incl : C ⟶ V} {proj : V ⟶ A⟦(1:ℤ)⟧}
    {hU : Triangle.mk u j h ∈ distTriang SyntheticSpectrum}
    {hL : Triangle.mk l rho delta ∈ distTriang SyntheticSpectrum}
    {hF : Triangle.mk f incl proj ∈ distTriang SyntheticSpectrum}
    (O : Triangulated.Octahedron hcomp hU hL hF)
    (a : S ⟶ E) (b : S ⟶ A⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)
    (hab : a≫delta=b≫(shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map u) :
    ∃ v : S ⟶ V, v≫O.m₃=a ∧ v≫proj=b := by
  have huj : u ≫ j = 0 := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ hU
  have haz : a ≫ (delta ≫ (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map j)=0 := by
    rw [←Category.assoc,hab,Category.assoc,←Functor.map_comp,
      huj,Functor.map_zero,comp_zero]
  obtain ⟨v0,hv0⟩ := O.triangle.coyoneda_exact₃ O.mem a haz
  change S ⟶ V at v0
  change a = v0 ≫ O.m₃ at hv0
  let e := b-v0≫proj
  have he : e ≫ (-((shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map u))=0 := by
    simp only [e,Preadditive.comp_neg,Preadditive.sub_comp,Category.assoc,O.comm₄]
    rw [←Category.assoc,←hv0,←hab,sub_self,neg_zero]
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := (Triangle.mk u j h).rotate.coyoneda_exact₃
    (rot_of_distTriang _ hU) e he
  change S ⟶ D at c
  change e=c≫h at hc
  have hzero : O.m₁ ≫ O.m₃ = 0 := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ O.mem
  refine ⟨v0+c≫O.m₁,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [Preadditive.add_comp,Category.assoc,
      hzero,comp_zero,add_zero]
    exact hv0.symm
  · rw [Preadditive.add_comp,Category.assoc,O.comm₂,←hc]
    dsimp only [e]
    abel

        (by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using
          a ≫ ((model.quotients.tower B).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)).delta)) :
    let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(i:ℤ))
    let L := (model.quotients.tower B).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)
    let u := F.map (XModLambdaN.map G (i+q-i))
    let V := HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib (u≫L.lambdaMap)

      HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι (u≫L.lambdaMap) ≫ p = L.rho ∧
      v ≫ p = a ∧
      biSuspensionHomEquiv m w i (XModLambdaN A q)
        (by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using
          v ≫ HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ (u≫L.lambdaMap)) = b := by
  dsimp only
  let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(i:ℤ))
  let L := (model.quotients.tower B).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)
  let u := F.map (XModLambdaN.map G (i+q-i))
  let b' : BiHom m w ((F.obj (XModLambdaN A (i+q-i)))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧) := by
    simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using
      (biSuspensionHomEquiv m w i (XModLambdaN A q)).symm b
  have source_compare (d : ℕ) (hd : d=q)
      (δ : BiHom m w ((F.obj (XModLambdaN B d))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)) :
      biSuspensionHomEquiv m w i (XModLambdaN B q)
        (by simpa only [hd] using δ) = b ≫ XModLambdaN.map G q →
      δ = (by simpa only [hd] using
          (biSuspensionHomEquiv m w i (XModLambdaN A q)).symm b) ≫
        (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map (F.map (XModLambdaN.map G d)) := by
    subst d
    intro hδ
    apply (biSuspensionHomEquiv m w i (XModLambdaN B q)).injective
    rw [bi_susp_natural model.quotients.coherence]
    change (biSuspensionHomEquiv m w i (XModLambdaN B q)) δ =
      (biSuspensionHomEquiv m w i (XModLambdaN A q))

      (δ : BiHom m w ((F.obj (XModLambdaN A d))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧))
      (hδ : δ = (by simpa only [hd] using
        (biSuspensionHomEquiv m w i (XModLambdaN A q)).symm b)) :
      biSuspensionHomEquiv m w i (XModLambdaN A q)
        (by simpa only [hd] using δ)=b := by
    subst d
    change (biSuspensionHomEquiv m w i (XModLambdaN A q)) δ = b
    change δ = (biSuspensionHomEquiv m w i (XModLambdaN A q)).symm b at hδ
    rw [hδ,AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

private theorem finite_quotient_octahedral_comparison
    {A B C D : SyntheticSpectrum} (G : A ⟶ B) (j : B ⟶ C) (h : C ⟶ D)
    (hGj : G≫j=0) (hjh : j≫h=0)

    let L := (model.quotients.tower B).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)
    let u := F.map (XModLambdaN.map G (i+q-i))
    let f := u≫L.lambdaMap
    let V := HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib f
    ∀ p : V ⟶ XModLambdaN B i,
      HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι f≫p=L.rho →
      ∃ (φ : V ⟶ XModLambdaN C (i+q))
        (K : (F.obj (XModLambdaN A (i+q-i)))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧ ⟶ XModLambdaN D (i+q))
        (z : (F.obj (XModLambdaN A (i+q-i)))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧ ⟶ XModLambdaN C i),
        HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι f≫φ=XModLambdaN.map j (i+q) ∧
        HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ f≫K=φ≫XModLambdaN.map h (i+q) ∧
        φ≫(model.quotients.tower C).rho i (i+q) (by omega) -
          p≫XModLambdaN.map j i = HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ f≫z := by
  dsimp only
  intro p hp
  let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(i:ℤ))
  let L := (model.quotients.tower B).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)
  let u := F.map (XModLambdaN.map G (i+q-i))
  let f := u≫L.lambdaMap
  let T := Triangle.mk f (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι f) (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ f)
  have hT := HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished f
  have hzero : f≫XModLambdaN.map j (i+q)=0 := by
    dsimp only [f,u,F]
    rw [(model.quotients.natural G).lambda_naturality hi (show i < i+q by omega),
      Category.assoc,quotient_map_comp_zero G j hGj,comp_zero]
  obtain ⟨φ,hφ⟩ := T.yoneda_exact₂ hT (XModLambdaN.map j (i+q)) hzero
  change HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib f ⟶ XModLambdaN C (i+q) at φ

private theorem normalized_octahedral_comparison (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (B C D : SyntheticSpectrum) (ef eg : ℤ) (hef : 0 ≤ ef)
    (eC : C ≅ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,ef+eg)).obj
      (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)))
    (G : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,eg)).obj
      (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) ⟶ B)
    (j : B ⟶ C) (h : C ⟶ D) (hGj : G≫j=0) (hjh : j≫h=0)
    (i q : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hq : 0 < q) :
    let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(i:ℤ))
    let L := (model.quotients.tower B).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)
    let u := F.map (XModLambdaN.map G (i+q-i))
    let f := u≫L.lambdaMap
    let V := HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib f
    ∀ p : V ⟶ XModLambdaN B i,
      HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι f≫p=L.rho →
      ∃ (φ : V ⟶ XModLambdaN C (i+q))
        (K : (F.obj (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,eg)).obj
          (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary))) (i+q-i)))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧ ⟶
            XModLambdaN D (i+q)),
        HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι f≫φ=XModLambdaN.map j (i+q) ∧
        HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ f≫K=φ≫XModLambdaN.map h (i+q) ∧
        ∀ (m w : ℤ) (v : BiHom m w V),
          v≫φ≫(model.quotients.tower C).rho i (i+q) (by omega) =
            v≫p≫XModLambdaN.map j i := by
  dsimp only
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨φ,K,z,hφ,hK,hz⟩ := finite_quotient_octahedral_comparison
    G j h hGj hjh i q hi hq p hp
  refine ⟨φ,K,hφ,hK,?_⟩
  intro m w v
  have hzero := normalized_finite_no_return X Y C ef eg hef eC (i+q-i) i
    (by omega) hi m w
    (v≫HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.map G (i+q-i))≫
        ((model.quotients.tower B).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)).lambdaMap)) z

  rw [←Preadditive.comp_sub,hz,←Category.assoc]
  exact hzero

private theorem octahedral_lift_difference_factor
    {A B V D : SyntheticSpectrum}
    {f : A ⟶ B} {ι : B ⟶ V} {δ : V ⟶ A⟦(1:ℤ)⟧}
    (hT : Triangle.mk f ι δ ∈ distTriang SyntheticSpectrum)
    {K J : A⟦(1:ℤ)⟧ ⟶ D}
    (hKJ : δ ≫ K = δ ≫ J) :
    ∃ t : B⟦(1:ℤ)⟧ ⟶ D,
      K - J = (-(shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map f) ≫ t := by
  have hzero : δ ≫ (K-J)=0 := by
    rw [Preadditive.comp_sub,hKJ,sub_self]
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := (Triangle.mk f ι δ).rotate.yoneda_exact₃
    (rot_of_distTriang _ hT) (K-J) hzero
  change B⟦(1:ℤ)⟧ ⟶ D at t
  change K-J = (-(shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map f) ≫ t at ht
  exact ⟨t,ht⟩

    (v : S ⟶ V) (b : S ⟶ A⟦(1:ℤ)⟧) (hv : v ≫ δ = b) :

    simp only [hzero,comp_zero]

  rintro x ⟨z,rfl⟩

  simp only [KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel, KIP126.Literature.boundaryLabel, P,
    ←Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]

    (y : Ambient D X p)
    (hy : RepresentsOnPage (D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)) r p y 0) :
    y ∈ KIP126.Literature.boundaries D X (r-1) p := by
  let E := D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)
  let P := E.ssData p
  let k : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat
  obtain ⟨hr,z,hz,hz0⟩ := hy
  rw [initialProjection_eq_cycleLabel D X r hr p] at hz
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := (P.pageπ_eq_zero_iff k z).mp hz0
  change ∃ b, KIP126.Literature.boundaryLabel D X (↑(r-1-1).toNat) p b = y
  have hk : (↑(r-1-1).toNat : WithTop ℕ) = k := by
    dsimp only [k,E]
    rw [D.classical.firstPage]
    congr 2; omega
  rw [hk]
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  have hlabel : Subobject.ofLE (P.B k) (P.Z k) (P.B_le_Z k) ≫
      KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel D X k p = KIP126.Literature.boundaryLabel D X k p := by
    dsimp only [KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel, KIP126.Literature.boundaryLabel, P, E]
    simp only [←Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
  rw [←hlabel, ModuleCat.comp_apply, hb]
  exact hz

    (δ : ℤ × ℤ) (f g : A ⟶ B)
    (hfg : ∀ (m w : ℤ) (c : BiHom m w A), c ≫ f = c ≫ g)
    (m w : ℤ) (c : BiHom m w ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj A)) :

    (biShiftAddIso (m-δ.1,w-δ.2) δ (m,w) (by ext <;> simp)).app S_0_0
  let c₀ := ff.preimage (ε.hom ≫ c)
  have h := congrArg F.map (hfg (m-δ.1) (w-δ.2) c₀)
  have hc : F.map c₀ = ε.hom ≫ c := ff.map_preimage _
  rw [Functor.map_comp,Functor.map_comp,hc] at h
  apply (cancel_epi ε.hom).mp

private theorem map_filtration_one_shift_iff (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary) :
    MapFiltrationAtLeast model.classicalTower ((shiftFunctor Spectrum (1:ℤ)).map f) 1 ↔
      MapFiltrationAtLeast model.classicalTower f 1 := by
  let S := model.classicalSuspension Y
  let ff := Functor.FullyFaithful.ofFullyFaithful (shiftFunctor Spectrum (1:ℤ))
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a,ha⟩
    let b := ff.preimage (a≫(S.tower 1).hom)
    refine ⟨b,?_⟩
    apply ff.map_injective
    change (shiftFunctor Spectrum (1:ℤ)).map (b≫_) = _
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    dsimp only [b]
    rw [Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage,Category.assoc]
    erw [suspension_projection_one Y]
    exact ha
  · rintro ⟨a,ha⟩
    refine ⟨(shiftFunctor Spectrum (1:ℤ)).map a≫(S.tower 1).inv,?_⟩
    rw [Category.assoc]
    erw [←suspension_projection_one Y]
    simp only [S,Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [←Functor.map_comp]
    exact congrArg (shiftFunctor Spectrum (1:ℤ)).map ha

    let e0 := model.firstQuotient X 0 (w-m) w
    have hz : (e0 (homotopyRegrade (by omega) (by simp) (a≫e.hom))) = 0 :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _

    ((biShiftAddIso (m,w) (1,0) (m+1,w) (by ext <;> simp)).app S_0_0).symm ≪≫

code:
private theorem homology_short_exact_of_boundary_zero
    (T : Triangle Spectrum) (hT : T ∈ distTriang Spectrum)
    (hz : ZeroOnModTwoHomology model.coefficients T.mor₃) :
    HomologyShortExact model.coefficients T := by
  letI := closedBackground.symmetric
  letI := closedBackground.tensorShift model.coefficients.object
  letI := closedBackground.tensorExact model.coefficients.object
  let e := (BraidedCategory.tensorLeftIsoTensorRight model.coefficients.object).symm
  letI := Functor.CommShift.ofIso e ℤ
  letI := Functor.CommShift.ofIso_compatibility e ℤ
  letI := Functor.isTriangulated_of_iso e
  let F := tensorLeft model.coefficients.object
  let U := F.mapTriangle.obj T
  have hU : U ∈ distTriang Spectrum := F.map_distinguished T hT
  have hu (n : ℤ) (a : HomotopyGroup n U.obj₃) : a≫U.mor₃=0 := by
    change a≫F.map T.mor₃≫_=0
    change a≫(model.coefficients.object ◁ T.mor₃)≫_=0
    have hh : a≫(model.coefficients.object ◁ T.mor₃)=0 := hz n a
    rw [←Category.assoc,hh,zero_comp]
  intro n
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro a b hab
    have hab' : (a-b)≫U.mor₁=0 := by
      change a≫U.mor₁=b≫U.mor₁ at hab
      rw [Preadditive.sub_comp,hab,sub_self]
    let S := shiftFunctor Spectrum (1:ℤ)
    have hh : S.map (a-b)≫S.map U.mor₁=0 := by
      rw [←Functor.map_comp,hab',Functor.map_zero]
    obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := U.coyoneda_exact₁ hU (S.map (a-b)) hh
    let eS : Sphere (C:=Spectrum) (n+1) ≅ S.obj (Sphere n) :=
      ((shiftFunctorAdd' Spectrum n 1 (n+1) rfl).app SphereSpectrum)
    have hz' : (eS.hom≫d)≫U.mor₃=0 := hu (n+1) _
    have hd0 : d≫U.mor₃=0 := (cancel_epi eS.hom).mp
      (by simpa only [Category.assoc,comp_zero] using hz')
    have hs0 : S.map (a-b)=0 := hd.trans hd0
    have hab0 : a-b=0 := S.map_injective
      (by simpa only [Functor.map_zero] using hs0)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hab0
  · intro a
    constructor
    · intro ha
      obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := U.coyoneda_exact₂ hU a ha
      exact ⟨b,hb.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨b,rfl⟩
      change (b≫U.mor₁)≫U.mor₂=0
      rw [Category.assoc,comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ U hU,comp_zero]
  · intro a
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := U.coyoneda_exact₃ hU a (hu n a)
    exact ⟨b,hb.symm⟩
statement:

    (T : Triangle Spectrum) (hT : T ∈ distTriang Spectrum)
    (hz : ZeroOnModTwoHomology model.coefficients T.mor₃) :
    HomologyShortExact model.coefficients T

        (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map (zero_positive_iso A ef hf).hom =

        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-1)).map σ.hom ≫

  simp only [eqToHom_refl,eqToIso_refl,Iso.trans_hom,Iso.refl_hom,Category.id_comp]

  have hn := (SyntheticCategory.biShift_compat (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) 1).hom.naturality

  simp only [Category.assoc]
  erw [←hn,←hleft,Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc,hright]
  erw [SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.naturality_assoc]
  erw [SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.naturality_assoc]
  erw [SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.naturality_assoc]
  simp only [Functor.id_map,Iso.app_hom]

private theorem finite_zero_shift_label (X : ClassicalObject) (q : ℕ)
    (s t : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) :
    familyPageMap model.family
      (XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q) 2 (s,t,t-k)
      (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteNuLabel model X q 0 s t k x)) =
        finiteTargetLabel model X q s t k x := by
  unfold finiteNuLabel finiteTargetLabel targetNuLabel
  rw [page_regrade]
  have regrade_cast {B : SyntheticAdamsSS.{0}} {i j : Tridegree} (h : i=j) (z : B.E₂ i) :
      regradeE2 h z = (congrArg (fun k => (B.E₂ k : Type)) h).mp z := by
    subst j
    rfl
  rw [regrade_cast]
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let z : (model.family.obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).obj A)).E₂ (s,t,t-k) :=
    (congrArg (fun i => ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,0)).obj A)).E₂ i : Type))
      (show (s,t,t+0-k)=(s,t,t-k) by simp)).mp (model.comparison.nuE2 X 0 s t k x)
  change familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) q) 2 (s,t,t-k)
      (familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl _ q) 2 (s,t,t-k) z) =
    familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl A q) 2 (s,t,t-k)
      (familyPageMap model.family (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) 2 (s,t,t-k) z)
  rw [← ModuleCat.comp_apply, family_page_comp, ← XModLambdaN.incl_naturality]
  rw [← family_page_comp, ModuleCat.comp_apply]
  rfl

private theorem tower_essential_iff_target_nonzero_of_no_crossing
    (M : ConvergentMap E g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n : ℤ)
    (x : ((E.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)
    (he : TowerExtensionEquation M p s n x y)
    (hnc : TowerNoCrossing M p s n) :
    TowerEssentialExtension M p s n x y ↔ y ≠ 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hess hy
    exact ((tower_essential_iff_no_zero M p s n x y he).mp hess) (by rwa [←hy])
  · intro hy
    apply (tower_essential_iff_no_zero M p s n x y he).mpr
    intro he0
    obtain ⟨hn,ar,br,hab,hax,hby⟩ := (tower_extension_iff M p s n x y).mp he
    obtain ⟨br0,hab0,hb0⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame M p s n x 0 he0 hnc ar hax
    have hbr : br = br0 :=
      (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow).mp inferInstance
        (hab.symm.trans hab0)
    apply hy
    apply (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).toLinearEquiv.injective
    change (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y =
      (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom 0
    rw [←hby,←hb0,hbr]

private theorem short_finite_has_crossing_iff
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (r : ℕ) (s t : ℤ) :
    FiniteHasCrossing model X Y f r
      ((normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f:ℤ)+1) s t ↔
    3 ≤ r ∧ ∃ (x : Ambient model X (s+1,t+1))
      (y : Ambient model Y
        (s+1+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f,
          t+1+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)),
      ∃ W : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f (r-1)
        (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+1) (t+1) x y,
        W.Essential ∧ y ∉ boundaries model Y 2
          (s+1+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f,
            t+1+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a,b,ha,har,hb,H⟩
    have hlen : (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f:ℤ) ≤
        (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f:ℤ)+1-a-b := by
      obtain ⟨x,y,W,_,_⟩ := H
      exact W.length_lower
    have ha1 : a=1 := by omega
    have hb0 : b=0 := by omega
    subst a; subst b
    refine ⟨by omega,?_⟩
    have he : (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f:ℤ)+1-(1:ℕ)-(0:ℕ) =
        normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f := by omega

private theorem shifted_finite_first_kernel_filtration (X : ClassicalObject)

    (a : BiHom (t-s) (t+e)

    FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+1) a := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  by_cases hq1 : q=1
  · subst q
    have hz : a=0 := by
      simpa only [(model.quotients.tower _).rho_id,Category.comp_id] using ha
    rw [hz]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  have h1q : 1<q := by omega
  let T := (model.quotients.tower ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj A)).triangle
    (show 0<1 by decide) h1q
  have haz : a≫T.rho=0 := by
    simpa only [T,(model.quotients.tower _).triangle_rho] using ha
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := (Triangle.mk T.lambdaMap T.rho T.delta).coyoneda_exact₂
    T.distinguished a haz
  change BiHom (t-s) (t+e) ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(1:ℤ))).obj
    (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj A) (q-1))) at b
  change a = b≫T.lambdaMap at hb
  letI := model.exactness.shiftCommShift (0,e)
  letI := model.exactness.shiftExact (0,e)
  obtain ⟨ε,_,_⟩ := quotient_shift_exists model.quotients.coherence (0,e) (q-1) A
  let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(1:ℤ))
  let I : F.obj (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj A) (q-1)) ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e-1)).obj (XModLambdaN A (q-1)) :=
    F.mapIso ε ≪≫
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (0,e) (0,-(1:ℤ))).app _ ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun p => (SyntheticCategory.biShift p).obj (XModLambdaN A (q-1)))
        (by ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg]))

    (t-s) (t+e) (b≫I.hom)
  have hbottom' : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+1) (b≫I.hom) := by
    convert hbottom using 1; omega

    (.shift (0,e-1) (.quotient (q-1) (.nu X)))
    (.shift (0,-(1:ℤ)) (.quotient (q-1) (.shift (0,e) (.nu X)))) I.inv)

    simpa only [FiltrationAtLeast,Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id,Category.comp_id] using hbf
  have hmap := map_preserves_filtration (model.convergentMap
    (.shift (0,-(1:ℤ)) (.quotient (q-1) (.shift (0,e) (.nu X))))
    (.quotient q (.shift (0,e) (.nu X))) T.lambdaMap)
    (t-s,t+e) (s+1) b hbfil

      (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,1)).obj

    ∃ x : Ambient model X (s,t), x ∈ cycles model X q (s,t) ∧
      Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.shift (0,1) (.nu X))))
        (s,t,t+1) (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteNuLabel model X q 1 s t 0 x)) a := by
  letI := model.exactness.shiftCommShift (0,1)
  letI := model.exactness.shiftExact (0,1)
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  obtain ⟨ε₁,hε₁,_⟩ := quotient_shift_exists model.quotients.coherence (0,1) 1 A
  obtain ⟨εq,hεq,_⟩ := quotient_shift_exists model.quotients.coherence (0,1) q A
  let a0 := quotientUnshift X (0,1) (t-s,t) q εq (homotopyRegrade (by simp) rfl a)
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := quotient_first_label_exists X q hq s t a0
  have hcycles := first_label_lift_cycles X q hq s t x a0 hx
  refine ⟨x,hcycles,shifted_finite_source_detects_of_first X q hq 1 s t x hcycles a ?_⟩
  have hunshift : quotientUnshift X (0,1) (t-s,t) 1 ε₁
      (homotopyRegrade (by simp) rfl (a≫(model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 q hq)) =
      quotientUnshift X (0,1) (t-s,t) 1 ε₁
        (homotopyRegrade (by simp) rfl ((model.firstQuotient X 1 s t).symm x)) := by
    rw [positive_first_desuspend X s t x ε₁ hε₁]
    rw [regrade_comp,←quotient_unshift_restriction X (0,1) (t-s,t) 1 q
      (by decide) hq ε₁ εq hε₁ hεq]
    exact hx
  have hh := congrArg (fun z => shiftHomotopyClass (0,1) (t-s,t) z≫ε₁.inv) hunshift
  simp only [shift_quotient_unshift] at hh
  have hinj : Function.Injective (homotopyRegrade
      (show t-s=((t-s,t)+(0,1)).1 by simp) (rfl : t+1=t+1)
      (X:=XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,1)).obj A) 1)) := by
    intro a b hab
    have h := congrArg (homotopyRegrade (show ((t-s,t)+(0,1)).1=t-s by simp)
      (rfl : t+1=t+1)) hab
    simpa only [homotopy_regrade_inverse] using h
  exact hinj hh

    (X : ClassicalObject) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (s t : ℤ)

      Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.shift (0,0) (.nu X))))
        (s,t,t+0) (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteNuLabel model X q 0 s t 0 x)) a := by
  let x := (model.firstQuotient X 0 s t)
    (a≫(model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 q hq)
  have hfirst : a≫(model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 q hq =
      (model.firstQuotient X 0 s t).symm x :=
    ((model.firstQuotient X 0 s t).symm_apply_apply _).symm
  have hfirst0 : homotopyRegrade rfl (show t+0=t by simp) a≫
      (model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 q hq=firstLabel model X s t x := by
    have hh := congrArg (homotopyRegrade rfl (show t+0=t by simp)) hfirst
    rw [regrade_comp] at hh
    have hl : homotopyRegrade rfl (show t+0=t by simp)
        ((model.firstQuotient X 0 s t).symm x)=firstLabel model X s t x := by
      have cast (m w w' : ℤ) (h : w=w') (A : SyntheticSpectrum) (z : BiHom m w A) :
          homotopyRegrade rfl h z=(congrArg (fun v => BiHom m v A) h).mp z := by
        subst w'; rfl
      unfold firstLabel
      exact cast _ _ _ _ _ _
    exact hh.trans hl

    ⟨homotopyRegrade rfl (by simp) a,hfirst0⟩
  have hcycle : x ∈ cycles model X q (s,t) := by
    have hh := ((isCycle_iff_reaches model X (q+1) (by omega) (s,t) x).mpr hreach).2
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hh

      (XModLambdaN ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) q)) :
    ∃ x : Ambient model X (s,t), x ∈ cycles model X q (s,t) ∧
      Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)))
        (s,t,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
        (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteNuLabel model X q
          (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s t 0 x)) a := by
  have core (e : ℤ) (he : e=0 ∨ e=1)
      (a : BiHom (t-s) (t+e) (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,e)).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q)) :
      ∃ x : Ambient model X (s,t), x ∈ cycles model X q (s,t) ∧
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.shift (0,e) (.nu X))))
          (s,t,t+e) (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteNuLabel model X q e s t 0 x)) a := by
    rcases he with rfl | rfl
    · exact zero_finite_source_label_exists X q hq s t a
    · exact positive_finite_source_label_exists X q hq s t a
  exact core (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
    (by have := normalizedExponent_le_one model.classicalTower f; omega) a

private theorem minimal_finite_witness_of_detected_source
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (s t : ℤ)
    (a : BiHom (t-s) (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
      (XModLambdaN ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) q))
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (hx : x∈cycles model X q (s,t))
    (hax : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)))
      (s,t,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
      (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteNuLabel model X q
        (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s t 0 x)) a) :
    ∃ (y : Ambient model Y (s+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f,
        t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)),
      ∃ _W : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f (q+1)
        (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s t x y,
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)))
          (s,t,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
          (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteNuLabel model X q
            (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s t 0 x)) a ∧
        (homotopyRegrade
          (m' := (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)-(s+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f))
          (w' := t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
          (by omega) rfl (a≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q))≫
            (model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 q hq =
          firstLabel model Y (s+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
            (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) y≫
            XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1 := by
  let e : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
  let b : BiHom ((t+e)-(s+e)) (t+e)
      (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) q) :=
    homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl (a≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q)
  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := quotient_first_label_exists Y q hq (s+e) (t+e) b
  have hycycle := first_label_lift_cycles Y q hq (s+e) (t+e) y b hy
  have hby := first_label_detects_unshifted Y q hq (s+e) (t+e) y b hy
  have hsource' : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)))
      (s,(t-s)+s,t+e) (finiteSourceForExtension model X Y f q s t x)
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl a) :=
    source_detects_reindex X q e s t x a hax
  have htarget := detects_transport
    (show (s+e,t+e,t+e)=(s+e,(t-s)+(s+e),t+e) by ext <;> (dsimp; all_goals omega)) _ _ hby
  have label_eq : finiteTargetForExtension model X Y f q e s t le_rfl y =
      regradeE2 (show (s+e,t+e,t+e)=(s+e,(t-s)+(s+e),t+e) by ext <;> (dsimp; all_goals omega))
        (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model Y q (s+e) (t+e) 0 y)) := by
    unfold finiteTargetForExtension
    rw [e2_regrade_trans]
    have labels (k k' : ℕ) (hk : k=k') (p : Tridegree)
        (h₁ : (s+e,t+e,t+e-k)=p) (h₂ : (s+e,t+e,t+e-k')=p) :
        regradeE2 h₁ (finiteTargetLabel model Y q (s+e) (t+e) k y)=
          regradeE2 h₂ (finiteTargetLabel model Y q (s+e) (t+e) k' y) := by
      subst k'; rfl
    exact labels _ _ (by dsimp [e]; omega) _ _ _
  have htarget' : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu Y)))
      (s+e,(t-s)+(s+e),t+e)
      (finiteTargetForExtension model X Y f q e s t le_rfl y)
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl (a≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q)) := by
    rw [label_eq]
    dsimp only [b] at htarget
    have comp {U : SyntheticSpectrum} {u v z w : ℤ}
        (huv : u=v) (hvz : v=z) (a : BiHom u w U) :
        homotopyRegrade hvz rfl (homotopyRegrade huv rfl a)=
          homotopyRegrade (huv.trans hvz) rfl a := by
      subst v; subst z; rfl
    rw [comp] at htarget
    exact htarget
  obtain ⟨xx,yy,hxx,hyy,heq⟩ := extension_equation_of_detected_pair
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient q (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient q (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q))

private theorem short_finite_noCrossing_tower
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0<q) (s t n : ℤ)
    (hn : n ≤ (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f:ℤ)+1)
    (hnc : FiniteNoCrossing model X Y f (q+1) n s t) :
    TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient q (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)) (.quotient q (.nu Y))
      (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s n := by
  intro u v hsu huv hvs x y hess
  have hposition := short_finite_crossing_position X Y f q hq s t n u v hn hsu huv hvs x y hess
  rcases hposition with ⟨hu,hv,hnEq⟩
  subst u; subst v; subst n
  have h1q : 1<q := by
    have H := finite_crossing_source_bound X Y f q hq s t (s+1)
      (s+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f+1) huv x y hess
    omega
  let e : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
  let A := (extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary
  let B := model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)
  let p := (t-s,t+e)
  let M := model.convergentMap (.quotient q (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
    (.quotient q (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q)
  have hrel : TowerExtensionEquation M p (s+1)
      ((s+e+1)-(s+1)) x y := hess.1
  obtain ⟨_,ar,br,hab,hax,hby⟩ := (tower_extension_iff M p (s+1)
    ((s+e+1)-(s+1)) x y).mp hrel
  let a : BiHom (t-s) (t+e) (XModLambdaN A q) :=
    ((model.syntheticTower.filtration (XModLambdaN A q)).F (s+1) p).arrow ar
  have ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+1) a := by
    have H : a∈ModuleCat.subobjectModule _
      ((model.syntheticTower.filtration (XModLambdaN A q)).F (s+1) p) := ⟨ar,rfl⟩
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,FiltrationAtLeast] using H
  have hnot : ¬FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+e+1+1)
      (a≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q) := by
    intro hhigh
    have hzero : y=0 := by
      apply (infinityGradedIso (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu Y)))
        p ((s+1)+((s+e+1)-(s+1)))).toLinearEquiv.injective
      change (infinityGradedIso (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu Y)))
          p ((s+1)+((s+e+1)-(s+1)))).hom y =
        (infinityGradedIso (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu Y)))
          p ((s+1)+((s+e+1)-(s+1)))).hom 0
      rw [←hby,map_zero]
      apply ((model.syntheticTower.filtration
        ((SyntheticObject.quotient q (.nu Y)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).toAssociatedGraded_eq_zero_iff
        ((s+1)+((s+e+1)-(s+1))) p br).mpr
      rw [←hab]
      have hhigh' : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower
          ((s+1)+((s+e+1)-(s+1))+1) (a≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q) := by
        convert hhigh using 1; omega
      simpa only [a,p,A,B,extensionSourceObject,SyntheticObject.obj,
        SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,FiltrationAtLeast]
        using hhigh'
    exact ((tower_essential_iff_no_zero M p (s+1) ((s+e+1)-(s+1)) x y hrel).mp hess)
      (by rwa [←hzero])
  obtain ⟨bS,hbS⟩ := normalized_finite_source_division X e 1 q (by decide) h1q
    (t-s) (t+e) (s+1) (by omega) a ha
  let E := verticalShiftEquiv (XModLambdaN A (q-1)) 1 (t-s) (t+e)
  let b0 := E.symm bS
  let b : BiHom ((t+1)-(s+1)) ((t+1)+e) (XModLambdaN A (q-1)) :=
    homotopyRegrade (by omega) (by omega) b0
  let c0 := b0≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-1)
  let c : BiHom ((t+1+e)-(s+1+e)) (t+1+e) (XModLambdaN B (q-1)) :=
    homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl (b≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-1))
  have hcomm := (model.quotients.natural (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map).lambda_naturality
    (show 0<1 by decide) h1q
  change (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(1:ℤ))).map (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-1))≫
      ((model.quotients.tower B).triangle (show 0<1 by decide) h1q).lambdaMap =
    ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle (show 0<1 by decide) h1q).lambdaMap≫
      finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q at hcomm
  have hactual : verticalShiftEquiv (XModLambdaN B (q-1)) 1 (t-s) (t+e) c0≫
      ((model.quotients.tower B).triangle (show 0<1 by decide) h1q).lambdaMap =
      a≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q := by
    let LA := ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle (show 0<1 by decide) h1q).lambdaMap
    let LB := ((model.quotients.tower B).triangle (show 0<1 by decide) h1q).lambdaMap
    let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(1:ℤ))
    have hcomm' : F.map (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-1))≫LB =
        LA≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q := hcomm
    have hm := congrArg (fun z =>
      verticalShiftEquiv (XModLambdaN A (q-1)) 1 (t-s) (t+e) b0≫z) hcomm'
    have hm' : (verticalShiftEquiv (XModLambdaN A (q-1)) 1 (t-s) (t+e) b0≫
        F.map (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-1)))≫LB =
      (verticalShiftEquiv (XModLambdaN A (q-1)) 1 (t-s) (t+e) b0≫LA)≫
        finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using hm

private theorem finite_extension_at_source_short
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (r : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ) (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (y : Ambient model Y (s+n,t+n))
    (W : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f r n s t x y)
    (hn : n≤(normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f:ℤ)+1)
    (hnc : FiniteNoCrossing model X Y f r n s t)
    (aZ : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (r-1)))
    (haZ : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (r-1) (.nu X))) (s,t,t)
      (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model X (r-1) s t 0 x)) aZ) :
    FiniteExtensionAtSource X Y f r n s t x y W aZ := by
  let q : ℕ := r-1
  let e : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
  have hq : 0<q := by dsimp [q]; have := W.page_ge_two; omega
  have hpage : q+1=r := by dsimp [q]; have := W.page_ge_two; omega
  have hFinite : FiniteNoCrossing model X Y f (q+1) n s t := by
    simpa only [hpage] using hnc
  have hTower := short_finite_noCrossing_tower X Y f q hq s t n hn hFinite
  let p := (t-s,t+e)
  obtain ⟨_,ar,br,hab,hax,hby⟩ := (tower_extension_iff _ p s n W.source W.target).mp W.equation
  let ah : BiHom (t-s) (t+e)
      ((SyntheticObject.quotient q (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) :=
    ((model.syntheticTower.filtration
      ((SyntheticObject.quotient q (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).F s p).arrow ar
  have hs := source_frame_detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)))
    p s W.source _ W.source_rep ar hax
  have hsNative := source_detects_native X q e s t x ah hs
  have hx : x∈cycles model X q (s,t) := by
    have H := ((isCycle_iff_reaches model X r (by have := W.page_ge_two; omega) (s,t) x).mpr
      W.source_cycle).2
    have hlevel : (q:ℤ)=(r:ℤ)-1 := by dsimp [q]; have := W.page_ge_two; omega
    rw [hlevel]
    exact H
  obtain ⟨y0,Wmin,_,_⟩ := minimal_finite_witness_of_detected_source X Y f q hq s t ah x hx hsNative
  obtain ⟨ahNew,hsNew,_,huNew⟩ := finite_extension_at_source_minimal X Y f (q+1)
    e s t x y0 Wmin le_rfl aZ haZ
  exact extension_at_source_of_normalized_source X Y f r n s t x y W aZ ahNew hsNew huNew hTower

private theorem layer_identity_two (X : Spectrum) (s : ℤ) :
    (𝟙 ((model.classicalTower.tower X).layer s) : _ ⟶ _) + 𝟙 _ = 0 := by
  let T := model.classicalTower.tower X
  have cofib_transport (a b c d : ℕ) (ha : a=c) (hb : b=d)
      (h : a≤b) (h' : c≤d) :
      HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib (T.map h) = HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib (T.map h') := by
    subst c; subst d; rfl
  by_cases hs : 0 ≤ s
  · have he : T.layer s = HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib (T.map (Nat.le_succ s.toNat)) := by
      dsimp [AbstractAdamsTower.layer,AbstractAdamsTower.mapAt]
      have hs1 : (s+1).toNat=s.toNat+1 := by omega
      exact cofib_transport _ _ _ _ rfl hs1 _ _
    let e : T.layer s ≅ model.coefficients.object ⊗ T.stage s.toNat :=
      eqToIso he ≪≫ T.layerIso s.toNat
    apply (cancel_epi e.inv).mp
    apply (cancel_mono e.hom).mp
    change (e.inv ≫ (𝟙 (T.layer s) + 𝟙 (T.layer s))) ≫ e.hom = (e.inv ≫ 0) ≫ e.hom
    rw [Preadditive.comp_add,Preadditive.add_comp,Category.comp_id,
      Iso.inv_hom_id,comp_zero,zero_comp]
    exact tensor_coefficient_identity_two (T.stage s.toNat)
  · have hs0 : s.toNat=0 := by omega
    have hs10 : (s+1).toNat=0 := by omega
    have he : T.layer s = HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib (𝟙 (T.stage 0)) := by
      dsimp only [AbstractAdamsTower.layer,AbstractAdamsTower.mapAt]
      exact (cofib_transport _ _ _ _ hs0 hs10 _ (le_refl 0)).trans
        (congrArg HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib (T.map_self 0))
    have hz : IsZero (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib (𝟙 (T.stage 0))) :=
      (Triangle.mk _ _ _).isZero₃_of_isIso₁ (HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib_distinguished (𝟙 (T.stage 0))) (by change IsIso (𝟙 (T.stage 0)); infer_instance)
    have hz' : IsZero (T.layer s) := he.symm ▸ hz
    exact hz'.eq_of_tgt _ _
statement:
private theorem layer_identity_two (X : Spectrum) (s : ℤ) :
    (𝟙 ((model.classicalTower.tower X).layer s) : _ ⟶ _) + 𝟙 _ = 0

  let D := (model.classical.obj X).ssData p

    simpa only [map_add,map_zero] using ambient_two X p ((D.Z j).arrow z)

private theorem finite_target_rep_add_boundary (X : ClassicalObject)
    (q k : ℕ) (hkq : k<q) (s t : ℤ) (x b : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (hb : b∈boundaries model X (k+1) (s,t))
    (e : ((model.family.quotient (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q).sequence.ssData
      (s,t,t-k)).eInfty)
    (hx : HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,t,t-k) (finiteTargetLabel model X q s t k x) e) :
    HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,t,t-k) (finiteTargetLabel model X q s t k (x+b)) e := by
  have hlabel (z : Ambient model X (s,t)) : nuWeightLabel model X s t (t-k) (by omega) z =
      targetNuLabel model X s t k z := by
    have hk' : (t-(t-k)).toNat=k := by omega
    have transport (a b : ℕ) (hab : a=b)
        (h : (s,t,t-a)=(s,t,t-b)) :
        regradeE2 h (targetNuLabel model X s t a z) = targetNuLabel model X s t b z := by
      subst b; rfl
    exact transport _ k hk' _
  have hrep := KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_finite_labels X q (by omega)
    s t (t-k) (by omega) x e
  rw [hlabel] at hrep
  obtain ⟨hxc,hxe⟩ := hrep.mp hx
  have hbc : b∈cycles model X (q-t+(t-k)) (s,t) :=
    boundaries_le_cycles model X (s,t) (k+1) _ hb
  have hxbc := (cycles model X (q-t+(t-k)) (s,t)).add_mem hxc hbc
  have hb' : b∈boundaries model X (1+t-(t-k)) (s,t) := by
    convert hb using 1; congr 1; omega
  have hbzero : subquotientClass (cycles model X (q-t+(t-k)) (s,t))
      (boundaries model X (1+t-(t-k)) (s,t)) ⟨b,hbc⟩=0 :=
    (CrossingLabels.subquotient_zero_iff _ _ _).mpr hb'
  have hclass : subquotientClass (cycles model X (q-t+(t-k)) (s,t))
      (boundaries model X (1+t-(t-k)) (s,t)) ⟨x+b,hxbc⟩=
      subquotientClass (cycles model X (q-t+(t-k)) (s,t))
        (boundaries model X (1+t-(t-k)) (s,t)) ⟨x,hxc⟩ := by
    change subquotientClass _ _ (⟨x,hxc⟩+⟨b,hbc⟩)=_
    rw [map_add,hbzero,add_zero]
  have hrep' := KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_finite_labels X q (by omega)
    s t (t-k) (by omega) (x+b) e
  rw [hlabel] at hrep'
  exact hrep'.mpr ⟨hxbc,hxe.trans hclass.symm⟩
statement:

    (e : ((model.family.quotient (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q).sequence.ssData

private def finite_extension_target_add_boundary (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (r : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ) (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (y b : Ambient model Y (s+n,t+n))
    (W : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f r n s t x y)
    (hb : b∈boundaries model Y (1+n-normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+n,t+n)) :
    FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f r n s t x (y+b) := by
  let k : ℕ := (n-normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f).toNat
  have hk : (k:ℤ)=n-normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f :=
    Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by have := W.length_lower; omega)
  have hkq : k<r-1 := by have := W.length_upper; have := W.page_ge_two; omega
  have hb' : b∈boundaries model Y (k+1) (s+n,t+n) := by
    convert hb using 1; congr 1; omega
  have hcycle : ReachesPage (model.classical.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary))
      ((r:ℤ)-n+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+n,t+n) (y+b) := by
    have hyr := (isCycle_iff_reaches model Y _ W.target_page_ge_two (s+n,t+n) y).mpr W.target_cycle
    exact (isCycle_iff_reaches model Y _ W.target_page_ge_two (s+n,t+n) (y+b)).mp
      (cycle_add_boundary Y _ _ _ y b hyr hb)
  have hp : (s+n,t+n,(t+n)-(k:ℤ))=
      (s+n,(t-s)+(s+n),t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) := by
    ext <;> dsimp <;> omega
  have repr {A : SyntheticAdamsSS} {p p' : Tridegree} (h : p=p')
      (z : A.E₂ p) (e : (A.sequence.ssData p').eInfty) :
      HasInfinityRepresentative A 2 p' (regradeE2 h z) e ↔
        HasInfinityRepresentative A 2 p z
          ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun p => (A.sequence.ssData p).eInfty) h.symm)) e) := by
    subst p'
    simp only [regradeE2,eqToHom_refl,ModuleCat.id_apply]
  have hwrep := W.target_rep
  change HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 _
    (regradeE2 hp (finiteTargetLabel model Y (r-1) (s+n) (t+n) k y)) W.target at hwrep
  have hnativ := (repr hp _ _).mp hwrep
  have hnew := finite_target_rep_add_boundary Y (r-1) k hkq (s+n) (t+n) y b hb' _ hnativ
  refine { W with target_cycle := hcycle, target_rep := ?_ }
  change HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 _
    (regradeE2 hp (finiteTargetLabel model Y (r-1) (s+n) (t+n) k (y+b))) W.target
  exact (repr hp _ _).mpr hnew

private theorem suspension_desuspends_add (X : ClassicalObject) (s t : ℤ)
    (sx sb : Ambient model (.shift 1 X) (s,t))

    (hx : (model.classicalSuspension X).DesuspendsClass s t sx x)
    (hb : (model.classicalSuspension X).DesuspendsClass s t sb b) :
    (model.classicalSuspension X).DesuspendsClass s t (sx+sb) (x+b) := by
  obtain ⟨a,c,ha,hc,hac⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨a',c',ha',hc',hac'⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨a+a',c+c',?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [map_add,ha,ha']
  · rw [map_add,hc,hc']
  · simpa only [map_add,Submodule.coe_add] using congrArg₂ (fun x y => x+y) hac hac'

        firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1 ∧

        (s+k+1,t+k,t+k-(k-i:ℕ))
        (finiteTargetLabel model X (k+1-i) (s+k+1) (t+k) (k-i) y)
        (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) (by dsimp; omega)
          (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (i:ℤ) (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (k+1-i))
            (a ≫ ((model.quotients.tower _).triangle hi (show i < k+1 by omega)).delta))) := by

      (i k : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hik : i ≤ k) (s t : ℤ)
      (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
      (y : Ambient model X (s+k+1,t+k))
      (hd : HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
        (k+1) (s,t) (s+k+1,t+k) x y)
      (hy : y ∈ KIP126.Literature.permanentCycles model X (s+k+1,t+k)) :
      let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
      let δ : XModLambdaN A k ⟶
          ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).obj (XModLambdaN A 1))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧ := by
        simpa only [show k.succ-k=1 by omega] using
          ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle (show 0<k by omega) (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).delta
      ∃ (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN A k))
          (α : BiHom ((t+k)-(s+k+1)) (t+k) A),
        a ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho 1 k (by omega) =
          firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) 1 ∧
        α ≫ XModLambdaN.incl A 1 =
          firstLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) y ≫
            XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) 1 ∧
        homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl
            (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (k:ℤ) (XModLambdaN A 1) (a ≫ δ)) =
          α ≫ XModLambdaN.incl A 1 ∧
        (a ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho i k hik) ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho 1 i hi =
          firstLabel model X s t x ≫
            XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) 1 := by
    dsimp only
    let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
    obtain ⟨a,ha,had⟩ := adjacent_mahowald_case X k (by omega) s t x y hd
    obtain ⟨α0,hα0⟩ := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.selected_permanent_lift X (s+k+1) (t+k) y).mp (by
      obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hy
      refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
      have h := normalizeInitialProjection
        ((model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).ssData (s+k+1,t+k))
        (↑(2-(model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)).r₀).toNat)
        ⊤ (by rw [model.classical.firstPage]; rfl) le_top
      exact (congrArg (fun f => f z) h).trans hz)
    let α : BiHom ((t+k)-(s+k+1)) (t+k) A :=
      α0 ≫ SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A
    have hα : α ≫ XModLambdaN.incl A 1 =
        firstLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) y ≫
          XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) 1 := by
      dsimp only [α]
      rw [Category.assoc,XModLambdaN.incl_naturality,←Category.assoc]
      exact congrArg (fun z => z ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) 1) hα0
    have hαρ : (α ≫ XModLambdaN.incl A 1) ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho 1 1 (by decide) =
        firstLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) y ≫
          XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) 1 := by
      rw [(model.quotients.tower A).rho_id,Category.comp_id]
      exact hα
    have hαd := first_label_detects_unshifted X 1 (by decide)
      (s+k+1) (t+k) y (α ≫ XModLambdaN.incl A 1) hαρ
    refine ⟨a,α,ha,hα,?_,?_⟩
    · exact finite_top_detection_unique X 1 (by decide)
        (s+k+1) (t+k) (t+k) (by omega) _ _ _ had hαd
    · rw [Category.assoc,(model.quotients.tower A).rho_comp hi hik]

  have selected_delta_cross_index_of_inclusion_square
       (X : ClassicalObject)
      (i k j : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hik : i ≤ k) (hkj : k < j)
      (v : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).obj
          (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (j-k)) ⟶
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).obj
          (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (j-i)))
      (hv : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).map
          (XModLambdaN.incl (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (j-k)) ≫ v =
        lambdaRestrictionSourceMap i k hik (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) ≫
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map
            (XModLambdaN.incl (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (j-i)))
      (m w : ℤ)
      (a : BiHom m w (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) k)) :

          ((model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).triangle hi

        (a ≫ ((model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).triangle

    let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
    rw [selected_delta_evaluation_eq_cofiber X i j,
      selected_delta_evaluation_eq_cofiber X k j]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [model.quotients.restriction]
    rw [←Category.assoc (XModLambdaN.restriction model.quotients.coherence A i k hik),
      quotient_restriction_boundary]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [←Functor.map_comp,←hv,Functor.map_comp]

  have canonical_finite_lambda_transition_exists {X : SyntheticSpectrum}
      (Q : FiniteLambdaQuotientTower X) (i k q : ℕ) (hik : i < k) (hdq : k-i < q) :
      ∃ v : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).obj (XModLambdaN X (q-(k-i))) ⟶
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).obj (XModLambdaN X q),
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl X (q-(k-i))) ≫ v =
          lambdaRestrictionSourceMap i k hik.le X ≫
            (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl X q) ∧
        v = (lambdaShiftAddIso (k-i) i k (Nat.sub_add_cancel hik.le)).inv.app
            (XModLambdaN X (q-(k-i))) ≫
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map
            (Q.triangle (by omega : 0 < k-i) hdq).lambdaMap := by
    let l := (Q.triangle (by omega : 0 < k-i) hdq).lambdaMap
    have hl : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-((k-i:ℕ):ℤ))).map
        (XModLambdaN.incl X (q-(k-i))) ≫ l = lambdaPow (k-i) X ≫ XModLambdaN.incl X q :=
      (Q.triangle (by omega : 0 < k-i) hdq).lambda_quotient
    refine ⟨(lambdaShiftAddIso (k-i) i k (Nat.sub_add_cancel hik.le)).inv.app
        (XModLambdaN X (q-(k-i))) ≫ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map l,?_,rfl⟩
    rw [←Category.assoc,NatTrans.naturality,Category.assoc]
    change (lambdaShiftAddIso (k-i) i k (Nat.sub_add_cancel hik.le)).inv.app X ≫
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map
          ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-((k-i:ℕ):ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl X (q-(k-i)))) ≫
            (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map l = _
    rw [←Functor.map_comp,hl,Functor.map_comp]
    simp only [lambdaRestrictionSourceMap,KIP126.Synthetic.Context.lambdaDegree,Category.assoc]

  have selected_cross_index_normalized
      
      (i k : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hik : i < k) :
      ∃ v : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).obj
          (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) 1) ⟶
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).obj
          (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (k+1-i)),
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ 1) ≫ v =
          lambdaRestrictionSourceMap i k hik.le _ ≫
            (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ (k+1-i)) ∧
        ∀ (m w : ℤ) (a : BiHom m w (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) k)),
          (a ≫ (model.quotients.tower _).rho i k hik.le) ≫
            ((model.quotients.tower _).triangle hi (show i < k+1 by omega)).delta =
          (a ≫ (by simpa only [show k.succ-k=1 by omega] using
            ((model.quotients.tower _).triangle (show 0 < k by omega) (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).delta)) ≫
            (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map v := by
    let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
    let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(k:ℤ))
    have hv_exists : ∃ v : F.obj (XModLambdaN A 1) ⟶
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).obj (XModLambdaN A (k+1-i)),
        F.map (XModLambdaN.incl A 1) ≫ v =
          lambdaRestrictionSourceMap i k hik.le A ≫
            (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl A (k+1-i)) := by
      have raw : ∃ v : F.obj (XModLambdaN A ((k+1-i)-(k-i))) ⟶
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).obj (XModLambdaN A (k+1-i)),
          F.map (XModLambdaN.incl A ((k+1-i)-(k-i))) ≫ v =
            lambdaRestrictionSourceMap i k hik.le A ≫
              (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl A (k+1-i)) := by
        obtain ⟨v,hv,_⟩ := canonical_finite_lambda_transition_exists
          (model.quotients.tower A) i k (k+1-i) hik (by omega)
        exact ⟨v,hv⟩
      exact (congrArg (fun n => ∃ v : F.obj (XModLambdaN A n) ⟶

    let c : XModLambdaN A (k+1-k) ⟶ XModLambdaN A 1 :=

    have incl_cast (n n' : ℕ) (h : n=n') :

    have hvraw : F.map (XModLambdaN.incl A (k+1-k)) ≫ (F.map c ≫ v) =

      rw [←Category.assoc,←Functor.map_comp]
      dsimp only [c]
      rw [incl_cast (k+1-k) 1 hn]

      subst n'
      simp only [eqToHom_refl,CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,Category.comp_id]
      rfl
    refine ⟨v,hv,?_⟩
    intro m w a
    have hc := selected_delta_cross_index_of_inclusion_square X
      i k (k+1) hi hik.le (Nat.lt_succ_self k) (F.map c ≫ v) hvraw m w a
    have hδ : ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle (show 0 < k by omega) (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).delta ≫
          (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map (F.map c) =
        (by simpa only [show k.succ-k=1 by omega] using
          ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle (show 0 < k by omega) (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).delta) := by
      exact cast_delta (fun n => XModLambdaN A n) F (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)) (XModLambdaN A k)
        (k+1-k) 1 hn _ _
    refine hc.trans ?_
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    have h := congrArg (fun z => (a ≫ z) ≫ (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map v) hδ
    simpa only [Category.assoc,A,ClassicalObject.obj] using h

  have selected_boundary_of_normalized_cross
      
      (i k : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hik : i < k) (s t : ℤ)
      (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
      (y : Ambient model X (s+k+1,t+k))
      (hd : HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
        (k+1) (s,t) (s+k+1,t+k) x y)
      (hy : y ∈ KIP126.Literature.permanentCycles model X (s+k+1,t+k))
      (v : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).obj
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) 1) ⟶
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).obj
          (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (k+1-i)))
      (hv : (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ 1) ≫ v =
        lambdaRestrictionSourceMap i k hik.le _ ≫
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map (XModLambdaN.incl _ (k+1-i)))
      (hc : ∀ (a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) k)),
        (a ≫ (model.quotients.tower _).rho i k hik.le) ≫
          ((model.quotients.tower _).triangle hi (show i < k+1 by omega)).delta =
        (a ≫ (by simpa only [show k.succ-k=1 by omega] using
          ((model.quotients.tower _).triangle (show 0 < k by omega) (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).delta)) ≫
          (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map v) :
      ∃ a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i),

        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (k+1-i) (.nu X)))
          (s+k+1,t+k,t+k-(k-i:ℕ))
          (finiteTargetLabel model X (k+1-i) (s+k+1) (t+k) (k-i) y)
          (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) (by dsimp; omega)
            (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (i:ℤ) (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (k+1-i))
              (a ≫ ((model.quotients.tower _).triangle hi (show i < k+1 by omega)).delta))) := by
    let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
    let δ : XModLambdaN A k ⟶
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).obj (XModLambdaN A 1))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧ := by
      simpa only [show k.succ-k=1 by omega] using
        ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle (show 0 < k by omega) (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).delta
    obtain ⟨ak,α,ha,hα,hδ,hfirst⟩ := adjacent_selected_representative_and_target_lift
      i k hi hik.le s t x y hd hy
    let α' : BiHom ((t-s)-1) (t+k) A := homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl α
    have regrade_comp {m m' w w' : ℤ} (hm : m=m') (hw : w=w')
        {A B : SyntheticSpectrum} (a : BiHom m w A) (f : A ⟶ B) :
        homotopyRegrade hm hw (a≫f) = homotopyRegrade hm hw a ≫ f := by
      subst m'; subst w'; rfl
    have regrade_compose {m m' m'' w w' w'' : ℤ}
        (hm : m=m') (hw : w=w') (hm' : m'=m'') (hw' : w'=w'')
        {B : SyntheticSpectrum} (b : BiHom m w B) :
        homotopyRegrade hm' hw' (homotopyRegrade hm hw b) =
          homotopyRegrade (hm.trans hm') (hw.trans hw') b := by
      subst m'; subst w'; subst m''; subst w''; rfl
    have undo_regrade {n n' w : ℤ} (hn : n=n') {B C : SyntheticSpectrum}
        (a : BiHom n w B) (b : BiHom n' w C) (f : C ⟶ B)
        (h : homotopyRegrade hn rfl a = b ≫ f) :
        a = homotopyRegrade hn.symm rfl b ≫ f := by
      subst n'
      exact h
    have hδ' : biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (k:ℤ) (XModLambdaN A 1) (ak≫δ) =
        α' ≫ XModLambdaN.incl A 1 := by
      exact undo_regrade (by omega) _ α (XModLambdaN.incl A 1) hδ
    have hδactual : ak≫δ =
        (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (k:ℤ) A).symm α' ≫
          (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).map
            (XModLambdaN.incl A 1)) := by
      apply (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (k:ℤ) (XModLambdaN A 1)).injective
      rw [hδ',bi_susp_natural model.quotients.coherence,AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have heval : biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (i:ℤ) (XModLambdaN A (k+1-i))
        ((ak ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho i k hik.le) ≫
          ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hi (show i < k+1 by omega)).delta) =
        homotopyRegrade rfl (by omega)
          (lambdaMultiply (k-i) α' ≫ XModLambdaN.incl A (k+1-i)) := by
      rw [hc,hδactual,Category.assoc,←Functor.map_comp,hv]
      exact lambda_transition_evaluation model.quotients.coherence i k hik.le (k+1-i) (t-s) t A α'
    refine ⟨ak ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho i k hik.le,hfirst,?_⟩
    rw [heval]
    have hcal := finite_lambda_detects X (k+1-i) (k-i) (by omega) (by omega)
      (s+k+1) (t+k) y hy α hα
    have cancel_lambda_regrade {n n' w w' : ℤ} (hn : n=n') (d : ℕ)
        (hw : w-(d:ℤ)=w') {B C : SyntheticSpectrum} (a : BiHom n w B) (f : B ⟶ C) :
        homotopyRegrade hn.symm hw.symm
          (homotopyRegrade rfl hw
            (lambdaMultiply d (homotopyRegrade hn rfl a) ≫ f)) =
          lambdaMultiply d a ≫ f := by
      subst n'
      subst w'
      rfl
    have hlast := cancel_lambda_regrade
      (show (t+k)-(s+k+1)=(t-s)-1 by omega) (k-i)
      (show (t+k)-(k-i:ℕ)=t+i by omega) α (XModLambdaN.incl A (k+1-i))
    exact (congrArg (Detects (model.convergence (.quotient (k+1-i) (.nu X)))
      (s+k+1,t+k,t+k-(k-i:ℕ))
      (finiteTargetLabel model X (k+1-i) (s+k+1) (t+k) (k-i) y)) hlast).mpr hcal

  obtain ⟨v,hv,hc⟩ := selected_cross_index_normalized i k hi hik
  exact selected_boundary_of_normalized_cross i k hi hik s t x y hd hy
    v hv (hc (t-s) t)

private theorem selected_mahowald_case (X : ClassicalObject)
    (i q : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hq : 0 < q) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (y : Ambient model X (s+i+q,t+i+q-1))
    (hd : HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      (i+q) (s,t) (s+i+q,t+i+q-1) x y)
    (hy : y ∈ KIP126.Literature.permanentCycles model X (s+i+q,t+i+q-1)) :
    let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
    let δ : XModLambdaN A i ⟶
        ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).obj (XModLambdaN A q))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧ := by
      simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using
        ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)).delta
    ∃ a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN A i),
      a ≫ (model.quotients.tower A).rho 1 i hi =
        firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app A) 1 ∧
      Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))) (s+i+q,t+i+q-1,t+i)
        (regradeE2 (by exact congrArg (fun w : ℤ => (s+i+q,t+i+q-1,w)) (by omega))
          (finiteTargetLabel model X q (s+i+q) (t+i+q-1) (q-1) y))
        (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl
          (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (i:ℤ) (XModLambdaN A q) (a≫δ))) := by

      (XModLambdaN (nuZero model .sphere) 1) ≃ₗ[ℤ] Ambient model .sphere (s,t))
      (Int.add_zero t)) (model.firstQuotient .sphere 0 s t)
  change c ((firstLabel model .sphere s t y ≫ Q.hom) ≫ Q.inv) = y
  rw [Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id,Category.comp_id]

          Ambient model .sphere (s,t)) h).mp e).symm z := by
    subst m

    exact cast_symm (t+0) t (Int.add_zero t) (model.firstQuotient .sphere 0 s t) y

private theorem sphere_finite_lambda_detects 
    (q : ℕ) (_hq : 0 < q) (s t : ℤ) (k : ℕ)
    (y : Ambient model .sphere (s,t))
    (α : BiHom (t-s) t (model.nu.functor.obj SphereSpectrum))
    (hα : α ≫ XModLambdaN.incl _ 1 =
      firstLabel model .sphere s t y ≫
        XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1) :
    Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu .sphere))) (s,t,t-k)
      (finiteTargetLabel model .sphere q s t k y)
      (lambdaMultiply k α ≫ XModLambdaN.incl _ q) := by
  have family_page_id (X : SyntheticSpectrum) (r : ℤ) (i : Tridegree) :
      familyPageMap model.family (𝟙 X) r i = 𝟙 _ := by
    change (model.family.map (𝟙 X)).pageMap r i = 𝟙 _
    rw [SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_id,SpectralSequenceMorphism.pageMap_id]
  let a : BiHom (t-s) t (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum) := α ≫ model.nu.unitIso.hom
  have hfirst : quotientClass 1 a =
      firstLabel model .sphere s t y ≫ XModLambdaN.map
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _ ≫ model.nu.unitIso.hom) 1 := by
    dsimp only [quotientClass,a]
    rw [Category.assoc,XModLambdaN.incl_naturality,←Category.assoc,hα,
      Category.assoc,←model.quotients.functoriality.map_comp]
    rfl
  have hl : (sphereFirstQuotient model.nu model.quotients.functoriality model.firstQuotient) s t (quotientClass 1 a) = y := by
    rw [hfirst]
    exact sphere_first_quotient_label s t y
  have hs := model.sphereDetectionCompatible.homotopy_lambda s t k a
  rw [hl] at hs
  have hforw : familyPageMap model.family model.nu.unitIso.hom 2 (s,t,t-k)
      (targetNuLabel model .sphere s t k y) = model.comparison.sphereE2 s t k y := by
    let z : (model.family.obj (nuZero model .sphere)).E₂ (s,t,t-k) := by
      simpa [SyntheticAdamsSS.E₂] using model.comparison.nuE2 .sphere 0 s t k y
    exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (family_page_comp
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) model.nu.unitIso.hom 2 (s,t,t-k)) z).trans
        (model.comparison.sphere_nu s t k y)
  have hback : familyPageMap model.family model.nu.unitIso.inv 2 (s,t,t-k)
      (model.comparison.sphereE2 s t k y) = targetNuLabel model .sphere s t k y := by
    rw [←hforw,←ModuleCat.comp_apply,family_page_comp,Iso.hom_inv_id,family_page_id]
    rfl
  have hc : lambdaMultiply k a ≫ model.nu.unitIso.inv = lambdaMultiply k α := by
    dsimp only [lambdaMultiply,a]
    simp only [Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id,Category.comp_id]
  have hn := detects_map .sphere (.nu .sphere) model.nu.unitIso.inv
    (s,t,t-k) _ _ hs
  have hn' : Detects (model.convergence (.nu .sphere)) (s,t,t-k)
      (targetNuLabel model .sphere s t k y) (lambdaMultiply k α) := by
    exact (congrArg₂ (Detects (model.convergence (.nu .sphere)) (s,t,t-k)) hback hc).mp hn
  exact detects_map (.nu .sphere) (.quotient q (.nu .sphere))
    (XModLambdaN.incl _ q) (s,t,t-k) _ _ hn'

    ∃ b : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((model.syntheticTower.filtration
      ((SyntheticObject.shift δ A).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).F s (p+δ)) : ModuleCat ℤ),

          (((model.syntheticTower.filtration (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).F s p).arrow a) ∧
      (model.syntheticTower.filtration ((SyntheticObject.shift δ A).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).toAssociatedGraded
        s (p+δ) b = (infinityGradedIso (model.convergence (.shift δ A)) (p+δ) s).hom

            ((essShift δ).filtered A p) s).hom e) := by

      ((essShift δ).ambient_eq A p _)
  · have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (S.projection_comm s) a
    simp only [ModuleCat.comp_apply] at h
    rw [ha] at h

    change (S.gradedIso s).hom ((towerGradedIso (model.convergence A) p s).hom e) =
      (towerGradedIso (model.convergence (.shift δ A)) (p+δ) s).hom
        ((towerInfinityIso (model.convergence A) (model.convergence (.shift δ A)) S s).hom e)
    simp only [towerInfinityIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, ←ModuleCat.comp_apply,

private theorem finite_lambda_detects (X : ClassicalObject) (q k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hkq : k < q)
    (s t : ℤ) (y : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (hy : y ∈ permanentCycles model X (s,t))
    (α : BiHom (t-s) t (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)))
    (hα : α ≫ XModLambdaN.incl _ 1 = firstLabel model X s t y ≫
      XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1) :
    Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))) (s,t,t-k)
      (finiteTargetLabel model X q s t k y)
      (lambdaMultiply k α ≫ XModLambdaN.incl _ q) := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let n := q-k
  have hn : 0 < n := by dsimp [n]; omega
  let a := α ≫ XModLambdaN.incl A n
  have ha := first_label_detects_unshifted X n hn s t y a (by
    dsimp only [a]
    rw [Category.assoc,(model.quotients.tower A).rho_quotient]
    exact hα)
  have hsource : (s,t,t)=(s,(t-s)+s,t) := by simp
  have hstem := detects_transport hsource _ _ ha
  let L : ((SyntheticObject.shift (0,-(k:ℤ)) (.quotient n (.nu X))).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) ⟶
      ((SyntheticObject.quotient q (.nu X)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) :=
    ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hk hkq).lambdaMap
  have hmap := shifted_map_detects (.quotient n (.nu X)) (.quotient q (.nu X))
    (0,-(k:ℤ)) (t-s,t) s L
    (regradeE2 hsource (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model X n s t 0 y))) a hstem
  have hindex : (s,((t-s,t)+(0,-(k:ℤ))).1+s,((t-s,t)+(0,-(k:ℤ))).2) =
      (s,t,t-k) := by ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hmap := detects_transport hindex _ _ hmap
  obtain ⟨e,he,b,hb,hgb⟩ := hmap
  obtain ⟨e0,he0,_⟩ := ha
  have heStem := representative_transport hsource _ _ he0
  have heMap := shifted_representative_map (.quotient n (.nu X)) (.quotient q (.nu X))
    (0,-(k:ℤ)) (t-s,t) s L _ _ heStem
  have heMap := representative_transport hindex _ _ heMap
  have heq := he.unique heMap
  have heq' : e = KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityFiniteLambda X q k hkq (s,t) t e0 := by
    convert heq using 1
    simp only [KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityFiniteLambda,
      InfinityShiftCoordinates.finiteLambdaMap, show k ≠ 0 by omega, ↓reduceDIte,
      InfinityShiftCoordinates.shift, infinityShift, Iso.trans_hom, ModuleCat.comp_apply,
      eqToIso.hom, KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityShiftData,
      KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityShift_comparison]
    rw [infinity_map_regrade L hindex]
    rfl
  have hlabel : HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,t,t-k)
      (finiteTargetLabel model X q s t k y)
      (KIP126.Literature.Standard.infinityFiniteLambda X q k hkq (s,t) t e0) := by
    apply (finite_target_label_iff X q (by omega) s t k hkq
      ⟨y,permanentCycles_le_cycles model X (s,t) _ hy⟩ _).mpr
    rw [KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_lambda_finite X q k hkq (s,t) t (by dsimp [n] at hn; omega)]
    have he0' := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_finite_labels X n hn s t t
      (by constructor <;> dsimp [n] at * <;> omega) y e0).mp
      ((congrArg (fun z => HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,t,t) z e0)
        (zero_weight_label X n s t y)).mpr he0)
    rw [he0'.2]
    rfl
  have heFinal : HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,t,t-k)
      (finiteTargetLabel model X q s t k y) e := by
    simpa only [heq'] using hlabel
  refine ⟨e,heFinal,b,?_,hgb⟩
  convert hb using 1
  simp only [regrade_comp]
  simp only [regrade_precomp, L, a, shiftHomotopyClass, lambdaMultiply,
    Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hk hkq).lambda_quotient,
    ←Category.assoc ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(k:ℤ))).map α), lambdaPow_naturality]
  simp only [←Category.assoc,eqToHom_trans]
  rfl

    (hy : y ∈ permanentCycles model X (s,t))
    (α : BiHom (t-s) t (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)))
    (hα : α ≫ XModLambdaN.incl _ 1 = firstLabel model X s t y ≫
      XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1) :

private theorem sphere_source_actual_mahowald_second_image
    (T : TriangleData model.auxiliary)
    (he : (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f : ℤ) +
      normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g + normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.h = 1)
    (hT : NormalizedTriangleCompatible model T he) (hY : T.Y = .sphere)
    (i q : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hq : 0 < q)
    (M W m sy ty : ℤ) (hM : M-1=ty-sy)
    (hW : W+i=ty+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g)
    (hqZ : (q:ℤ)=m-normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g+1)
    (y : Ambient model T.Y (sy,ty)) (yBar : Ambient model T.Z (sy+m,ty+m))
    (Wg : FiniteExtensionWitness model T.Y T.Z T.g (q+1) m sy ty y yBar)
    (pBar : ℤ×ℤ) (xBar : Ambient model T.Z pBar)
    (hd : HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary))
      (i+q) pBar (sy+m,ty+m) xBar yBar)
    (hyBar : yBar ∈ permanentCycles model T.Z (sy+m,ty+m)) :
    let a : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g
    let e : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f+a
    let b : ℤ := (i:ℤ)+e
    let A := extensionSourceObject model T.Y T.Z T.g
    let G : A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ model.nu.functor.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary) :=
      (model.normalizedMap T.Y T.Z T.g).map
    let Cg := HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib G
    let Xν := model.nu.functor.obj (T.X.obj model.auxiliary)
    let Yν := model.nu.functor.obj (T.Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    let Zν := model.nu.functor.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary)
    let C₀ := SyntheticObject.shift (0,b) (.quotient (i+q) (.nu T.X))
    let D₀ := SyntheticObject.shift (0,(i:ℤ)+a) (.quotient (i+q) (.nu T.Y))
    ∀ (eQ : XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,e)).obj Xν) (i+q) ≅
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,e)).obj (XModLambdaN Xν (i+q)))
      (eA : XModLambdaN (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (i+q) ≅
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,a)).obj (XModLambdaN Yν (i+q)))
      (esusp : XModLambdaN ((A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧) (i+q) ≅
          (XModLambdaN (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (i+q))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)
      (_hesusp : XModLambdaN.incl ((A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧) (i+q)≫esusp.hom =
          (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map (XModLambdaN.incl (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (i+q))),

        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-(i:ℤ))).obj (C₀.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) :=
        commonCofiberTargetIso e (normalized_g_cofiber_iso T he hT) i (i+q) eQ
      let eD : XModLambdaN ((A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧) (i+q) ≅
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-(i:ℤ))).obj (D₀.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) :=
        commonEdgeTargetFlatIso Yν a i q esusp eA
      let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(i:ℤ))
      let L := (model.quotients.tower Zν).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)
      let f := F.map (XModLambdaN.map G (i+q-i))≫L.lambdaMap
      let ff := SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (1,-(i:ℤ))
      ∀ (φ : HasFunctorialCofiber.cofib f ⟶ XModLambdaN Cg (i+q))

    (hgapC : (r:ℤ)≤q+b-a) (hgapD : (r:ℤ)≤q+cWeight-a)
    (hkill : (i:ℤ)≤b-a)
    (eY : model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary) ≅ Smn n w₀)

    (hC : C=.shift (0,b) (.quotient r (.nu X)))

      (familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) q) 2 p x) alpha)
    (hv : v≫h=alpha≫K)
    (hRzero : Detects (model.convergence D) p (familyPageMap model.family R 2 p x) 0) :

      Detects (model.convergence D) p
        (familyPageMap model.family J 2 p

  subst C
  subst D
  dsimp only [SyntheticObject.obj] at d h R K J rho x alpha v halpha hv hedge hRzero ⊢
  obtain ⟨dQ,hdQ⟩ := sphere_nu_high_target_extension Y X n w₀ a b q r hr hgapC eY d
  obtain ⟨RQ,hRQ⟩ := sphere_nu_high_target_extension Y Z n w₀ a cWeight q r hr hgapD eY R

  have hincRho : XModLambdaN.incl _ q≫(dQ≫rho)=XModLambdaN.incl _ q≫0 := by
    rw [←Category.assoc,hdQ,hdRho,comp_zero]
  have hcdRho : (alpha≫dQ)≫rho=0 := by
    have heq := finite_source_high_target_extensions_equal Y X q i hi a b
      (by omega) (dQ≫rho) 0 hincRho (p.2.1-p.1) p.2.2 alpha
    simpa only [Category.assoc,comp_zero] using heq
  have hinc : XModLambdaN.incl _ q≫(K-J) = XModLambdaN.incl _ q≫(dQ≫h-RQ) := by
    simp only [Preadditive.comp_sub,←Category.assoc,hdQ,hRQ]
    exact hedge
  have heq := finite_source_high_target_extensions_equal Y Z q r hr a cWeight
    (by omega) (K-J) (dQ≫h-RQ) hinc (p.2.1-p.1) p.2.2 alpha
  have heq' : alpha≫K-alpha≫J=(alpha≫dQ)≫h-alpha≫RQ := by
    simpa only [Preadditive.comp_sub,Category.assoc] using heq
  have hmath : (v-alpha≫dQ)≫h=alpha≫J-alpha≫RQ := by
    rw [Preadditive.sub_comp,hv]
    calc
      alpha≫K-(alpha≫dQ)≫h = (alpha≫K-alpha≫J)+alpha≫J-(alpha≫dQ)≫h := by abel
      _ = ((alpha≫dQ)≫h-alpha≫RQ)+alpha≫J-(alpha≫dQ)≫h := by rw [heq']
      _ = alpha≫J-alpha≫RQ := by abel
  have hdLabel : familyPageMap model.family dQ 2 p
      (familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl _ q) 2 p x) =
      familyPageMap model.family d 2 p x := by
    rw [←ModuleCat.comp_apply,family_page_comp,hdQ]
  have hRLabel : familyPageMap model.family RQ 2 p
      (familyPageMap model.family (XModLambdaN.incl _ q) 2 p x) =
      familyPageMap model.family R 2 p x := by
    rw [←ModuleCat.comp_apply,family_page_comp,hRQ]
  have hcd := detects_map (.quotient q (.shift (0,a) (.nu Y)))
    (.shift (0,b) (.quotient r (.nu X))) dQ p _ alpha halpha
  have hcd := (congrArg (fun z => Detects
    (model.convergence (.shift (0,b) (.quotient r (.nu X)))) p z (alpha≫dQ)) hdLabel).mp hcd
  have hres := detects_map (.quotient q (.shift (0,a) (.nu Y)))
    (.shift (0,cWeight) (.quotient r (.nu Z))) RQ p _ alpha halpha
  have hres := (congrArg (fun z => Detects
    (model.convergence (.shift (0,cWeight) (.quotient r (.nu Z)))) p z (alpha≫RQ)) hRLabel).mp hres
  have hres0 := detects_zero_of_detects_same_label_zero
    (.shift (0,cWeight) (.quotient r (.nu Z))) p _ _ hres hRzero
  have hJ := detects_map (.quotient q (.shift (0,a) (.nu Y)))
    (.shift (0,cWeight) (.quotient r (.nu Z))) J p _ alpha halpha
  have htarget := detects_add (model.convergence (.shift (0,cWeight) (.quotient r (.nu Z))))
    p hJ (detects_neg hres0)
  refine ⟨dQ,v-alpha≫dQ,hdQ,rfl,hcd,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [Preadditive.sub_comp,hcdRho,sub_zero]
  · rw [hmath]
    simpa only [SyntheticObject.obj,neg_zero,add_zero,sub_eq_add_neg] using htarget

private theorem desuspend_bijective (X : C) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (AbstractAdamsTower.desuspend X n) := by
  let e := (shiftFunctorAdd' C n (-1) (n - 1) (by omega)).app SphereSpectrum
  let d := (shiftFunctorCompIsoId C 1 (-1) (by omega)).app X
  constructor
  · intro a b h
    change e.hom ≫ (shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).map a ≫ d.hom =
      e.hom ≫ (shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).map b ≫ d.hom at h
    apply (shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).map_injective
    apply (cancel_epi e.hom).mp
    apply (cancel_mono d.hom).mp
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using h
  · intro b
    refine ⟨(shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).preimage (e.inv ≫ b ≫ d.inv), ?_⟩
    change e.hom ≫ (shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).map
      ((shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).preimage _) ≫ d.hom = b
    rw [Functor.map_preimage]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

private theorem raw_cycles_iff [HasFunctorialCofiber (C:=C)] {H : C} {unit : SphereSpectrum ⟶ H}
    {X : C} (T : AbstractAdamsTower unit X) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1≤r) (s t : ℤ)

    ∃ c : HomotopyGroup (t-s) ((T.stageAt (s+r))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧),
      c≫(T.mapAt (show s+1≤s+r by omega))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧' =
      a≫HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ (T.mapAt (show s≤s+1 by omega)) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b,hb⟩
    obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := (desuspend_bijective (T.stageAt (s+r)) (t-s)).2 b
    refine ⟨c,?_⟩
    apply (desuspend_bijective (T.stageAt (s+1)) (t-s)).1
    rw [desuspend_postcompose,hc]
    exact hb
  · rintro ⟨c,hc⟩
    refine ⟨AbstractAdamsTower.desuspend (T.stageAt (s+r)) (t-s) c,?_⟩
    change _≫T.mapAt (show s+1≤s+r by omega)=
      AbstractAdamsTower.desuspend (T.stageAt (s+1)) (t-s)
        (a≫HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ (T.mapAt (show s≤s+1 by omega)))
    rw [←desuspend_postcompose,hc]

private theorem desuspend_mem_raw_cycles (X : ClassicalObject)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1≤r) (s t : ℤ)
    (a : (model.classicalTower.tower ((X.obj model.auxiliary)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)).FirstPage (s,t))
    (ha : a∈(model.classicalTower.tower ((X.obj model.auxiliary)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)).cycles r hr (s,t)) :
    (model.classicalSuspension X).desuspendFirstPage s t a ∈
      (model.classicalTower.tower (X.obj model.auxiliary)).cycles r hr (s,t-1) := by
  let S := model.classicalSuspension X
  let T := model.classicalTower.tower (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := (raw_cycles_iff _ r hr s t a).mp ha
  let R := shiftFunctorComm Spectrum (1:ℤ) (1:ℤ)
  let e := c≫(S.tower (s+r)).hom⟦(1:ℤ)⟧'≫R.inv.app (T.stageAt (s+r))
  have he : e≫(T.mapAt (show s+1≤s+r by omega))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧'⟦(1:ℤ)⟧' =
      -(a≫(S.layer s).hom≫(HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibδ
        (T.mapAt (show s≤s+1 by omega)))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧') := by
    dsimp only [e]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    erw [←R.inv.naturality]
    simp only [Functor.comp_map]
    rw [←Functor.map_comp_assoc,S.tower_comm,Functor.map_comp]
    simp only [←Category.assoc]
    erw [hc]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    have hs := S.layer_connecting s
    have hs' := congrArg (fun f=>f≫R.inv.app (T.stageAt (s+1))) hs
    dsimp only [T,AbstractAdamsTower.layer] at hs'
    simp only [R,Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id_app,Preadditive.neg_comp] at hs'
    erw [Category.comp_id] at hs'
    erw [hs']
    simp only [Preadditive.comp_neg,neg_neg]
    rfl
  apply (raw_cycles_iff T r hr s (t-1) _).mpr
  let j := eqToHom (congrArg (Sphere (C:=Spectrum)) (show (t-1)-s=(t-s)-1 by omega))
  refine ⟨-(j≫AbstractAdamsTower.desuspend ((T.stageAt (s+r))⟦(1:ℤ)⟧) (t-s) e),?_⟩
  rw [Preadditive.neg_comp,Category.assoc,←desuspend_postcompose,he,map_neg]
  simp only [Preadditive.comp_neg,neg_neg]
  rw [←Category.assoc a]
  erw [desuspend_postcompose]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

    (x : Ambient model X (s,t-1)) :
    ∃ sx : Ambient model (.shift 1 X) (s,t),

  let PU := model.classicalTower.sequence ((X.obj model.auxiliary)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)
  let TX := model.classicalTower.tower (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let TU := model.classicalTower.tower ((X.obj model.auxiliary)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)
  let qx : Subobject.underlying.obj (DX.Z 0) ⟶ Ambient model X (s,t-1) := DX.pageπ 0 ≫
    eqToHom (by simp only [Ambient,DX,KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.Page,
      model.classical.firstPage,sub_self,Int.toNat_zero,Nat.cast_zero])
  haveI : Epi (DX.pageπ 0) := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  haveI : Epi qx := by
    dsimp only [qx]
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective qx).mp inferInstance x
  let xb := ((PX.ambient (s,t-1)).hom ((DX.Z 0).arrow b)).val
  obtain ⟨sa,hsa⟩ := (desuspendFirstPage_bijective X s t).2 xb
  have hsa_cycle : sa∈TU.cycles 2 (by omega) (s,t) := by
    apply (desuspend_mem_raw_cycles_iff X 2 (by omega) s t sa).mp
    rw [hsa]
    exact ((PX.ambient (s,t-1)).hom ((DX.Z 0).arrow b)).property
  let v := (PU.ambient (s,t)).inv ⟨sa,hsa_cycle⟩
  have hv : v ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule DU.V) (DU.Z 0) := by
    apply (PU.cycles (s,t) 0 v).mpr
    have he : (PU.ambient (s,t)).hom v = ⟨sa,hsa_cycle⟩ := by
      change ((PU.ambient (s,t)).inv ≫ (PU.ambient (s,t)).hom) _ = _
      rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
      rfl
    rw [he]
    exact hsa_cycle
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hv
  let qu : Subobject.underlying.obj (DU.Z 0) ⟶ Ambient model (.shift 1 X) (s,t) := DU.pageπ 0 ≫
    eqToHom (by simp only [Ambient,DU,ClassicalObject.obj,KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.Page,

    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  change S.desuspendFirstPage s t
    (((PU.ambient (s,t)).hom ((DU.Z 0).arrow a)).val)=xb

private theorem boundary_desuspend_bijective (X : C) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (AbstractAdamsTower.desuspend X n) := by
  let e := (shiftFunctorAdd' C n (-1) (n - 1) (by omega)).app SphereSpectrum
  let d := (shiftFunctorCompIsoId C 1 (-1) (by omega)).app X
  constructor
  · intro a b h
    change e.hom ≫ (shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).map a ≫ d.hom =
      e.hom ≫ (shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).map b ≫ d.hom at h
    apply (shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).map_injective
    apply (cancel_epi e.hom).mp
    apply (cancel_mono d.hom).mp
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using h
  · intro b
    refine ⟨(shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).preimage (e.inv ≫ b ≫ d.inv), ?_⟩
    change e.hom ≫ (shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).map
      ((shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).preimage _) ≫ d.hom = b
    rw [Functor.map_preimage]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
