private theorem desuspend_mem_raw_boundaries_iff (X : ClassicalObject)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1≤r) (s t : ℤ)
    (a : (model.classicalTower.tower ((X.obj model.auxiliary)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)).FirstPage (s,t)) :
    (model.classicalSuspension X).desuspendFirstPage s t a ∈
      (model.classicalTower.tower (X.obj model.auxiliary)).boundaries r hr (s,t-1) ↔
    a∈(model.classicalTower.tower ((X.obj model.auxiliary)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)).boundaries r hr (s,t) := by
  let S := model.classicalSuspension X
  let T := model.classicalTower.tower (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let U := model.classicalTower.tower ((X.obj model.auxiliary)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)
  have hi (b : HomotopyGroup (t-s) (U.stageAt s)) :
      boundary_desuspendHom (S.layer s) s t
        (b≫HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι (U.mapAt (show s≤s+1 by omega))) =
      boundary_desuspendHom (S.tower s) s t b≫
        HasFunctorialCofiber.cofibι (T.mapAt (show s≤s+1 by omega)) :=
    boundary_desuspendHom_natural _ _ _ _ (S.layer_inclusion s).symm s t b
  have hm (b : HomotopyGroup (t-s) (U.stageAt s)) :
      boundary_desuspendHom (S.tower (s-r+1)) s t
        (b≫U.mapAt (show s-r+1≤s by omega)) =
      boundary_desuspendHom (S.tower s) s t b≫T.mapAt (show s-r+1≤s by omega) :=
    boundary_desuspendHom_natural _ _ _ _ (S.tower_comm _ _ _) s t b
  constructor
  · intro ha
    obtain ⟨b,hb,he⟩ := (raw_boundaries_iff T r hr s (t-1) _).mp ha
    obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := (boundary_desuspendHom_bijective (S.tower s) s t).2 b
    apply (raw_boundaries_iff U r hr s t a).mpr
    refine ⟨c,?_,?_⟩
    · apply (boundary_desuspendHom_bijective (S.tower (s-r+1)) s t).1
      rw [hm,hc,hb,boundary_desuspendHom_zero]
    · apply (boundary_desuspendHom_bijective (S.layer s) s t).1
      rw [hi,hc]
      exact he
  · intro ha
    obtain ⟨b,hb,he⟩ := (raw_boundaries_iff U r hr s t a).mp ha
    apply (raw_boundaries_iff T r hr s (t-1) _).mpr
    refine ⟨boundary_desuspendHom (S.tower s) s t b,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [←hm,hb,boundary_desuspendHom_zero]
    · rw [←hi,he]
      rfl

private theorem initial_class_boundary_iff (D : SSData (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ))
    (n : WithTop ℕ) (z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z 0) : ModuleCat ℤ)) :
    (∃ b : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.B n) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      (Subobject.ofLE (D.B n) (D.Z 0)
        ((D.B_le_Z n).trans (D.Z_anti bot_le)) ≫ D.pageπ 0) b=D.pageπ 0 z) ↔
      (D.Z 0).arrow z∈(ModuleCat.subobjectModule D.V) (D.B n) := by
  let i := Subobject.ofLE (D.B n) (D.Z 0)
    ((D.B_le_Z n).trans (D.Z_anti bot_le))
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b,hb⟩
    have hz : D.pageπ 0 (z-i b)=0 := by
      rw [map_sub]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hb.symm
    have h0 := (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (D.B 0) (D.Z 0) (D.B_le_Z 0) _).mp hz
    have h0' : (D.Z 0).arrow (z-i b)∈(ModuleCat.subobjectModule D.V) (D.B n) :=
      (ModuleCat.subobjectModule D.V).monotone (D.B_mono bot_le) h0
    have hb' : (D.Z 0).arrow (i b)∈(ModuleCat.subobjectModule D.V) (D.B n) := by
      change (i≫(D.Z 0).arrow) b∈_
      rw [Subobject.ofLE_arrow]
      exact ⟨b,rfl⟩
    have h := ((ModuleCat.subobjectModule D.V) (D.B n)).add_mem h0' hb'
    rw [map_sub,sub_add_cancel] at h
    exact h
  · rintro ⟨b,hb⟩
    refine ⟨b,?_⟩
    have he : i b=z := by
      apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (D.Z 0).arrow).mp inferInstance
      change (i≫(D.Z 0).arrow) b=(D.Z 0).arrow z
      rw [Subobject.ofLE_arrow]
      exact hb
    change D.pageπ 0 (i b)=D.pageπ 0 z
    rw [he]

private theorem quotient_unshift_preserves_filtration
    (X : ClassicalObject) (δ p : ℤ × ℤ) (q : ℕ)
    (ε : XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q ≅
      (SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj
        (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q))
    (s : ℤ)
    (a : BiHom (p+δ).1 (p+δ).2
      (XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).obj
        (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))) q))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s a) :
    FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower s (quotientUnshift X δ p q ε a) := by
  let E := (essShift δ).filtered (.quotient q (.nu X)) p
  have hv := map_preserves_filtration
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient q (.shift δ (.nu X)))
      (.shift δ (.quotient q (.nu X))) ε.hom) (p+δ) s a ha
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := filtration_representative_exists model.syntheticTower _ (p+δ) s
    (a ≫ ε.hom) hv
  have he : E.ambient.hom (quotientUnshift X δ p q ε a) = a ≫ ε.hom := by
    rw [(essShift δ).ambient_eq]
    have h := congrArg (fun z => z ≫ ε.hom) (shift_quotient_unshift X δ p q ε a)
    simpa only [Category.assoc,Iso.inv_hom_id,Category.comp_id] using h
  have hi : E.ambient.inv (a ≫ ε.hom) = quotientUnshift X δ p q ε a := by
    rw [←he]
    exact E.ambient.toLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply _
  have hc := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (E.symm.level_arrow s) b
  change ((model.syntheticTower.filtration _).F s p).arrow ((E.level s).inv b) =
    E.ambient.inv (((model.syntheticTower.filtration _).F s (p+δ)).arrow b) at hc
  erw [hb,hi] at hc
  have hm : quotientUnshift X δ p q ε a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _
      ((model.syntheticTower.filtration _).F s p) := ⟨(E.level s).inv b,hc⟩
  simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,
    FiltrationAtLeast] using hm

    (A : SyntheticObject) (p : Tridegree)
    (x : (model.family.obj (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).E₂ p)

    (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (p.2.1-p.1,p.2.2) (show p.1 ≤ p.1+1 by omega) hd
  obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := filtration_representative_exists model.syntheticTower _
    (p.2.1-p.1,p.2.2) p.1 (b-a) hd'
  have hz : Detects (model.convergence A) p 0 (b-a) := by
    refine ⟨0,HasInfinityRepresentative.zero _ 2 (by omega) p,d,hd,?_⟩
    rw [map_zero]

    rw [hd]
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,
      FiltrationAtLeast] using ‹FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (p.1+1) (b-a)›
  simpa only [add_zero,add_sub_cancel] using detects_add (model.convergence A) p ha hz

private theorem finite_detected_target_bottom_lift
    (X : ClassicalObject) (q k : ℕ) (hkq : k<q) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (a : BiHom (t-s) (t-k) (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q))
    (ha : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X))) (s,t,t-k)
      (finiteTargetLabel model X q s t k x) a) :
    ∃ b : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (q-k)),
      b ≫ (model.quotients.tower _).rho 1 (q-k) (by omega) =
        firstLabel model X s t x ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _) 1 := by
  obtain ⟨e,he,_⟩ := ha
  have hlabel : nuWeightLabel model X s t (t-k) (by omega) x =
      targetNuLabel model X s t k x := by
    have hk' : (t-(t-k)).toNat = k := by omega
    have transport (a b : ℕ) (hab : a=b)
        (h : (s,t,t-a)=(s,t,t-b)) :
        regradeE2 h (targetNuLabel model X s t a x) = targetNuLabel model X s t b x := by
      subst b
      rfl
    exact transport _ k hk' _
  have hh := KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_finite_labels X q (by omega)
    s t (t-k) (by omega) x e
  rw [hlabel] at hh
  have hx : x ∈ cycles model X (q-k:ℕ) (s,t) := by
    have hx := (hh.mp he).1
    convert hx using 1
    congr 1
    omega
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_finite_lift X (q-k) (by omega) s t x).mp
    ((isCycle_iff_reaches model X ((q-k:ℕ)+1) (by omega) (s,t) x).mp
      ⟨by omega,by simpa using hx⟩)
  let f : nuZero model X ⟶ model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary) :=
    SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app _
  refine ⟨b ≫ XModLambdaN.map f (q-k),?_⟩
  rw [Category.assoc,←(model.quotients.natural f).rho_naturality (by omega),←Category.assoc,hb]

private theorem relative_boundary_equal_of_no_crossing (X : ClassicalObject)
    (i q : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hq : 0 < q) (s t : ℤ)
    (hnc : NoCrossingOn model X (i+q) (i+1) (s,t))
    (a a₀ : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+1) (a-a₀)) :
    a ≫ ((model.quotients.tower _).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)).delta =
      a₀ ≫ ((model.quotients.tower _).triangle hi (show i < i+q by omega)).delta := by
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let M := model.convergentMap (.quotient i (.nu X)) (.shift (1,-(i:ℤ)) (.nu X))
    (absoluteBoundary A i)
  have hnc' : TowerNoCrossing M (t-s,t) s (i+q) := by
    have H := classical_noCrossing_absolute_boundary X (i+1) (i+q) s t hnc
    exact H
  have h := tower_image_same_target_of_no_crossing M (t-s,t) s (i+q)
    (by omega) hnc' a a₀ ha
  change FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+(i+q)+1)
    (a ≫ absoluteBoundary A i - a₀ ≫ absoluteBoundary A i) at h
  rw [←Preadditive.sub_comp] at h
  have hα := (absolute_boundary_filtration_iff X i (t-s) t (s+(i+q)+1) (a-a₀)).mp h
  let α := biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t i A ((a-a₀) ≫ XModLambdaN.proj A i)
  have hproj : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+(i+q)+1)
      (α ≫ XModLambdaN.incl A ((i+q)-i)) :=
    map_preserves_filtration (model.convergentMap (.nu X) (.quotient ((i+q)-i) (.nu X))
      (XModLambdaN.incl A ((i+q)-i))) (t-s-1,t+i) (s+(i+q)+1) α hα
  have hz := finite_high_filtration_zero X ((i+q)-i) (by omega) (t-s-1) (t+i)
    (s+(i+q)+1) (by omega) _ hproj
  apply (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t i (XModLambdaN A ((i+q)-i))).injective
  rw [cofiber_boundary_projection X i (i+q) hi (by omega),
    cofiber_boundary_projection X i (i+q) hi (by omega)]
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  simpa only [α,Preadditive.sub_comp,map_sub] using hz

private theorem finite_target_rho_detects (X : ClassicalObject)
    (i j k : ℕ) (hki : k < i) (hij : i ≤ j) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (a : BiHom (t-s) (t-k) (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i))
    (ha : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu X))) (s,t,t-k)
      (finiteTargetLabel model X i s t k x) a)
    (b : BiHom (t-s) (t-k) (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) j))
    (hb : b≫(model.quotients.tower _).rho i j hij=a) :
    Detects (model.convergence (.quotient j (.nu X))) (s,t,t-k)
      (finiteTargetLabel model X j s t k x) b := by
  have hlabel : nuWeightLabel model X s t (t-k) (by omega) x =
      targetNuLabel model X s t k x := by
    have hk' : (t-(t-k)).toNat=k := by omega
    have transport (a b : ℕ) (hab : a=b)
        (h : (s,t,t-a)=(s,t,t-b)) :
        regradeE2 h (targetNuLabel model X s t a x) = targetNuLabel model X s t b x := by
      subst b
      rfl
    exact transport _ k hk' _
  have ha' : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu X))) (s,t,t-k)
      ((model.family.quotientProjection (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) i).pageMap
        2 (s,t,t-k) (nuWeightLabel model X s t (t-k) (by omega) x)) a := by
    rw [hlabel]
    exact ha
  have hh := rho_lift_detects X i j (by omega) hij s t (t-k) (by omega) x a ha' b hb
  rw [hlabel] at hh
  exact hh

private theorem minimal_corrected_total_extension
    (T : TriangleData model.auxiliary)
    (he : (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f : ℤ)+

    ∀ (eQ : XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,e)).obj Xν) r ≅
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,e)).obj (XModLambdaN Xν r))
      (εe : XModLambdaN Af r ≅ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,ef)).obj (XModLambdaN Xν r))
      (εA : XModLambdaN ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,eg)).obj Af) r ≅
        (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,eg)).obj (XModLambdaN Af r))
      (eAg : XModLambdaN Ag r ≅ (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,eg)).obj (XModLambdaN Yν r))
      (esusp : XModLambdaN (Ag⟦(1:ℤ)⟧) r ≅ (XModLambdaN Ag r)⟦(1:ℤ)⟧)
      (_heQ : XModLambdaN.incl _ r≫eQ.hom=(SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,e)).map (XModLambdaN.incl Xν r))
      (_hεe : XModLambdaN.incl _ r≫εe.hom=(SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,ef)).map (XModLambdaN.incl Xν r))
      (_hεA : XModLambdaN.incl _ r≫εA.hom=(SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,eg)).map (XModLambdaN.incl Af r))
      (_heAg : XModLambdaN.incl _ r≫eAg.hom=(SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,eg)).map (XModLambdaN.incl Yν r))
      (_hesusp : XModLambdaN.incl _ r≫esusp.hom=(shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map (XModLambdaN.incl Ag r))
      (cGeometry : BiHom M W (XModLambdaN Cg r)),

      let eD := commonEdgeTargetFlatIso Yν eg i q esusp eAg
      let ff := SyntheticCategory.biShift_fullyFaithful (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (1,-(i:ℤ))

      let Jq := ff.preimage ((biSuspensionIso (i:ℤ) (XModLambdaN Ag (r-i))).hom≫
        (shiftFunctor SyntheticSpectrum (1:ℤ)).map
          ((model.quotients.tower Ag).triangle hi (show i < r by omega)).lambdaMap≫esusp.inv≫eD.hom)
      ∀ (c' : BiHom (M-1) (W+i) C₀)
        (_hρ : c'≫(SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,(i:ℤ)+e)).map ((model.quotients.tower Xν).rho i r (by omega)) =
          ff.preimage ((biShiftAddIso (M-1,W+i) (1,-(i:ℤ)) (M,W)
            (by ext <;> dsimp; all_goals omega)).hom.app S_0_0≫cGeometry≫eC.hom)≫
            (SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,(i:ℤ)+e)).map ((model.quotients.tower Xν).rho i r (by omega)))
        (_hc : Detects (model.convergence (.quotient r (.nu T.X))) (s,t,t)
          (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.X r s t 0 x))
          (homotopyRegrade (by simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd] <;> omega)
            (by simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd]; dsimp [e,ef,eg] at * <;> omega)
            (quotientShiftDesuspend T.X (1,e) r eQ M W (cGeometry≫XModLambdaN.map eCg.hom r))))

          (s+n,t+n,t+n+eg) (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteNuLabel model T.Y (r-i) eg (s+n) (t+n) 0 y)) ag)

            (s,(t-s)+s,t+ef) (finiteSourceForExtension model T.X T.Y T.f r s t x)
            (homotopyRegrade (by simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd] <;> omega) rfl af) ∧

private theorem generalized_mahowald_zero_layer_sphere
    (T : TriangleData model.auxiliary) (hY : T.Y = .sphere) :
  ∀ he : (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f : ℤ) + normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g +
      normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.h = 1,
  KIP126.Literature.NormalizedTriangleCompatible model T he →
  ∀ (n m l s t : ℤ),
  m = (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g : ℤ) →
  l = (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.h : ℤ) →
    let r := n + m + l
    let n₁ := n - normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f
    let m₁ := m - normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g
    let l₁ := l - normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.h
    let r' := r - m₁
    ∀ (x : Ambient model (T.X) (s + l, t + l - 1))
      (y : Ambient model (T.Y) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n))
      (xBar : Ambient model (T.Z) (s, t))
      (yBar : Ambient model (T.Z) (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m))
      (suspendedX : Ambient model (.shift 1 T.X) (s + l, t + l)),
      1 ≤ n₁ → 0 ≤ m₁ → 0 ≤ l₁ →
      IsCycle model (T.X) n₁ (s + l, t + l - 1) x →
      IsCycle model (T.Y) (m₁ + 1) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n) y →
      IsCycle model (T.Z) (r - 1) (s, t) xBar →
      IsPermanent model (T.Z) (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m) yBar →
      (model.classicalSuspension T.X).DesuspendsClass (s + l) (t + l) suspendedX x →
      FiniteExtension model T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h r'.toNat l s t xBar suspendedX →
      DifferentialAt model (T.Z) r (s, t)
        (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m) xBar yBar →
      (FiniteNoCrossing model T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h r'.toNat l s t ∨
        NoCrossingOn model (T.Z) r r' (s, t)) →
      FiniteExtension model T.Y T.Z T.g (m₁ + 2).toNat m (s + l + n) (t + l - 1 + n) y yBar →
      IsCycle model (T.X) (n + m + normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.h) (s + l, t + l - 1) x ∧
        ∃ y' : Ambient model (T.Y) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n),
          FiniteExtension model T.X T.Y T.f (n + m + 1 + normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.h).toNat
            n (s + l) (t + l - 1) x y' ∧
          Congruent model (T.Y) r' (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n) y' y := by
  intro he htriangle n m l s t
  dsimp only
  intro hmZero hlZero x y xBar yBar suspendedX hn hm hl
    hx hy hxBar hyBar hsusp hh hd hcross hg
  let eg : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g
  let ef : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f
  let eh : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.h
  let pg : ℕ := (m-eg+2).toNat
  let q : ℕ := pg-1
  let i : ℕ := (n+l+eg-1).toNat
  let Q : ℕ := (n+m+eh).toNat
  let sf : ℤ := s+l
  let tf : ℤ := t+l-1
  have hpg : 2 ≤ pg := by dsimp [pg,eg]; omega
  have hq : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hqZ : (q:ℤ)=m-eg+1 := by dsimp [q,pg]; omega
  have hi : 0 < i := by dsimp [i,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hiZ : (i:ℤ)=n+l+eg-1 := by dsimp [i,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hQ : 0 < Q := by dsimp [Q,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hQZ : (Q:ℤ)=n+m+eh := by dsimp [Q,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := by have := Nat.zero_le (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f); omega
  have hnf : ef ≤ n := by dsimp [ef]; omega
  let Wg : FiniteExtensionWitness model T.Y T.Z T.g pg m (sf+n) (tf+n) y yBar :=
    Classical.choice hg
  let Zν := model.nu.functor.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary)
  let boundary (aZ : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i)) :
      BiHom ((tf+n)-(sf+n)) (tf+n+eg) (XModLambdaN Zν q) :=
    homotopyRegrade (by dsimp [tf,sf]; omega) (by dsimp [tf]; omega)
      (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (i:ℤ) (XModLambdaN Zν q)
        (by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using
          (aZ ≫ ((model.quotients.tower Zν).triangle hi (show i < i + q by omega)).delta)))
  have boundary_representative :
      ∃ aZ : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i),
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.Z))) (s,t,t)
          (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.Z i s t 0 xBar)) aZ ∧
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu T.Z)))
          (sf+n+m,((tf+n)-(sf+n))+(sf+n+m),tf+n+eg)
          (finiteTargetForExtension model T.Y T.Z T.g q m (sf+n) (tf+n) Wg.length_lower yBar)
          (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl (boundary aZ)) ∧
        (NoCrossingOn model T.Z (n+m+l) (n+m+l-(m-eg)) (s,t) →
          ∀ a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i),
            Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.Z))) (s,t,t)
              (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.Z i s t 0 xBar)) a →
            boundary a = boundary aZ) := by
    have hmi : eg ≤ m := by dsimp [eg]; omega
    have hxi : xBar ∈ cycles model T.Z (i:ℤ) (s,t) :=
      cycles_antitone model T.Z (s,t) (by omega : (i:ℤ) ≤ n+m+l-1) hxBar.2
    have hxiR : ReachesPage (model.classical.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+1) (s,t) xBar :=
      (isCycle_iff_reaches model T.Z (i+1) (by omega) (s,t) xBar).mp
        ⟨by omega, by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hxi⟩
    obtain ⟨a0Zero,ha0Zero⟩ := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_finite_lift T.Z i hi s t xBar).mp hxiR
    let a0 : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i) :=
      a0Zero ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app Zν) i
    have ha0first : a0 ≫ (model.quotients.tower Zν).rho 1 i hi =
        firstLabel model T.Z s t xBar ≫
          XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app Zν) 1 := by
      dsimp only [a0]
      have hnat : (model.quotients.tower (nuZero model T.Z)).rho 1 i hi ≫
          XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app Zν) 1 =
          XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app Zν) i ≫
            (model.quotients.tower Zν).rho 1 i hi :=
        (model.quotients.natural
          (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app Zν)).rho_naturality hi
      rw [Category.assoc,←hnat,←Category.assoc,ha0Zero]
    have target_correction :
        ∃ c : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i),
          c ≫ (model.quotients.tower Zν).rho 1 i hi = 0 ∧
          Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu T.Z)))

code:
public def GeneralizedLeibnizLaw (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.auxiliary) : Prop :=
  ∀ (page : ℕ) (r m l s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient D X (s, t)) (y : Ambient D Y (s + m, t + m))
    (xInfinity : Ambient D X (s + r, t + r - 1))
    (yInfinity : Ambient D Y (s + r + l, t + r - 1 + l)),
    2 ≤ page → (page : ℤ) ≤ r →
    (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ m →
    m ≤ (page : ℤ) - 2 + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f →
    (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ l →
    IsCycle D X (r - 1) (s, t) x →
    IsCycle D Y (r - 1 - m + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f) (s + m, t + m) y →
    IsPermanent D X (s + r, t + r - 1) xInfinity →
    IsPermanent D Y (s + r + l, t + r - 1 + l) yInfinity →
    DifferentialAt D X r (s, t) (s + r, t + r - 1) x xInfinity →
    FiniteExtension D X Y f page m s t x y →
    InfiniteExtension D X Y f l (s + r) (t + r - 1) xInfinity yInfinity →
    (NoCrossingOn D X r page (s, t) ∨
      FiniteNoCrossing D X Y f page m s t) →
    InfiniteNoCrossing D X Y f l (s + r) (t + r - 1) →
    DifferentialAt D Y (r + l - m) (s + m, t + m)
      (s + r + l, t + r - 1 + l) y yInfinity

    (x : Ambient D X (s, t)) (y : Ambient D Y (s + m, t + m))
    (xInfinity : Ambient D X (s + r, t + r - 1))
    (yInfinity : Ambient D Y (s + r + l, t + r - 1 + l)),
    2 ≤ page → (page : ℤ) ≤ r →
    (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ m →
    m ≤ (page : ℤ) - 2 + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f →
    (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ l →
    IsCycle D X (r - 1) (s, t) x →
    IsCycle D Y (r - 1 - m + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f) (s + m, t + m) y →
    IsPermanent D X (s + r, t + r - 1) xInfinity →
    IsPermanent D Y (s + r + l, t + r - 1 + l) yInfinity →
    DifferentialAt D X r (s, t) (s + r, t + r - 1) x xInfinity →
    FiniteExtension D X Y f page m s t x y →
    InfiniteExtension D X Y f l (s + r) (t + r - 1) xInfinity yInfinity →
    (NoCrossingOn D X r page (s, t) ∨
      FiniteNoCrossing D X Y f page m s t) →

public def GeneralizedMahowaldLaw (T : TriangleData D.auxiliary) : Prop :=
  ∀ he : (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.f : ℤ) + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.g +
      normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h = 1,
  KIP126.Literature.NormalizedTriangleCompatible D T he →
  ∀ (n m l s t : ℤ),
    let r := n + m + l
    let n₁ := n - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.f
    let m₁ := m - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.g
    let l₁ := l - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h
    let r' := r - m₁
    ∀ (x : Ambient D (T.X) (s + l, t + l - 1))
      (y : Ambient D (T.Y) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n))
      (xBar : Ambient D (T.Z) (s, t))
      (yBar : Ambient D (T.Z) (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m))
      (suspendedX : Ambient D (.shift 1 T.X) (s + l, t + l)),
      1 ≤ n₁ → 0 ≤ m₁ → 0 ≤ l₁ →
      IsCycle D (T.X) n₁ (s + l, t + l - 1) x →
      IsCycle D (T.Y) (m₁ + 1) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n) y →
      IsCycle D (T.Z) (r - 1) (s, t) xBar →
      IsPermanent D (T.Z) (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m) yBar →
      (D.classicalSuspension T.X).DesuspendsClass (s + l) (t + l) suspendedX x →
      FiniteExtension D T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h r'.toNat l s t xBar suspendedX →
      DifferentialAt D (T.Z) r (s, t)
        (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m) xBar yBar →
      (FiniteNoCrossing D T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h r'.toNat l s t ∨
        NoCrossingOn D (T.Z) r r' (s, t)) →
      FiniteExtension D T.Y T.Z T.g (m₁ + 2).toNat m (s + l + n) (t + l - 1 + n) y yBar →

public theorem tower_extension_iff
    {Syn : Type u} [SyntheticCategory.{u,v} Syn]
    [KIP126.StableHomotopy.HasFunctorialCofiber (C := Syn)]
    {H : Syn} {unit : S_0_0 ⟶ H} {F : SyntheticAdamsFamily Syn}
    {P : SyntheticTowerPresentation unit F} {X Y : Syn} {g : X ⟶ Y}
    {cx : SyntheticTowerConvergence P X} {cy : SyntheticTowerConvergence P Y}
    (M : ConvergentMap F g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n : ℤ)
    (x : ((F.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty) :
    TowerExtensionEquation M p s n x y ↔
      0 ≤ n ∧ ∃ (a : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
        (b : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
        ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow a ≫ g = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow b ∧
        (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p a = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x ∧
        (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p b = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y :=
  Internal.tower_extension_iff M p s n x y

private theorem detected_grade_zero_of_higher_filtration
    (A : SyntheticObject) (s t w : ℤ)
    (x : (model.family.obj (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).E₂ (s,t,w))
    (a : BiHom (t-s) w (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
    (ha : Detects (model.convergence A) (s,t,w) x a)
    (hhigh : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+1) a) :
    HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,t,w) x 0 := by
  obtain ⟨e,he,b,hb,hbe⟩ := ha
  have hzero : e=0 := by
    apply ((model.convergence A).identification (s,t,w)).toLinearEquiv.injective
    change ((model.convergence A).identification (s,t,w)).hom e =
      ((model.convergence A).identification (s,t,w)).hom 0
    rw [map_zero, hbe]
    apply ((model.syntheticTower.filtration (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).toAssociatedGraded_eq_zero_iff
      s (t-s,w) b).mpr
    rw [hb]
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,
      FiltrationAtLeast] using hhigh
  rwa [hzero] at he

private theorem crossing_differential_contradicts_delta_no_crossing
    (X : ClassicalObject) (q i k : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hiq : i < q)
    (hik : q-i ≤ k) (r s t : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hv : s+(i:ℤ)+(k:ℤ)+1≤s+r)
    (hnc : TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient q (.nu X)) (.shift (1,-(q:ℤ)) (.nu X))
      (absoluteBoundary (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) q))
      (t-s,t) s r)
    (x : Ambient model X (s+i,t+i))
    (y : Ambient model X (s+i+k+1,t+i+k))
    (hd : HasNonzeroDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      (k+1) (s+i,t+i) (s+i+k+1,t+i+k) x y) : False := by
  have hk : 0<k := by omega
  have hd' : HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      (k+1) (s+i,t+i) (s+i+k+1,t+i+k) x y := by
    obtain ⟨h,xr,yr,hx,hy,he,_⟩ := hd
    exact ⟨h,xr,yr,hx,hy,he⟩
  obtain ⟨a,ha,had⟩ := differential_absolute_boundary X (q-i) k (by omega) hik
    (s+i) (t+i) x y hd' (differential_target_permanent X k hk _ _ x y hd')
  let A := model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)
  let a0 : BiHom (t-s) (t+i) (XModLambdaN A (q-i)) :=
    homotopyRegrade (by omega) rfl a
  let aS := verticalShiftEquiv (XModLambdaN A (q-i)) i (t-s) t a0
  let aL := aS≫((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hi hiq).lambdaMap
  have haf : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+i) a0 := by
    have H := finite_bottom_filtration X (q-i) (by omega) (s+i) (t+i) a
    exact (regrade_filtration_iff _ _ _ _).mpr H
  have haS : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+i) aS :=
    (vertical_shift_filtration_iff (.quotient (q-i) (.nu X)) i (t-s) t (s+i) a0).mpr haf
  have haL : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+1) aL := by
    have H := map_preserves_filtration (model.convergentMap
      (.shift (0,-(i:ℤ)) (.quotient (q-i) (.nu X))) (.quotient q (.nu X))
      ((model.quotients.tower A).triangle hi hiq).lambdaMap)
      (t-s,t) (s+i) aS haS
    exact model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule_antitone _ (t-s,t) (by omega) H
  have hlarge := delta_image_high_of_no_crossing X q r s t hr hnc aL haL
  have hsmall : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+r+1)
      (aS≫(SyntheticCategory.biShift (0,-(i:ℤ))).map (absoluteBoundary A (q-i))) :=
    (divided_boundary_filtration_iff X i q hi hiq (t-s) t (s+r+1) aS).mp
      (by simpa only [aL,Category.assoc,A] using hlarge)
  rw [vertical_shift_comp] at hsmall
  have hsmall := (vertical_shift_filtration_iff (.shift (1,-((q-i:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu X))
    i (t-s) t (s+r+1) (a0≫absoluteBoundary A (q-i))).mp hsmall
  have hsmall := (absolute_boundary_filtration_iff X (q-i) (t-s) (t+i) (s+r+1) a0).mp hsmall
  have transport_boundary (m m' w v : ℤ) (hm : m=m')
      (b : BiHom m w (XModLambdaN A (q-i))) :
      FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower v
        (biSuspensionHomEquiv m' w (q-i:ℕ) A
          (homotopyRegrade hm rfl b≫XModLambdaN.proj A (q-i))) ↔
      FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower v
        (biSuspensionHomEquiv m w (q-i:ℕ) A (b≫XModLambdaN.proj A (q-i))) := by
    subst m'; rfl
  have hnative := (transport_boundary ((t+i)-(s+i)) (t-s) (t+i) (s+r+1) (by omega) a).mp hsmall
  have hsmall : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+i+k+1+1)
      (homotopyRegrade (m' := (t+i+k)-(s+i+k+1)) (by omega) rfl
        (biSuspensionHomEquiv ((t+i)-(s+i)) (t+i) (q-i:ℕ) A
          (a≫XModLambdaN.proj A (q-i)))) := by
    apply (regrade_filtration_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
    exact model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule_antitone _
      (((t+i)-(s+i))-1,t+i+(q-i:ℕ))
      (by omega : s+(i:ℤ)+(k:ℤ)+1+1≤s+r+1) hnative
  have hzero := detected_grade_zero_of_higher_filtration (.nu X)
    (s+i+k+1) (t+i+k) (t+i+(q-i:ℕ)) _ _ had (by simpa only [A] using hsmall)
  have hyB : y∈boundaries model X (1+(t+i+k)-(t+i+(q-i:ℕ))) (s+i+k+1,t+i+k) := by
    have H := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.eInfinity_nu_labels X
      (s+i+k+1) (t+i+k) (t+i+(q-i:ℕ)) (by omega) y 0).mp hzero
    apply (CrossingLabels.subquotient_zero_iff _ _ ⟨y,H.1⟩).mp
    simpa only [map_zero] using H.2.symm
  exact nonzero_differential_target_not_boundary X (k+1)
    (1+(t+i+k)-(t+i+(q-i:ℕ))) _ _ (by omega) (by omega) x y hd hyB

    (hv : s+(i:ℤ)+(k:ℤ)+1≤s+r)

private theorem delta_no_crossing_implies_classical
    (X : ClassicalObject) (page : ℕ) (r s t : ℤ)
    (hpage : 2 ≤ page) (hpr : (page:ℤ) ≤ r)
    (hnc : TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient (page-1) (.nu X)) (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu X))
      (absoluteBoundary (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (page-1)))
      (t-s,t) s r) :

  refine ⟨by omega,hpr,?_⟩
  rintro ⟨a,b,ha,har,hb,hbr,x,y,hd⟩
  let q : ℕ := page-1
  let i : ℕ := a.toNat
  let k : ℕ := (r-a-b-1).toNat
  have hqZ : (q:ℤ)=(page:ℤ)-1 := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hiZ : (i:ℤ)=a := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hkZ : (k:ℤ)=r-a-b-1 := by dsimp [k]; omega
  have H := crossing_differential_contradicts_delta_no_crossing X q i k
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) r s t (by omega) (by omega) hnc
  have hs : s+a+(k:ℤ)+1=s+r-b := by omega
  have ht : t+a+(k:ℤ)=t+r-b-1 := by omega
  have hl : (k:ℤ)+1=r-a-b := by omega
  rw [hiZ,hs,ht,hl] at H
  exact H x y hd

public theorem classical_crossing_iff_delta_crossing
    (X : ClassicalObject) (page : ℕ) (r s t : ℤ)
    (hpage : 2 ≤ page) (hpr : (page:ℤ) ≤ r) :
    HasCrossingOn model X r page (s,t) ↔ DeltaHasCrossing X page r s t := by
  classical
  have hdef : DeltaHasCrossing X page r s t ↔
      ¬TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
        (.quotient (page-1) (.nu X)) (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu X))
        (absoluteBoundary (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (page-1)))
        (t-s,t) s r := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u,v,hu,huv,hv,x,y,hess⟩ hn
      exact hn u v hu huv hv x y
        (by simpa only [Operations.biSuspensionIso,absoluteBoundary] using hess)
    · intro hn
      by_contra hnot
      apply hn
      intro u v hu huv hv x y hess
      apply hnot
      exact ⟨u,v,hu,huv,hv,x,y,
        by simpa only [Operations.biSuspensionIso,absoluteBoundary] using hess⟩
  rw [hdef]
  constructor
  · intro hcross hnc
    exact (delta_no_crossing_implies_classical X page r s t hpage hpr hnc).2.2 hcross
  · intro hcross
    by_contra hnc
    exact hcross (classical_noCrossing_absolute_boundary X page r s t ⟨by omega,hpr,hnc⟩)

private theorem essential_short_source_not_in_range
    (Al Bl Ae Be : SyntheticObject)
    (gl : Al.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ Bl.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
    (ge : Ae.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ Be.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
    (ra : Al.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ Ae.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
    (rb : Bl.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ Be.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
    (hsquare : ra ≫ ge = gl ≫ rb) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n u d : ℤ)
    (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hu : s < u) (htarget : u+d=s+n)
    (hcross : ExtensionNoCrossingRange (model.convergentMap Al Bl gl) p s n s)
    (xe : ((model.family.obj (Ae.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (u,p.1+u,p.2)).eInfty)
    (ye : ((model.family.obj (Be.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (u+d,p.1+(u+d),p.2)).eInfty)
    (he : TowerEssentialExtension (model.convergentMap Ae Be ge) p u d xe ye)
    (xl : ((model.family.obj (Al.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (u,p.1+u,p.2)).eInfty)
    (hxl : (model.family.map ra).eInftyMap (u,p.1+u,p.2) xl = xe) : False := by
  let FL := model.syntheticTower.filtration (Al.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
  let FE := model.syntheticTower.filtration (Ae.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
  let GE := model.syntheticTower.filtration (Be.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
  let IL := infinityGradedIso (model.convergence Al) p u
  let IE := infinityGradedIso (model.convergence Ae) p u
  haveI : Epi (FL.toAssociatedGraded u p) := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  obtain ⟨ar,har⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective (FL.toAssociatedGraded u p)).mp
    inferInstance (IL.hom xl)
  let α := (FL.F u p).arrow ar
  have hα : α ∈ model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule (Al.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) u p := by

      (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty) :

    (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) p s (α≫f)

  have hf := representative_grade_naturality (model.convergentMap A B f) p s ar br hbr.symm

private theorem infinityGradedTransportComm
    {A B A' B' : (ℤ × ℤ) → ModuleCat.{0} ℤ}
    {F : Filtration A} {G : Filtration B} {F' : Filtration A'} {G' : Filtration B'}
    {f : FilteredMorphism F G} {f' : FilteredMorphism F' G'}
    {p q : ℤ × ℤ} (e : FilteredMapTransport f f' p q) (s : ℤ) :
    f.inducedGrMap s p ≫ (e.target.gradedIso s).hom =
      (e.source.gradedIso s).hom ≫ f'.inducedGrMap s q := by
  have level_comm : (f.compat s p).choose ≫ (e.target.level s).hom =
      (e.source.level s).hom ≫ (f'.compat s q).choose := by
    apply (cancel_mono (G'.F s q).arrow).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [e.target.level_arrow, (f'.compat s q).choose_spec]
    rw [← Category.assoc, (f.compat s p).choose_spec, Category.assoc,
      ← e.map_comm]
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun a => a ≫ f'.map q)
      (e.source.level_arrow s).symm

          (S.filtered X p) s).hom ≫

  let M := D.convergentMap X Y f

    ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map f)

  change M.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s p ≫ ((S.filtered Y p).gradedIso s).hom =

  have hM' : M'.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s (p+δ) =

        (D.family.map ((SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map f)).eInftyMap

        (towerGradedIso (D.convergence (.shift δ Y)) (p+δ) s).hom := by
    calc
      _ = (towerGradedIso (D.convergence (.shift δ X)) (p+δ) s).inv ≫

            M'.filteredMap.inducedGrMap s (p+δ)) := by

  simp only [towerInfinityIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [← Category.assoc, infinityTowerGradedNatural (D.convergence X) (D.convergence Y) M]

private theorem correctionInfinity_rho (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (i q : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hiq : i ≤ q) (s t : ℤ) (a : ℕ)
    (z : ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.quotient q (.nu X)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a),((t-s)+(s+a))-a)).eInfty) :
    (model.family.map ((model.quotients.tower ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj
      model.nu model.auxiliary)).rho i q hiq)).eInftyMap _
      (correctionInfinity X Y f q s t a z) =
    correctionInfinity X Y f i s t a
      ((model.family.map ((model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).rho i q hiq)).eInftyMap _ z) := by
  let e : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
  let δ : ℤ × ℤ := (0,e)
  let u : ℤ := s+a
  let p₀ : ℤ × ℤ := (t-s,((t-s)+(s+a))-a)
  let p : ℤ × ℤ := (t-s,t+e)
  let hdeg : (u,(p₀+δ).1+u,(p₀+δ).2)=(u,p.1+u,p.2) := by
    ext <;> dsimp [δ,p₀,p,u,e] <;> omega
  let ra := (model.quotients.tower ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj
    model.nu model.auxiliary)).rho i q hiq
  let rn := (model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))).rho i q hiq
  let srn := (SyntheticCategory.biShift δ).map rn
  let IL := towerInfinityIso (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X)))
    (model.convergence (.shift δ (.quotient q (.nu X))))
    ((essShift δ).filtered (.quotient q (.nu X)) p₀) u
  let IE := towerInfinityIso (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu X)))
    (model.convergence (.shift δ (.quotient i (.nu X))))
    ((essShift δ).filtered (.quotient i (.nu X)) p₀) u
  let castL := eqToHom (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj
    ((SyntheticObject.shift δ (.quotient q (.nu X))).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData k).eInfty) hdeg)
  let castE := eqToHom (congrArg (fun k => ((model.family.obj
    ((SyntheticObject.shift δ (.quotient i (.nu X))).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData k).eInfty) hdeg)
  let zs := castL (IL.hom z)
  let zl := correctionInfinity X Y f q s t a z
  have hQ := correction_rho_square_infinity X Y f i q hi hiq p u zl
  have hcancel : (model.family.map (correctionShiftIso X Y f q).hom).eInftyMap _ zl = zs := by
    dsimp only [zl,correctionInfinity,zs,castL,IL,p₀,δ,u,e,hdeg]
    simp only [←ModuleCat.comp_apply,Category.assoc,←SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_comp,
      ←SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_comp,Iso.inv_hom_id,SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_id,
      SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_id,Category.comp_id,ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hcancel] at hQ
  have hNat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (infinityTowerNatural model δ (essShift δ) (.quotient q (.nu X)) (.quotient i (.nu X)) rn p₀ u) z
  have hshift : (model.family.map srn).eInftyMap (u,p.1+u,p.2) zs =
      castE (IE.hom ((model.family.map rn).eInftyMap _ z)) := by
    have hcast := infinity_map_regrade (.shift δ (.quotient q (.nu X)))
      (.shift δ (.quotient i (.nu X))) srn hdeg (IL.hom z)
    exact hcast.trans (congrArg castE hNat.symm)
  have hh := congrArg ((model.family.map (correctionShiftIso X Y f i).inv).eInftyMap
    (u,p.1+u,p.2)) (hQ.trans hshift)
  have hleft : (model.family.map (correctionShiftIso X Y f i).inv).eInftyMap _
      ((model.family.map (correctionShiftIso X Y f i).hom).eInftyMap _
        ((model.family.map ra).eInftyMap _ zl)) = (model.family.map ra).eInftyMap _ zl := by
    simp only [←ModuleCat.comp_apply,Category.assoc,←SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_comp,
      ←SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_comp,Iso.hom_inv_id,SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_id,
      SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_id,ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
  rw [hleft] at hh
  exact hh

    FiniteExtensionNonliftableShortTo X Y f rEarlier rLater n s t x y Wearly ∨
      ¬ ExtensionNoCrossingRange (model.convergentMap
        (.quotient (rLater-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
        (.quotient (rLater-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rLater-1)))

      (.quotient (rLater-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (rLater-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rLater-1)))

  · have hy := earlier_target_nonzero X Y f rEarlier rLater n s t x y Wlater Wearly hle hess
    obtain ⟨a,ha,han,x',hx',z,hz,hs⟩ := finiteExtension_essential_shorter_source
      X Y f rEarlier n s t x y Wearly hy hne

    · have hi : 0<rEarlier-1 := by have := Wearly.page_ge_two; omega
      have haq : a<rEarlier-1 := by have := Wearly.length_upper; omega
      obtain ⟨zl,hzl⟩ := correction_source_lift_of_late_cycle X Y f
        (rEarlier-1) (rLater-1) hi (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1) s t a haq x' hxl z hz

        (.quotient (rLater-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
        (.quotient (rLater-1) (.nu Y))
        (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
        (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y))

        (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier-1))
        ((model.quotients.tower ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).rho

        ((model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary))).rho

private theorem extension_square_map
    (A B A' B' : SyntheticObject)
    (g : A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
    (g' : A'.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ B'.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
    (ra : A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ A'.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
    (rb : B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ B'.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
    (hsquare : ra ≫ g' = g ≫ rb) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n : ℤ)
    (x : ((model.family.obj (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((model.family.obj (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)
    (h : TowerExtensionEquation (model.convergentMap A B g) p s n x y) :
    TowerExtensionEquation (model.convergentMap A' B' g') p s n
      ((model.family.functor.map ra).eInftyMap (s,p.1+s,p.2) x)
      ((model.family.functor.map rb).eInftyMap (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2) y) := by
  obtain ⟨hn,a,b,hab,ha,hb⟩ :=
    (tower_extension_iff (model.convergentMap A B g) p s n x y).mp h
  let a' := ((model.convergentMap A A' ra).filteredMap.compat s p).choose a
  let b' := ((model.convergentMap B B' rb).filteredMap.compat (s+n) p).choose b
  have ha' : ((model.syntheticTower.filtration (A'.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).F s p).arrow a' =
      ((model.syntheticTower.filtration (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).F s p).arrow a ≫ ra := by
    have hh := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      ((model.convergentMap A A' ra).filteredMap.compat s p).choose_spec a
    change _ = (model.convergentMap A A' ra).filteredMap.map p
      (((model.syntheticTower.filtration (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).F s p).arrow a) at hh
    exact hh.trans (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      ((model.convergentMap A A' ra).filteredMap_map p) _)
  have hb' : ((model.syntheticTower.filtration (B'.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).F (s+n) p).arrow b' =
      ((model.syntheticTower.filtration (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).F (s+n) p).arrow b ≫ rb := by
    have hh := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      ((model.convergentMap B B' rb).filteredMap.compat (s+n) p).choose_spec b
    change _ = (model.convergentMap B B' rb).filteredMap.map p
      (((model.syntheticTower.filtration (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).F (s+n) p).arrow b) at hh
    exact hh.trans (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      ((model.convergentMap B B' rb).filteredMap_map p) _)
  apply (tower_extension_iff (model.convergentMap A' B' g') p s n _ _).mpr
  refine ⟨hn,a',b',?_,?_,?_⟩

public theorem finiteExtension_descends
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (y : Ambient model Y (s+n,t+n))
    (hr : 2 ≤ rEarlier) (hle : rEarlier ≤ rLater)
    (hnUpper : n ≤ (rEarlier : ℤ) - 2 + normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
    (h : FiniteExtension model X Y f rLater n s t x y) :
    FiniteExtension model X Y f rEarlier n s t x y := by
  obtain ⟨W⟩ := h
  let ra := (model.quotients.tower
    ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).rho
      (rEarlier-1) (rLater-1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1)
  let rb := (model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary))).rho
    (rEarlier-1) (rLater-1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1)
  refine ⟨{
    page_ge_two := hr
    length_lower := W.length_lower
    length_upper := hnUpper
    source_cycle := reaches_earlier (by omega) (by omega) W.source_cycle
    target_cycle := reaches_earlier (by omega) (by omega) W.target_cycle
    source := (model.family.functor.map ra).eInftyMap
      (s,(t-s)+s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) W.source
    target := (model.family.functor.map rb).eInftyMap
      (s+n,(t-s)+(s+n),t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) W.target
    source_rep := ?_
    target_rep := ?_
    equation := ?_ }⟩
  · have hh := family_infinity_representative_map ra _ _ W.source W.source_rep
    rw [finite_source_rho] at hh
    exact hh
  · have hh := family_infinity_representative_map rb _ _ W.target W.target_rep
    rw [finite_target_rho] at hh
    exact hh
  · exact extension_square_map
      (.quotient (rLater-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (rLater-1) (.nu Y))
      (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y))
      (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rLater-1))
      (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier-1)) ra rb
      ((model.quotients.natural (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map).rho_naturality
        (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s n W.source W.target W.equation

private theorem tower_essential_shorter_same_target

    (x : ((F.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)
    (h : TowerExtensionEquation M p s n x y)
    (hy : y≠0) (hne : ¬TowerEssentialExtension M p s n x y) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, 0<a ∧ (a:ℤ)≤n ∧
      ∃ z : ((F.obj X).sequence.ssData (s+a,p.1+(s+a),p.2)).eInfty,
        TowerEssentialExtension M p (s+a) (n-a) z
          ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun d =>
            ((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData (d,p.1+d,p.2)).eInfty)
            (show s+n=(s+a)+(n-a) by omega))) y) := by
  classical
  let Pred (a : ℕ) : Prop := 0<a ∧ a≤n.toNat ∧ ∃
    (ar : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F (s+a) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
    (br : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
    ((P.filtration X).F (s+a) p).arrow ar ≫ g =
      ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ∧
    (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br =
      (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y
  obtain ⟨_,ar1,br1,heq1,hbr1⟩ :=
    (tower_inessential_iff_higher_source_same_target M p s n x y h).mp hne
  have hp1 : Pred 1 := ⟨by decide,by omega,ar1,br1,heq1,hbr1⟩
  let a := Nat.findGreatest Pred n.toNat
  obtain ⟨ha,han,ar,br,heq,hbr⟩ := Nat.findGreatest_spec (P:=Pred)
    (show 1≤n.toNat by omega) hp1
  let I := infinityGradedIso cx p (s+a)
  let z := I.inv ((P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded (s+a) p ar)
  have haz : (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded (s+a) p ar = I.hom z :=
    (I.toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).symm
  have he : TowerExtensionEquation M p (s+a) (n-a) z
      ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun d =>
        ((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData (d,p.1+d,p.2)).eInfty)
        (show s+n=(s+a)+(n-a) by omega))) y) :=
    (tower_extension_reindexed M p (s+a) (n-a) (s+n) (by omega) z y).mpr
      ⟨by omega,ar,br,heq,haz,hbr⟩
  refine ⟨a,ha,by omega,z,?_⟩
  by_contra hnot
  have he0 := (tower_inessential_iff_zero_source_same_target M p (s+a) (n-a)
    z _ he).mp hnot
  obtain ⟨_,ar0,br0,heq0,har0,hbr0⟩ :=
    (tower_extension_reindexed M p (s+a) (n-a) (s+n) (by omega) 0 y).mp he0
  have hzero : (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded (s+a) p ar0=0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using har0
  have hmem : ((P.filtration X).F (s+a) p).arrow ar0 ∈
      P.filtrationSubmodule X (s+a+1) p := by
    have hh := ((P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded_eq_zero_iff (s+a) p ar0).mp hzero
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hh
  have hanext : a+1≤n.toNat := by
    by_contra hgt
    have hae : (a:ℤ)=n := by omega
    have hhigh := map_preserves_filtration M p (s+a+1)
      (((P.filtration X).F (s+a) p).arrow ar0) hmem
    have htarget : ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br0 ∈
        ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n+1) p) := by
      rw [←heq0]
      simpa only [hae,SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hhigh
    have hbzero := ((P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded_eq_zero_iff (s+n) p br0).mpr htarget
    apply hy
    apply (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).toLinearEquiv.injective
    change (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y =
      (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom 0
    rw [←hbr0,map_zero,hbzero]
  have hmem' : ((P.filtration X).F (s+a) p).arrow ar0 ∈
      P.filtrationSubmodule X (s+((a+1:ℕ):ℤ)) p := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,add_assoc] using hmem
  obtain ⟨arn,harn⟩ := filtration_representative_exists P X p (s+((a+1:ℕ):ℤ))
    (((P.filtration X).F (s+a) p).arrow ar0) hmem'
  have hpnext : Pred (a+1) := by
    refine ⟨by omega,hanext,arn,br0,?_,hbr0⟩
    rw [harn]
    exact heq0
  have hamax := Nat.le_findGreatest (P:=Pred) hanext hpnext
  change a+1≤a at hamax
  omega

private theorem correction_label_exists (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (s t : ℤ) (a : ℕ) (ha : a < q)
    (z : ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.quotient q (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj
      model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a),t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)).eInfty) :
    ∃ x : Ambient model X (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a)),
      x ∈ cycles model X ((q:ℤ)-a) (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a)) ∧
      HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 _ (finiteExtensionCorrectionLabel X Y f q s t a x) z := by
  let e : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
  let u : ℤ := s+a
  let v : ℤ := (t-s)+(s+a)
  let p : ℤ × ℤ := (t-s,v-a)
  let Q := correctionShiftIso X Y f q
  let I := towerInfinityIso (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu X)))
    (model.convergence (.shift (0,e) (.quotient q (.nu X))))
    ((essShift (0,e)).filtered (.quotient q (.nu X)) p) u
  let hdeg : (u,(p+(0,e)).1+u,(p+(0,e)).2) =
      (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a),t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) := by
    ext <;> dsimp [p,u,v,e] <;> omega
  let zs := ((model.family.map Q.hom).eInftyMap _ z)
  let zu := I.inv ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun i =>
    ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.shift (0,e) (.quotient q (.nu X))).obj
      model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData i).eInfty) hdeg.symm)) zs)
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hrep,_⟩ := CrossingLabels.finite_grade_label X q hq u v (v-a)
    (by dsimp [v]; constructor <;> omega) zu
  have hlabel : nuWeightLabel model X u v (v-a) (by omega) x =
      targetNuLabel model X u v a x := by
    have hk : (v-(v-(a:ℤ))).toNat=a := by omega
    have transport (b c : ℕ) (he : b=c) (hi : (u,v,v-b)=(u,v,v-c)) :
        regradeE2 hi (targetNuLabel model X u v b x) = targetNuLabel model X u v c x := by
      subst c
      rfl
    exact transport _ a hk _
  rw [hlabel] at hrep
  refine ⟨x,?_,?_⟩
  · convert hx using 1 <;> dsimp [u,v] <;> congr 1 <;> omega
  have hs := ((essShift (0,e)).representative_iff (.quotient q (.nu X)) 2
    (by decide) p u (finiteTargetLabel model X q u v a x) zu).mp hrep
  have hs' := infinity_representative_regrade hdeg _ _ hs
  have hz : ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun i =>
      ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.shift (0,e) (.quotient q (.nu X))).obj
        model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData i).eInfty) hdeg)) (I.hom zu)) = zs := by
    dsimp only [zu]
    simp only [←ModuleCat.comp_apply,Category.assoc,Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
      eqToHom_trans,eqToHom_refl,ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
  rw [hz] at hs'
  have hm := family_infinity_representative_map Q.inv _ _ zs hs'
  have hc : (model.family.map Q.inv).eInftyMap _ zs = z := by
    dsimp only [zs]
    rw [←ModuleCat.comp_apply,←SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_comp,
      ←SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_comp,Q.hom_inv_id,SyntheticAdamsFamily.map_id,
      SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_id,ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
  rw [hc] at hm
  exact hm

    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ) (x y)

    (Wearly : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f rEarlier n s t x y)

  let rb := (model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary))).rho
    (rEarlier-1) (rLater-1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1)
  have hh := family_infinity_representative_map rb _ _ Wlater.target Wlater.target_rep
  rw [finite_target_rho] at hh
  have heq := hh.unique Wearly.target_rep
  have hlate : Wlater.target ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply ((tower_essential_iff_no_zero _ _ _ _ _ _ Wlater.equation).mp hess)
    simpa only [hz] using Wlater.equation
  intro hz
  apply hlate
  apply rho_infty_injective Y (rEarlier-1) (rLater-1)
    (by have := Wearly.page_ge_two; omega) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1)
    (s+n) ((t-s)+(s+n)) (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
    (by have := Wearly.length_upper; omega)
  change (model.family.map rb).eInftyMap _ Wlater.target =
    (model.family.map rb).eInftyMap _ 0

public theorem finiteExtension_inessential_iff_shorter (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ) (x y)
    (Wlater : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f rLater n s t x y)
    (Wearly : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f rEarlier n s t x y)
    (hle : rEarlier ≤ rLater) (hess : Wlater.Essential) :
    ¬ Wearly.Essential ↔ ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧
      (a:ℤ) ≤ n-normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f ∧
      ∃ x' : Ambient model X (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a)),
        x' ∈ cycles model X (((rEarlier-1:ℕ):ℤ)- (a:ℤ)) (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a)) ∧
        ∃ z,
          HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 _
            (finiteExtensionCorrectionLabel X Y f (rEarlier-1) s t a x') z ∧
          TowerExtensionEquation (model.convergentMap
            (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
            (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier-1)))
            (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+a) (n-a) z
            ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun d =>
              ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)).obj
                model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
                (d,(t-s)+d,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)).eInfty)
              (show s+n = (s+a)+(n-a) by omega))) Wearly.target) := by

    model.nu model.auxiliary
  let B := (SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary
  let p : ℤ × ℤ := (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
  let M := model.convergentMap
    (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
    (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier-1))
  have hy := earlier_target_nonzero X Y f rEarlier rLater n s t x y Wlater Wearly hle hess
  constructor
  · intro hne
    have hn := inessential_length_strict X Y f rEarlier n s t x y Wearly hy hne
    have hq : 1 < rEarlier-1 := by have := Wearly.length_upper; omega
    obtain ⟨hn0,ar,br,heq,hbr⟩ :=
      (tower_inessential_iff_higher_source_same_target M p s n
        Wearly.source Wearly.target Wearly.equation).mp hne
    let I := infinityGradedIso (model.convergence
      (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))) p (s+1)
    let z := I.inv ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).toAssociatedGraded (s+1) p ar)
    obtain ⟨x',hx',hz⟩ := correction_label_exists X Y f (rEarlier-1)
      (by omega) s t 1 hq z
    refine ⟨1,by decide,by omega,x',hx',z,hz,?_⟩
    apply (tower_extension_reindexed M p (s+1) (n-1) (s+n) (by omega) z Wearly.target).mpr
    refine ⟨by omega,ar,br,heq,?_,hbr⟩
    exact (I.toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).symm
  · rintro ⟨a,ha,han,x',hx',z,hz,he⟩
    obtain ⟨_,ar,br,heq,_,hbr⟩ :=
      (tower_extension_reindexed M p (s+a) (n-a) (s+n) (by omega) z Wearly.target).mp he
    have hα : ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F (s+a) p).arrow ar ∈
        model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule A (s+a) p := by
      have hm : ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F (s+a) p).arrow ar ∈
          ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F (s+a) p) := ⟨ar,rfl⟩
      simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hm
    have hα' := model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule_antitone A p
      (show s+1 ≤ s+a by omega) hα
    obtain ⟨ar',har'⟩ := filtration_representative_exists model.syntheticTower A p (s+1)
      (((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F (s+a) p).arrow ar) hα'
    apply (tower_inessential_iff_higher_source_same_target M p s n
      Wearly.source Wearly.target Wearly.equation).mpr
    refine ⟨by have := Wearly.length_lower; omega,ar',br,?_,hbr⟩
    rw [har']
    exact heq

            (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
            (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier-1)))
            (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+a) (n-a) z

private theorem image_correction_in_next
    (M : ConvergentMap E g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n threshold : ℤ) (hthreshold : threshold ≤ s+n)
    (hcross : ExtensionNoCrossingRange M p s n threshold)
    (a : BiHom p.1 p.2 X)
    (ha : a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X (s+1) p)
    (hga : a ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y threshold p) :
    a ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (s+n+1) p := by
  let F : ℤ → AddSubgroup (BiHom p.1 p.2 X) :=
    fun k => (P.filtrationSubmodule X k p).toAddSubgroup
  let G : ℤ → AddSubgroup (BiHom p.1 p.2 Y) :=
    fun k => (P.filtrationSubmodule Y k p).toAddSubgroup
  let f : BiHom p.1 p.2 X →+ BiHom p.1 p.2 Y :=
    (syntheticHomotopyMap g p).hom.toAddMonoidHom
  by_contra hnot
  have hnot' : f a ∉ G (threshold + (s+n+1-threshold).toNat) := by
    have hindex : threshold + ((s+n+1-threshold).toNat : ℤ) = s+n+1 := by
      rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ s+n+1-threshold by omega)]
      omega
    rw [hindex]
    change ¬ a ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (s+n+1) p
    exact hnot
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbn,hgb,hgbnext⟩ :=
    first_nonzero_filtration_grade G threshold (s+n+1-threshold).toNat (f a)
      hga hnot'
  by_cases hbs : b ≤ s
  · apply hgbnext
    exact P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone Y p (by omega)
      (map_preserves_filtration M p (s+1) a ha)
  · apply hgbnext
    exact Internal.Leibniz.higher_source_image_of_nonessential f F G
      (fun i j hij z hz => P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone Y p hij hz)
      (fun k z hz => map_preserves_filtration M p k z hz) s b (by omega)
      (fun k hsk hkb z hz hgz => by
        change z ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y b p at hgz
        have hno : ∀ x y, ¬TowerEssentialExtension M p k (b-k) x y := by
          intro x y hess
          have hy := hcross k b hsk hkb hb (by omega) x y hess.1
          subst y
          exact (Internal.Leibniz.tower_essential_iff_no_zero M p k (b-k) x 0 hess.1).mp hess hess.1
        have hh := Internal.Leibniz.tower_correction_of_nonessential M p k (b-k)
          (by omega) hno z hz (by
            simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using hgz)
        change ∃ b', b' ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X k p ∧
          z-b' ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X (k+1) p ∧
          b' ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (b+1) p
        simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using hh) a ha hgb

    (hcross : ExtensionNoCrossingRange M p s n threshold)
    (a : BiHom p.1 p.2 X)
    (ha : a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X (s+1) p)

  rw [har,hbr]

public theorem extension_noCrossingRange_iff
    (M : ConvergentMap E g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n threshold : ℤ) (hthreshold : threshold ≤ s+n)
    (x : ((E.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)
    (he : TowerExtensionEquation M p s n x y) :
    ExtensionNoCrossingRange M p s n threshold ↔
      ∀ a : BiHom p.1 p.2 X, RepresentsInfinityClass cx p s x a →
        a ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y threshold p →
        RepresentsInfinityClass cy p (s+n) y (a ≫ g) := by
  obtain ⟨hn,ar₀,br₀,he₀,hx₀,hy₀⟩ := (tower_extension_iff M p s n x y).mp he
  let a₀ : BiHom p.1 p.2 X := ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar₀
  let b₀ : BiHom p.1 p.2 Y := ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br₀
  have hx : RepresentsInfinityClass cx p s x a₀ := ⟨ar₀,rfl,hx₀⟩
  have hy : RepresentsInfinityClass cy p (s+n) y b₀ := ⟨br₀,rfl,hy₀⟩
  have hbase : a₀ ≫ g = b₀ := he₀
  constructor
  · intro hc a ha hga
    have hdiff := representatives_difference p s x a a₀ ha hx
    have himage : (a-a₀) ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y threshold p := by
      rw [Preadditive.sub_comp,hbase]
      exact (P.filtrationSubmodule Y threshold p).sub_mem hga
        (P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone Y p hthreshold (represents_mem p (s+n) y b₀ hy))
    have hh := image_correction_in_next M p s n threshold hthreshold hc (a-a₀) hdiff himage
    apply represents_of_difference p (s+n) y (a≫g) b₀ hy
    simpa only [Preadditive.sub_comp,hbase] using hh
  · intro hall u v hsu huv htv hvs xx yy he'
    obtain ⟨_,ar,br,heq,hxx,hyy⟩ := (tower_extension_iff M p u (v-u) xx yy).mp he'
    let a : BiHom p.1 p.2 X := ((P.filtration X).F u p).arrow ar
    have ha : a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X u p := by
      have h : a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration X).F u p) := ⟨ar,rfl⟩
      simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using h
    have hfa : a≫g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y v p := by
      have h : a≫g ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration Y).F (u+(v-u)) p) :=
        ⟨br,heq.symm⟩
      simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,
        add_sub_cancel] using h
    have hsum : RepresentsInfinityClass cx p s x (a₀+a) := by
      apply represents_of_difference p s x (a₀+a) a₀ hx
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using
        (P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone X p (show s+1 ≤ u by omega) ha)
    have hsumg : (a₀+a)≫g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y threshold p := by
      rw [Preadditive.add_comp,hbase]
      exact (P.filtrationSubmodule Y threshold p).add_mem
        (P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone Y p hthreshold (represents_mem p (s+n) y b₀ hy))
        (P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone Y p htv hfa)
    have hdet := hall (a₀+a) hsum hsumg
    have hdiff := representatives_difference p (s+n) y ((a₀+a)≫g) b₀ hdet hy
    have hnext : a≫g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (v+1) p := by
      have h : a≫g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (s+n+1) p := by
        simpa only [Preadditive.add_comp,hbase,add_sub_cancel_left] using hdiff
      exact P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone Y p (by omega) h
    have hzero := (Internal.element_grade_equal_iff (P.filtration Y) (u+(v-u)) p br 0).mpr
      (by
        rw [←heq,map_zero,sub_zero]
        simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply,
          add_sub_cancel, a] using hnext)
    apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (infinityGradedIso cy p (u+(v-u))).hom).mp inferInstance
    rw [map_zero]
    rw [map_zero] at hzero
    exact hyy.symm.trans hzero
statement:
public theorem extension_noCrossingRange_iff
    (M : ConvergentMap E g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n threshold : ℤ) (hthreshold : threshold ≤ s+n)
    (x : ((E.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)

    (M : ConvergentMap E g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n : ℤ)
    (x : ((E.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)

    (hmap : ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ a : BiHom p.1 p.2 X,
      a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X k p →
      a ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (k+n) p) :
    ExtensionNoCrossingRange M p s n s := by
  apply (extension_noCrossing_iff M p s n x y he).mpr
  obtain ⟨_,ar₀,br₀,he₀,hx₀,hy₀⟩ := (tower_extension_iff M p s n x y).mp he

  have hy : RepresentsInfinityClass cy p (s+n) y b₀ := ⟨br₀,rfl,hy₀⟩

  intro a ha
  apply represents_of_difference p (s+n) y (a≫g) b₀ hy
  have hdiff := hmap (s+1) (a-a₀) (representatives_difference p s x a a₀ ha hx)

public theorem filtered_extension_noCrossingRange_iff (f : A →+ B)
    (F : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup B)
    (hF : Antitone F) (hG : Antitone G)
    (hf : ∀ u a, a ∈ F u → f a ∈ G u)
    (s n threshold : ℤ) (ht : threshold ≤ s+n)
    (a0 : A) (ha0 : a0 ∈ F s) (hfa0 : f a0 ∈ G (s+n)) :
    FilteredNoCrossingRange f F G s n threshold ↔
      ∀ a : A, a ∈ F s → a-a0 ∈ F (s+1) → f a ∈ G threshold →
        f a ∈ G (s+n) ∧ f a-f a0 ∈ G (s+n+1) := by
  constructor
  · intro hc a _ hd hfa
    have hh := filtered_correction_in_next f F G hG hf s n threshold ht hc
      (a-a0) hd (by rw [map_sub]; exact (G threshold).sub_mem hfa (hG ht hfa0))
    have hdiff : f a-f a0 ∈ G (s+n+1) := by simpa only [map_sub] using hh
    refine ⟨?_,hdiff⟩
    have h := (G (s+n)).add_mem (hG (show s+n ≤ s+n+1 by omega) hdiff) hfa0
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using h
  · intro hall u v hsu huv htv hvs a ha hfa
    have ha' : a ∈ F (s+1) := hF (by omega) ha
    have hsum : a0+a ∈ F s := (F s).add_mem ha0 (hF (by omega) ha)
    have hdiff : a0+a-a0 ∈ F (s+1) := by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using ha'
    have hsumf : f (a0+a) ∈ G threshold := by
      rw [map_add]
      exact (G threshold).add_mem (hG ht hfa0) (hG htv hfa)
    have hh := (hall (a0+a) hsum hdiff hsumf).2
    have hh' : f a ∈ G (s+n+1) := by simpa only [map_add,add_sub_cancel_left] using hh
    exact hG (by omega) hh'

private theorem nu_sphere_automorphism_detects (X : ClassicalObject)
    (s t : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (y : Ambient model X (s,t))
    (u : Smn (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (t-s) (t-k) ≅ Smn (t-s) (t-k))
    (a : BiHom (t-s) (t-k) (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)))
    (ha : Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s,t,t-k)
      (targetNuLabel model X s t k y) a) :
    Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s,t,t-k)
      (targetNuLabel model X s t k y) (u.hom ≫ a) := by
  let q := k+1
  have hq : 0<q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hmap := detects_map (.nu X) (.quotient q (.nu X)) (XModLambdaN.incl _ q)
    (s,t,t-k) _ a ha
  have hauto := sphere_automorphism_finite_detects X q k (by dsimp [q]; omega)
    s t y u (a≫XModLambdaN.incl _ q) hmap
  have hfil := detects_filtration (.nu X) _ _ _ ha
  obtain ⟨e,he,_,_,_⟩ := ha
  apply detects_reflect (.nu X) (.quotient q (.nu X)) (XModLambdaN.incl _ q)
    (s,t,t-k) (nu_projection_infinity_injective X q hq s t (t-k) (by dsimp [q]; omega))
    _ e he (u.hom≫a)
    (sphere_precomp_preserves_filtration (t-s) (t-k) s u.hom a
      hfil)
  simpa only [finiteTargetLabel, SyntheticAdamsFamily.pageMap,
    familyPageMap, SyntheticAdamsFamily.map, SyntheticObject.obj, Category.assoc] using hauto

code:
private theorem weighted_absolute_boundary (X : ClassicalObject)
    (n k a : ℕ) (ha : a<n) (hnk : n≤a+k) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (y : Ambient model X (s+k+1,t+k))
    (hd : HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      (k+1) (s,t) (s+k+1,t+k) x y)
    (hy : y∈permanentCycles model X (s+k+1,t+k)) :
    ∃ b : BiHom (t-s) (t-a) (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) n),
      Detects (model.convergence (.quotient n (.nu X))) (s,t,t-a)
        (finiteTargetLabel model X n s t a x) b ∧
      Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s+k+1,t+k,t-a+n)
        (nuWeightLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) (t-a+n) (by omega) y)
        (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl
          (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) (t-a) n (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
            (b≫XModLambdaN.proj _ n))) := by
  by_cases ha0 : a=0
  · subst a
    obtain ⟨b,hb,hδ⟩ := differential_absolute_boundary X n k (by omega) (by omega) s t x y hd hy
    have H (w : ℤ) (hw : w=t) :
        ∃ c : BiHom (t-s) w (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) n),
          Detects (model.convergence (.quotient n (.nu X))) (s,t,w)
            (regradeE2 (show (s,t,t-(0:ℕ))=(s,t,w) by simp [hw])
              (finiteTargetLabel model X n s t 0 x)) c ∧
          Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s+k+1,t+k,w+n)
            (nuWeightLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) (w+n) (by omega) y)
            (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl
              (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) w n (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
                (c≫XModLambdaN.proj _ n))) := by
      subst w
      exact ⟨b, first_label_detects_unshifted X n (by omega) s t x b hb, hδ⟩
    simpa only [regradeE2, eqToHom_refl,ConcreteCategory.id_apply] using H (t-(0:ℕ)) (by simp)
  have ha' : 0<a := by omega
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hδ⟩ := differential_absolute_boundary X (n-a) k (by omega) (by omega) s t x y hd hy
  let c := finiteLambdaClass X n a ha' ha s t b
  have hc := finite_quotient_lambda_detects X n a ha' ha s t x b hb
  refine ⟨c,hc,?_⟩
  have hauto := nu_sphere_weight_detects X (s+k+1) (t+k) (t+(n-a:ℕ)) ((t-s)-1)
    (by omega) (by omega) y (boundaryDivisionSourceIso a n ha.le (t-s) t)
    (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t ((n-a:ℕ):ℤ)
      (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (b≫XModLambdaN.proj _ (n-a))) hδ
  have hdiv := divided_boundary_eq_reindex X a n ha' ha (t-s) t b
  dsimp only at hdiv
  rw [boundaryDivisionReindex_eq_precomp] at hdiv
  have transport_weight (w w' : ℤ) (he : w=w') (hw : w≤t+k) (hw' : w'≤t+k)
      (z : BiHom ((t-s)-1) w (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)))
      (hz : Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s+k+1,t+k,w)
        (nuWeightLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) w hw y)
        (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl z)) :
      Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s+k+1,t+k,w')
        (nuWeightLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) w' hw' y)
        (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) he z) := by
    subst w'
    exact hz
  have ht := transport_weight (t+(n-a:ℕ)) (t-a+n) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) _ hauto
  rw [←hdiv] at ht
  convert ht using 1
  dsimp only [c]
  rw [finiteLambdaClass_vertical]
  simp only [regrade_precomp,←Category.assoc,eqToHom_trans]
statement:
private theorem weighted_absolute_boundary (X : ClassicalObject)
    (n k a : ℕ) (ha : a<n) (hnk : n≤a+k) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (y : Ambient model X (s+k+1,t+k))
    (hd : HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      (k+1) (s,t) (s+k+1,t+k) x y)
    (hy : y∈permanentCycles model X (s+k+1,t+k)) :
    ∃ b : BiHom (t-s) (t-a) (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) n),
      Detects (model.convergence (.quotient n (.nu X))) (s,t,t-a)
        (finiteTargetLabel model X n s t a x) b ∧
      Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s+k+1,t+k,t-a+n)
        (nuWeightLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) (t-a+n) (by omega) y)
        (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl
          (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) (t-a) n (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
            (b≫XModLambdaN.proj _ n)))

    ∃ b : BiHom (t-s) (t-a) (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) n),
      Detects (model.convergence (.quotient n (.nu X))) (s,t,t-a)
        (finiteTargetLabel model X n s t a x) b ∧
      Detects (model.convergence (.nu X)) (s+k+1,t+k,t-a+n)
        (nuWeightLabel model X (s+k+1) (t+k) (t-a+n) (by omega) y)
        (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl
          (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) (t-a) n (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
            (b≫XModLambdaN.proj _ n))) := by
  rcases ha.lt_or_eq with ha | heq
  · exact weighted_absolute_boundary X n k a ha hnk s t x y hd hy
  subst a
  have hzero := KIP126.Literature.Standard.finite_quotient_vanishing X n hn 2 (by omega)
    s t (t-n) (Or.inr (by omega))
  have hsource : finiteTargetLabel model X n s t n x=0 :=
    (ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hzero).elim _ _
  have hsourceDet := detects_zero_representative (.quotient n (.nu X)) (s,t,t-n)
    (finiteTargetLabel model X n s t n x) (by
      rw [hsource]
      exact HasInfinityRepresentative.zero _ 2 (by omega) _)
  have hr : 2≤(k:ℤ)+1 := by
    obtain ⟨_,_,_,hx,_,_⟩ := hd
    exact hx.1
  have hlater := FinitePageCalculus.differential_target_later_zero
    (t := (k:ℤ)+2) (by rw [model.classical.firstPage]; omega) (by omega) hd
  have hbound := represents_zero_mem_boundary model X ((k:ℤ)+2) (s+k+1,t+k) y hlater
  have htarget := nu_boundary_detects_zero X (s+k+1) (t+k) (t-n+n) (by omega) y hy (by
    convert hbound using 1
    congr 1
    omega)
  refine ⟨0,hsourceDet,?_⟩
  have hz {m m' w w' : ℤ} (hm : m=m') (hw : w=w') (A : SyntheticSpectrum) :
      homotopyRegrade hm hw (0 : BiHom m w A)=0 := by
    subst m'; subst w'; rfl
  simpa only [zero_comp,map_zero,hz] using htarget

private theorem boundary_detects_shifted (B : SyntheticObject) (n : ℕ) (m w v : ℤ)
    (a : BiHom m w ((SyntheticObject.quotient n B).obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
    (y : (model.family.obj (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).E₂ (v,m-1+v,w+n))
    (hy : Detects (model.convergence B) (v,m-1+v,w+n) y
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl
        (biSuspensionHomEquiv m w n (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)
          (a≫XModLambdaN.proj _ n)))) :
    Detects (model.convergence (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) B)) (v,m+v,w)
      (syntheticBoundaryLabel B n m w v y)
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl (a≫absoluteBoundary (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) n)) := by
  let β := biSuspensionHomEquiv m w n (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (a≫XModLambdaN.proj _ n)
  have hd := detects_shift B (1,-(n:ℤ)) (m-1,w+n) v y β hy
  have he : a≫absoluteBoundary (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) n =
      homotopyRegrade (sub_add_cancel m 1) (add_neg_cancel_right w (n:ℤ))
        (shiftHomotopyClass (1,-(n:ℤ)) (m-1,w+n) β) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z => z≫(biSuspensionIso n (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).inv)
      (bi_susp_symm_eq m w n (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) β)
    simpa [β,absoluteBoundary,shiftHomotopyClass,susp_invariance,Iso.homCongr] using h
  have hind : (v,((m-1,w+n)+(1,-(n:ℤ))).1+v,((m-1,w+n)+(1,-(n:ℤ))).2)=(v,m+v,w) := by
    ext <;> dsimp <;> omega
  have hd := detects_transport hind _ _ hd
  convert hd using 1
  · rfl
  · rw [he]
    simp only [regrade_precomp,←Category.assoc,eqToHom_trans]

      (k+1) (s,t) (s+k+1,t+k) x y)
    (hy : y∈permanentCycles model X (s+k+1,t+k)) :
    ∃ ex ey,
      HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,(t-s)+s,t-a)
        (syntheticDeltaSourceLabel X n s t a x) ex ∧
      HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a)
        (syntheticDeltaNuLabel X n k a s t hnk y) ey ∧
      TowerExtensionEquation (model.convergentMap (.quotient n (.nu X))
        (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.nu X)) (syntheticAbsoluteBoundary X n))
        (t-s,t-a) s (k+1) ex ey := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hδ⟩ := weighted_absolute_boundary_closed X n k a hn ha hnk s t x y hd hy
  have hb' := detects_transport (show (s,t,t-a)=(s,(t-s)+s,t-a) by simp) _ _ hb
  have hδ' := detects_transport
    (show (s+k+1,t+k,t-a+n)=(s+(k+1),(t-s)-1+(s+(k+1)),t-a+n) by ext <;> dsimp <;> omega)
    _ _ hδ
  have hδ' := boundary_detects_shifted (.nu X) n (t-s) (t-a) (s+(k+1)) b _ (by
    convert hδ' using 1
    simp only [SyntheticObject.obj,regrade_precomp,←Category.assoc,eqToHom_trans])
  have he := extension_equation_of_detected_pair
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient n (.nu X)) (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.nu X))
      (syntheticAbsoluteBoundary X n)) (t-s,t-a) s (k+1) (by omega)
      (syntheticDeltaSourceLabel X n s t a x) _ b (b≫syntheticAbsoluteBoundary X n)
      (by exact hb') (by
          simpa only [syntheticAbsoluteBoundary, absoluteBoundary,Operations.biSuspensionIso,
            SyntheticObject.obj] using hδ') rfl
  exact he

private theorem not_essential_of_source_injective
    (M : ConvergentMap E g ca.toConvergence cb.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s d : ℤ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hf : Function.Injective ((E.functor.map g).eInftyMap (s,p.1+s,p.2)).hom)
    (x : ((E.obj A).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj B).sequence.ssData (s+d,p.1+(s+d),p.2)).eInfty) :
    ¬ TowerEssentialExtension M p s d x y := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨_,ar,br,hab,hx,_⟩ := (tower_extension_iff M p s d x y).mp h.1
  have ha : ((P.filtration A).F s p).arrow ar ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule A s p := by
    have hh : ((P.filtration A).F s p).arrow ar ∈
        ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration A).F s p) := ⟨ar,rfl⟩
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hh
  have hb : ((P.filtration A).F s p).arrow ar ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule B (s+1) p := by
    apply P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone B p (show s+1 ≤ s+d by omega)
    have hh : ((P.filtration A).F s p).arrow ar ≫ g ∈
        ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration B).F (s+d) p) := ⟨br,hab.symm⟩
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hh
  have hn := next_filtration_of_infinity_injective M p s hf _ ha hb
  have hz : (P.filtration A).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = 0 := by
    have hh := (element_grade_equal_iff (P.filtration A) s p ar 0).mpr (by
      simpa only [map_zero,sub_zero,SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,
        OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hn)
    simpa only [map_zero] using hh
  have hx0 : x = 0 := (infinityGradedIso ca p s).toLinearEquiv.injective
    (hx.symm.trans (hz.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  subst x
  exact zero_source_not_essential M p s d (by omega) y h

private theorem not_essential_of_target_surjective
    (M : ConvergentMap E g ca.toConvergence cb.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s d : ℤ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hf : Function.Surjective ((E.functor.map g).eInftyMap (s+d,p.1+(s+d),p.2)).hom)
    (x : ((E.obj A).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj B).sequence.ssData (s+d,p.1+(s+d),p.2)).eInfty) :
    ¬ TowerEssentialExtension M p s d x y := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨_,ar,br,hab,hx,hy⟩ := (tower_extension_iff M p s d x y).mp h.1
  have hrange : (infinityGradedIso cb p (s+d)).inv
      ((P.filtration B).toAssociatedGraded (s+d) p br) ∈
        Set.range ((E.functor.map g).eInftyMap (s+d,p.1+(s+d),p.2)).hom :=
    hf _
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hbc⟩ := (infinity_image_iff_lift M p (s+d) br).mp hrange
  have hcs := P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone A p (show s ≤ s+d by omega) hc
  have hcs1 := P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone A p (show s+1 ≤ s+d by omega) hc
  let a : BiHom p.1 p.2 A := ((P.filtration A).F s p).arrow ar
  have ha : a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule A s p := by
    have hh : a ∈ ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration A).F s p) := ⟨ar,rfl⟩
    simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hh
  obtain ⟨ar',har'⟩ := filtration_representative_exists P A p s (a-c)
    ((P.filtrationSubmodule A s p).sub_mem ha hcs)
  have hnew : (a-c) ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule B (s+d+1) p := by
    simpa only [a,Preadditive.sub_comp,hab] using hbc
  obtain ⟨br',hbr'⟩ := filtration_representative_exists P B p (s+d) ((a-c)≫g)
    (P.filtrationSubmodule_antitone B p (show s+d≤s+d+1 by omega) hnew)
  apply ((tower_essential_iff_no_zero M p s d x y h.1).mp h)
  apply (tower_extension_iff M p s d x 0).mpr
  refine ⟨by omega,ar',br',by rw [har',hbr'],?_,?_⟩
  · have hdiff : ((P.filtration A).F s p).arrow ar -
        ((P.filtration A).F s p).arrow ar' ∈
        ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration A).F (s+1) p) := by
      rw [har']
      simpa only [a,sub_sub_cancel,SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,
        OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hcs1
    exact ((element_grade_equal_iff (P.filtration A) s p ar ar').mpr hdiff).symm.trans hx
  · have hdiff : ((P.filtration B).F (s+d) p).arrow br' -
        ((P.filtration B).F (s+d) p).arrow
          (0 : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration B).F (s+d) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)) ∈
        ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((P.filtration B).F (s+d+1) p) := by
      rw [hbr',map_zero,sub_zero]
      simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hnew
    have hh := (element_grade_equal_iff (P.filtration B) (s+d) p br' 0).mpr hdiff
    simpa only [map_zero] using hh

private theorem initialProjection_eq_cycleLabel (X : ClassicalObject) (r : ℤ)
    (hr : 2 ≤ r) (p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    let E := D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)
    let P := E.ssData p
    let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2-E.r₀).toNat
    let m : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat
    Subobject.ofLE (P.Z m) (P.Z n)
      (P.Z_anti (by
        change (↑(2-E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ) ≤ ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat
        exact_mod_cast (show (2-E.r₀).toNat ≤ (r-E.r₀).toNat by omega))) ≫
      P.pageπ n = KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel D X m p := by
  dsimp only
  exact normalizeInitialProjection _ _ _ (by rw [D.classical.firstPage]; rfl)
    (by exact_mod_cast (show (2-(D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)).r₀).toNat ≤
      (r-(D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)).r₀).toNat by omega))
